missions.name: Finer Points of Negotiation
missions.summary: Louden MacEwen will teach you some tricks about being a tradesmen that will be very beneficial to him, you just need to be able to pay his fee.

nodes.text: /bow Hi there @name, I'll be needin' some cold, hard credits. I've got mouths to feed ya know!

branches.text: Money is always tight, can we haggle on the price?
Well, they won't be my credits, see ya later.

nodes.text: /point Without a profit you'll never move up at Infiniticorp!

branches.text: Well, I guess I'll buy something.. maybe.

nodes.text: So you think you're a trader huh? /rude *snort* Huh, well you buy as many Nanobots from me and maybe some other goods too. Then you'll sell them at Earth Station. There in the Bazaar you can see Sondra Benen and sell them for a profit. As a Trader you will always make a good profit compared to other classes. Whatever you do, get 1000 Credits, you'll need them if you wanna move up in the world. Ready for this? /point
That's what I like to hear, now get out there, make five thousand credits and get your crusty barge of a ship back to me to to pay up and I might be willing to give you new information.
Wanna look around? I actually think I might've sold all my stock, so nevermind. You might try sometime later. /bow

stages.description: You need 5,000 credits to pay to Louden MacEwen to get more information.

nodes.text: /salute Congratulations, you've done it. /bow I'm proud of you learning so quickly. Negotiation, the most important trait for any trader and you learned it rapidly. You show great promise for InfinitiCorp.

branches.text: So, have you got anything for me other than that?

nodes.text: /laugh1 My, you're a quick study I see. Well yes, I've got a thousand credits for you. Make good use of it and you could double or even triple your money. DeWinter expects her tribute so you better get out and earn if you ever want to become a Merchant Prince.

missions.name: Reactor Leak
missions.summary: Find Navs: Volatile Ship and the Waste Disposal Station in Loki sector.

nodes.text: /point Hello @name, you are back. Are you here to help, or just looking around?

branches.text: I'm just looking around a bit.
I heard you need my help. What's up?

nodes.text: /no Good, good, get to buying low and selling high, you'll be a Merchant Prince in no time if you're good. And take it from someone who knows, being a Merchant Prince of InfinitiCorp is a profitable proposition. /happy1

/bow Let me check the logs....one monent please.....ah...ah..oh, yes! I have here a problem with my data. Here in the High Earth sector we're observing an old ship that seems to be leaking. I need new data on this thing, my reports are over 2 weeks old now, and old information isn't worth a dime. If there's anything I hate, it's when something is worthless!
It's a bit risky.. you might run into some trouble, for it to be leaking the hull is busted, that means someone hit it, and they probably hit it pretty hard. /rude

branches.text: That won't be a problem, I can hold my own..
You mean I have to risk my ship for this? What kinda scam are you runnin' round here?

nodes.text: /point You'll do it? Good on ya, I might be able to find something to give ya for yer troubles stranger. But do me a favor and be careful out there, ya? Good luck to yer trader!

stages.description: You need to visit some navs: First the Waste Disposal Station here in High Earth sector.
Find the Volatile Ship, after this you should return to Louden MacEwen

nodes.text: /salute Thanks for the data.... /bow Great job, I've got yer pay. Here, you've earned it.

stages.description: Return to Louden, quickly now!

nodes.text: /salute Thanks for the data.... /bow Great job, I've got yer pay. Here, you've earned it.

missions.name: Supply Run
missions.summary: Buy the components for a stack of Defender Missiles and sell the components to Eagan Monroe in Loki Station's Bazaar.

nodes.text: /bow Oh, @name, would you happen to need some more credits?

branches.text: Hmm...yes, but something easier would be nice.

nodes.text: /point ......easier huh....let me think a moment.... I have it! Eagan Monroe in the Bazaar inside this station has an order for test missiles. But they can't leave their booth to buy the components they need. What about you bring him a sample?

branches.text: Must be frustrating...just bring him the components?
You haven't got anything easier than that? What good are you?

nodes.text: /shoot Yes. Uhm...no..just a little thing to do before. You need to buy the components and then you can deliver them.

branches.text: Ok, no problem. What components do I need?

nodes.text: /bow Checking... You'll need: Proton Basic Missile Frame, Turbo2 HardShot Warhead, Vortex Hydrogen. Once you've got them, bring 'em back and let me see. If they are of good enough quality I'll tell you where to go from there.
No, I'm afraid not. See you later if you're interested.

stages.description: Buy the Components: Proton Basic Missile Frame, Turbo2 HardShot Warhead, Vortex Hydrogen Burst. Return to Louden MacEwen and show him the components.

nodes.text: /point I see that you have gathered the components, that's great! Now take the compnents to Eagan Monroe in the Bazaar here on Loki station. Be careful dealing with him, he will want the parts fer free! So remind him yer ar' a trader and not some kinda saint. /salute

stages.description: Bring the components to Eagan Monroe in the Bazaar.

nodes.text: Ah, hello @profession, you've brought me my components, have you?

branches.text: Yes, are they enough for you? I might be able to bring you some more, for a price!

nodes.text: No, thanks, those will be enough. Will you just put them back here? I could perhaps use them sometime.

branches.text: Wait just a minute there, guy. I will sell you these, I never said I'd give them to ya for free!

nodes.text: /panic Ok... ok... it was worth a try, haha. I forgot, that im speaking with a @profession. I will give you 1000 credits for them so please, have the worker bots unload them at the freight bay. Thanks for your help. Have a profitable day! /bow

stages.description: Go back and talk to Louden MacEwen in the main lobby area of this station.

nodes.text: /point Well done, well done. Visit me again sometime, I'm sure to find a way to fatten up your pocketbook. For now, I've uploaded some data for you to read over on your ship's computer that will teach you how to build some weapons for fun and profit. First you need to dismantle new items, analyze them, and build them from base components. Then you sell them and voila you make profit.

missions.name: A Time to Kill
missions.summary: You'll be needin' a new Missile Launcher and a stack of ammo for them, bring them back get them inspected and complete the task assigned by Louden MacEwan.

nodes.text: /bow Hello there, young @profession. I suppose you're here for your first promotion. Well, I can't say as you're worthy of that just yet. /rude

branches.text: I'm ambitious enough for the likes of you, what have ya got for me?

nodes.text: I'll be needin' yer to go over to Earth Station and acquire a new Orb Weaver Missile Launcher and some ammo for it. Once you've got that, you'll want to come back and visit me.
/point Ok, go now, time is money my friend. Get back in one piece, but whatever you do, do it fast! /bow

stages.description: Go get yourself a ML-X4 "Orb Weaver" Mk. II Launcher, and a stack of ammo for it from Earth Station, then return to Louden MacEwan

nodes.text: /shoot Oh good, you've got the weapons. Now, I need you to go find something to kill. /happy1 I received word that the InfinitiCorp Shipyard in New Edinburgh had a problem last week with some Chavez that were disrupting traders who came to visit for upgrades. Why don't you go get rid o' the problem? That too much to ask of you?
/shoot Remember, you need to come back in one piece to get a reward, so don't get too brave! It might be dangerous, but the new missile launcher you have should make it a little easier on you.

stages.description: Kill 2 1st Circle Chavez Mechanics near InfinitiCorp Shipyard in New Edinburgh sector, Tau Ceti system. Bring back anything you find on them.
Return and talk to Louden MacEwan on Loki Station in High Earth sector.

nodes.text: /point Good job, @profession. I like good work, and since you did a good job I'll pay well. /shoot

missions.name: Prospecting Iron Ore
missions.summary: In this mission you will learn how to prospect ore.

nodes.text: Greetings. I am the Sha'ha'dem instructor Shin-Tzu Li. With me you will learn how to prospect ore.

Here's how you will proceed. Target an asteroid and approach it, stop moving when the pickaxe button above the target display goes bright then press it to access the asteroid contents. To mine an ore click on the ore you want. Your beam will then mine the amount that your reactor and prospect skill will allow. That stack will be tractored to your cargo bay.
What I need you to do is undock from the station, fly to Refuse Area, mine two iron ore, and return to the station. Good luck, and be careful.

Ore is important to our economy. Almost all of our equipment is made out of ores, so they are valuable to players and vendors alike. Vendors will buy ores in bulk so they can continue manufacturing their goods. You can also sell it to players so they can manufacture components that make ammo and equipment you and others can use. Others see mining as a good method to get exploration experience.

stages.description: Go to the Refuse Area (Io, Sol System).
Find a prospectable asteroid and prospect some Iron Ore.
Prospect another unit of Iron Ore from a prospectable asteroid.
Return to Shin-Tzu Li in the lounge of the Nishino Research Facility.

nodes.text: There you are. You have returned with the iron ore? Excellent. We detected a strange energy signature from your cargo bay when you docked. It seems you managed to pick up something extra when you prospected that asteroid.

branches.text: That's odd, there was some kind of object in my cargo?

nodes.text:
Yes, that is strange. It seems to be a old piece of a rock that bears carvings on it. It appears chipped but could still yield us valuable information.
I would like to examine this further but I do not currently have the means. There is someone who could help identify this however. 
After you have completed your training here, I would like you to take this artifact to my friend Ayako Ravenlock on Paren Station in Kailaasa, Capella. 
Oh and please, when you arrive at the station could you please remind her that she is still my night rose? We may be far from each other but tell her that she is always on my mind!

Excellent! In the meantime I'll keep the object with me. Continue your training and then after it is complete, talk to me and we can deal with this strange find of yours.
For now, go to Sai Siddhun across the room. She will instruct you further.

missions.name: Nishin Teaches the Scan Skill
missions.summary: Buy training from Nishin Si'mir to learn Scan.

nodes.text: What can I do for you?

branches.text: I heard you can teach the Scan skill.

nodes.text: So you have come looking for the secret to exploring the stars. Is that all?

This is not so simple as a few lessons and off you go. You must first understand that your eyes must not only see but percieve the mysteries of the universe. This lesson is not so easily learned, and I cannot teach you this. When you have percieved that all is not as simple as you would have them, return to me again.
Goodbye for now. /wave

Ahhh, hesitation means doubt and doubt will allow you to question what you see. This is an important lesson in learning to see the mysteries of the universe. When you are prepared, I will teach you the secrets of Scanning. 
I will also ask a fee of 2500 credits for my time, do you accept?

branches.text: I don't have the credits at the moment.

nodes.text: Speak with me again, when you are ready.
Then return to me when you do. /shrug

stages.description: Talk to Nishin Si'imr to learn the Scan skill.

nodes.text: There it is, the secret to increasing your scanning range. Not just manipulating technology and pushing buttons is it?
Yes.... well off you go. I have some work to do. And remember, keep your eyes open.

missions.name: Path of Dark and Brightness
missions.summary: Follow these steps along the path of the Shinwa.

nodes.text:
Welcome J'nai @name, it is good to see another trainee wishing to make a mark on history. I am Ten'Shao Anala and I am your instructor. I will lead you on the path of Shinwa to better prepare you for what you must face in the universe. 
First, you must first answer a few questions before you embark on this journey.

branches.text: I am not yet prepared. I will return later.

nodes.text: When the attack on Jove City came, there was a Shinwa warrior who fought bravely but fell to his enemy. He was known to be a great warrior. Why did he falter?

branches.text: He did not know his enemy.

nodes.text:
A warrior will often find a situation where he combats a new foe and must adapt to learn the foe's tactics. This was not the case, as before he had met the Progen menace and triumphed. 
It was a lack of knowing his own self that he fell. While he watched the city tortured and reaved he felt shame and pity. He fell because he did not put his feelings aside to accomplish his task.

Indeed. His hesitation came of a lack of understanding his own feelings that were conflicted as he witnessed the reaving of the city. His shame and pity caused him to fall as he forgot to put aside his feelings to complete his task.

branches.text: I see the truth of it.

nodes.text:
Cowardice stems from an unwillingness to put ones self in harms way. Obviously this was not the case. 
His hesitation came of a lack of understanding his own feelings that were conflicted as he witnessed the reaving of the city. His shame and pity caused him to fall as he forgot to put aside his feelings to complete his task.
Now you must face truth. The Shinwa were born from fire and thus are the stuff of fire. Here in Europa we teach the Shinwa the ways of battle. What then, is Europa?

branches.text: There is both light and darkness here.
It is a place of death and destruction.
This is a place of hope.

nodes.text: Correct. While we strive to bring honor and duty to our bretheren the tasks we take to ensure the safety of our people should not also be forgotten. We must both embrace and lament our path. You have done well.
It is that, but there is also hope. For as we destroy, it is to bring a better and safer life to our people. Thus we must walk a path of both light and darkness for the light to shine on the rest.
It is that, but it is also a breeding ground of death and destruction.

From this you must learn that to succeed in our mission, you must always know yourself for doubt and dispair will surely bring your downfall through hesitation. Be ever mindful of your feelings and keep them in check until your task is complete for it is our task to bring darkness so that in the aftermath, light can shine through. And then, only in hindsight can we lament.
Now, it is time for you to begin your journey. Go to the Sun at Noon and speak with U'nai Amitola. /bow
Very well, do not leave your training too long for we have pressing need of capable warriors.

stages.description: Speak with U'nai Amitola and complete The Sun at Noon. This stage will teach you how to Summon.
Speak with U'nai Wakisa and complete The Trial of the Horde.
Speak with U'nai Magena and complete The Lotus Opens. Here you will learn to Fold Space.
Speak with U'nai Cyrus and complete Trial by Fire.
Speak with U'nai Yavin after reaching level 7 to learn Critical Targeting. Then complete The Presence Overwhelms.
Speak with Dai'Shao Ohanzee at the Final Step of the Shinwa to upgrade your hull. You must be level 10 to receive this mission.

nodes.text: I see you are ready for your first ship upgrade. Here at the shipyard we have set up an automated process, so hang on tight and we will fix you up. When complete, you should return to the Ashanti Maru and speak again with Ten'Shao Anala.

stages.description: Return to the Ashanti Maru and speak with Ten'Shao Anala to complete your training.

nodes.text:
J'nai @name. You have performed your tasks admirably and completed all your trials. Like all Shinwa before you, you are now ready to go and serve the Jenquai. Remember the skills you have learned here.

We Jenquai are few in number. Remember the Sun at Noon and use Summon to overcome superior numbers.


When the enemy is too strong or a weapon too powerful to withstand, remember the Lotus. Use Fold Space to escape your enemies when flight is the only path to choose.

Know yourself. Know your enemy. Strike where the armor is weakest. Remember the Presence Overwhelms and use Critical Targeting to strike a mightier blow upon the enemy.
At the moment there are two paths you can take: The path to Jupiter and the path to Sirius.  In these places you will find monsters, stations, and ships of every kind.

The path to Jupiter will lead you straight into the Sol System, a system of great historical background. If you travel to the Sol System you are bound to run into Jenquai sections as well as Terran and Progen sections. In Jupiter you will also learn important weapon skills which will allow you to utilize different weapons at your need.

Sirius is a rugged system made up of two sectors. In it you will find the main headquarters of the Shinwa, Swooping Eagle Planet. There you will learn the majority of your skills. Sirius is still relatively newly discovered and mysterious, perfect for an adventure.

Remember, @name, always to strike a balance between the Passive and the Active, the Dark and the Bright. This is a path you must travel throughout your life. Do not forget that the journey is as important as the destination.



Go now, and write a story of your own making, D'nai @name. You are ready.

You have passed your trials, J'nai. You are the Sun at Noon.





You are the Lotus that Opens.





You are the Presence that Overwhelms.





Having completed the Path of Dark and Brightness, you have moved beyond J'nai. Now, you are truly Shinwa, and have become D'nai.




With your new ship you will have greater ability to travel far and seek out skills that can improve your effectiveness as a warrior.




I have also assigned you to report to our leader, Du'Shao Silva, in Swooping Eagle. Whatever else you decide to do, Silva always welcomes the assistance of every willing Shinwa.



Go now, and write a story of your own making, D'nai @name. You are ready.

branches.text: What paths are open for me?

missions.name: The Lotus Opens
missions.summary: Speak with U'nai Magena and learn how to fold space.

nodes.text: Hello J'nai. You are eager for training no doubt, but calm yourself. Be as the lotus, beautiful in color, strong as parchment, and most importantly tranquil. The lotus is a perfect combination of these three traits. The Jenquai Defender too has traits that guide it; tact, power, and evasion. First we must begin your training in tact. Are you ready?

To be tactful, you must know what must be done at all times and have the resourcefulness to carry out the duty. An example: you could go outside of this station and fight monsters until your lasers turn obsolete, but you would hardly get stronger. You need to be diverse in attack and defence to get the best of your opponent. Not unlike the Lotus.
You will now learn the art of defence. How to evade your enemies so you may return to seek victory once more. Travel to the start and move towords Lotus. When you get close use the skill I have taught to evade, then return to me.
Come back again when you are ready.

stages.description: Head to the Start nav.
Travel to the Lotus nav.
Target the Lotus nav and use Fold Space skill on it.
Return to U'nai Magena.

nodes.text:
You escaped the sting of the Lotus I see. As the lotus you must bend and give thus allowing you to return strong and resilient. 
Good. Excellent! You are ready for your next trial. Seek out The Fiery Aspect and attend U'nai Cyrus to further your training.
May your training bear fruit.

missions.name: Terran Promotion Notification 2
missions.summary:
Terran Trader/Terran Enforcer, second promotion mission. 10,000 credits required.
Reward: Hull 2 Upgrade, 2000 Exploration XP

nodes.text: Oh, hello thar, it's you again @name, please, could yer do me a favor. I'm buildin' a new weapon. Th' blueprint was given to me by one of our expert traders he bought it, fer a steal of course, from an explorer. I need some parts, but i can't go away at the moment. Wouldja mind grabbing some stuff fer me? /point

branches.text: Sorry, I have no time, maybe later I can take care of that.

nodes.text: Hmm, ok then. Maybe you'll come back,  and maybe you won't. If you have time to spare, let me know. I could really use the parts. /bow

/bow Thankee, I 'preciate it. I've been needin me five O2 Canisters. As I have heard, they are available in only a few stations. Earth Station, I believe is one of these stations. Have a look, buy me five Canisters if'n ya can find 'em and come back to me. Be careful, the galaxy be a dangerous place righ' now

stages.description: Exec. MacKellan wants you to buy about 5 O2 canisters for her new weapon design. Have a look around in the Earth Station Bazaar. Bring them back to her.

nodes.text: /bow Thanks, I be happy to see yeh've got me parts. Now I'll needja ter bring this item, n give it to Reclaimer Nayol Wat in Arx Magister. He knows so much about upgrading weapons, he will surely be able to improve it. I'm a corporate exec, so ye be doin' well by me, and ye be just plain doin well, catch my drift?

branches.text: Sorry, time's up. I have to go for my own business now.

nodes.text: Gah..I could've used better news, go away and leave me alone. Bring yer arse back if yer think you kin do what be asked of ye, greater things are at stake here!

/bow Good ter hear, remember: get there as fast as you can, we don't know if someone other than us is working on this new prototype. We need ter be the first ter get it on th' markets. Also, t'would be catastrophic if it fell inter the wrong hands.

stages.description: Visit Reclaimer Nayol Wat in Arx Magister, Mars Sector.

nodes.text: Hallo @race, what could I possibly do for a Terran in a Progen station? Not every day that you see Terrans visiting Progens. They usually won't come back a second time. Ok, back to business, I'm awaiting a Terran....could that be you, that would certainly brighten my day. Executive MacKellan sent you, eh? Well... why didn't you say so?

branches.text: Yes, I'm the one. Think you can take a look at this?

nodes.text: /bow Sure let me have a look...yes, yes, I've got it. Seems there's not too much room for improvement. Yet, it could be improved a bit if we are careful with the modifications. Wait a moment....ok......yes...done. Here it is! Best I could do on short notice. Tell Ol' MacKellan, that takes care of one of the favors I owe her. /laugh Now, get goin' I have other things to do.

stages.description: Bring back the improved Item to Executive MacKellan in Earth Station.

nodes.text: /bow Oh @name, yagottit? That's what I be needin'. Wots that ya say?...well it's a new prototype. I thankee very much. Now when yer ready, visit me in again to get your next promotion. I toldjer I pay well, unfortunately I still be havin' ter make yer part with yer credits. Company policy, ya know?

stages.description: Visit Executive Cailleach MacKellan (Earth Station, Earth) and pay the required 10,000 credit materials fee to get your Hull Upgrade.

nodes.text: /happy1 Welcome back, ae bin' lookin' ter see ya again, figured the promotion would draw yer interest. Yer are interested, aren't ye? Well, ye be promoted to yer next rank, and I've ordered yer hull ter be enhanced wif more cargo room, and who knows, perhaps yer might be havin' a new mount or two available. C'mon back and see me the next time you think you qualify for a promotion. Oh yeah, 10,000 credits. I'll be havin' that now. Thankee for yer business.

missions.name: EarthCorps Promotion Ceremony
missions.summary: Promotional Ceremony for all Terran Enforcers: Reward: Hull 1 Upgrade, Missile Weapon Skill, 1000 Combat XP, this starts the TE Upgrade chain.

nodes.text: /bow Hello @name, just the pilot I've been lookin' for. I see you're in need of some experience. If ya want, I might have some work for ya to do. It would be worth the time. Are you interested?

branches.text: No thanks, I need some more experience first.
Hmm, let me think about it.

nodes.text: Ok then. Come back when you feel you are ready for my mission. Good luck out there @name!

Thank you @name. If you show exceptional skill at completing your assignment, I may just deign to reward you with your first overhaul. And if you act now, as a bonus I'll retrofit your ship to use missiles! /point
I thought as much. Ok here we go, I need to complete a navigation point in my starcharts. The location is: Nav Luna Hub. Please come back once you've found the nav point.

stages.description: Find the Navigation Point: Nav Luna Hub. Then come back to Lt. Raine.

nodes.text: Oh you're already back, wow was that fast. /happy3 I like that, get the orders and go out to make it happen immediately. Please, do me a favor, in this sector there are too many Scuttle Nymphs. I have had reports of swarms seen last night around the Advanced Combat Training navs. Kill 5 of 'em for me.

/point But before you go, you should know that I've had your ship retrofitted with Missile Launcher mounts. You should arm yourself with some heavy duty launchers and ammunition, they will serve you well in the fight ahead. /happy1

branches.text: I've killed some of these before, they didn't drop these symbols that you mention.

nodes.text: If you don't find the Symbols, that's fine. Just make sure to kill at least 5 of the Scuttle Nymphs, that's the important part!

stages.description: Kill 5 Scuttle Nymphs and come back to Lieutenant Raine.

nodes.text: /bow Great job @name! I am impressed, and I assure you that's quite the complement coming from me. Anyway, /give here's your reward, I need to do a little follow-up report on your mission. Report to the Yeager Shipyard here in Luna Sector per the orders of Admiral Herrera.

stages.description: Visit the Yeager shipyard for your promotion and to have your ship retrofitted to the next hull level. You'll get your next upgrade from Exec. MacKellan at Earth Station.

nodes.text: Hello @name, Lieutenant Raine radioed ahead and said you were cleared for your first hull refit. On behalf of EarthCorps, I thank you for your services. Admiral Diego Herrera also sends congratulations, and said for us to tell you, "Congratulations Lieutenant."

Well, you are now. If Admiral Herrera says so, that's the way it is. In any case, your retrofit to the hull was completed. Come back to see us the next time EarthCorps high command determines that you're eligible for a promotion. Remember, when you are of adequate experience to obtain another upgrade and promotion, then you should go to Earth Station and visit Executive MacKellan.

stages.description: Report to Executive Mackellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching overall level 30.
Visit the Yeager shipyard for your promotion and to have your ship retrofitted to the next hull level. You'll get your next upgrade from Exec. MacKellan at Earth Station.

nodes.text: Hello again Lieutenant @name. I have received authorization to upgrade your ship from EarthCorps High Command, I believe the Admiral has taken over your file from here. He will be personally looking into you as time goes on. You should be very proud to have caught his eye. Anyway, congratulations Lieutenant Commander.

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 50 for another upgrade.
Visit the Yeager shipyard for your promotion and to have your ship retrofitted to the next hull level. You'll get your next upgrade from Exec. MacKellan at Earth Station.

nodes.text: Welcome Lieutenant commander, I've received a message from Admiral Hererra indicating that you are eligible for a hull re-fit. He has also taken your file and has begun to keep his eye on you more proactively. He sends the following: "Congratulations, Commander."
You're welcome *static* the hull upgrade will now begin. Please do not accelerate or enter warp for a few moments while your ship is rebuilt.

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 75 to begin your next rank up mission.
Visit the Yeager shipyard for your promotion and to have your ship retrofitted to the next hull level. You'll get your next upgrade from Exec. MacKellan at Earth Station.

nodes.text: :::*hissfzZZtZt* Hello there @name, this is Admiral Hererra. I wanted to personally congratulate you. You've achieved a captaincy within EarthCorps. That is no small feat. Given time you may even rise to the rank of Admiral and be one of my personal advisors. As such, you must learn how to use everything at your disposal for the good of the galaxy. Remember, have pride and protect Terran Interests out in this hostile galaxy. That is all for now, Captain. *zzt* END MSG, Adm. Hererra:::

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 100 to begin your next rank up mission.
Visit the Yeager shipyard for your promotion and to have your ship retrofitted to the next hull level. You'll get your next upgrade from Exec. MacKellan at Earth Station.

nodes.text: Welcome back again @name, it's becoming more and more often that I see you. You have ambition for sailing through the ranks. That's a rarity out here, a good quality that you should never lose. I've received authorization from Admiral Hererra that you are now promoted to Commodore. Congratulations Commodore @name.

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 135 to begin your next rank up mission.
Talk to the shipyard again to get your final orders, congratulations Admiral.

nodes.text:
***incoming Message Adm. Hererra, commander-in-chief EarthCorps Navy***
Hello, if you're seeing this, it's because you've been promoted to an Admiralcy in the EarthCorps Navy. We need you on the front lines. Get out there and protect Terran interests in the galaxy. Come visit me from time to time on EarthCorps High Command in the Zweihander sector.

Welcome to EarthCorps, our 200 years of pride as the strongest military in the galaxy. Despite what those clone-sick progen have to say about the matter.
Fight with Honor and Dedication! Serve Terran Interests in the galaxy and protect our trade, be it Infiniti or GetCo.
This is Admiral Herrera, OUT. *static* ***END OF TRANSMISSION***

missions.name: Bring Mordanite to Jenya Erelius
missions.summary: Find Mordanite and return it to Jenya Erelius in Porvenir Mons, Endirago Planet.

nodes.text: Test for stage zero. (Go find Mordanite for Jenya)

stages.description: Talk to Jenya Erelius in Porvenir Mons (Endriago Planet, Gallina System) after you have aquired a piece of Mordanite.

nodes.text: Have you... have you brought the Mordanite?

stages.description: Give the Mordanite to Jenya Erelius.

nodes.text: Mordanite... it is so beautiful... so cold... so... the face! I can see it! The violet eyes... I must concentrate... Yes... yes... I WAS Jenya-A Erelius. I was... I am a Versatile... I have been assigned... to escort IT... to a place of safety.
Memory of IT... has been burned from my mind...
Oh... I can hardly...

Now... it is sleep cycle, and the ship moves... we are assigned to watch IT... Nausicaa... my friend and gene-sister... and I...
Commotion! Outside...
I am mad with fury, vengeful! I leap at her, to rip her, tear her... but she is a warrior, and too swift...
...and we... we will know chaos... such as she knows...
That is it... that is all there is. I do not... I do not remember her killing me, but I know it was done.

branches.text: What do you mean by IT?

nodes.text:
Whatever it was... it was burned from my memories... somehow. For good reason, I am sure. The Magisters Magna were wise, as always. I do not want these memories.
Please... take your Mordanite, and go.

missions.name: Hunting Haywire
missions.summary: Sai Siddhun sends you to hunt the vicious haywire for your combat training. It is advised you be careful.

nodes.text: Hello @name, it is time to learn how to defend yourself.
/agree Absolutely! Not only is it your task to explore and mine but you must also be able to survive should you be attacked while performing those tasks.

Yes, eventually you will learn that but it will not make you invulnerable to attack nor will it help you harvest the more difficult resources that are often guarded. No, you must learn combat to properly be Sha'ha'dem.

At the decommissioned transport there are a number of drones that were programmed to salvage the wreck. A few of them have gone a bit, well...  Haywire. It would be convenient should you remove one or two so the rest can continue thier work.

stages.description: Go to the Decommissioned Transport in the Refuse Area (Io, Sol System).
Find and destroy Haywire near the Decommissioned Transport (Io, Sol System).
Return to Sai Siddhun in the lounge of the Nishino Research Facility (Io, Sol System).

nodes.text: So, are there a few less Haywire drones now?
Traffic control will be happy to hear about that, they have been a nuisance lately. Here are some credits for your efforts.
Actually there was a reward for them, and it seemed best you deal with it as we needed to teach you about combat anyway.

At least I shared the reward with you. Besides, part of Sha'ha'dem training is to find the opportunities in a situation, and bend them to your advantage.
Now, I need you to review your training. When you are ready to proceed speak with me again,

missions.name: Jenquai Rank 4 Upgrade
missions.summary: Completing this mission will result in the Rank 4 Upgrade for Jenquai. Must be at least level 75.

nodes.text: Level 75, a great step for any Jenquai. I am guessing you are here for a hull upgrade.
I would love to give you the hull upgrade but first you must prove yourself worthy of it.
Lately I have heard of a "party".
Well I wasn't invited to this party.

No, it's not that. It's just I think something is going to happen at said party. It's a very exclusive party. I have a list of the invitees and it appears only one was invited for each major race. I fear something is up. The attendents have been told not to discuss the invitation with anyone who is not invited.

Well here's the thing, P1625 has been invited to this party as the psionic representative but he refuses to leave the station to go to it. Since P1625 hasn't left the station in years, not many people know him, so it might work out for you to impersonate him.

Something important to know, you must act like P1625. He is one of the psionics and can be quite pessimistic at times. Don't give yourself away.

I'll need you to talk to each invited member of this party and discover who the mastermind is.
Ok then.

stages.description: Jenquai Advancement Mission Step 1 - Talk to Wenton Ness on Friendship 7 (Glenn, Beta Hydri System)

nodes.text: /bow Ahh hello, who might you be?
Interesting. I've never met a psi before. Tell me about yourself!

branches.text: I enjoy romantic walks on the beach..-
I'm a brawler from the space of Slayton.
I'm a sneaky Shinwa who fought in the Gate War.
I spent 25 of the last 30 years of my life in a wretched mine.

nodes.text: You're no Psi, I have no business with you.
Where was the mine? What was it like?

branches.text: It was on Inverness Planet.. and they didn't feed us.
I was based in Aganju. I used to labor 20 hours a day.
I actually worked at a casino in Shakti. It was nice.

nodes.text: Inverness is a gas planet.. liar...
You don't sound like a Psi to me..
Who were your captors? What were they like?

branches.text: They were those nasty Sha'ha'dem. And how cruel they were.
Freespacers. Their names make it so ironic!
Earthcorps. They called 'em bruisers to be exact.

nodes.text: /chuckle Hah yeah right. I'm not going to waste my time with lying scum like you.
Small talk aside, what are you here for?

branches.text: So what's the deal with this party? Who's running it?

nodes.text: I really have no idea, but I bet Hugo Mecklan knows.

stages.description: Jenquai Advancement Mission Step 2 - Talk to Hugo Mecklan in Arx Tiberius (Tarsis, Vega System)

nodes.text: Welcome to Arx Tiberius. Who are you?
What do you want?
What do you want to know?
Appetizers are always a bonus, shrimp cocktails, light pastries, MacGregor's Lager...
Semi formal. Other than that what you wear is up to you. The party has a green theme so make sure to wear some green!
It's being hosted by Ze'ev Azifi. Talk to him for more detailed information.

stages.description: Jenquai Advancement Mission Step 3 - Talk to Ze'ev Azifi on Joves Fury (Jupiter, Sol System).

nodes.text: Greetings traveler, what can I do for you?
What?

branches.text: Your evil plot has come to an end!

nodes.text:
Ugh.. every year we have a party at this time but we don't invite the Councillor. She does anything she can to coax us into giving her an invitation. Last year she claimed to have an illness that could only be cured by going to the closest party.. This year she tells a Jenquai she will give him a hull upgrade if he infiltrates the party??

Well I feel bad for you and tell you what, I'll give you the upgrade if you go back to her and tell her wrong info.
Come back to me after you talk to her.

stages.description: Jenquai Advancement Mission Step 4 - Lie to Councillor Uje'da on Joves Fury (Jupiter, Sol System).

nodes.text: So what did you find out?

branches.text: The party had just ended, sorry.

nodes.text: WHAT?! THIS IS UNBELIEVABLE! The Jenquai race is doomed! DOOOMED!

stages.description: Jenquai Advancement Mission Step 5 - Return to Ze'ev Azifi on Joves Fury (Jupiter, Sol System).

nodes.text: What did she say?

branches.text: If I could describe it in one word it'd be "RAHH"

nodes.text: Oh well, it serves her right for always trying to get in our heads. Excellent job Jenquai!

missions.name: Terran Promotion Notification 3
missions.summary: Executive Cailleach MacKellan wants you to visit Captain Gerard Braun in EarthCorps High Command, (Zweihander Alpha Centauri) and Lady Isabel deWinter on Somerled Station (New Edinburg, Tau Ceti)

nodes.text: Hello @name, I hear yer efforts have been successful, I admit, you show some potential, but yer still not up ter task for anything I could really be wantin'. 'owever, since yeh've proved yerself useful 'll ave ye go n pay a visit ter Captain Gerard Braun in EarthCorps High Command 'n give 'im this symbol.

stages.description: Visit Captain Gerard Braun in EarthCorps High Command, Zweihander Sector.

nodes.text: /point Oh, you must be @race that's here for the Tour of Promotion. Executive Cailleach MacKellan contacted me in advance, she wasn't sure she could trust you completely. The Symbol you brought me isn't the only one. So i'll give you another, when combined they are the Terran Crest. Go now, give this combined Symbol to Lady Isabel deWinter in Somerled Station in New Edinburgh (Tau Ceti Sector)

stages.description: Find Lady Isabel deWinter in Somerled Station (New Edinburgh, Tau Ceti) Pay her 30000 Credits for your upgrade. Be sure to have the 30,000 credit InfinitiCorp Processing Fee, she'll be happy to rip off what you do have, if you don't.

nodes.text: /angry *glare*

branches.text: Hi, I was told to visit ya and give this to you.

nodes.text: /point You? To me? Hmmm.....ok, so you've earned the Terran Crest, that says somethin' of ya, but frankly, I could care less. If you aren't making me money, then you don't exist, or at least you don't deserve to.

branches.text: *stammer* Promotion.. I'm here for a promotion.

nodes.text: ...let me see it.....ah, aah,  hmm...ok, I guess. Still, even with something like this I'm going to need at least 30,000 credits, so I'll be havin' those now. You've got your hull upgrade, now get the hell out of my sight unless you're making me more money.

missions.name: Tiberius Shipyards - open for business!  [Version 1.0.-]
missions.summary: Reminder.  All hull upgrades for Progen will now be done using the Tiberius Shipyards.  Please visit the Tiberius Shipyards now!

nodes.text: Please visit the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus Space.

@name.
Remember all hull upgrades are now being done from Tiberius Shipyards.

stages.description: Make yourself known by the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus.

nodes.text:
Yes, @profession, we are back in business.
All hull upgrades from now on will be done by ourselves.

Remember that.
Ioanna-J Deinon on Porvenir Mons, Endriago Planet (Gallina) requests the assistance of a valliant @profession - ie you, @name!
See you soon!

missions.name: Prove yourself worthy [Version 2.2.-] [CRED]
missions.summary: Prove yourself worthy to be considered for a level 50 hull upgrade.  Find Red Dragons in Asteroid Belt Gamma named Saam Lo Veteran Red Dragon and kill 3 of them.

nodes.text:
/point I need a progen...hey you! 
@name I bet you want to help me out with this task. In Asteroid Belt Gamma are some Red Dragons they need a lesson. Decrease them a bit....oh, and as you are in a flush killing these rats, if you kill me 3 of these bastards you'll prove yerself worthy.

@profession.

Hull upgrades are getting a bit pricy so we're limiting them to those who prove themselves worthy.  Killing the 3 Saam Lo Veteran Red Dragons will prove you worthwhile to invest in.

stages.description:
Kill 3 Saam Lo Veteran Red Dragons in Asteroid Belt Gamma near Comm Junction 1.
Then come back to Proconsul Dionysius Kerr, Arx Magister, Mars.
Return to Proconsul Kerr with result of killing the Red Dragons

nodes.text:
/Ok, well done young progen. I like progen which do their job as ordered. 

I know you may be low on cash, so if you do something for Lancearate Fortunatis in Arx Tiberious we'll provide something nice in return.  Or you can visit the Tiberius Shipyards and get the upgrade.  What do you want to do?

Please note if you choose to do the mission and fail, you will have to report back to me and kill more Red Dragons!

branches.text: I'll visit the Tiberius Shipyards for the Upgrade.
I'll report to the Warrior for the Mission.

nodes.text: Visit the Tiberius Shipyards with 30,000 credits for the Hull Upgrade.
Go and see Lancearate Fortunatis in Arx Tiberious for the Hull 3 upgrade mission.  If you have already had this upgrade, you will be unable to do this mission.

stages.description: Give 30,000 credits to the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus. If you have already done Lacearate Fortunatis's Mission you will be unable to get the same Hull Upgrade.

nodes.text: Here is what you have paid for.

missions.name: The Trial of the Horde
missions.summary: Practice the art of Summon by following U'nai Wakisa's instructions.

nodes.text: You have learned how to summon an enemy and bring him to you. Now you will learn to use this ability in combat. When faced with a horde the best strategy is to separate your opponent from that horde. You will now face such a trial, the Trial of the Horde.
To face this task you need a stronger attack. You have been given a new beam that will pack a stronger punch, please equip the Damaged Drone Defense Laser. Fight well J'nai.

stages.description: Summon a horde member to you and destroy it.

nodes.text: l

stages.description: Speak with U'nai Wakisa.

nodes.text:
Well done! Now you see the wisdom in separating your foes. This way you may deal with them one at a time. 
Now you must speak with U'nai Magena at the Lotus Opens for your next task.
Patience and discipline, J'nai.

missions.name: Strange Object
missions.summary: Find out what the strange object found in an asteroid is. Talk to Ayako Ravenlock on Paren station.

nodes.text:
Now that you have completed your training, initiate, I would like you to take the strange object you found to my close friend Ayako Ravenlock.

You don't have to do it immediately, but the artifact you found may be very useful to the Sha'ha'dem.
Be careful @name.

stages.description: Take the object to Ayako Ravenlock on Paren station in Kailassa, Capella.

nodes.text: Hello, did you see my notes by chance?

branches.text: No, but I did find an strange object.

nodes.text:
Oh? Let me have a look at this. Odd it seems to be rock encrusted, is there something beneath?...
Oh my! It seems to be made of a material I cannot identify. It also bears runes of some kind.
Where did you find this?
Io? Did you speak with Shin-Tzu by chance?

branches.text: Yes, he told me to come here. He says you are still his Night Rose.

nodes.text:
That sentimental sweet old fool. I realy should visit him one of these days. 
Well enough of that. I need you to leave this with me for a while. It needs to be studied before I can determine exactly, or perhaps vaguely what it is.
I hope you don't mind. Do not fear you will recieve the credit of its find and perhaps a bit more if my presumptions are correct.

Stay in touch. Once I determine the nature of this artifact there will be work to be done that may be of paramount importance. For now, I need you to explore Capella.
Off you go now, and be careful.

missions.name: Missile Weapon Training [Version 1.0.-]
missions.summary: A Progen needs to learn how to use multiple types of weaponary.

nodes.text: Yo, I'm Zieg, the Progen missile instructor.
Here you go.  Now I need you to go to the MissileTrial Nav point, over by Nav point Remus Way 1, and kill 5 Missile Drones.

stages.description: Destroy 5 Missile Drones at the Missle Trial Nav point.
Return to Zieg.

nodes.text: Have fun with your new skill?
No problem.

missions.name: PROGEN  100 Bonus [Version 0.0.S]
missions.summary: To be used as bonus when we can set requirements as mission owner creates item.  Level 100 bonus - requires build shield, build devices. prospect. refine.  Not coded: 0.0

stages.description: Talk to Vinda

nodes.text: CLASSIFIED
CLASSIFIED

missions.name: Jenquai Rank 3 Upgrade
missions.summary: Completing this mission will result in a hull upgrade for Jenquai. Available only at level 50.

nodes.text: The time has come. You have had quite a journey getting to level 50 I am sure. It is time for you to advance.
You must go on a pilgrimage to each of the Jenquai memorials. Meditate at each and return to me.

branches.text: I will do what you ask of me.

nodes.text: Good luck, young one.
Goodbye then.

stages.description: Jenquai Hull Upgrade Step 1 - Go to the Jenquai Group Shrine.
Jenquai Hull Upgrade Step 2 - Go to the Ngozi Maru Memorium.
Jenquai Hull Upgrade Step 3 - Go to Vasen'or Prospect Memorium.
Jenquai Hull Upgrade Step 4 - Go to The Mourning Circle.
Jenquai Hull Upgrade Step 5 -  Go to Sha'ryun's Tear.
Jenquai Hull Upgrade Step 6 - Go to the Ruins of Jove City.
Jenquai Hull Upgrade Step 7 - Return to Councillor Uje'da.

nodes.text: Welcome back. How was the pilgrimage?
Good to hear. Enjoy your hull upgrade.

missions.name: Pest Extermination
missions.summary: For your projectile training Sergeant Jones sends you to help Mister Fleer exterminate some pests.

nodes.text: Who are ya?
Wut ya want?
Wut?
Aww, so ya here 'ta lern how 'ta shoot huh..
Wut?

Okay, well mosta thuh other officers'd tell ya 'ta hunt bogeril but I got some cousins in thuh bogeys. So I'm gunna send ya 'ta Mister Fleer. I heard he got some problems with pests. Go visit 'im in Jagerstadt on thuh planet. Hopefully he'll give ya somethin' 'ta shoot.
Wut?

stages.description: Pest Extermination Step 1 - Talk to Mister Fleer in Jagerstadt City (Zweihander Planet, Alpha Centauri).

nodes.text: Who are you? What are you?! Where did you come from?!! I think you're the cause of all this. I think you're evil. EVIL!!....   You see them don't you?
The gulls! They're after me!
IT'S THE END OF THE WORLD!!

branches.text: Calm down, Fleer. What's going on?

nodes.text: THE GULLS!

branches.text: Don't worry, I'm here to help.

nodes.text: ..Y...You can help! Close the windows... Don't let them get me!!
No not that... that will not work... Oh... Take this projectile weapon and use it to pop the gulls! Don't forget to grab ammo for it from the vendor and equip it.
Yes.. and.. er... bring me back five gull wings to prove you did it. But please hurry.... before they take me!

stages.description: Pest Extermination Step 2 - Buy pellets from the vendor and kill gulls. Return to Fleer with 5 gull wings.

nodes.text: They have stopped for now.. well done. But they will be back.

branches.text: So you will be fine for now?

nodes.text: For now. But keep popping those gulls, no mercy!

missions.name: WANTED: Milk and Cookies
missions.summary: Help Gunter Elfman retrieve the Milk and Cookies he made as a treat for Old Nick.

nodes.text: /bow Merry X-mas to ya!
So what did YOU ask Old Nick for?

branches.text: A Ten-Gu wearing a Santa Hat!

nodes.text: I hope you get what you asked for! I asked for a candy cane corporation and two younger brothers who run the corporation for me, but since someone has stolen my milk and cookies from under my x-mas tree, I doubt I will get what I asked for.

branches.text: Why would you need milk and cookies?

nodes.text: Don't you know? Santa only gives presents if you bring him milk and cookies! Lucky for you, I had enough milk and cookies for two. So what do you say? Will you help me? I think I have a lead.

branches.text: Old Nick will bring me coal this year!
Sure I will help you Gunther.

nodes.text: Oh well, I guess I will get coal this year too...
Awesome. My first lead is Nayol Wat. He was the one who was supposed to guard my milk and cookies.

stages.description: WANTED: Milk and Cookies Step 1 - Talk to Reclaimer Nayol Wat on Arx Magister (Mars, Sol System).

nodes.text: I am Reclaimer Nayol Wat. I am charged with the grisly task of reclaiming bodies of fallen pirates.

I admit I should have guarded the milk and cookies more carefully... but I was a bit busy. Reclaiming bodies is a full time job, and those Kraken Cows have been killing people like it's nobody's business. However I found sleigh bells and an Onorom Prison cell key in the room.

stages.description: WANTED: Milk and Cookies Step 2 - Investigate Detention Center Onorom (Asteroid Belt Gamma, Sol System).

nodes.text: YOU CAUGHT ME RED HANDED! I stole the milk and cookies! Please don't punish me!

branches.text: Wow, and I didn't even accuse you.

nodes.text: Before I give you the cookies I must tell you that after I stole the milk and cookies, they were stolen from me!

branches.text: Oh no! Not another dramatic twist!

nodes.text: Find the cookie thief! It was a mischievous nazari in this very sector. It has been stealing things from around the universe so you may still be able to recover the milk and cookies. You can find it in the group of hoarding nazari by Saturn Beta Junction in this sector.

stages.description: WANTED: Milk and Cookies Step 3 - Hunt the Hoarder Nazari at Saturn Beta Junction (Asteroid Belt Gamma, Sol System).
WANTED: Milk and Cookies Step 4 - Return to Gunter Elfman at Arx Magister (Mars, Sol System).

nodes.text: Magnificent work. Thank you for retrieving my milk and cookies!

branches.text: I'm just happy not to get coal!

nodes.text: As I promised, here is a glass of milk and a plate of cookies. Give them to Old Nick when he's around and he'll give you a present.  One more thing - Merry X-mas!!

missions.name: Waste Disposal
missions.summary: Nah Radioactives dont hurt, I promise.

nodes.text: /point Ah there you are @name. About time for you to show up. Ready for some work? There's a lot to do around here as you can see.

branches.text: Work? Do I look like one of your subordinates ?
Sure if there are credits involved.

nodes.text: /rude Then get out of my sight.
/salute Ahh thats the spirit... allways after credits eh ? /smile

Here is you first assignment. Fly some radioactive waste out to the Waste disposal Station.  Just follow Nav1 towards the gate to Altair III until you reach your destination.  

Oh, they may be busy.  Let them know you've arrived.

branches.text: Sure as long the payment is proper.
Radioactives ? For how stupid do you take me ?

nodes.text: /salute Fly safe and return to me upon completition.

stages.description: Find the Waste Disposal Station (Head towards Altair III gate in Mars Gamma).  They prefer it if you admire the view when you get there, click on something else before you try and speak to them.

nodes.text:
Greetings Pilot. This is an probihited area.
Unless you have business with us i got to ask you to leave at once.

branches.text: I got a cargo full of Radioactives i would like to get rid off.
Ehm sorry i got lost somehow

nodes.text:
Ok Pilot get close and we will pick up your cargo.
For the Republic.
I got to ask you to leave at once then.

stages.description: Visit Crones Christopher (Arx Busra / Mars Gamma) again to complete the mission.

nodes.text: Ah you're back. What took you so long ?

branches.text: I got the job done thats all that matters not ? Now pay me

nodes.text: Allright here's your payment.

missions.name: Equipped for the job [Version 1.0.P]
missions.summary: Time to gear up.

nodes.text: Care for another assignement?

branches.text: If you want to keep your toes the pay needs to be better.
No way. You fooled me once, you wont fool me again.

nodes.text: /rude Then begone.

Hmm .. That last one wasnt that bad or was it ?

Anyway...it is time you learn the value of craftmanship.  In order to this you will build your own items.  I can provide you with the knowledge but you have to advance your skill to the level of the equipment in order to build stuff.

Dont believe the commercials, true Progens only use Projectiles. 

Projectiles are great Weapons really, we can even change the type of damage
on the fly by choosing the proper Ammo. But this is also the backdraw.. we need Ammo.

branches.text: Why should it matter ? I could always just buy it
Sorry im running out of time.. see you

nodes.text:
Yes and No.

Trust me, crafting your own ammo has it's value.  /give Here take this implant, and find it out on your own.  You now have the ability to build Excecutioner Blade ammunition.  Buy the resources needed and rebuild them.  Come back if you have done so.

stages.description: Craft some Exectioners Blades then return to Crones Christopher.

nodes.text:
Excellent.  Have you noticed the Damage increase ? 

Crafted ammo is way superior to what you can get on the market you know,
Oh and heres some credits for your time.   Enjoy.

missions.name: Mining For a Cause
missions.summary: Collect harvestables for Liam O'Faolain to help him out.

nodes.text: Hello @name! Is there something specific I can help you with today? I'm a very busy person you know... dealing with all these chemicals...

branches.text: I was hoping to find some work!

nodes.text: I'm not sure there is anything you can help me with... you dont look much like a physicist.

branches.text: I'm sure I can put my skills to some good use.

nodes.text: In fact. just maybe there is. You see. I'm in need of some Plutonium Ore. Do you think you could gather me up 300 Plutonium?
Excellent... now off you go.

stages.description: Find 300 Plutonium Ore.
Return to Liam O'Faolain.

nodes.text: Ohh. you're back and just in time! Do you have the Plutonium?

branches.text: I have it here for you.

nodes.text: Excellent. now let's see we add just a drop of the mandang concoction to the Plutonium. Stand back for a second. And. What! It didn't work. Darn it! Ohh. I forgot. I have to have some Zalmoxium Ore as well. Could you run out and grab some for me? I only need 20 of these.
Excellent!

stages.description: Collect 20 Zalmoxium Ore.
Return to Liam O'Faolain.

nodes.text: Now were talking. let me see the Zalmoxium Ore.

branches.text: Here you go. this better be worth it.

nodes.text: Patience my friend. patients. Now let's add just one of those and bang bang bang. Excellent! You see what we have here?

branches.text: It looks like eggs and bacon!

nodes.text: Exactly! Eggs and Bacon! We have found the food of the future! Here taste it!
Ok. I will feed it to some Osterae first to see the effects.

branches.text: Sounds better than me testing it.

nodes.text: Well, I don't have much to offer for your help. I do have this device that helps increase your mining skill. Does that sound good to you?
Ok here you go. and you notice something a little extra as well.

missions.name: Special Ingredients
missions.summary: Some hard work for Liam O'Faolain for a treat. Collect some special ingredients to help.

nodes.text: Welcome @name. It's not normal to see your kind around here. Is there something I can help you with? I'm a very busy person you know!

branches.text: I was hoping you had some work for me to do!

nodes.text: What is there that you could possibly help me with? You don't look like a physicist.

branches.text: Well I can kill anything that you would like.

nodes.text: Ohh. I'm glad you just said that! In fact there is something you could help me with!
There are some Osterae in Varen's Girdle that I really need 10 Ostarae Fronds from. Do you think you could gather them up for me?
Hurry back now.... this just cant wait!

stages.description: Kill 5 Ostarae Vega.
Speak to Liam O'Faolain.

nodes.text: Do you have the Ostarae Fronds?

Excellent. Now we take the Fundli and add it to the Ostarae Fronds and. and. Wait a minute.. I forgot the Sponge Chloride form the Level 15 Manes that are flying around the area. Could you get me 20 of the Sponge Chloride's?

branches.text: I will be back as quickly as I can.

nodes.text: Hurry back... were almost done! Ohh.. you can find them northwest of Observer Relay 4 in Fenris!

stages.description: Need Sponge Chloride quickly! Kill 3 Garish Manes to abtain a Chloride.
Return to Liam O'Faolain.

nodes.text: Yes. that's what we need. ohh. Just in time @name. Do you have the Chloride for me?
Ok. we take the Sponge Chloride and mix it with our Fundli and Ostarae Fronds. and bang. bang. bang. Here we go! Do you see what we have done?

branches.text: It looks like a steak and potato to me!

nodes.text: Exactly! Steak and Potatoes! The warrior food of the future! Would you like to taste it?

branches.text: I think I will pass. Not sure how you got that from those ingredients!

nodes.text: You're right. I should test this on helpless animals first!

ohh. I was just kidding. Isn't that @class humor? Anyways. I don't have much laying around here to reward you with except for maybe this device that helps you move a little fast during combat. I think that would be helpful to you!
Have a wonderful day @name! Tell your friends about my food!

missions.name: Finding the Goods
missions.summary: Liam O'Faolain needs some goods... Help him get them and be amazed.

nodes.text: Welcome @name. What Can I help you with? Please hurry. I have lots of work to do!

branches.text: I came in hopes of doing some work for you.

nodes.text: And exactly what is it that you think you can do for me? You don't look much like a physicist to me?

branches.text: I have Quick speed. I can transfer stuff from here to there for you!

nodes.text: Actually. That makes perfect sense. I need for you to do me a huge favor.  Go speak to Arinyl Nardia at Trader's Fort. You should get a chocolate flecks and then return to me. He is expecting you!
Don't let it melt!

stages.description: Report to Arinyl Nardia at Trader's Fort.

nodes.text: My ohh my. I know you don't I. Let me guess. Tzu.. No no that's not it. ummm. Feng. No no he's in the other room..

branches.text: I don't believe we have ever met before.

nodes.text: Why didn't you say that sooner.? It's not good for me to rattle my brain like that you know. So who are you and what can I do for you?

branches.text: My name is @name, Liam sent me for some type of supply.

nodes.text: Ohhh. How is my good friend Liam? Last time I saw him he was weighing nearly 400lbs. But anyways, yes, he told me to be expecting you. Here is the stuff he requested. Just take this to him and tell him I said hi.
Fairwell @name!

stages.description: Report back to Liam O'Faolain.

nodes.text: There you are. what took you so long. Did you get the chocolate fleng I need?

branches.text: Here you go. and Arinyl said hi.

nodes.text: Arinyl. who is that?

branches.text: The person you sent me to for that stuff.

nodes.text: ohh.. You mean Arinyl.

ohh. anyways. Let's get to work here. We add the chocolate fleng to the pinglets and. and. and darnit! I forgot the other ingredients. Could you go get one more thing for me? I need some Glamour Goo from Arinyl Nairda.

branches.text: I just came from there. You should have had me pick it up then.

nodes.text: Hey. I'm in the middle of a experiment that will change the course of the future. I cant remember everything.

branches.text: Ok.. I will be right back.

nodes.text: Hurry now... the chocolate is melting...

stages.description: Report back to Arinyl Nardia.

nodes.text: You're back again. Let me guess that silly Liam forgot something again. He's always forgetting stuff.

branches.text: He certainly did. Can you help me out? He needs some Glamour Goo.

nodes.text: I will help you out. Here you go. Make sure you tell Arinyl hi for me again
Have a wonderful day @name!

stages.description: Report back to Liam O'Faolain.

nodes.text: Welcome back again @name, did you get the Glamour Goo for me?

branches.text: Yes. here you go. Arinyl said hi again as well.

nodes.text: Here we go with the Arinyl again. who is this person?

branches.text: The person you sent me to.

nodes.text: You make no sense to me sometimes. Ok. so lets add the Glamour goo to the pinglets and the smuckeroni... and bang. bang.. bang. There we go. what's that look like to you?
Exactly. isn't it wonderful! This will change the universe. Would you like to try it?

branches.text: There's no way I'm sticking that in my mouth!

nodes.text: Ok. can't say I blame you. it must be tested first. Moving on. I don't really have much to give you for all your help but I do have this device here that increases your warp speed. would that be something you could use?
Excellent, Here you go and thank you again.

missions.name: Test Mission
missions.summary: test mission to test tags

nodes.text: Thanks for the Cannisters! Have fun in EandB.

missions.name: First Chance with Tzu
missions.summary: Recover lost goods for Tzu.

nodes.text: What are you looking at.? You don't look like you should be around these parts!

branches.text: You right I should not be here

nodes.text: You want to get in my good graces do you? I'm telling you now! I don't like the way you look. Something tells me your going to be more trouble than its worth.

branches.text: I promise to follow all your directions Tzu!
I do not like the way you look either

nodes.text: Do you think that is what I want and need?  I tell you what. I have one thing that I need done. Are you up for it?

branches.text: I will do what needs to be done.
I do not  think I can give you what you need

nodes.text: So be it. Located in Vishao's Cove there are some Belter that have been taking explosives from some of my trainees. I need you to go get them back for me. I'm not certain how many are there, so bring me back at least 1!

branches.text: Explosives? I am out of here

nodes.text: Just go do the job! I will determine if you are worthy or not when you get back!
You never become a Red Dragon you scum

stages.description: Kill 2 Belter Driller in Vishao's Cove.
Return to Tzu at Orsinin Mining Platform.

nodes.text: So you have come back have you? Did you confiscate my explosives and bring them back to me?

branches.text: I have them right here for you!

nodes.text: Give them here! You fool. Don't drop them!
Be quiet now! Let me look them over so I can ensure you're not cheating me.

branches.text: I assure you they are all there. 45 of them.

nodes.text: I knew you couldn't be trusted! I told you a minimum of 50!

branches.text: ohh. That's what I meant! There are 50 there.

nodes.text: You better not be playing games with me. I will have you lynched in a second.
Ok. They seem to check out. For your hard work I'm going to give you a little taste of what it's like to be a Red Dragon. Take this. and don't come back around here, if you know what's good for you.

missions.name: Helping the Red Dragons
missions.summary: Help Shou Tzu recover his device.

nodes.text: I thought I told you not to come back around here again?

branches.text: I was in hope to do more work for you.

nodes.text: You seem to be doing much better now! You still need a little bit of a growl in your voice!
That's what I said can you not hear me? I said a snarl! Grrrrr.. Can you do that Grrrr.
That's more like it! If you want to be one of the meanest around you have to have a good growl!
Now that seems to be much better. Now that I have you starting to act at least a little more like a Red Dragon and not a Prissy Pants lets see if I have something you can do for me.
Here we go! I have one of my most secretive things going on here! I don't want my normal crew to do this one. So keep this one quiet!

I know it's not a problem! If it was you wouldn't be here now would you? Anyways. here's what I need for you to do. Go to this Harvey Krum guy in Chernevog Station. He has a device that belongs to me. Go get it back.

stages.description: Talk to Harvey Krum

nodes.text: Well hello there @name! I've never seen you around these parts. So what brings you here?

branches.text: Tzu sent me to get his device from you!

nodes.text: (Nervously) Tzu. I don't know who you're talking about.

branches.text: He told me to get the device from you no matter what!

nodes.text: Wait a minute fellow! I think maybe you have me mistaken for someone else.

branches.text: No! He specifically said your name.

nodes.text: Ok. ok. No need to get hostile here. Maybe we can work something out? I have this extra change sitting over here. You know you could just pick it up and walk away?

branches.text: That's it. Time to bust some kneecaps!

nodes.text: No not my knee's! I need those for walking! Wait. I give in. Here is the device. That Tzu sent one of his best this time didn't he.?

branches.text: Don't let me have to come see you again!

nodes.text: Me Too.

stages.description: Return to Tzu

nodes.text: Did you get my device back from that scoundrel Harvey Krum?
THAT'S NOT THE DEVICE! Where is my device?

branches.text: That is the one that Harvey Krum gave to me!

nodes.text: That low life! I will ensure he hangs for this one. Go back to him, let him know that if he does not give you the right device that I will have 100 henchmen haunting his every move!
You better be!

stages.description: Return to Harvey Krum

nodes.text: No No No!!! Why are you back. don't hurt me!

branches.text: Tzu said that was the wrong device!

nodes.text: But. I can't give him the right device because I don't have it. You see. I was on my way back from Varens Girlde when a Miner attacked me out of nowhere! Sometime during the battle it was jolted out of my ship and I think the Miner took it.

branches.text: You have got to be kidding me!

nodes.text: I assure you I am not! If you go get that device back from them and bring it to me, I can fix it up and you can take it back to Tzu. That way everything works out great for both of us!

branches.text: I will be back! Getting this device is not an option!

nodes.text: Hurry now. Kill the Miners, Once you find the one that has the scrutinizer it will automatically be loaded onto your ship, just bring it back to me as soon as you have it.

stages.description: Retrieve Scrutinizer from Lunatic Miners in Varens Girdle
Return to Harvey Krum

nodes.text: Did you get the research equipment? Please tell me you did!

branches.text: Here it is... Now you fix it quick so I can return it to Tzu!

nodes.text: Ok. Just one second.  Dum dee dum. dum dee dum.. Ok. Here you go, send Tzu my regards!

branches.text: What is this? You had one already that you could have given me?

nodes.text: Well. ummm. ummm. Yes, but you see.

branches.text: That's it. get ready for a beating!

nodes.text: WAIT! No.. You see those Miners had contacted me about getting some devices as well but after I delivered they never paid me, so I figured if you helped me out then I would give you the device to make you look good for Tzu!
Yes it was. and I apologize! But we both get the better end of the deal this way!

stages.description: Return to Tzu

nodes.text: What took you so long! Where is my device!

branches.text: I have it right here Tzu!

nodes.text: That's the device that I wanted! That Harvey Krum didn't give you a hassle did he?

branches.text: A little. but nothing I couldn't handle.

nodes.text: That's good to hear. Thank you for recovering this for me! You are turning out to be a very good sidekick!

missions.name: An offer you can't refuse
missions.summary: Privateer Negotiate Mission, speak to Mathis Alexander

nodes.text:
Hello @name. Negotiation is not just haggling the best price.
It can be an intimidating thing. There are many ways to get the job done.
Hey! I can't give all my secrets

branches.text: Teach me some of the tricks of the trade

nodes.text:
With Negotiation, words will only get you so far. 
Sometimes you got to put a lean in to them. /smash ..if you get my drift.

branches.text: Sorry i'm to busy right now

nodes.text:
Ok, good now on to business. Time is money you know.

Mario Iannon in Arx Magister is owing me a favor, and all I need you to do is take this letter to him. Get him to sign it and bring it back.
Make sure he signs it.
/point Now begone..

Well you could also make an extra credit, by taking some Drive Waste with you, and load some Construction Equipment on your trip back here.
If you got room in your cargohold, that is.
Come back when you have more common sense.

stages.description: Deliver the letter to Mario Iannon at Arx Magister

nodes.text: What. what do you want
/noway I can't sign this. Not now - not ever. Get lost or else.... !

branches.text: OK here is the deal, either I take this back soaked in your blood, or with your mark. You get me ?
Ok ok but you understand i had to try ..

nodes.text: Ok.man.. Here take it  /give
Now bugger off and forget you ever meet me.

stages.description: Bring the signed letter back to Mathis Alexander at Arx Bursa

nodes.text:
Welcome back @name. What do you have for me ? 
A signed letter or his denture ?

branches.text: After putting up some pressure, he was really cooperative.
Im sorry I have let you down.

nodes.text:
As I told you.. Sometimes words arent sufficent.
Thanks and here is your reward.
Thats very unfortunate. I really tough you had more common sense.

missions.name: The Cleaner [Version 1.2.P]
missions.summary: Clear the mobs interfering with the smooth running of Arx Bursa.

nodes.text:
Greetings @name.
As you may heard we got a small problem with the Critters out there. I'm authorized by the Collegia to reward you well if you volunteer to eliminate them.

What are Credits compared to the honour of having served the Collegia?
Go kill at least five of these Critters and i promise you won't be disappointed, Quaestor.

branches.text: To much honor for my taste mate

nodes.text:
Right on then.
Return to me as soon you're done.
Bah ! You will have to get back to me sooner or later...

stages.description: Clear out the Critters around Arx Bursa.
Return to Sub Commander Brook.

nodes.text:
/salute Welcome @name.
Glad to see your back and in one piece.

branches.text: Those werent a match for me.

nodes.text:
We do have demand for skilled pilots like you.
Here take this implant. It will teach you how to use Projectile weapons.
I can't allow my agents to use substandard weaponry, and if you dont mind i got another task.
Sad to see you go, but you will be back in no time im sure.

missions.name: The missing Transport 1/4  [Version 1.1.P]
missions.summary: Something smells...

nodes.text:
@name to be honest with you, we have a problem.

A Transporter containing a station radar array from Mars is long overdue. Without this array Arx Bursa is basically deaf and blind. Go and intercept the Transporter and make sure he arrives here intact.

branches.text: Yes Sir, i will have it back here in no time.
Dont you have anybody else to do this ... ?

nodes.text:
Great.
We lost contact as soon as the Freighter entered this System from Mars.
Bah! Be gone from my sight.

stages.description:
Check the area around the Mars gate.
Report back to Sub Commander Brook when you found something unusual
Report back to Sub Commander Brook that you have found a un-marked and un-known artificial gravity well, but no freighter.  [Coordinate X:  -19     Y:  +47 ]

nodes.text: So where is the Freighter ?

branches.text: No clue but i encountered a Gravity well
No clue and dont care.. pay me...

nodes.text:
A Gravity well in this sector ? These are alarming news. 
Who would be foolish enough to place a trap in the heart of Progen space.
Strange very strange..
Bah get lost

missions.name: The missing Transport 2/4  [Version 1.3.P]
missions.summary: Find the Transport ship.

nodes.text:
We need to investigate this further @name. 

Check out that gravity well and search the area around it.  Find the freighter and its cargo or bring me proof of its demise.
Be careful out there, that grav well is not a natural occurance.

Disappointing to hear that you're letting us down when we need you the most. 
Away with you...

stages.description: Find the Transporter and bring back proof of some form.
Return to Sub Commander Brook to inform him of the fate of the Transporter.

nodes.text: Destroyed ? I cant believe that...

branches.text: Believe it or not, i dont care...

nodes.text: This wont reflect well on me.
/point Away with you then..

missions.name: The missing Transport 3/4  [Version H.0.P]
missions.summary: Get a new radar Array at Arx Magister in Mars.

nodes.text:
You must depart at once.
/give Here, take these documents to Zieg at Arx Magister and grab 
a Radar Array.
We can only hope there is another Radar Array in stock.
/salute For the Collegia.
Most annoying...

stages.description: Talk to Zieg at Arx Magister.

nodes.text: Yes whats the matter ?

branches.text: I got urgent News from Arx Bursa.

nodes.text:
They lost the Freighter with the Array ?
Aargh Brook again right ? No wonder he never made it past sub commander.
Who right in mind would let such an important  transport fly unguarded ?

branches.text: Wasnt my decision, so do you have another Array or not ?
Hey get off my back ok..

nodes.text:
Aye ...well all we got is a backup Array but that will have to do it for Bursa then.
Not my fault if the Commander in charge is incompetent.

branches.text: Just load it into my cargo and im gone.
On a secon tough, i dont think i want to help Brook.

nodes.text:
You will find the Array in your Cargohold.
Fly safe /salute
Bah get out of my viewrange.

stages.description: Talk to Sub Commander Brook at Arx Bursa.

nodes.text: Ah glad you make it back alive. Do you have the Array ?

branches.text: Well take a look into my Cargohold
Nope im fed up with your incompetence

nodes.text: But what is that ? Only an backup Array ?

branches.text: Zieg had nothing else to offer for you
Bla bla know what im outa here

nodes.text:
Oh well, better then nothing i guess.
Our technicans should have it installled within the hour.
Anyway you did your Job well. /give Here your Reward as it's proper.
You will regret this.

missions.name: The missing Transport 4/4  [Version 1.1.P]
missions.summary: This is the level 10 promotion mission for the Progen Privateer.  Complete before you go and get  your Hull Upgrade.

nodes.text:
Welcome back @name . You've arrived on time. 
The Array is finally working, and we've discovered a Red Dragon Freighter in the System at the far side of the planet.

branches.text: Why should I care about Red Dragons?

nodes.text:
/nod Yes. Things never cease to amaze me.

Looks like the Red Dragons are loading their freighter with our Freighter's Cargo. Needless to say we got to stop this.

branches.text: I am ready, just give me the command
The cargo is lost anyway so why bother?

nodes.text:
Time will tell if you're ready or not.

The Freighter is not alone out there. We also detected signatures of combat fighters guarding this Vessel.

branches.text: They are no match for my guns

nodes.text:
I don't like to send Pilots into a death-trap so take this implant @name .

/give It will grant you the Shield recharge skill. A very useful skill I may add, you can recharge your friend's or even your own shields. This will help you a lot.  Talk to me again when you are ready to defeat your foes.
I thought you were smarter than that.

stages.description: Talk to Sub Commander Brook to go and kill the Red Dragons on the far side of the system, behind the planet.  Draw a line from the Mars Gate to the Wrecked Freghter and continue along that course.

nodes.text:
Now then @name the time has come to strike back.
/point Go and destroy the Red Dragon Freighter and it's Escort.

branches.text: Bah send Arx Plebem to do your bloody work

nodes.text: Oh and I would suggest you to take a wingman with you.
Your such a disapointment to the Collegia.

stages.description: Destroy the Red Dragon Freighter and It's Escort
Return and speak to Sub Commander Brook for your reward.  Then head off to Arx Magister for your first Hull Upgrade.

nodes.text:
/cheer That will be a lesson they wont forget so fast.
You did very well out there @name.
Here is a small reward of my own to you, for helping me out of this situation, im sure it will come in handy.
Also I got to inform you that you are beeing expected by Proconsul Dionius Kerr at Arx Magister. Depart at once, dont let the Proconsul wait.
I feel so much anger in this one...

missions.name: Engines for EarthCorps
missions.summary: Julie Bristol will teached you an advanced Terran art, the art of engine building. Go see her upon reaching level 45

nodes.text: /bow /wave Welcome again @name, I see you're here to learn about Engines right?
Engines I say.. /rude

branches.text: er, no, I um have an appointment... with Admiral Herrera

nodes.text: /crazy Sure ya do, kid. Anyway, since you're here for engines, I'll teach you some secrets on how to build engines. Go get prepared and come back to see me!

stages.description: Julie Bristol is going to teach you about Engines, but you had no idea she was going to spring this on you with no time to study! Get ready and talk to her again.

nodes.text: /rude Ah, you're back, took you long enough. Anyway we have a lot to cover. Engines are important /crazy if you know how to build 'em right, then you'll find that you can get exceptional levels of thrust and high warp speeds allowing you to maneuver better than any warrior out there!

branches.text: ... but I didn't get any orders about having to learn how engines work?

nodes.text: /laugh Oh, no orders you say? Well, that's too bad. I've been ordered to teach you, so you're gonna learn. Even if it hurts, catch my drift? *glare*

That's what I thought. Now, on to engines. *gets a starry look in her eyes* Engines are great you know? They let you go fast, and going fast is always good.
