Anyway, essentially, you're going to want to buy some engines, take them to your nearest Analysis terminal and dismantle it. You may need several before you can learn what all is needed.

Once you've learned how to build each engine, all you'll need to do is collect the necessary components either from another builder, looting, or even purchasing from some station based traders in a seedy bazaar somewhere.

branches.text: Hm, seedy bazaars huh? I don't think I like this.

nodes.text: So, got all that?

branches.text: What? No, I fell asleep, sorry.

nodes.text: /rude Of course, well I'll sum up. Analyze purchased or looted engines and analyze them to learn how to make them, then gather the components and take them to a manufacturing terminal. Then all you have to do is assemble them. Got it?
/clap I'll be damned, you can be taught! Now go build me a Kestrel L2, we'll see just how much you've learned!

stages.description: Julie is testing you. She's sent you to analyze and learn the Kestrel L2. This engine might even be quite useful to you if you haven't upgraded yet.
Take the completed engine back to for her inspection. Then you might consider learning the rest of the line, it could be useful to make some credits.

nodes.text: You've done it, very good. Well.. at least on the task, this is one of the shoddiest pieces of worksmanship I've ever seen. /rude
Ah well /happy1 I guess you've learned your lesson. That's the important part.

missions.name: Reclaimers
missions.summary: Discovering the Reclaimers for Arinyl Nairda for testing.

nodes.text: Hello again @name. It's been some time since I saw you last time. What is it that brings you around these parts?

branches.text: Looking for work, thought you would be able to help.

nodes.text: I have something that needs immediate attention that you might be able to help me with. That's if you're interested in a little bit of combat.

There are some Reclaimer's up near Dolars Bluff that have been preventing me from getting samples from the surface in order to run some tests and to get some materials that Laim O'Faolain needs. Could you head there and kill 10 of them for me, this would help me more than you can imagine.

branches.text: Consider me the one for the job.

nodes.text: Let me know when you have gotten rid of these pests.

stages.description: Kill 10 Reclaimers
Return to Arinyl Nairda

nodes.text: Outstanding. you are a quick worker and got rid of those reclaimers very fast! You don't know how much I appreciate it!
Here is something for all your help.

missions.name: Exploring Niefleheim Cloud's Einherjar Research Platform
missions.xml_name: Exploring Nifleheim Cloud's Einherjar Research Platform
missions.summary: Research needs to be done on the Einherjar Research Platform. Help Feng Yonghong to research it.

nodes.text: Hello @name! I'm glad that you have stopped by. I'm in desperate need of help from someone just like you!

branches.text: What is it that I can assist you with?

nodes.text: A location that was recently discovered called Niefleheim Cloud has a new anomaly that has struck the interest of just about everyone. It's called the Einherjar Research Platform. It's a very dangerous place from what I understand. But I'm in some desperate need of it to be analyzed.

branches.text: I feel up to the task.

nodes.text: Excellent my friend. I need for you to only get close enough to the Research Platform for you to examine it. Be careful though, as I said before it's a very dangerous place. Once you're done report back to me immediately. I have attached a special device to your ship to take some readings for me.

stages.description: Go to Research Platform.
Return to Fen Yonghong.

nodes.text: Were you able to examine the Research Platform?

branches.text: I was able to but like you said, it was a very dangerous place.

nodes.text: I knew it would be. I hope that you were not harmed. I have my technicians removing the device from your ship now. Once I have it I will review the data. In the meantime can you do me one more favor?

I have a personal friend of mine that has been in Freya working in the mining fields. He has come under attack by the Nagifars many times and he has grown very weary of it. Can you go eliminate The nasty Sult for me? By the time you return I will have been able to inspect the information on the device for information.

branches.text: Sult? I would be glad to rid the galaxy of a few of them.

nodes.text: I'm sure my friend will thank you very handsomely. They must be the mid level Nagifars though.

stages.description: Kill the level 46 Sult.
Return to Feng Yonghong.

nodes.text: @name! The information you recovered from the Einherjar Research Platform tells me very little I must re-analize it and maybe in the future have more trips taken there to inspect more. For all your help I would like to give you something special. And my friend that you helped with the Nagifars would also like to pay you 40000 credits for your help.

missions.name: Sturmer's Wacky Games: Round 1
missions.summary: Defeat Sturmer's game of exploration.

nodes.text: Sturmer's the name, Sturmer's the Game.  You willing to play the game?
Sturmer I said.  And it's my game.  Sturmers Game.  You want to play?

branches.text: If it pays good, I will play.

nodes.text: Ok.  But its no easy task. Sturmer's game is well worth it though.

Sturmer wants you to visit a few places.  Are you ready to write them down?  Here are they are.  Tokee in Aragoth Prime.  Akara's Tear in Fenris.  Listening Post Gladius in Freya.  Free Spacer Void Moot in Jotunhiem.  Jormund Mining Station in Muspelheim.  Visit those places and come back and see me.  You have 3 hours to complete this.
Sturmer's game.  Sturmer's rules.  I tell you what I'm gonna do.  I'll be a real nice guy and give you 4 hours.
I would get moving, though.  The time starts now!

stages.description: Visit Tokee.
Visit Akara's Tear
Visit Listening Post Gladius.
Visit FreeSpacer Void Moot.
Visit Jormund Mining Station.
Return to Sturmer

nodes.text: Did you do it?  You are something amazing!  I honestly didn't think it was possible, you see.  The game of Sturmer should not be beaten you see.  But you have and now I must reward you.  You have done something nobody else ever has.

branches.text: Well it certainly was not fun.  I ran into a lot of problems along the way.

nodes.text: Sturmer's game was not fun?  Sturmer's Game made you run.  If you want more come see me again, when you reach a higher level.

missions.name: Sturmer's Wacky Games: Round 2
missions.summary: Sturmer has another Challenge for anyone willing. Visit his locations and win a prize.

nodes.text: Sturmer again! I see you came for some more of the Sturmer Game?

branches.text: I want to play the Sturmer game!

nodes.text: Hey it's my job to make things rhyme. Ok. This time I will make it nice, visit these places in 4 hours. Ready to write? The Sinker in Odin's Rex. Gunnlod in Odin's Belt. Fields of Danger in Valkyrie Twins. Andaren's Tomb in Varen's Girdle. You got that?
Then you better go, cause time starts now!

stages.description: Visit The Sinker
Visit Gunnlod
Visit Fields of Danger
Visit Andaren's Tomb
Return to Sturmer.

nodes.text: @name. You have done it again. I don't know what to do. You have defeated me once again. You have proven you are up to the challenge.

missions.name: FreeSpacer Studies
missions.summary: Help Tarnish McHollis and learn of the FreeSpacers.

nodes.text: What can I do for ya mate? Things are very busy around here right now. Those Freespacers attacked another one of our ships!

The Freespacers are descendants form the First Colonial War. They say they used to be humans but they have been so isolated from humanity that who knows what they are now. Being isolated from people for so long and not talking they must have gone insane 20 times over.

branches.text: Does anyone know more about them?

nodes.text: Not much is known about them, really. I heard that there are one or two people out there that have gotten close enough to them to learn some of their secrets. For instance, they live in their ships, all the time, always.

branches.text: That would have to be miserable.

nodes.text: I could only imagine, it gets crowded enough in this station. Would you happen to have some extra time to help me out?

branches.text: What is it that you need done?

nodes.text: When the Freespacers attacked the local ship they took the shattered datacube from it before we found it. We know the datacube was shattered because shortly before the ship fell under attack the pilot radioed into us and told us he was replacing it.

What I need for you to do is kill the Free Spacer Captain and get the datacube back. Once you kill it the datacube will automatically be loaded into your system. We have information on there that they do not need to know. Will you do the mission?
Hurry Back @name, I'll look forward to the final results.
See ya then mate!

stages.description: Kill the Free Spacer Captain.
Return to Tarnish McHollis.

nodes.text: @name, were you able to get the datacube? Please tell me you did!

branches.text: I have it right here Tarnish.

nodes.text: Thank goodness. They don't need to have access to this information.

branches.text: What's in there that's so important?

nodes.text: I can't say for certain, I know that my life was threatened by those in charge of Infiniticorp over losing this to them though.

branches.text: WOW! That must be pretty important.

nodes.text: You may have possibly saved my life my friend. If you ever need anything let me know.

missions.name: Focus on the Battle
missions.summary: A Warrior needs to be able to fight their enemy without retreating.

nodes.text: Hail Centuriata. I am in need of your help.

branches.text: Hi.  My name is @name.  How can I help you?
I'm actualy on my way out.

nodes.text: Just recently we lost contact the capital ship Pax Regalia, by Leviticus.  They were ambushed by an unknown hostile force and we have not recieved any contact from them in the past hour.

branches.text: What do you need me to do?

nodes.text: I need you, @name, to proceed to Nav Promethicus 3, which was the last know location of the Pax Regalia. If the Pax Regalia was destroyed, annihilate any hostile forces as payback and then report back to me.
Before you depart, I want to teach you a skill called Combat Trance.

branches.text: New skill to help kill? I like it.

nodes.text: Instead of fleeing like our enemies (or those Terrans), the Progen Warrior can withstand and deal more punishment while remaining stationary.  The more you invest in this skill, the more benifical it will be for you.

branches.text: I will not flee, I will fight to the death!

nodes.text: That is the spirit of a true Centuriata Warrior!
Come back to me when your ready to help me.

stages.description: Proceed to Nav Promethicus 3
Engage the hostile forces (Shang Lo), and destroy at least 3 of them.
Return to Lancearate Fortunatis to report your findings.

nodes.text: Welcome back @name.

branches.text: I found the Pax Regalia.  It was destroyed.

nodes.text: Damn. Who was the hostile force that took out the Pax Regalia?

branches.text: The hostile force was the Red Dragon pirates.

nodes.text: I will send out a squadron or patrol craft to determine the strength of these Red Dragon pirates.

branches.text: Good to hear. Need me to do anything else?

nodes.text: Yes. Please talk to me again, when you are ready for your next assignment.

missions.name: Prospecting Copper Ore
missions.summary: Sai Siddhun wants you to review what you have learned and make sure you know it well. Proceed to mine copper ore.

nodes.text: Now that you understand prospecting and are able to defend yourself, the next task will be a bit more challenging.

I am glad to hear you are eager but caution serves the Sha'ha'dem best.
Head back to the decommissioned transport and harvest some copper ore from the field nearby. Five should do the trick although you are welcome to get as much as you like. It might serve you to know that it takes five ore to refine into one alloy.
Off you go! /wave

stages.description: Go to the Decommissioned Transport in the Refuse Area (Io, Sol System).
Find a prospectable asteroid and prospect some Copper Ore.
Return to Sai Siddhu in the lounge of the Nishino Research Facility (Io, Sol System).

nodes.text: Ok now that you have the ore, you can use the refining station to refine it into useable material. Once you have refined material you can then use it to make  the components necessary for making Devices, Weapons, Engines and Shields.

Yes, it does cost a fee to refine, but if you sell the refined material you will actually make a profit. That is a healthy way for a Sha'ha'dem to gather a decent savings to begin their career. 
Here are some extra credits to get you started.

You are welcome, but first thing is first. you need to learn the skills necessary to build various equipment. For now, I will now teach you to build devices. As you train this skill higher, you will be able to build more complex devices of the level that your skill equates. You will also have a better chance of building higher quality equipment.

As your training progresses, the more complex skills that are available to you will be taught by others. The individuals who train these skills are indicated in the description of each skill.
Now, our time together has come to an end, return to Kalas Ben Joseph and report your success. 
Good luck @name. /wave

missions.name: Practice Cloaking
missions.summary: After learning your first activatable skill, Cloak, Kalas Ben Joseph suggests you practice with it.

nodes.text:
What makes the Sha'ha'dem differ from other classes? Not only is it the skills that they learn but how they use those skills to perform.
You will now learn a skill that prevents enemies from detecting you, it is called Cloaking. It will render your ship almost invisible, but be aware this will drain your reactor's energy while in use so be careful that your energy does not run out.

branches.text: I am ready to learn this skill.

nodes.text: Good, to use a skill you must first drag it on your shortcut bar. Press the second icon in the bottom left corner of your screen and you will see cloak. Make sure you have at least one point in the skill. When you leave the station, drag the skill from the skills page to your shortcut bar. Please, proceed out to the nav point Pylon Alpha to experiment with it.

stages.description: Go to Pylon Alpha (Io, Sol System), and target the nav.
Make sure you have Pylon Alpha targetted and engage the Basic cloaking skill.
Remain in cloak and thrust to Pylon Beta (Io, Sol System).
Thrust back to Pylon Alpha.
Return to Kalas ben Joseph in the lounge of the Nishino Research Facility (Io, Sol System).

nodes.text: It seems you understand the capabilities of cloak. As you explore you will learn how invaluable it really is.

branches.text: Well yes, it looks very pretty.

nodes.text: /salute Now it comes time for your final training mission. You must face the Zenrei Tempest. All trainees must pass this crucial mission. Come back to me when you are ready.

missions.name: The Tempest Test
missions.summary: Your final training mission. Summon your courage and communicate with the Zenrei Tempest, a powerful being that can annihilate the most experienced pilots.

nodes.text: For your final task I will send you on your most dangerous mission yet. It is customary that all Sha'ha'dem speak with the Zenrei Tempest before heading off into the universe.

You are welcome. Many of my trainees meet their end here from careless inattention, but without discussing with the Tempest I will not allow you to progress. This is the final step to becoming Sha'ha'dem, Aspirant. I wish you luck.

To become Sha'ha'dem is to discover and understand.  And to discover, one needs to explore. Part of your training requires that you think beyond instruction and seek your goal on your own. Many times you will find yourself unable to locate your journey's end and must discover it alone.
I will tell you, however, that the Tempest resides near the bright side of IO.

branches.text: How do I explore without a nav point?
Thats too hard, why can't you just tell me?

nodes.text:
If you wish to be Sha'ha'dem, you must learn to survive on your own. If that is too difficult for you perhaps you should be Shinwa. At least you will be told what to do.
Come back to me if you wish to learn to be independant. /rude

Ahhh, now comes the root of the Sha'ha'dem. To seek that which is not initialy revealed. You must now learn to free warp. This tactic had allowed many explorers to discover that wich has remained hidden for aeons. It also will allow you to discover areas that are heavily defended if you are clever.

branches.text: Sounds fun! How do I do it?

nodes.text:
To do this you must remove any target aquired. Face yourself in the direction you wish to travel and then activate warp.
Bear in mind this drains your reactor greatly and the distance you can travel is limited to the amount of energy in your reactor, and any gravity field will still pull you from warp but if successful, you will be able to discover even the most well hidden secrets in the universe.

Excellent! I am glad to see you are willing to dedicate yourself to becoming true Sha'ha'dem. First I must warn you, many of my trainees meet their end with the Tempest from careless inattention, but without meeting this great being I will not allow you to progress. This is the final step to becoming Sha'ha'dem, Aspirant. I wish you luck.

The Zenrei Tempest is an intelligent yet terrifying entity. You will need to approach it in cloak lest it's energy signature should destroy you. To communicate with it, you must come very close and approach its psionic receiver. If you get too close you will need a way to distance yourself quickly before the energy destroys you. This can be done with the Fold Space skill, which I will teach you now, before you go.
This will allow you to instantly transport yourself a distance away, which gets farther and safer the higher you train the skill. It will serve you well in times to come.

branches.text: Where can I find the Tempest?

stages.description: Go to Tempest Fringe (Io, Sol System).
Target the Tempest Fringe nav and engage your Basic cloaking skill.
Approach the Zenrei Tempest in cloak and target it when you are close to communicate with it. You may have to retarget it at different ranges.

nodes.text: *STATIC*   ZZZZZzz...   I detect an energy form... Hmmm.

You are lucky I cannot see you, energy. Why would a brilliant creature such as I want to harm you? The answer is simple. There is a reason I call you not by your name. It is not because I do not know it, but your name means nothing to me. All that matters to me is energy, I am made of it, you are made of it, everything is. What would the universe be without energy? It would be nothing, there would be no movement, and with no movement, nothing would exist.

Does it make sense that if no energy is nothing, energy is everything?

branches.text: Yes, but why are you telling me this?

nodes.text: I want you to understand the role of energy in the universe, that every creature, organic or synthetic, has a portion of the energy in this universe. The only way to improve oneself is to accumulate and focus energy. Remember this lesson, energy form, and you will be able to do best for yourself and others.
You will see. *STATIC* zzzZZZZ

stages.description: Return to Kalas ben Joseph in the lounge of the Nishino Research Facility (Io, Sol System).

nodes.text:
Congratulations Initiate! You have completed the tests set to you, and now you are ready to join the Sha'ha'dem in ernest. 
For your efforts I will grant you the Heart of the Tempest reactor. It will serve you well in the path to come as it has many who came before. May it remind you of the Tempest's teachings.

You are welcome, Initiate @name. 
Here we must part ways. You have all the skills you need to begin your path as Sha'ha'dem. From here you take with you the most important aspect you will ever need, intuition.

You have learned well but you have yet much to discover. 
What would you like to know?

branches.text: I want to know about mining.
Nothing, I am ready to move on.

nodes.text: You have the tools necessary to mine, seek out fields that will bring you profit, or resources to craft. The more challenging the field the better the resource. Keep your reactor updated as that is energy and a miner's lifes blood.

branches.text: That is all I need to know.

nodes.text: You can find many foes to combat, upgrading your weapons and shields will allow you to meet tougher opponents. Seek them throughout the galaxy but beware not to engage anything beyond your ability. Finding an even opponent will most always ensure victory.

Everywhere! You have learned that which you need to explore, for that is the foundation of the Sha'ha'dem. Ensure your engine is up to par and keep a potent reactor as warping requires much energy. Go where none have been, learn all that is learnable and above all, teach others what you know.

branches.text: I understand. I am ready to move on now.

nodes.text: Very well. Merjan Kathrada on Paren Station in Kailaasa has requested your presence, go and heed her well for she is the Emmesary, primary among our class. But before you report to her, speak to me one last time.

missions.name: Masaaki's Initiation
missions.summary: Masaaki teaches you how to use a projectile weapon in this mission.

nodes.text:
Young Jenquai, I know why you are here. You seek your maximum potential. I will help you.




In order to fight at your full potential you must understand a few things. A few... truths.. about what it means to be Jenquai.

branches.text: I do not need your guidance at the moment.

nodes.text: TRUTH: There was a massacre at Jove City. Millions were killed.
Goodbye then. I suspect you will return soon.
TRUTH: Progen Dog Soldiers cruelly murdered the entire population of the city, and took great pleasure from doing so.
The Progen, ruthless with the projectile weapon, used it to kill many of our ships, regardless of whether they were civilian or military, before the end of the bloody war.

We cannot turn the page on our past. We will face our enemies. Fortunately the war is over and there will be no more bloodshed between us and the Progen. Now all we must do is face our fears. Master and conquer the projectile weapon.

stages.description: Masaaki's Initiation Step 1 - Destroy a Progen Battle Drone by the Gate War Hulk (Asteroid Belt Beta, Sol System). Do not forget to buy ammo at the weapons vendor.
Masaaki's Initiation Step 2 - Return and speak with Masaaki Rosanjin (Jove's Fury, Jupiter, Sol System).

nodes.text: Jenquai, you return. Your mission completed.

branches.text: Thank you for teaching me projectile weapon.

nodes.text: You have learned more than just to fire a weapon. You have learned the plight of your own people. I hope you can use what you have learned to better your cause.

missions.name: Sample Delivery
missions.summary: Dr. Tobias Mats needs you to deliver a sample of something he has been researching to Paren Station.

nodes.text: Hey Sha'ha'dem, are you busy?
Well you just signed yourself up for a delivery!
Suuuure you are. Now shoo.
That's perfect then! You could do my delivery for me AND I will teach you navigate! How does that sound?

So, I've been analyzing the soil around here to see if it's suitable for llama farming. I have a sample and I believe it contains enough nitrogen for the task at hand, but my tools are still broken and I need to check my data with Hsing Fu'un on Paren station. Now if you will just pay attention, since you will do me a favor, I will show you how to Navigate.
Great! So now you know the fine art of Navigation. I will have the sample tossed into your hold. Should be ready before you take off.

stages.description: Talk to Hsing Fu'un on Paren station in Capella and deliver the matter sample.

nodes.text: Hey! What you think you are doing?! You disturb me.

branches.text: What? Umm, I am here to deliver these samples.

nodes.text: I no care, you bug me, go!

stages.description: Talk to Hsing Fu'un again.

nodes.text: /panic Whaaaat! What you want!?

branches.text: Look, Tobias Mats told me to bring these samples here.

nodes.text: Who?
Ohhhh, why you no say that before? You stooopid or something? /gender1

branches.text: Uhhh, riiight. So are you going to take these or what?

nodes.text: /noway Why I take that? I ate already.

branches.text: This is what he told me to give you.

nodes.text: /point That someone's lunch, why you bring that to me?
Ok, you go now. Bring me proper sample.

stages.description: Return to Tobias Mats on Dahin.

nodes.text: /laugh Wow! I can't believe you fell for that! That cracks me up, every time.
Hey come on can't ya take a joke?

branches.text: Look, do you have a real delivery or not?

nodes.text: Yeah, ok mister fun stuff. I guess I can let you deliver the real thing this time.

branches.text: Sure thing, but no funny business.

nodes.text: Hah! Nice to meet someone with a sense of humor. Hey look. I actually do have a sample to deliver, still interested?

branches.text: Ok, but I am gonna check it THIS time.

nodes.text: Ok so here's the deal. I will have the proper sample put in your cargo now, but be careful this stuff can be a bit finiky. Just follow the navs directly back to the gate, no detours, and everything should work out fine. Don't keep Hsing waiting.

stages.description: Follow the navs back to Kailaasa, then speak with Hsing Fu'un on Paren.

nodes.text: What was that!? Looks like your warning system is telling you there is something dangerous leaking in your cargo hold. You have very little time before it starts damaging the ship. You better hurry!
Better hope the ship holds together...

stages.description: ALERT: Communicate with the Sha'ha'dem Satellite next to the Sector Gate to Dahin in Kailaasa.

nodes.text:
*STATIC*





Hello? You there? Hsing Fu'un here. I detect you have problem. That sample is leaking, very dangerous, will melt your ship soon. I teach you to open wormhole so you get here quick. Pay attention!
Better open a wormhole here. That be the quickest way. Put button in action bar and activate, quick!

stages.description: Wormhole to the Kailaasa Weft, dock at Paren Station and talk to Hsing Fu'un as soon as possible before the matter sample explodes!

nodes.text: /shocked Wow! You lucky. Got here just in time.

branches.text: Cut it a bit close didn't you?

nodes.text: /smash You no blame me! I not tell you to transport dangerous material. You go talk to Tobias.
I take material off your ship. Very dangerous. Have to pay docking fee for handling it. So no pay to you,
/threaten Fair!? You tell me fair? You learn to make wormhole. I no teach that to anyone. Go! You ungrateful. No bug me again, you hear? /rude

missions.name: Defense of the Sharim
missions.summary: Omaka Kasinagi will train you in Combat skills.

nodes.text: /point So, you have come to learn the art of combat? /laugh HAH! You are nothing but a courier, yet when I am finished with you, you will be a warrior! Now! Pay attention.

branches.text: I didn't sign up for this. I am outta here.

nodes.text:
To begin you must learn to walk before you can fly. First you must learn to control your fear. Travel to Combat Training Nav 1, there you will fight the Arbhaka Tykes. Twelve should do. 
Be wary there are more powerful Arbhaka that wander the area, and your shields are not strong enough to protect you from them. Perhaps, if you return, I will show you a trick to give you an edge in combat.
If you survive, return to me for further instruction.

branches.text: I am not afraid. I will be back.

nodes.text: We shall see, now GO! /point
/rude HAH! I expected such from a coward! Begone!

stages.description: Find Combat Training Nav 1 and engage 12 Arbhaka Tykes.
Return to Omaka Kasinagi, on the Azmundi Maru.

nodes.text: /shocked So, you return alive! I am truly impressed. Perhaps you are more than a simple delivery boy after all.

branches.text: Damn straight! How about something challenging now?
It was a tough fight, but I made it.

nodes.text:
/talk5 Your caution will serve you well, it seems you are able to learn after all. Very good, we shall continue...
/smash No doubt you found that your shield weakened quickly when attacked, I shall now show you how to recharge them during combat.

branches.text: Gimme a break, this is kid's stuff.

nodes.text: You are nothing but a braggart! /rude I will warn you only once, bragging is the recourse of the successful coward. /point Do not incur my wrath.

/talk5 This skill I teach you now will allow you to shunt energy to the shield generator and give an instant boost to your shields, in effect regenerating your total shield strength. /talk1 This will drain energy from your reactor, and the more complex the skill the more energy is drained, however the amount of energy infusing the shield is increased as well.
/talk2 Keep in mind, it takes a few seconds for the recharge to activate so keep an eye on your shield strength and time it right. Many pilots were killed because they did not start the recharge until their shields were completely drained. Do not let your hesitance be your downfall.

/smash Good, now pay attention! With your new knowledge you should be able to handle a stronger opponent. /point Go to Combat Training Nav 2 and engage eight Grown Arbhaka. If you have payed attention you should be able to survive.
/point Pay heed for if you continue to annoy me I will force you to start your lessons over from the beginning!
/rude Now you learn a new lesson, respect.

stages.description: Go to Combat Nav 2 and kill 6 Grown Arbhaka.
Return to Omaka Kasiagi on Azmundi Maru to continue training.

nodes.text: /point I see you are paying attention. Good! You have done well to survive this far. From now on it will become more difficult on you and your ship.

branches.text: Yeah yeah, this is all too easy.

nodes.text:
/disagre Do not be overly proud, confidence will save you if moderated only with caution. Soon you shall learn the art of concealment, but first I have one more task for you.
/point Now you must go to the Training Area and engage the belligerent arbhaka. Only when you have destroyed two of them will you be ready to continue.
/give To help you with your challenge here is a stronger shield generator we recovered from the wreckage of my last student. It will allow you to engage tougher and more numerous opponents. I have also granted you the skill fold space to give you a way to escape if the arbhaka begin to swarm. With your new shield and skill you should have no problem defeating the arbhaka, but be wary of the Great Pashu, he roams the area and is more than a match for the likes of you.
/disagree Have you learned nothing? Are your ears not hearing my words? GO! And contemplate respect and understanding. Return when you are ready to listen. /rude

stages.description: Head to Combat Training Area and engage 2 Belligerent Arbhaka. Use Fold Space if you need to escape.
Return to Omaka Kasinagi on Azmundi Maru to complete your combat training.

nodes.text: /point Now you are ready to learn.

branches.text: Am I not a Warrior now?

nodes.text: /talk5 All you have discovered is how to stay alive. What you must yet learn is how to attack, and win! /smash

branches.text: I have other tasks to do

nodes.text: /laugh HAH! You have only learned to stay alive. What you must yet learn is how to attack, and win! /smash

branches.text: Ok, what do I do next?

nodes.text:
/point So be it. Should you be ready to learn the next step in becoming a Warrior, speak with Silva at level 10 and he will teach you to Cloak yourself. That, at least, will allow a MERCHANT to hide from his enemies.
For now we must continue training you the basics! /rude

/clap It is good to hear such eager youth! I may no longer be Shinwa but the success of a student brings pride in my shame. 
Now, go! See if you can practice what you have learned. When you are prepared, come back to me to continue training. 
Then, speak with Silva at level 10 and see if he can teach you to Cloak your ship. Fight well, Seeker. /bow

missions.name: Tricks of the Trade
missions.summary: Speak with Rashid Bandy to follow the path of learning Negotiation.

nodes.text:
/bow Welcome Seeker! I trust Omaka was not too hard on you? He is a noble man, if not a bit gruff. /chuckle
/talk5 As a Seeker, now comes the task of learning the tools of your trade. You must learn the lucrative art of Negotiation.

/talk5 You must now seek out Crayden Marco and speak with him on the subject of negotiation. /talk3 He has had many successful years as a trader and will know best how to instruct you. He can be found in the Bazaar on this station. /point Listen to him carefully for it may mean success or failure.

stages.description: Speak with Crayden Marco on Azmundi Maru.

nodes.text: Hello there, what can I do for you?

branches.text: Rashid sent me to talk to you.

nodes.text: Ah fresh blood! Welcome to the Sharim!

branches.text: Yeah, yeah. Can I have my skill now?

nodes.text: You will find that people will respond to you better if you get on thier good side. That would mean you not saying anything rude or ignorant...
Ok, lets get to work. Negotiation is not just about getting a good price. In fact getting a good deal from someone is more about how you present yourself to them than what goods you have.

branches.text: So I have to be nice to people?
So what? As long as you got the goods.....

nodes.text:
Let me see if I can be more clear. I know you are here to get something you want from me, right? So, I am not going to give it up cheap.
But, if you talk to me like a friend I may warm up to you and feel better about giving you a break. See?

branches.text: Yeah, I get what you are saying.

nodes.text: You should care what people think of you. It's not like we are robots following a program, we have feelings and sometimes those feelings can be offended. In fact if you upset someone they may even charge you more or not deal with you at all.

Ok then, lets put this into practice. I need you to go to Ishuan station and talk to a little guy there named Ichiro. He is a little odd and I have no time for Sha'ha'dem nonsense, but I need some articles from him and I think you can manage it. Remember, he will only give you the parts if you get on his good side, if you upset him you may find yourself starting over again.

branches.text: Ok, I know where that is.

nodes.text: Ok, then, off you go.
Oh, right. It's in the Castor system, in orbit around Ishuan itself. Just keep following the path from the gate and take the Castor Skyway Nav path when you see it. The station is at the end.

stages.description: Get the parts from Ichiro on Ishuan Station in the Castor System.

nodes.text: To Ishuan, the path of Sharim are you welcomed.

branches.text: Crayden sent me here for some parts.
Whatever Yoda, give me the parts.

nodes.text: Curiosity is the seed from which grows all wisdom. What seeds will you sow?

branches.text: Crayden sent me for some parts.
What the heck are you babbling about?

nodes.text: Only through experience do we find understanding as we perceive that which we experience.

branches.text: I wish to understand about trade by perceiving exchange.
I want to perceive some parts.
Look, give me the parts or else...

nodes.text: Inquiry is the path one must follow to find resolution.

branches.text: I need some parts you possess to learn trade.
Ok, I need the parts for Crayden, can I have them?

nodes.text: Then by possession you will find enlightenment.

branches.text: Does that mean I get the goods?

nodes.text: Your path leads to Ganymede, and enlightenment. /bow
If you persue apathy, you will find apathy, if you seek wisdom you receive enlightenment.

branches.text: Look I just want to finish my mission here.
Quit with the Yoda talk and hand me the goods.

nodes.text: But surely you seek only the physical. It is through the ephemeral that you will meet success.

branches.text: All right. Ok let's start over.

nodes.text: Through ignorance, you truly strive for perfection. /rude Return to the beginning to seek the end.

stages.description: Bring the parts to Crayden Marco on Azmundi Maru in Ganymede.

nodes.text: Well! What do you know? You got em! /take

branches.text: I would not have if you didn't show me how.

nodes.text:
/laugh Ha HAH! See, you got it! Now I will have to tell everyone how you did such a masterful job. /clap Here is a little something for your trouble.
Ok, head back to Bandy, no doubt he will want to know how it went, and thanks again.
/disagree That easy huh? Oookay. Well thanks for the parts, here is a fair price for your time, better go see if Bandy needs anything else. Bye.

stages.description: Return to Rashid Bandy on Azmundi Maru.

nodes.text: /bow Welcome back @name. What did you learn?

branches.text: You have to be a politician as well as a trader.
I learned how to put up with annoying people.

nodes.text: /laugh It is true indeed! One must speak well of others to get what one desires, yes? Also keep in mind, as you increase your Negotiation skill the prices you pay will drop, and thus the profits will increase. This is the keystone for the Sharim.

/give I now leave you with a parting gift. These engines I had made custom for my ship. May they bring you quickly to your next fortune. /bow
Now that you have the basics learned, it is time to seek your fortune. Crayden Marco has some goods with which you can begin. Examine the goods to see at which station they are needed then stock up and head there to sell them.
It has been an honor training you. /bow Profit and fortune be yours, brother.

/crash Then you learned how to carry goods only. Take these old hand-me-down engines, perhaps they may allow you to run away quickly. /rude Now is the time for you to go out into the galaxy and ply your trade. Crayden should have some goods that will able you to begin your path of the Seeker.

missions.name: The Sun at Noon
missions.summary: Follow U'nai Amitola's instructions to learn the art of Summon.

nodes.text: Greetings J'nai. It is time to start you on the path of the Shinwa. Pay attention for if you misunderstand your task it may cost you your life.

To begin, you must learn the ability to summon. This will allow you to bring a distant enemy or team mate close to you, thus saving a friend or bringing a single foe into weapon range. You must be cautious as any enemy witnessing the summoning may also become aggresive. Are you ready to begin?

Very well. You must test your new skill by summoning your shadow to you from the field provided. You must not pass the ring as your ship will be drained of power. You must time it right as you may only summon when the shadow is in range.
Begin.

stages.description: Summon and defeat the shadow.

nodes.text: hi

stages.description: Speak with U'nai Amitola.

nodes.text: Now, you are ready to face the real test. You must take what you have learned here and apply it in a more dangerous setting. Go and speak with U'nai Wakisa at the Unruly horde to practice what you have learned.
Learn well.

missions.name: Nishin Teaches the Scan Skill
missions.summary: For a fee, Nishin will teach you scan.

nodes.text: So you have come to learn scan?
Excellent. I am teaching it... for a price.
35,000 credits.

branches.text: Why can't you just teach me?

nodes.text: Let me know when you have the money.
I have to make a living somehow.. Besides, you're a trader. I'm sure you can afford it. Now go get me the money!

stages.description: Return to Nishin with 35,000 credits

nodes.text: There you are.
Go now and be wary.

missions.name: Masaaki's Initiation
missions.summary: Masaaki teaches you how to use a projectile weapon in this mission.

nodes.text:
Young Jenquai, I know why you are here. You seek your maximum potential. I will help you.




In order to fight at your full potential you must understand a few things. A few... truths.. about what it means to be Jenquai.

branches.text: I do not need your guidance at the moment.

nodes.text: TRUTH: There was a massacre at Jove City. Millions were killed.
Goodbye then. I suspect you will return soon.
TRUTH: Progen Dog Soldiers cruelly murdered the entire population of the city, and took great pleasure from doing so.
The Progen, ruthless with the projectile weapon, used it to kill many of our ships, regardless of whether they were civilian or military, before the end of the bloody war.

We cannot turn the page on our past. We will face our enemies. Fortunately the war is over and there will be no more bloodshed between us and the Progen. Now all we must do is face our fears. Master and conquer the projectile weapon.

stages.description: Masaaki's Initiation Step 1 - Destroy a Progen Battle Drone by the Gate War Hulk (Asteroid Belt Beta, Sol System). Do not forget to buy ammo from the Jove's Fury Bazaar.
Masaaki's Initiation Step 2 - Return and speak with Masaaki Rosanjin (Jove's Fury, Jupiter, Sol System).

nodes.text: Jenquai, you return. Your mission completed.

branches.text: Thank you for teaching me projectile weapon.

nodes.text: You have learned more than just to fire a weapon. You have learned the plight of your own people. I hope you can use what you have learned to better your cause.

missions.name: Biological Sample 1
missions.summary: Report to Dr. Sacha Ileiko in Jagerstadt City to assist him with a project. Reward: Skill (Critical Targeting)

nodes.text: /happy1 Hello, @name, I've been expecting you.
Good, I need you to go out and capture or kill a few of the Storm Gulls to be found outside on Zweihander's surface. I need some Biological samples for my studies.

stages.description: Dr. Ileiko needs you to get a biological sample from the birds that congregate outside. Kill at least three of them and return with a Gull Wing or two.
You need to talk to Dr. Sacha Ileiko in Jagerstadt City.

nodes.text:
Hello, @name, I've been expecting you. We shall begin promptly, now, pay attention!

The Admiral has called you here to undergo training. You are to learn Critical Targeting Theory. The basic premise is that you will make use of the skills you've already learned, and to gain an advantage over our enemies. Or to get rid of those foul Bogerils, scourge of the sector they are!

branches.text: Hey! I like the bogeril. Why do you hate 'em?

nodes.text: I have my reasons, now Silence. I have much to teach you, stop interrupting me. *sigh*

Now, when you're locked in a dogfight with the enemy vessel, you'll notice that your missiles will take a few seconds to reach your target and that your target is continually moving.

 You can use this to your advantage. With my new targeting computer, the processing speed of your ship's targeting systems has been multiplied by many times. This allows you to gain a target lock on some bastard, and blast him back to the War of Secession!

What did I say about interrupting me? *sigh* We'll never get much done if you continue to prattle on and not learn.

The War of Secession was when the divergence of the human race occurred and progen and jenquai become their own soverign nations and cultures.

Anyway, back to targeting theory, yes? We've got work to do...

Well, anyway... the idea is basically your ship's computer will be able to target more accurately and quickly because of the new targeting computer. You will be able to take out vital systems on enemy vessels causing extra damage and with good fortune, loss of life or fighting capability for your enemy.

So, what do you think of this?

branches.text: I'm more than willing to give it a shot!

nodes.text: That's the spirit. The computer should now be installed. Why don't you go find yourself an enemy and test your ship's new capabilities.

branches.text: Yes, sir! Requesting permission to leave.

nodes.text: Granted. Now go, and may your enemies shake in fear when they encounter you. *goes back to looking at his books* /wave Oh yeah....

I could use your help for a sample collection, if you would be so kind, I will reward you for your time. Come back and see me again if you're interested.

*nods* Oh and my friend Lt. Baird from the ECS Dauntless in Asteroid Belt Alpha's ECS Dauntless wanted to see you about something important. You should go visit when you have a moment.

missions.name: Going for Repairs
missions.summary: Enforcers must learn how to repair equipment on-the-fly to stay useful on a battlefield. See Julie Bristol on Earth Station upon reaching level 20.

nodes.text: Hello @name, I assume you're here to learn about equipment repairs, yes?

/panic Don't call me that! Now pay attention. We've got work to do. Make sure you've got everything in order and talk to me again when you're ready. Be sure to bring me the 2,500 credits for processing.

stages.description: Speak with Julie Bristol again to discuss the topic of on-the-fly equipment repairs.

nodes.text: Now, let's get started, shall we? Equipment repairs can be difficult, and you don't always have time to return to a station, especially in the middle of a battle. I'm going to teach you to make use of the nanobots every @profession's ship comes equipped with to complete repairs on-the-fly.

Alright, I like your enthusiasm. /clap Please direct your attention to these documents. Now, the nanobot is capable of analyzing the damage to your ship and determining how to make repairs efficiently. In the beginning it may take some time to complete repairs.

If you /point apply the theory of advanced repairs using Nanobots, you can repair on the fly and get back in the fight. This is important for large-scale incursions with our foes. We simply must make sure that EarthCorps and Terran-kind are the dominant culture in the Galaxy.

branches.text: So, basically, I let the bots analyze, and then direct them to repair what I want?

nodes.text:
Correct, @name, and with experience and practice, you'll be able to advance above theory and learn useful methods to repair more equipment at once or even to repair your friends to keep them on the battlefield when needed.

What do you have to say about that?

branches.text: Repairs on-the-fly you say, yeah. I like it.
Say what now? *yawn* I wasn't listening.

nodes.text: Good, now get out there @class, EarthCorps needs your help to destroy the foul denizens of the galaxy that get in the way of peace and prosperity. /give

missions.name: Ambush the Red Dragon Pirates
missions.summary: Lt. Stephanie Baird has sent you to complete an interception against some rogue Red Dragon Pirates amassing a few parsecs north of ECS Dauntless.

nodes.text: Hello @name, /point I've been expecting you. Orders came down from on high that you cadets were to be taught some more advanced skills like how to Rally your squadmates to victory. Are you ready to begin the training?

/clap Good, enthusiasm is helpful, but you need to pay attention /shake_fist if you don't you will risk the doom of your squad and the possible defeat of EarthCorps. You don't want that to happen do you?
GET OUTTA MY SIGHT, MAGGOT!
I'm glad to hear that. We've got a lot to cover. Prepare to take copious notes.

/happy1 Good, I have intel that says the Red Dragons are amassing at the nav Dutch Flat in Asteroid Belt Alpha, please go out and smash these fools before they try something stupid like attacking the Dauntless. You'll need to stay near Dutch Flat and take out at least 2 freighters. We've got better things to do than to fend off inconsequential pirates looking to make a name for themselves. /salute

stages.description: Lt. Baird has sent you out to ambush a red dragon gathering. The intel we have says the gathering is happening at the Nav "Dutch Flat" which should be a few klicks to the north in this sector after leaving the Dauntless. Make sure to take out any Saam Lo Red Dragons that you see, those are the troop ships. Make sure you get at least 3 of them to stunt the offensive.

nodes.text: a

stages.description: Return to Lt. Baird and let her know what you saw and that you took out at least 2 of those freighters.

nodes.text: Hi @name, welcome back to the Dauntless. /wave Did you manage to ambush those Dragons? Do we need to worry about them.

branches.text: Nothing to worry about anymore Lieutenant. I made them think twice about messing with EarthCorps!

nodes.text: /happy2 Good to hear! I was not looking forward to defending this base with so few supplies, to thank you for your time, I'm going to teach you how to Rally your squadmates. Take a few minutes, prepare yourself and come back to chat with me.

stages.description: Go back and speak with Lt. Baird when ready and she will teach you about Rally.

nodes.text: Ready? /laugh1 I don't think you are, but alas, I am required to follow my orders. So basically, you will be taught about advanced Rally tactics so that you may increase your squad's effectiveness in battle. This is an ability unique to those with @race ingenuity. Any questions so far?

Right, soldier. Then off we go. It is important that you make use of your academy-taught tactics and experience to give your squad pointers and ideas to make them more effective in battle. To do this, you will open a private channel with them and encourage them. In the beginning you may find it a bit rough.. but given time you might become an asset to EarthCorps; however, I doubt it.

branches.text: I am already an asset, you're just blind.

nodes.text: Did you just talk back to me soldier? I'll bring you up on charges so fast that even the Ancients technology won't be able to save you from my retribution. Despite those rumors about control over time and space itself.

branches.text: I'll speak as I choose, wench.

nodes.text: That's what I thought, now, Rallying your fellow compatriots is important. I've modified your systems so that you can initiate Rally channels with your friends. /explode I said pay attention!
Only a disrespectful Maggot like you would talk back to someone of my skill, get out of my sight and return when your ego isn't so swollen, perhaps we can teach you something worthwhile.

Ok, ok to sum up, paying attention to the moods and opinions of your squadmates, and offering them advice can be beneficial to your squad. It can also be beneficial to yourself for protection from incapacitation and to allow your squad to do heavy damage with little risk. You should go give it a try.

missions.name: Negotiation Techniques
missions.summary: Maxi Bubumpa in Jagerstadt City may have something important to show you, if you can complete her task.

nodes.text: Hello @name, We've been watching you for a while now.
Yes, WE, EarthCorps Intelligence. /panic We don't have much time, so listen up.

ECIS needs some items from the Bazaar here, but I can't buy them myself, seein' as I'm undercover. I need you to go to the Bazaar and get me 1 each of the following: Turbo2 Galactic Iron Rails, Evolver Rush, Dingo L4, and a Kestrel L4. /shake_fist Keep this quiet if you want to go on breathing. /rude

stages.description: Go get the items requested by Maxi for ECIS, and keep quiet about it. You need a Kestrel L4, Dingo L4, Evolver Rush, and Turbo2 Galactic Iron Rails.

nodes.text: Have you got what I requested? It would be best for you if you did, you know? No, I guess you don't. I assure you though, you don't want to be on the wrong side of the lines, if ya know what I mean? *chuckle* So, do you have them?

branches.text: Of course. I've got them right here.

nodes.text: Good.

stages.description: Give the items to Maxi as requested.

nodes.text: Good, good. *rubs hands together with a greedy look in her eye*

branches.text: Maxi? Did you need anything else.

nodes.text: Well, you've helped us, so now we'll help you. I'm going to teach you how to Negotiate. /agree

branches.text: Ok, what's the value in negotiation? I just blast things outta my way.

nodes.text: No, no buts...

/disagree1 Sometimes, I don't understand you warrior types. Anyway, negotiation is useful because it will teach you how to save money when you purchase parts, weapons, equipment, or trade goods. It will also give you the ability to get better prices for your old equipment when you sell it.

...so to sum up, you must learn to look your fiscal opponent in the eye, and take everything he's got for a steal... without actually stealing of course. In any case, you get to save money for better items. Make good use of this information. You won't regret helping us.
/self Nope, and you never know. You may hear from us again at some point, if you're lucky. We'll be watching you!

missions.name: Hold your Foe
missions.summary: Practice using the Gravity-Link skill, to prevent your enemies from fleeing or warping away.

nodes.text:
Greetings Legionaire. It's my pleasure to welcome you here to Arx Forgus.
I am Sub-Commander Tasha Trask, and I am here to see that you become
a full-fledged Centuriata Warrior.

branches.text: I am @name, Legionaire of the Centuriata.

nodes.text:
Lets get started then. Gravity Link allows you to slow your enemy from escape.
Test your new skill on a few Mercury Drones at Nav Mercury Training ground.

stages.description: Use Gravity Link on the first Mercury Drone, kill it for its' loot.
Use Gravity Link on the second Mercury Drone, kill it for its' loot.
Use Gravity Link on the third Mercury Drone, kill it for its' loot.
Report back to Trask when this is done.

nodes.text: Welcome back Legionaire. Was the Gravity-Link skill sufficient for killing the Mercury Drones?

branches.text: Yes. I can forsee many glorious battles thanks to this skill.

nodes.text: That is good to hear. Talk to me again when you are ready to do your training with Projectile weapons.

missions.name: Exploit Enemy Weakness
missions.summary: A Warrior needs to learn and practice the usage of Projectile Launchers.

nodes.text: @name, Projectiles are the weapon of choice, for us Progen. They inflict considerable damage, and allow you to keep a little bit of distance from your foe, when compared to Beams.

branches.text: Yes Ma'am. Who needs those Jenquai stinking beams.

nodes.text: I will now give you an implant, to use the projectile weapon that I will hand you for your ship. Don't forget to get to purchase the ammo, from the Bazaar.
Go buy a stack of Executioner Blades from the Bazaar, while my crew configure your ship for Projectile Weapons.

stages.description: Buy a stack of "Executioner Blades" from the Bazaar.

nodes.text: I see you have the Ammo.
I want you to go to Achilles Training Ground and kill 5 Achilles Drone. Report back to me when you have done this. Don't forget to install your Projectile Weapon and Ammo, before engaging in combat.

stages.description: Kill 5 Achilles Drone at "Achilles Training Ground" near Nav Warrior Training 2.
Report bact to Sub-Commander Trask when you have done this.

nodes.text: As you may have noticed, that extra range can be very helpful, as well as the quick fire rate.

branches.text: It really did make a difference. I like these projectiles.

nodes.text: /salute Go and honor us Progen and Kill!

missions.name: Overwhelming Force
missions.summary: A Warrior needs to practice using the Shield Inversion skill on drones.

nodes.text: I will now give you an implant on how to use the Shield Inversion skill.
Go test it on Hercules Drones, at Nav Hercules Training ground.

stages.description: Activate Shield Ram on the first Hercules Drone.
Kill another 2 Hercules Drones using your Shield Ram skill.
Report back to Trask.

nodes.text: Nicely done @name. It's never a bad thing to have a little extra punch.
Dont forget to watch your shield level when using this. You don't want to be the first Legionaire the Sabine have to call forward, just because you were careless.

missions.name: Speak with Gratis Augustus Var
missions.summary: Report to Legate Gratis Augustus Var in Tarsis Sector.

nodes.text: You did well out there @name, But your time here is coming to an end now.

branches.text: Where do the Centuriata need me the most?

nodes.text:
For now, you will report to Magnus Gratis Augustus Var in Tarsis.
He will instruct you. He always finds a use for young pilots like you.
/point Shut up Legionaire! I won't allow any subordinate to talk to me like that.

I admit the galaxy can be dangerous for one like you @name. 
Here take this Troy shield and this implant for Damage Control. Im sure you will find both useful /give
And now you must depart for Arx Tiberius, in the Tarsis Sector.

stages.description: Procede to Arx Tiberius, in Tarsis Sector, and speak to Gratis Augustus Var.

nodes.text:
You Legionair! /point
State you name, ID number, and your purpose here.

branches.text: I am a @name, ID number 97482354313, I was ordered to report to you, Sir!

nodes.text:
ID Number 97482354313? Let's see...
Hmm according to these recordings from Trask, you're qualified for a Promotion in the ranks of the Centuriata.
I am ordering you /point to depart to Arx Magister, in Mars, at once and report to Proconsul Dionysius Kerr. You will receive your Promotion from him. Afterwards report back to me. Now go!

missions.name: A Warriors Promotion
missions.summary: You have earned the rank of Centurion. Get your promotion.

nodes.text: /point Who are you that you would embrace greater glory ?

branches.text: I am @name. Legionaire of the Centuriata.

nodes.text: Stand forward Centurion and be judged in the sight of Mars and the Progen Republic.
Hail Centurion, The Tribunal and Presidium hold you in the utmost esteem and judge your genome worthy of continuance.

It is the judgment of your Centuriata peers that you have demonstrated the patriotism, the valor, and the strength that are worthy of a Progen and thus that you merit the most prized of commendations.
Thusly...
In the name of Vita Theodora our mother in spirit..
In the name of Artimis Jericho our father in strength...
And with the approval and approbations of The Tribunal and Presidium.....
I extoll your genome and appoint you Centurion, go forth and serve the Republic. Hesitation is weakness.
Er.. certainly.. it isn't quite finished though.

I'm also required Lancearate to ask a service of you on behalf of the Republic, it's customary everyone is asked on there first official promotion though the task differs for each, the mission will warrant considerable reward at considerable risk.

In your case , the task in question.. well i don't envy you much. Seems that Ianno Dennon one of our chief geneticists requires the assistance of a warrior, I don't know much beyond that, but those Sabine are unnatural.

But I'm required to ask it of you, there's little shame in refusing.... of course the greatest of our Centuriata soldiers have suceeded in their task, Lucius Attius certainly did, and so did Anjuren Kahn.

branches.text: Sounds like I can't refuse then.

nodes.text: I can't say I approve of it, but as you wish. You'll be expected to report to "Ioanna Deinon," in the city of Porvenir Mons, on the planet Endriago. The Republic will expect you to follow her instructions, and to serve until released.
Much as I hate to release a fellow warrior to the clutches of that gene witch, I know the rewards could be great.
Given the nature of your task, you'd best be prepared, I know that's the advice Attius would give. As a Lancerate your entitled to a hull upgrade and you can get it at Tiberius shipyards.

branches.text: Where do I find the Tiberius shipyards?

nodes.text: You'll find it in Primus sector in the Vega system and remember you'll be required to donate ten thousand credits to the republic in exchange for your upgrade as it proper.

branches.text: *Sigh* I knew this sounded to good to be true...

nodes.text: Your strength and determination have served you well, your a credit to the Republic, and it's been a honor to observe your progress of your career.

branches.text: Rest assured, Proconsul, I wont forget that.

nodes.text: Now you are to proceed directly to the Tiberius shipyards in Primus sector for your hull upgrade. It doesn't reflect well to the republic to be flying a substandard ship.
And a wise decision it is to serve that Ioanna Deinon, I'd not want to encounter her again myself.
Still should you change your mind, I'm obliged to tell you that you may return here, the opportunity lasts as long as you hold the rank of Centurion but the rewards may admitttedly be great.
Go now...

stages.description: Arrive at the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus Sector, when you have the required credits.

nodes.text:
/salute I will set up my men to work on refitting your hull. I must 
request 10,000 credits before work begins, Sir. Sorry. Sir, those 
are my orders. Do you have the correct amount for your requisition?

branches.text: No. I do not have the credits.

nodes.text: There you are @name. Take care of her, and she'll take care of you.
Im sorry, then you'll need to come back to me, when you have raised the funds. /rude

stages.description: Report to Ioanna J Deinon in the city of Porvenir Mons, planet Endriago upon reaching overall level 30.

nodes.text: So you think you got what it takes to serve me Centurion ?

missions.name: Practice, Makes Perfect.
missions.summary: Travel around Mars Alpha exterminating the Mactor Drones.

nodes.text: Hail! Young Warrior, have I got a job for you. /point
This is a mission under development, I would like you to Travel around Mars Alpha killing off those pesky mactor drones.
Come back if you change your mind.
Why? For the glory of the Centuriata (spelling?), that's why.  Not really, actually we have a bit of a problem with these drones.
We found a bug in the software A.I. of the Mactor series drones and they have become a threat to us.

branches.text: So you want me to clean up this mess?

nodes.text: That is right. Besides, you will gain invaluable expierence and some fancy salvage as well.  I've heard that a few of the drones may even have some fancy Crossbow projectile launchers.

branches.text: Sounds like a deal to me.

nodes.text: Good Luck.

stages.description: Travel south of the station, to the "Search and Destroy Grounds" Nav point.
Kill 5 Feeble Mactors.
Kill 5 Might Mactors
Travel to the Northeast of the station, to the "Mactor Combat Course Alpha"
Kill 5 Feeble Mactors.
Travel to the East of the station, to the "Mactor Combat Course Beta"
Kill 4 Mactors.
Return to Arx Forgus, and speak to Pedagogue Kluu.

nodes.text: Welcome back, young Warrior. Did you enjoy slaughtering those Mactors?

branches.text: I loved every minute of it; It was a glorious!

nodes.text: Good to hear! Report to Sub-Commander Trask when you are at least level 10, for new orders.
Dismissed.

missions.name: A Privateers Promotion 1.0
missions.summary: You have earned the rank of Aedile, now go get your promotion.

nodes.text: /point Who are you that you would embrace greater glory ?

branches.text: I am @name. Quaestor of the Collegia.

nodes.text: Hail Centurion, Tribunal and Presidium hold you in the upmost esteem and judge your genome worthy of continuence.
It's the judgment of your Collegia fellows that you have demonstrated the patriotism, the valour and the strength that are worthy of a Progen and thus that you merit the most prized of comendations.
Thusly........
In the name of Vita Theodora our mother in spirit..
In the name of Artimis Jericho our father in strength
And with the approval and approbations of Tribunal and Presidium.....
I extoll your genome and appoint you Aedile, go forth and serve the Republic hesitation is weakness.
Er.. certainly.. it isn't quite finished though.

I'm also required Aedile to ask a service of you on behalf of the Republic, it's customary everyone is asked on there first official promotion though the task differs for each, the mission will warrant considerable reward at considerable risk.

In your case , the task in question.. well i don't envy you much. Seems that Ianno Dennon one of our chief geneticists requires the assistance of a trader, i don't know much beyond that, but those Sabine are unnatural.
But i'm required to ask it of you, there's little shame in refusing.... of course the greatest of the Centuriata have suceeded in there task, Lucius Attius certainly did and so did Anjuren Kahn.

branches.text: Sounds like i can't refuse then...

nodes.text: I can't say i approve of it, but as you wish you'll be expected to report to Ianno J Dennon in the city of Porvenir Mons on the planet Endriago, the Republic will expect you to follow her instructions and to serve until realeased.
Much as i hate to release a fellow trader to the clutches of that gene witch, i know the rewards could be great.

Given the nature of your task, you'd best be prepared, I know that's the advice Attius would give.
As a Aedile your entitled to a hull upgrade and you can get it at Tiberius shipyard.

branches.text: Ah now were getting to the point old man

nodes.text:
Hold on Tiberius Shipyards just reported a shortage on resources. 
Hmm.. Well we can do such an small upgrade here at Arx Magister as well but remember you'll be required to donate ten thousand credits to the republic in exchange for your upgrade as it proper. Technican Bors is the one you will want to see. He can usually be found in the Hangar area.

branches.text: *Sigh* I knew this sounded to good to be true...

nodes.text: Luck and strength to you Aedile and protection against those unnatural Sabine.

branches.text: Rest assured Proconsul i wont forget that ... ever

nodes.text: Remember you'll be required to donate ten thousand credits to the republic in exchange for your upgrade as is proper.

stages.description: Talk to Technican Bors Solus when you have the required credits.

nodes.text:
Sir. I will set up my men to work on refitting your hull. I must 
request 10,000 credits before work begins, Sir.   Sorry. Sir, those 
are my orders. Do you have the correct amount, Sir ?

branches.text: No. I do not have the credits.

nodes.text: There you are @name.   Take care of her, and she'll take care of you.
Im sorry then come back to me when you have raised the funds.

stages.description: Report to Ioanna J Deinon in the city of Porvenir Mons, planet Endriago upon reaching overall level 30.

nodes.text: So you think you got what it takes to serve me Aedile ?

missions.name: Basic Shooting Range
missions.summary: Learn about combat from Lt. Raine. (Reward: Enrage skill, Combat XP)

nodes.text: Hello @name, just the pilot I was lookin' to see. I've got an assignment for you. I need you to go on patrol for us. We've received reports of some of our Trash Collector Bots malfunctioning and going rogue after they've collected something from the wreckage to be found around Luna.

branches.text: What are we trying to find?

nodes.text: Well, that's just it see? We have no idea what they've found. Whatever it is seems to be causing some interference with their programming. This leads to you, go out and destroy any rogues you find and see if you can gather what they are carrying. I would think if you can destroy 3 of them, we might be able to get an idea.

stages.description: Lt. Raine has sent you to destroy some pesky rogue Trash Collector Bots in Luna Sector. They can be found near the Basic Shooting Ranges.
Return to Lt. Raine to get the mission data recorder checked.

nodes.text: Welcome back soldier, I am downloading the mission data recorder from your ship right now to see if we can determine what's causing these malfunctions.
... I'm not sure, just a few more moments. The computer is analyzing the logs.

/agree AHA! Yes, these bots were affected by the strong radiation on these hulks. That's something we will need the traders to investigate since they can afford the environment protection for their newest pilots. /give I want you to take this logbook and go back out and pay a lethal visit upon five more of those Trash Collector Bots, I'll reward you well for your time.

branches.text: I like rewards. I'll go now.

nodes.text: I thought you might say that. Good luck soldier!

stages.description: Lt. Raine wants you to go destroy 5 more Trash Collector Bots.
Return to Lt. Raine for Debriefing.

nodes.text: /wave Welcome back pilot! You did a damn fine job out there. Good work! As promised, since you've done the task that I've requested, please accept this reward from EarthCorps High Command. Come see me again
Aye, yer welcome laddie, enjoy the reward. I have a few more tasks for you if you're up to the challenge.

missions.name: Data Dumping
missions.summary: In this mission you will learn cloak and receive your first hull upgrade.

nodes.text: Greetings Sharim, it is time for your advancement mission. If you complete this mission you will become Zi'Jeu. Your ship will have a stronger hull, better mounts, and others will give you greater respect. Are you ready?

branches.text: With and offer like that, how can I refuse?
I like things the way they are.

nodes.text: Ok, well first of all I will give you the ability to cloak, I hope it will serve you well. Do not forget to put skill points into it and place it on your skill bar.
Suit yourself. If you do not return for advancement you will suffer because of it.
Yes, the mission involves checking the data from a satellite at the Ancient Gate. It's really not that tough, just go over there, get the data, and come back.

stages.description: Data Dumping Step 1 - Travel to the Ancient Gate Replica (Ganymede, Sol System).
RED ALERT, PIRATES DETECTED. Target the ancient gate replica immediately and activate Basic Cloaking.
Data Dumping Step 3 - Thrust to the Research Satellite near the Ancient Gate Replica.
DATA RETRIEVED. Escape the sight of the pirates, deactivate cloak and return to Kayen Silva.

nodes.text: Well that was easy wasn't it?
I know, what about them?
Yeah it's quite sad, in the past, many of the Sharim trainees decided to desert and become pirates.

Some of them didn't really like our style of teaching it seems, while others were just greedy. Wherever there are riches and vulnerability, there are some to exploit it.

But, putting that aside, congratulations on your first hull upgrade. I send you off. Train abroad to obtain the rest of your skills and enjoy the universe!

missions.name: Kill Scuttle Larva
missions.summary: Kill 3 Scuttle Larvae. (Rewards: Combat XP, Lv 2 Shield)

nodes.text: /wave Hello again @name, you've got some nerve, I like that in a pilot.
/shrug It's a good thing too. I've got a new mission for you. I need you to go out to Nav Advanced Combat Training and put a damper on the plans of 3 Scuttle Larva.

branches.text: Alright, sounds good, what can I look forward to in the reward department?

nodes.text: /panic My son, ask not what your faction can do for you, ask what you can do for your faction! No more of this needless chatter regarding rewards. They'll be worth your time. Just get out there and get it done as you've been ordered.
/clap That's more like it. I look forward to hearing the results.

stages.description: Per Orders: Proceed to Nav Advanced Combat Training and destroy 3 Scuttle Larvae.
Return to Lt. Raine for debriefing on Luna Station.

nodes.text: Welcome back again @name, are you ready for debriefing?
/happy1 Good, good. Did you kill the Scuttle Larvae? Those things have been a real pest to our new pilots. Good for combat training but they multiply almost too fast.

branches.text: Yeah, they should be outta your hair, for a little while at least.

nodes.text: /laugh1 Great, that's just what I wanted to hear! You've done a great job. /thumbs_up Now, about that reward, since you just wouldn't keep quiet about it... /give
/shrug I know, that's why you got it. Anyway, come back and see me again later, I may have another mission for you.

missions.name: Message For The First Sergeant
missions.summary: Lt. Raine sends you to see First Sergeant Kagiso and deliver a message. (Rewards: TradeXP, Explore XP)

nodes.text: /crazy Hello again pilot. I need you to deliver a message to First Sergeant Kagiso. She can usually be found floating around out by the Nav Luna Hub. She tends to stay in her ship most of the time, so you may want to have a look out there.

branches.text: What message would you like me to deliver?

nodes.text: /rude Never you mind, just take this and give it to her!

stages.description: Go see First Sergeant Kagiso and provide the message given by Lt. Raine.

nodes.text: Thanks for the updates pilot. This data will be useful for setting up EarthCorps strategy in the Beta Hydri sector.
/rude Oi, do I look old to you? Stop calling me ma'am!
/sick Well, that's not entirely an improvement, but I guess it'll do. Come back and see me in a few minutes after I transmit this data and we'll discuss what you can do next.

missions.name: Blast a Devil Spawn 1.0
missions.summary: Show them no mercy, Sabine!

nodes.text: /salute Welcome to Arx Prima. I am Centurion Minda of the Centuriata.

branches.text: Greetings Centurion. I am @name of the Sabine.

nodes.text:
/nod  *Checks Datapad* @name @name ....ah there you are...
Basic combat training is on your list now.
/give Here take this implant. You will now learn how to use Projectile guns. While I set my technican to work on your ship, go get yourself some Exorcist ammo from the Bazaar.

branches.text: I'm expected to pay for the ammo for the training on my own?

nodes.text: Yes.. Do you have a problem with that?

stages.description: Get Exorcist Rounds from the Bazaar. One stack of ammo is recommended.

nodes.text: So do you have the ammo?

branches.text: Yes, I was barely able to afford some.
No this stinks.... you're cheating me on the ammo!

nodes.text: Ok, then you will install and use this Exorcist to blast Devils Spawns at Nav Psionic Emitter 1. Do not stop unless you have killed at least three of these bastards, but the more the merrier.
Bah, big Crybaby.. Come back when you grow up. /rude

stages.description: Kill Devil Spawns at Psionic Emitter 1.
Return to Minda after you have killed 3.

nodes.text: Ah so you're back and in one piece. I admit I didn't expect that.
Ok, ok get off my back. Here, take your payment. Report to Tovar maxe for your next assignment.

missions.name: Report to Sergeant Jones
missions.summary: Get out, see the sights, maybe you'll toast a few bogeril. You need to go to EarthCorps High Command in the Zweihander Sector of Alpha Centauri.

nodes.text: /bow Hey there @name, Your new orders have come in. EarthCorps High Command has requested you to report to Sergeant Jones on their Orbital Station around Zweihander Planet. You are to report immediately soldier.
Right you are, now get goin' Don't make me say it again. /rude
/happy1 See you!
/angry *glares malevolently at you*

stages.description: Sergeant Jones is expecting you. You'd better hurry! You have about 4 minutes until your appointment and another 6 months if you take too long! (Zweihander Sector, EC High Cmd. Station)

nodes.text: /wave Good, yer here. Admiral Herrera has a speshul assignment fer ya, but he's a busy man so if'n he don't have nuthin' fer ya at th' moment, then yer might'n wanna ter check on 'im later. If yer not at least a Lieutenant he's not gonna be wantin' to acknowledge yer appointment wif him.
Well get out thar n fix it, are ya a @race or wut? 'onestly one would tink that would be common sense wif all the chaos out thar right now. /crazy

branches.text: Do yer have any wurk fer me?

nodes.text: I'm sorry sir! I didna mean ter offends yer. I'll go right ahead and register yer appointment now. I've got a few tasks that may be needing some doing if you could afford the time or someone from yer staff ter assist. Good luck ter ya, @name. /bow
I might'n so. Let me fetch me records, come yammer at me again in a couple of minutes if yer've got the time. I'll be able ter help ya out if yer up to a challenge. /happy1

missions.name: A Sentinels Promotion 1.0
missions.summary: You have earned the rank of Librorum. Get your promotion.

nodes.text: @name, our time has come to an end. Proceed to Arx Magister, in Mars Sector, and report to Proconsul Dionysius Kerr for your promotion.

stages.description: Speak to Proconsul Dionysius Kerr on Arx Magister, in Mars Sector.

nodes.text: A Sabine... excuse me i was just practicing, not that i need it of course, the work of ..er..your kind is always very thorough.

branches.text: I am @name. Inceptor of the Sabine.

nodes.text: Know this Inceptor , Tribune and Prisidium judge you to be a disgrace to the Republic, only your tireless labour gives us pause from destroying you outright.

It is determination of Tribunal and Prisidium that your genome should continue, that you should be promoted in rank in the hope that this promotion will spark in you a greater devotion to the Republic.
And with the hesitant approval of Tribunal and Prisidium....
I appoint you Liborum, go forth and serve the Republic ... Hesitation is Weakness.
Yes well.... see that you'll live up to it.
Well you could start by attacking our enemies and be sure to serve only those who have the interests of the republic at heart and for the love of Mars don't harm any fellow progen.
For myself i find it usefull to think of the life and deeds of the great Primach Lucius Attius, but some today belive that Anjuren Kahn is the better model of the ideal Centuriata.
Er.. certainly.. it isn't quite finished though.

I'm also required Librorum to ask a service of you on behalf of the Republic, it's customary everyone is asked on there first official promotion though the task differs for each, the mission will warrant considerable reward at considerable risk.

In your case the Magister's have assigned you to assist Ianno Dennon, she is..uhmm.. a leading geneticist and a unique woman, now i don't know much about the ways of your kind, but far be it from me to say anything against a fellow Progen but....
Ianno Dennon .......she's.......unnatural.
As you wish then, you'll be expected to report to Ianno Dennon in the city of Porvenir Mons on planet Endriago, the Republic will expect you to follow there instructions and to serve untill released.
Much as i hate to release a Sabine to the clutches of that gene witch, i know the rewards could be be great.

Given the nature of your task, you'd best be prepared, I know that's the advice Attius would give.
As a Aedile your entitled to a hull upgrade and you can get it at Tiberius shipyard.

Hold on Tiberius Shipyards just reported a shortage on resources. 
Hmm.. Well we can do such an small upgrade here at Arx Magister as well but remember you'll be required to donate ten thousand credits to the republic in exchange for your upgrade as it proper. Technican Bors is the one you will want to see. He can usually be found in the Hangar area.
Luck and strength to you Aedile and protection against those unnatural Sabine.

branches.text: Rest assured Proconsul i wont forget that ... ever

nodes.text: Remember you'll be required to donate ten thousand credits to the republic in exchange for your upgrade as is proper.

stages.description: Talk to Technican Bors Solus when you have the required credits.

nodes.text:
Sir. I will set up my men to work on refitting your hull. I must 
request 10,000 credits before work begins, Sir.   Sorry. Sir, those 
are my orders. Do you have the correct amount, Sir ?

branches.text: No. I do not have the credits.

nodes.text: There you are @name.   Take care of her, and she'll take care of you.
Im sorry then come back to me when you have raised the funds.
