stages.description: Report to Ioanna J Deinon in the city of Porvenir Mons, planet Endriago upon reaching overall level 30.

nodes.text: So you think you are strong enough to serve me Librorum ?

missions.name: Hull Damage Mitigation Techniques
missions.summary: Alexa Richter has sent you orders to go talk with Julie Bristol on Earth Station under the orders of Admiral Herrera himself.

nodes.text: Hello there @name, I have an urgent mission for you. It is most imperative that you go to Earth Station and see Julie Bristol. I have been speaking with her about you. She has some information for you.
/agree Yes, it's time for you to learn one of the secrets of the fleet and what has led to 200 years of EarthCorps service! Be proud pilot, and go see Julie.

stages.description: Alexa Richter has requested you to go see Julie Bristol on Earth Station.

nodes.text: /bow Hey there @name, I've been expectin' ya. The Admiral put in a good word for you aside from what Alexa told me. You should be honored. We need you to go and visit with Executive McKellan here on Earth Station. Can you do it? She's got something important for you.
Off you go then! /bow /clap

stages.description: Go see Executive MacKellan in the main room at Earth Station.

nodes.text: Congratulations @name, per the signed request of Admiral Herrera, Infinitcorp has graciously refitted your ship wit' nanites that will assis' in fixin' yer hull. *scowls* We don't really think you're worthy, but Admiral Herrera does a lot to keep us in safe hands while we make massive profits, so he gets a little bit of what he wants.

branches.text: What does InfinitiCorp have against me?!

nodes.text: /explode Because, you warrior types do nothing for my profits, you only eat into them. Therefore you are a cost drain on my company and if not for the fact that you helped protect my trade routes, I wouldn't have anything to do with you. /rude
Well, I have more important things to do right now. *glare* Now, go away.

missions.name: Find the Red Dragon Informant
missions.summary: Edward Tervs of the InfinitiCorp Sector Command in Asteroid Belt Alpha sends you out to meet the Red Dragon Informant that has negotiated for a price some information about the movements of the RD in Aragoth.

nodes.text: Hello there @profession, My name is Edward Tervs and we could use your help. By that we mean help us, or we'll make sure you never work in this sector again!

You'll do as your told, this is direct from DeWinter my dear @race. You can't afford to resist what she wants, you'll be crushed. Now that we have that out of the way, you'll take this 10,000 credits, pay it to the Red Dragon Informant as a bribe and get all the information you can to stay ahead of them. He should be found at the Nav Beltway Junction.

stages.description: Find the Red Dragon Informant, whoever they are, they should be close to Nav Beltway Junction. This was the agreed upon meeting point. You'll need to give them 10,000 credits for the information bribe.

nodes.text: *STATIC* Hello there, @profession. I'm the informant who spoke with DeWinter's agents *STATIC*

branches.text: What the hell was going on here?

nodes.text: Well they were chasing me obviously, they apparently overheard or discovered my plans and plotted to take me down and sell me out to Shin Tzu. *STATIC* I'm afraid my fees have doubled due to the stress you've put me through here today.

branches.text: ...what? I had nothing to do with it, in fact, I recall that I just saved your hide!

nodes.text: *STATIC* Yeah, what of it? If you want my information, you'll pay my price or you'll just go away and disappoint DeWinter. I'm sure you don't want that.... Do you? *STATIC*

branches.text: ... Well no, can't say that I do. FINE, take the 20,000 credits.

nodes.text: *STATIC* Thanks, now, for the information. Here you go, I've sent it to your cargo hold. Now get out of here before you give me away to any more rogue dragons looking to take me out. I've got to get out of here. *STATIC*

stages.description: Return to the InfinitiCorp Sector HQ and transfer the updates back to them and get this over with.

nodes.text: Welcome back @profession, have you got my updates?

branches.text: I thought you said these were for DeWinter!

nodes.text: Er, they are, they are. Don't get your trousers twisted.

branches.text: Then why did you say "my" updates?!

nodes.text: Gah, here, since you've helped to maintain peace and get me those updates, I'm going to put a note in your file. You've learned how to befriend your enemies. Remember, money rules EVERYTHING!

missions.name: Biological Sample 2
missions.summary: Dr. Ileiko will need some more Gull Wings for his studies.

nodes.text: /bow Hello again, young @profession, I'm glad you've decided to return. I really needed help. I need some more Gull Wings for my studies, think you can help out?

branches.text: Perhaps, but how many will you need?

nodes.text: /happy1 Oh I think 5 or so would do nicely for now. Do you think you can do it?

branches.text: Sure doc, I'm on my way.

nodes.text: Oh, that's too bad, come back if you happen to change your mind, I can reward you for your time.
/happy2 /shoot Great! This will help our studies of the native wildlife a great deal. Earth Corps Science Services thanks you for your contributions to our cause.

branches.text: Yeah, we'll talk about all that when I get back...

nodes.text: I assume we will indeed... good luck @name.

stages.description: Get out there and rip apart some Storm Gulls, Kill at least 5 and bring back 5 Gull Wings to Dr. Sacha Ileiko
Return to Dr. Ileiko and provide the samples you've collected.

nodes.text: Oh good, @name, you're back. You have my samples?
Good, good, I'll take them now please. /take

branches.text: Hey hey hey, what about that reward you mentioned?

nodes.text: Drat, I was hoping you wouldn't remember, well here's some data from a tracking computer I replaced in another ship. It should teach you a few things about some of the nastier denizens of the galaxy that you haven't encountered yet. Ah well, here you go... /give

missions.name: Build Chemical Resistance Device
missions.summary: Maks Babin of Inverness Down needs you to build a chem resist device to protect the station.

nodes.text: /panic Quick @profession, the station needs a chemical resistance booster device for one of our comm arrays that has sustained serious and critical damage from some type of chemical weapons. /shoot

branches.text: What do you need from me, exactly?

nodes.text: Can't you build devices? I mean you're a Trader after all. The supposed greatest merchants in the universe come from InfinitiCorp. Can you make something like that or not?

Well right then, get to makin' I'll pay well. We need a Chemical Inhibitor, and I might recommend one for yourself. /bow You'll need to see my friend in Earth Station, Julie Bristol, she knows how to build just about everything. She might be able to teach you..

stages.description: Inverness Down Station needs a chemical inhibiting device. Maks Babin told you to go see Julie Bristol on Earth Station.

nodes.text: Hi there @name, yes, I know of you. It's always good to have information ahead of time. Maks called me and told me of what she needed. I've already got it ready, but you're gonna need to pay for it...
Nope, I think I'll need at least 50,000 credits if you want it.

branches.text: That's unfair... I don't have that kinda money.

nodes.text: /disagree1 Blah, what kind of representative of InfinitiCorp has so little in the way of credits. Meh, I'll tell you what, I'm in a good mood. I'll give it to you for 25,000 credits. You better take this deal while you can get it!

/laugh1 /take What a sucker, I'd probably have negotiated more with you, what kinda @profession are you anyway? 'onestly from the looks of you I'd have thought you were tradesmen, but you sure don't act like one. You know the old sayings, if it looks like a duck and quacks like a duck, it's a duck. Well you ain't a duck.

stages.description: After being robbed of 25,000 credits by that ever-devious Julie Bristol, you need to take the device back to Maks Babin on Inverness Down.

nodes.text: /bow Thanks @name, you're a life-saver you know. I got the old one back from the station engineer. He had dismantled it and cleaned the parts. I feel only fair I should give them to you. You can probably use them and rebuild another one for yourself.

branches.text: Thank you, Maks. I'll see if I can do anything with 'em shortly.

nodes.text: Farewell and goodluck, @race

missions.name: Tinkering with Parts
missions.summary: Katlyn Walsh of Somerled Station (New Edinburgh, Tau Ceti) is willing to teach you how to build components, for the right price of course!

nodes.text: /bow Hello there @name, I hear you're here for learning the trade of Components. Well, I can teach ya, but it'll cost ya!

branches.text: ....What? Again? My pockets aren't deep enough for this job.

nodes.text: /rude Then go make some money. /crazy

branches.text: You haven't told me what you wanted for it.

nodes.text: Huh, /not_sure well I guess I didn't. I guess I'll be needing about 25,000 credits. Information is power, and with my information you can produce things for much cheaper than you might be able to do otherwise. Once you've got some experience o' course.
Great. /bow Let's begin.
/rude Gotta spend money to make money, don't tell me they didn't teach you THAT at the academy!

stages.description: You've learned how to dismantle and manufacture components. You might take the recipe given: Electro AI InfoROM v2.0, K3 Voltage Regulator, and an Electro Force 10K to make an experimental design. Talk to Katlyn again to get this information loaded into your PDA.

nodes.text: Now that you've learned to build components, a quick study I might add. /bow You can use this blueprint that I'm uploading to your PDA, it'll help you build a new experimental design. Please remember to dismantle other components as you're able and you'll be a great builder in no time.

stages.description: Now, make one and show that you understand how it works! Return to Katlyn once you've built a Dragon's Horde. Shhh, it's a secret to everyone!

nodes.text: /bow Very good job, better than expected. Keep that a secret, that technology is illegal Red Dragon stuff. I bought it off one of them a while back and figured it out, but if EarthCorps stops you, they might take it away.
@name, be sure that you do! Perhaps you can show me some of your talents once you master the fine art of component construction.

missions.name: Exploration of Interfaces
missions.summary: Zebenio Sefu in Luna Sector near the Scrap Yard, she will teach you how to Hack enemy systems.

nodes.text: Hey there @name, I'm a member of EC Intelligence Services. I've received an order that you are to learn about the interfaces of opponent ships. You can certainly make use of this to apply your system decryption routines and remove an opponents system, reactor, or even weapons. Come back and chat when ready and I'll update your ship's decryption routines in the meanwhile.
It is. You can use it to your great tactical advantage and destroy your opponents before they can harm you.

stages.description: Zebenio should have had time to prepare the upload for your ship's decryptor module. Speak to her again to get the upgrade.

nodes.text: So you've come to learn, very good. Hacking a computer is pretty simple. Engage your ship's computer to hack your opponent. Your decryptor module will go to work to try to give you access to the interface.
Now, you've mastered the basics of Hacking systems. Use it to great effect and win more battles for EarthCorps.

stages.description: Test out your new decryptor on a nearby EarthCorps Lion Drone.
Return to Zebenio Sefu and talk to her.

nodes.text: Good, you've been able to successfully use Hacking, a useful skill indeed, yes?

branches.text: Wow..you didn't make it sound all that impressive, but just... WOW

nodes.text: Haha, yes, now go use it to dominate the galaxy in the name of EarthCorps! /loop

branches.text: I think I will, thanks for your help Zebenio.

nodes.text: /salute Just remember, we're always watching you. EarthCorps Intelligence out.

missions.name: Build Missile Weapons
missions.summary: First Sergeant Kagiso is going to teach you how to build weapons. Visit her at Nav Luna Hub in Luna. (Sol)

nodes.text: /bow Hello @name. I've received orders that you are to be taught how to build weapons, this skill will drastically reduce your operating costs and make you a more effective member of the EarthCorps fleet.

branches.text: ...You don't have to twist my arm..

nodes.text: *drones on for hours about how to build weapons* *takes a breath* Get all that? Come back and talk with me again after you think you've mastered what I've told you.

stages.description: Do you think you've mastered everything First Sergeant Kagiso told you? If so, talk with her again.

nodes.text: /wave I have to admit, I feel kind of bad asking you to remember all of that, but since there was so much, I will sum up for you to reinforce your learning: Find or buy weapons, take them to an Analyze terminal in your nearest station. Analyze them, learn how to build them after you Dismantle them, and then you can build something new!

branches.text: That sounds pretty good, I'll give it a try when I need some ammo.

nodes.text: *kzzz* No, you'll try it NOW soldier. *kzz* You should go learn to build the Good ML Type X1. You may not be able to use it yet, but you'll need it later.

stages.description: Kagiso sent you in to learn how to build a Good ML Type X1. You should be able to find one of those in stock at the Luna station Weapons vendor.
Return to First Sergeant Kagiso, she'll inspect your new ML to make sure it's up to snuff.

nodes.text: *kzz* That was quicker than I expected, well done soldier. *bzz* Inspecting your data now.
*ttzztztz* @name, that launcher will do. Now make sure you've got one for each mount available to you, then come back and see me. I'll teach you how to use 'em. Out. *bzzkzzkt*

missions.name: Scouting your Prospects
missions.summary: Administrator Luzzinni has your first assignment as an explorer for Hyperia.

stages.description: Speak with Administrator Luzzinni

nodes.text: /wave Oh, hello there.   You must be @name, the new Explorer Class pilot I was told to expect.  Welcome to Guiana Space Port.  I hope you're ready to put in some work for the station!  We could certainly use the help.

branches.text: You bet I am.  What can I do to help out?
Work?   Uhm...I have to...go brush my dog's teeth.  Yeah.

nodes.text: /celebrate Great!  So here's the most pressing problem at the moment.  Raw materials.  As you may have learned from India or Don Jose in the main room of the station here, the Hyperia Explorers have only recently come back to active duty.  GETCo is doing a lot for us, but we've got to help carry our weight too.

branches.text: Yeah, it seems like kind of an odd situation.  Ms. Helkein-Navarre seems a little stressed.
I'm ready to do my part, just tell me what you want me to do.

nodes.text: ...right.  /shrug Whatever, come back if you decide you want to help out.

/agree And you're right there.  She's overseeing the rebirth of the Hyperia Explorers as the Heiress to GETCo's Navarre family, and not long after Infiniti Corp shut them down.  It's a proving ground for GETCo, and it's also a little personal for India.

branches.text: Well, GETCo and Hyperia's success can only benefit me, right?

nodes.text: Right.  /agree What I need you to do is head out into the sector, and gather some resources.  Specifically, we need Hydrocarbons for some plastics and other items needed to repair ships and whatnot.  If you can gather up about seven units each of Lithium Ore and Crude Graphite; that will go a long way toward helping the station out.

branches.text: Wait, how am I supposed to do that?

nodes.text: /no Sorry, I'm not going to go into detail on that one.  /point I will tell you, though, that Mrs. van Helkein-Navarre and Lady Isabel DeWinter are extremely fierce rivals, and you'll learn more when it becomes information you need to know.

branches.text: Wow.  Alright, I probably shouldn't get involved then, huh?

nodes.text: It's easy, no worries @name.  Your ship is already outfitted with a mining laser and tractor beam. /thumbs I'll have the docking bay crew enable your mining laser and control system before you leave.  Then all you /point need to do is move your ship closer enough to a minable asteroid, and your ship's computer will light up the "Mining" button on the targetting system.

branches.text: Ohh..so I don't have to get out of my ship.  Ok, I'm on it!

nodes.text: Thanks.  Check around the "Rosetta Point" or "Cassini Point" navs.  Explore the sector too, while you're out.  May as well familiarize yourself with the area, right? /chuckle

stages.description: Head out into space and gather the materials the Administrator requested.  Check "Rosetta Point" for the type of asteroids you need to mine.

nodes.text: Check the area for minable asteroids, then investigate Cassini Point.

stages.description: Check the other nav point Luzzinni mentioned, "Cassini Point" and see about getting the materials for the station.

nodes.text: High Hydrocarbon concentration detected nearby.

stages.description: Return to Administrator Luzzinni on Guiana Space Port with the raw materials he asked for.

nodes.text: Hey, welcome back @name! /wave I just got a message from the docking bay crew, and they're unloading the materials as we speak.   I really appretiate your help with keeping us stocked up.   As promised, here's some cash for your time, and effort.  /give

missions.name: Seeking the Key [NOT READY]
missions.summary: Unlocking the secrets of Vishao's Gate.

missions.name: Jenquai Pilgrimage
missions.summary: Follow the path to learn Jenquai history.

nodes.text: Greetings @profession, it is time to learn of the past. Every Jenquai must walk this path and bear witness to what went before so that we may better prepare ourselves against future error. Will you take this journey?

branches.text: I will do as you ask.

nodes.text: Very good. You must first bear witness to the past at the Nogzi Maru Memorium. There your path begins and from there your journal will keep record of your next step. Pay heed and learn well what you see, for it is the story of our history and our people.
Very well. Return when you wish to learn more of your people.

stages.description: Go to the Ngozi Maru Memorial and meditate.

nodes.text: Look before you. What you see is all that is left of the Ngozi Maru, defender of the Jenquai people. The Ngozi Maru was stationed to Jove City during the great tragedy that was the Gate War. This is her story.

The Progen attacked us and although we Jenquai are strong, we are not many. The Progen, bred for war in their genetic tanks, would hear no talk of peace. Our fleet fought hard, fought bravely, but their plight was hopeless. The Progen were too many.

When it was clear that the Progen would win control of Jovian space, the Jenquarum recalled the entire fleet to facilitate the evacuation of the civilian population. Although we had many transports, only the Ngozi Maru remained of our fighting ships that could reach us, and she was already scarred from battle.

The people were afraid. Panic, even among Jenquai, was setting in. The masses pushed toward the docking bay in fear and dread, but only a small percentage could fit on each transport and the first of those, the Esdi Maru, launched with a few hundred of our people under the watchful eye of the Ngozi Maru.

Then, from behind the moon of Thebe came a Progen Battle Cruiser. First one, then another, then another. They flew in like vultures, like demonic birds of prey, and blocked the Esdi Maru's escape. Only the Ngozi Maru stood between them and oblivion, the graceful lines of her hull backlit by the sun.

The odds were against her. Ngozi Maru stood no chance. She set a course away from the Progen battle group and engaged her cloak. The Progen saw this tactic as cowardice and they moved to fall upon the defenseless Esdi Maru. Not a soul stirred in the domes of Jove city as they watched.

Then, in the shadow of Jupiter, a crackle of light heraled the return of Ngozi Maru. She came about with a great roar of engines and flew full speed at the Progen flank, guns blazing. She struck the Progen again and again, bright lances of light slashing at the bulky Progen ships as they wheeled to face her.

With a burst of flames and a mighty explosion one of the Progen cruisers exploded under the withering fire of the Ngozi Maru. Still she fired. And as weapons lit up the Jovian sky, so was a spark lit among the people still stranded in Jove City, a single spark of hope. The call began, first as a whisper, then growing to a deafening roar. "Come on Ngozi Maru! Come on."

The ships exchanged deathblows, but by now the Progen fleet had turned to face their enemy, and they were soon joined by others. There were too many. Her hull shook with impact after impact and finally rent. Ngozi Maru died. As the last flames within her shattered hull faded, so faded the last hope of Jove City. Jovian Space belonged to the Progen.

But in the distance flew Esdi Maru, safe. The silent crowds of Jove City watched her dwindle in the distance, those few hundred lives bought with the blood of the captain and crew of the Ngozi Maru. 
Remember this. Remember what transpired here those many years ago. Remember Ngozi Maru.

It is traditional that Jenquai who visit here meditate upon what they have seen. It brings us peace and insight, two commodities that are very rare.
Will you meditate on the past?
Remember.

stages.description: Go to the Jove City ruins and meditate.

nodes.text:
Before you lie the ruins of Jove City, first city of the Jenquai, founded by the crew of the Jin-Qui Maru. 
For years, Jove City was the center of our science, art, and philosophy. We built a shining city of knowledge unsurpassed to this day.

But this golden age was not to last, and out city was doomed to fall beneath the boots of the Progen. Our fleet, though valiant was defeated, and the Progen owned all of Jovian Space, but for Jove City itself. The remaining warriors dug in and prepared for a long and drawn out siege, confident that the mighty defenses of Jove City could hold off even the Progen.

They were wrong. The Progen proved more cunning than we thought. They tunneled in from beneath the city where the defenses were weakest. They carved their way through miles of hull, and pipes, and machinery, crawled through places we thought no human could survive.

But survive they did. Dahaka Kahn's Dog Soldiers emerged behind our defenses and slaughtered the warriors guarding Jove City. Our beloved Jove City was lost. The fight was over, but the horror had only just begun. Dahaka Khan and his Dog Soldiers were not satisfied with the destruction of the warriors. They thirsted for blood and it did not matter to them that all that remained were unarmed civilians. They tortured, they maimed and they killed. They swam in Jenquai blood. Would that they had drowned in it.

The Progen played games with living human beings, used them to test their weapons and tactics, spaced them for sport, and murdered for sheer pleasure. Dahaka Kahn let his Dog Soldiers do as they pleased, and the only thing that pleased them was suffering. Dahaka Kahn himself became known as Al' Mu'azib "The Tormentor". He took dark glee in murder and torture. The only reason his name was not purged from Jenquai consciousness is to remind us that this must never happen again.

No citizen of Jove City, save those aboard Esdi Maru, survived the occupation. Eventually the Progen left this place, but their taint never did. No Jenquai could stand to be here where the smell of blood still stood rank in their nostrils, where the ghosts of those slain still howled for vengeance.

We preserved this place, both as a reminder and a place to mourn. This once great city is now a burial ground for out honored dead. A new station was built in its place, not a city, nor a university, nor a place of meditation. We did not build the new station for our grief or our sadness. We built it for our rage, so that no one forgets what happened here. That station is Jove's Fury. It is the fury of all Jenquai. Never forget what has happened here. 
Remember the dead. Brother. Remember them in honor, in sadness, and in fury.

It is traditional that Jenquai who visit here meditate upon what they have seen. It brings us peace and insight, two commodities that are very rare. 
Will you meditate on the past?
Remember.

stages.description: Go to Sha'ryun's Tear and meditate.

nodes.text: This is the monument Sha'ryun's Tear. Sha'ryun was a ship captain and an honored Sha'ha'dem. After the devastation of the Jenquai fleet at the Battle of Jove City, he was the highest-ranking officer left alive. His ravaged fleet huddled at the edge of Jovian space... and listened.

Dahaka Kahn was a monster. The Progen are monsters, cold creations of genetic factories. Not satisfied to torture and murder our people, he broadcast his depravity across the sector. Sha'ryun watched in helpless horror. His heart broke at the sight of his people in such terror and pain.

The Jenquai fleet was battered and broken and in no condition to drive out the invaders. And the Progen had concentrated their strength around Jove City. The massacre went on. Sha'ryun hailed the Progen again and again, beseeching them to stop and to allow him to evacuate his people. Dahaka would not listen.

Not wishing to risk what ships he had left, Sha'ryun resolved to face Dahaka alone. In a tiny, unarmed shuttlecraft, he flew toward the Progen under flag of truce. Surely they could not refuse a parlay if he went in person. He would offer himself as hostage, the leader of the remaining Jenquai forces, in exchange for the lives of helpless men, women and children.

Behold the cruelty of Al'Mu'azib, Dahaka Kahn. He had Sha'ryun stopped at the Progen perimeter and permitted him to speak. Sha'ryun, still overcome by his grief, spoke with tears pouring down his face. "You have won." he said. "Show mercy to the helpless."
Al' Mu'azib laughed. He took Sha'ryun's tears for weakness. Without a thought, he ordered the Progen fleet to open fire on Sha'ryun who died within sight of Jove City. And still the massacre went on.

This is Sha'ryun's Tear, frozen in space as the vacuum took him. This is the reminder of crimes past. This is our monument to the soul of the Jenquai people and to the soul of Sha'ryun. We will never fall to the Progen again. Remember. We have what they do not. There is no gene bank that can manufacture a soul.

It is traditional that Jenquai who visit here meditate upon what they have seen. It brings us peace and insight, two commodities that are very rare. 
Would you meditate now, Brother Jenquai?
Remember.

stages.description: Go to the Mourning Circle and meditate.

nodes.text: This is the monument to every Jenquai who has ever perished in conflict. This is the circle upon which we focus. The circle has many meanings. The circle illuminates our own nature. Every Jenquai is joined, like every point upon the circle. We are all brothers and sisters. An attack on one, is an attack on all. We must be conscious of this, remain together in spirit, and protect one another.

The circle grants us vision. With every disaster comes the birth of new hope. It is good and right to mourn those who have passed before us, but the memorials you have seen also serve to remind us of what may yet be built.

The circle serves as a reminder. We Jenquai have endured despite those who would destroy us. As the circle doubles back upon itself, so must we always look to our roots. 
Remember the price of freedom so that we may never suffer disaster again.

Around the circle, you see the Shinwa honor guard. They circle this monument. 
We are circles within circles, ever vigilant to those who would harm us. Remember the circle.
Remember your roots and those who passed before. 
When the circle comes around once more, we will be ready.

It is traditional that Jenquai who visit here meditate upon what they have seen. It brings us peace and insight, two commodities that are very rare. 
Will you meditate on the past?
Remember.

stages.description: Return to Master Sevti on Jove's Fury.

nodes.text: You return. Have you completed the circle? Do you return to the beginning?

Then you know now what must be done. Never forget and never allow such things to occur again. This is our history, our sorrow, and our shame.
There is more to learn of our people. So much more and you have but scratched the surface. I can reveal more to you and, in time, will have more to tell. For now, go. Wander among your people and bear witness to our strength and in your learning add to the future.
Travel well @profession. /bow

missions.name: The Freespacer Romantic
missions.summary: Help Relk Goodspeed ignore his lonliness by retrieving him three Romance Novels. In return he will teach you Jumpstart.

nodes.text: Hello... It's not often that I get visitors.
As I guessed. I can't say that brightens my dreary mood of constant lonliness. Well, at least I can make use of you.

branches.text: What do you want me to do?

nodes.text:
You know, @name, I believe there's someone out there for everyone. My dream girl could be in Earth or perhaps Kailaasa. Where ever she is, she's out there, and the only thing that could brighten my spirits is thinking about her.

I am a big fan of Romance Novels, novels that help me think about my unknown beloved, so maybe if you go get me some novels I will be a bit better off.
How about you go bring me three and return to me. Once you do that I will be happy to teach you Jumpstart.
I can't leave my post. If I went to go find some Romance Novels, who would teach the explorers how to Jumpstart?
Nice try, but no.

stages.description: The Freespacer Romantic Step 1 - Find three Romance Novels and bring them to Relk Goodspeed.

nodes.text: Thank you @name, I've been looking forward to these titles for some time now. It can get lonely up here, anyway, time to teach you how to Jumpstart other incapacitated and stranded friends.
There you go, good luck and use it well. Be careful when saving incapacitated friends because you never know what may be lurking around next to them.

missions.name: Scout Combat Training
missions.summary: Terran Scout Missile Weapon training.

nodes.text: Ah, @name.  I was just about to have the station's Comm center call for you.  I've been watching your progress, and I'm pleased.

branches.text: I'm glad to be of service.  Did you need something?

nodes.text: It's not what I need @name, it's more a matter of how I can help you /point progress even more quickly.  It's time you had some proper combat training with a REAL weapon.  /shoot

branches.text: Combat training?   ...I thought I was going to be exploring?
NOW you're talking!  So what do I get?

nodes.text: /noway Don't get too full of yourself, @name.  As an @profession, you're in more danger out there than you are apparently aware of.

/agree Danger.  You'll be visiting both known and uncharted space, @name.  You never know what creatures or people will be hostile, or predatory.  There are plenty of pirate factions out there too, and they'd like nothing more than to shoot you down /crash and get a free payload of whatever you happen to have in your cargo hold.  Less work for them if you've been mining, too.

branches.text: Whoa.   Alright, you have my attention now.  Seriously.

nodes.text: You ARE going to be exploring, @name.  Exploring is dangerous by it's very nature.  I'm sure you have some idea of how hostile space can be in the known parts of our little bit of the universe. /point What you don't know, however, is what things or people you will face in uncharted areas.

branches.text: I never thought about it like that...   I'm listening.

nodes.text: Your enthusiasm would probably be out of place among explorers like the Jenquai, but you're going to be armed a little bit better than them, so I think I'll call it an advantage here.  Ready to get started?
Good.  I want you to walk over and talk to Don Jose de Sevilla there.  He's going to get you started with the weapon we Terran love the most.  Missiles. /shoot /crash

stages.description: Speak with Don Jose de Sevilla to get started

nodes.text: /wave Hi there, @name.  India says you're ready for your first bit of combat training.  I'm going to teach you how to use missile systems, but we're going to start small first. /chuckle

branches.text: Sounds good, I'm not so sure about this whole combat thing.
Small?  Do I look like a weakling or something?!

nodes.text: /laugh Don't worry.  You'll be fine.  As a matter of fact, as your expertise builds over time, you can potentially become rather formidable!  For now, I'm going to have you try out your standard issue beam weapon though.

branches.text: Alright, so what should I do?

nodes.text: /shocked Geez, relax @name!  You need to switch to Decaf or something. /no If India hears you carrying on like that, you'll be lucky if all she does is remove you from duty. /point Besides, it has nothing to do with weakness or strength, it's about knowing your weapons and their inherant advantages or disadvantages.

branches.text: Tactical, huh?  Alright, I'm in.  What should I do?

nodes.text: Head out to a nav called "Huygens Point".   We have some drones out there, just wandering around day in and day out.  There are two different kinds, so you need to pay attention to what you're shooting at.  Destroy five of the Corral Drones, with your beam weapon, and then come back.

stages.description: Head out to Huygens Point and look for Corral Drones.  Destroy five of them, and return to Don Jose when you are finished.

nodes.text: Attack and destroy 5 Corral Drones.

stages.description: Return to Don Jose de Sevilla on Guiana Space Port for further instruction.

nodes.text: Nice job, @name.  Looks like you had yourself a good time! /laugh

branches.text: A good time?  I got trounced out there!
No problem, that turned out to be cake.

nodes.text: You sure did! /laugh The problem with beam weapons, is they're an up-close and personal kind of weapon.  They're powerful, sure, and they don't require you to carry ammunition.  One thing that's always good to have over an adversary, is range.  Missiles will give you that advantage, and a few more.

branches.text: Advantages are something I could definitely use.

nodes.text: Great! /celebrate It won't always be so easy, though.  Out in open space, and especially in unknown space, it's good to have as many advantages as you can get.  Missiles have a number of advantages to them, not the least of which is range.

Exactly.  Now, I want you to go back out to Huygens Point.   This time, I want you to engage and destroy five of the Achilles Drones.  They're packing slightly better beams than the Corral Drones, /shoot but that isn't going to matter, because you're going to try and off them before they can get in range to fire on you. /thumbs

branches.text: I like the sound of "before they can get in range"...

nodes.text: You'll like the FEELING to.  It feels like winning. /laugh I'm going to have the docking bay crew Set up your ship's computer for missile weapons, and put a shiny new missile launcher in your cargo bay.  Install it, then take this money and buy yourself a stack of missles to load into it. /give  Go out there and make a mess of them! /crash

stages.description: Head back to Huygens Point, but this time, look for Achilles Drones.   Destroy five of them with your new missiles.

nodes.text: Attack and destroy 5 Achilles Drones.

stages.description: Return to Don Jose de Sevilla.

nodes.text: /celebrate Nice!  You picked up the use of missiles pretty quick, @name.  Here, buy yourself something nice for that ship of yours.  /give  I'd say your training was a success!

missions.name: High-Grade Engines for Sale!
missions.summary: Mettan Gunderson(Somerled, Tau Ceti) is willing to teach you about engines when you reach an overall level of 40.

nodes.text: /point Hey there @profession, do you have a few moments to spare? I could use some help and may be willing to teach you something interesting for your time.

branches.text: Maybe... what do you have in mind?

nodes.text: /rude Your loss then, shee, try to give someone a break and they just completely blow you off, what's this galaxy comin' to?
/clap That's what I wanted to hear. You see, I made a bet with Lady DeWinter, its for a vast sum of credits. As such, I need to appropriately bend the outcome in my favor.

branches.text: So, what do you need me to do?
Go against Lady DeWinter, are you crazy?

nodes.text: /panic You don't have to say it so loud! What if she heard you? *whisper* Come back if you change your mind, hear?

/shake_fist She's won for the last time, what I need you to do is go visit Julie Bristol on Earth Station. She'll have some items I need to produce a new line of engine. If you bring them back to me in a hurry so I can get it built and ready before her techs do, then I'll reward you well.

branches.text: I'm a big fan of rewards.

nodes.text: /very_bored I expected as much. Go ahead and get me those items and then we'll talk more.

stages.description: Mettan sent you to talk to Julie Bristol on Earth Station about some parts for a build schematic he has planned.

nodes.text: /take *reading the invoice Mettan sent with you*

branches.text: Hurry it up, lady. I have to get back!

nodes.text: /rude You don't rush genius, @name, but anyway I think I have the gist of this. He'll need the following parts: a Level 2 "Breton" class engine, and the Proton Power Pivot Dual component to make the design he has in mind.

branches.text: So, where do I get those?

nodes.text: You can try looking in the bazaars on stations, or I can give them to you now for the low, low price of 25,000 credits.
/laugh1 Here you go, @profession, may high profits come your way!

stages.description: You obtained the parts from Julie, you now need to rush them back to Somerled Station in New Edinburgh, Tau Ceti

nodes.text: /take Thank you! Now I have the parts, there's just one final part to all of this. Go distract Lady DeWinter while I put this together. Think you can handle that?
/crash Well, on with it. Come back here after she's been sufficiently distracted and I'll reward you for your troubles.

branches.text: Ok, I'll be back in a few minutes.

nodes.text: /agree Be seein' ya!

stages.description: Mettan sent you to talk with Lady Isabel deWinter as a delaying action. Figure out a way to convince or confuddle her long enough for Mettan to modify the engine.

nodes.text: /shake_fist You'd better not be here asking for a handout. I don't like beggars!

branches.text: Actually, that's precisely why I'm here...
No, no you've got me all wrong! I'm just here to talk business.

nodes.text: /explode GET OUT OF MY FACE! I've got important business all over the galaxy and don't have time for the likes of you.

branches.text: I er... wait... I need to.. it's important...

nodes.text: /laugh1 Business you say, well business is my game. What kind of business do you have in mind?

branches.text: er, well... you see I didn't expect you to ask that...

nodes.text: /rude Well what DID you expect? I'm an important businesswoman with a company that spans the entire galaxy.

branches.text: Erhm, well I wanted to see if you liked making money and if you could give me advice on how to do it.
Well, you see.. Mettan sent me. He needed me to delay you so he could beat you at some bet.

nodes.text: /happy2 Did he now... that's interesting, why exactly would you tell me that?

branches.text: Well, I was hoping for a reward of course. I like money, I AM an employee of InfinitiCorp afterall.

nodes.text: /point Money you say, well, money might be arranged if you can prevent him from creating that engine before my prototype is running. But I doubt you can do that.

branches.text: You're right, I probably can't. At least, not without some incentive to do so.
I have no idea how to foil him, he's already manufacturing it now!

nodes.text: /clap Spoken like a true @profession, I'm glad to see the slime pools we have recruiting actually managed to catch a decent specimen for once. In any case, here's 5,000 credits but you needn't fear about distracting me. My engine was ready before I made the bet with Mettan. You've got to understand, I'm a businesswoman. I'm in it for the credits.

branches.text: Interesting, I like the way you think.

nodes.text: /very_bored That's good, because if you didn't I'd just have you killed. Now get out there and earn InfinitiCorp more money!

stages.description: You were successful (sort of), go back to Mettan Gunderson and let him know the good news!

nodes.text: /wave Welcome back @name, did you manage to get deWinter to chase her own tail for a moment?

branches.text: Actually, Mettan, I have something to tell you.

nodes.text: /sick I'm not going to like this am I?

branches.text: Depends, how much are you willing to pay for it?

nodes.text: /shrug That would depend on what you're going to tell me...

branches.text: DeWinter is ahead of you already. Her engine is ready.

nodes.text: /rude Gah! That's definitely not what I wanted to hear. Well, anyway, here's your reward for helping me. A schematic for the Breton Mark III and the ability to construct engines. Congratulations, @profession, you're on the road to the big money now.

missions.name: Trial by Fire
missions.summary: Now put your training to use. See if you can survive a real battle.

nodes.text:
Good, you are here. It is time to test your mettle! You must travel now to the Trial by Fire and fight a Shikari. Only then will you be worthy to continue.
First I will offer you a new reactor that you might have the power needed to utilize your skills. Upgrade your reactor skill and install it in your ship before you go.
Go now and be victorious.

stages.description: Destroy a Bright Shikari.
Return to U'nai Cyrus.

nodes.text: I see you are triumphant! Very good,
I send you off to speak with U'nai Yavin. Go to the Presence Overwhelms and do as you are told. Victory or death, Shinwa!

missions.name: The Presence Overwhelms
missions.summary: Head to the Presence Overwhelms and speak with U'nai Yavin.

nodes.text:
So, U'nai Cyrus has passed you on has he? Well, that must mean you are prepared to learn more advanced arts of combat. Here you will be trained to attack a foe's weak point so that you might inflict heavier damage. 
Are you prepared?

branches.text: Not yet I have something to do.

nodes.text:
Very good! I like an eager student. Now, you must be aware that critical targetting does not constantly produce results, in fact when you first learn it this skill you will find it occuring seldom. As you increase your understanding of the skill, however, you can produce regular devastating results.
But first, you must understand the difference. Go to the Realm of the Daevas and destroy a drone to gauge the difficulty of your opponent.
Do not take long. Every moment you tarry means the death of another Jenquai. Return to me when you are prepared.

stages.description: Destroy a Daeva.
Return to U'nai Yavin.

nodes.text: So, now you see what you are up against. Did you manage to get the feel of your opponent?
Excellent! Now you have learned Critical Targeting, go back to engage another drone. Pay attention to the amount of damage that you inflict. If you are fortunate you will see a great difference.

stages.description: Use Critical Targeting to destroy a Daeva.
Return to U'nai Yavin to finish your task.

nodes.text: That was fast, I trust your new understanding has found example?

branches.text: Yes. I noticed I inflicted more damage that time.
Nope didn't see a difference at all.

nodes.text:
Excellent! Now you are ready to become true Shinwa. 
When you attain an overall level of 10, speak with Dai'Shao Ohanzze at the Final Step of the Shinwa for a promotion and hull refit. 
If you need further combat training, you could head to the Way of the Hunt. Or, you could always head to Jove's Fury and speak with Master Sevti to learn more about our history.

Unfortunate, perhaps when you are in a fight for your life you will realize the potency of this tactic. Go and speak with Dai'Shao Ohanzze when you reach an overall level of 10 , perhaps he will find you ready for advancement.
If you need further combat training, you could head to the Way of the Hunt. Good luck, J'nai!

missions.name: Learn Build Shield Skill
missions.summary: Orkael Lazarra, TT mission for Build Shield, Reward TradeXP, skill (Build Shields), Schematics(Tada-O Not Weak / More Not Weak / Most Not Weak Shield Model X

nodes.text: Hello @profession, welcome to Aganju.

branches.text: Why, thanks! Now, who exactly are you?

nodes.text: /laugh1 I am Orkael Lazarra. A representative of Kinshasa-Mbali station.
/not_sure Maybe, maybe not, depends on who's asking.

branches.text: *laugh* I'm just a trader, nothing more.

nodes.text: /agree Good, well I have a job for you, could be highly profitable in the long run, are you interested?

branches.text: Maybe... but you're gonna have to provide some details first.

nodes.text: /panic What? What kind of details do you want?

branches.text: Details, I mean, you haven't exactly told me WHAT you want done...

nodes.text: /point Well, my idea here is that you can take this here Nommos license, carry it out to Nommos Point, and once there you can hunt up some Nommos to get me some blubber. If you can get me at least 5 pieces of it. It should be fairly easy, Nommos are quite stupid and helpless.

branches.text: But the EarthCorps ships will turn my ship into swiss cheese!

nodes.text: /disagree2 That's why I'm gonna give you the license, see? One o' the perks of bein' a stationmaster is that I can do things like that, and not make you pay the usual 2,000 credit fee to purchase one.

branches.text: Well that's handy, because I wasn't about to pay to help you, I mean I'm a Terran after all... sheesh.

nodes.text: /rude Well, why not, I can teach you interesting things... for fulfilling my quo..errr, I mean handling my request.

Well, I did spend 20 years building shields for Tadakatsu-Obata, what you know as "Tada-Oooooo". I might be able to teach you about shields, and perhaps you might have the capacity to learn shield building yourself. Though I do admit, I doubt you can fulfill the request though.

branches.text: Why do I feel like there is a catch to this?

nodes.text: /point Well, there is one small problem, you see, this blubber will solidify and become useless in 20 minutes after being harvested, you have to bring it back so I can get it processed. Otherwise, you'll have to get some more fresh samples and try again.

branches.text: aha.. there HAD to be something. 20 minutes huh, well, I'll give it a shot.

nodes.text: /thumbs_up Very good, I'll see you when you get back.

stages.description: Orkael Lazarra, station master of Kinshasa-Mbali here in Aganju needs you to get out to Nommos point with the license and retreive 5 Nommos Blubber samples and bring them back to him. The catch: 20 minutes and they spoil.

Hurry, time is ticking away, you need to get back to Orkael on the station and deliver this blubber, if it's too late it'll spoil and you'll have to kill more Nommos! (Should receive schematics for these three shields, this will change when Manu is implemented.)

nodes.text: Welcome back, looks like you made it just in time, it's already starting to congeal! Give it to me! /take

branches.text: Hey hey now, what about the reward you promised!

nodes.text: /rude Just a moment! I need to take care of this before it solidifies. If I don't have my quota in on time Lady DeWinter'll have my head!

branches.text: QUOTA?! You made me do your work!?

nodes.text: /explode Yes I did, what of it?! I'm goin' to teach you something important afterall. Just give me a minute..

branches.text: Well, alright... but hurry up. I can make some serious cash building shields, I need some profit.

nodes.text: ... Alright, done. Now, what you need is to take a look at the manufacturing terminal, I have granted you some schematics from my personal data. These are from a few blueprints for Tada-O shields. They get the job done, and might make a warrior happy to find you so they can buy it. You can also build shields now, just look at the blue prints carefully, shields are fairly simple to create.

missions.name: Flight of the Navigator
missions.summary: Explore the galaxy, you ARE the Navigator! Sander Pauls has you visiting a few places, he says you will come to know something important.

nodes.text: Hello again, @name. I've got something you must learn if you're to be a successful @profession.

branches.text: ...this had better not be as much of a pain as it was the last time..

nodes.text: /disagree2 It won't be. In fact, this time all I want you to do is take a tour. I need you to visit a few places.
To start with... you need to know where the best information in the galaxy is found. Visit Net-7 Station in Saturn.

branches.text: I should know better... but this sounds simple enough.

nodes.text: /clap Off you go then, trust me, in the end this WILL be worth it!

stages.description: Sander said to visit Net-7 to learn about information... or something.

nodes.text: ***Decoding Message*** Hello again @name, this is a coded message left here for you, please now proceed to a station that has a racetrack nearby. If you do, the rewards shall surely be great!

stages.description: The nav had a coded message, it said to be sure to visit a station with a racetrack nearby, it sounds like it could possibly be Friendship 7. Go find and note it's location.

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** Hello again @name, it looks like you've found the second locale. Great job so far Navigator; however, now I need you to visit a station close to Earth that contains a class leader. Good luck on the hunt!

stages.description: Another coded message, he indicated you needed to go to a station near Earth that contained a class leader. The nearest solar system to Sol is Alpha Centauri, the next is Tau Ceti. That means either Hererra in Zweihander, or DeWinter in New Edinburgh.

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** So, you've correctly guessed my clue, very good navigator. Now you must find a trade station associated with Tadakatsu-Obata, commonly known as "Tada-O".

stages.description: You need to visit a station affiliated with the Tadakatsu-Obata in the Beta Hydri system.

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** Good, good, you've arrived. You're almost there, just a little longer now. Next I want you to visit a station that has some serious Psionic interference and has need of devices to defend the population of the station.

stages.description: ...another message. Let's hope Sander actually plotted an end to this... course. This time, to he indicated there was a station with serious Psionic interference, this could be the Psis in 61 Cygni, or there were some rumors about a Jenquai station that had a problem like this.

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** You're proving yourself more efficient than I would've imagined. So you've found another point. That's good, now to really bake your noodle. Visit a station where a bloodbath occurred during a major war of the Earth dwelling species.

stages.description: He said in the last message that you recovered that you must visit a station where a major bloodbath occurred. It's defunct now but he must have been talking about Jove City, or well what's left of it...

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** Good, you found it. I'm impressed... course that's not sayin' too much, I mean they say I'm crazy after all. In any case, your next destination...  A mining station found in the Proxima Centauri system, off with you!

stages.description: A. Mining Station that's in Proxima Centauri. If you visit you might find some useful trade and more importantly: PROFIT! Kind of curious that the message had a period after the A. Was that a mistype in his coded message?

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** Oh, you've found A. Mining Station. I wasn't expecting this.. erhm, next you can visit a highly restricted station in Terran Space. If you guess where that is, you might find something useful.

stages.description: He mentioned a highly restricted station in Terran Space... he must be referring to Margesi Station near Loch Mar which is controlled by the vile GetCo. Hopefully this voyage will end soon! Mental Note: Never do anything for Sander Pauls again...

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** You're becoming a bit of a Nuisance. I'll make this one a little easier. Go to a station that is located in the same sector as the Red Planet. This will be your final test!

stages.description: Final? did that message say Final? My god, this has been a long ride. A station near the Red Planet, he must mean that it is Arx Magister in Mars, Let's go, maximum warp.

nodes.text: *** Decoding Message *** Oi, well you've made it through my obstacle course, I can't think of anywhere else to send you on a wild goose chase... I mean, uh... a useful mission for. Come back to me and I'll reward you for your time.

stages.description: Finally, back to Sander. This reward had better be worthwhile, ugh at all the lost profit taking this much time.

nodes.text: /point Welcome back @name, so what did you think of the sights on my tour? Somerled is nice isn't it? The Proxima Centauri sector is also nice this time of year. /shake_fist You can visit places for trade and to find new customers. It's a handy thing to know if you're going to be a successful @profession.

branches.text: It took FOREVER though, I mean honestly. Time is money after all.

nodes.text: Ah yes, I did forget to tell you, now that your ship's computer has explored some the heuristic software in your map module can now plot routes much more accurately.

/happy2 Well, you see, the whole point of this was for you to learn to navigate. It's all there in your head, now you just figure out how to use it as you go and you'll be able to achieve much more efficient routing and thus be able to move faster when warping and your skills at making shortcuts in your navicomputer will increase.

branches.text: So I can go faster, then?!

nodes.text: Much more so. You will be amazing. Insane even, like ME! Now do you understand?

branches.text: er.. well not insane. I just go insane for more profit. And having said that, what else do I need to do?

nodes.text: /shrug Whatever you'd like to do. You might find some interesting things out there, and if there's anything mega profitable, do drop me a hint sometime. /bow

missions.name: Survival of the Fittest
missions.summary: Sander Pauls aboard Earth Station has a task for you, and if you excel at it, you might learn something useful from him. Then again, he is kind of crazy so you might not.

nodes.text: /crazy Hello @profession, everyone here thinks I'm crazy. What do you think?

branches.text: er.. I, well, no.. I don't think you're crazy. You're just special.

nodes.text: /happy2 That's very good, because I have something important to impart to you, and if you'd said I was crazy I would've just sent you away.

branches.text: I was lying to protect your feelings buddy, you are NUTS!

nodes.text: /rude Get outta here then, I'll not be teachin' you anything.
/happy3 Good good, now I'll be needin' you to go visit Mettan Gunderson on Somerled Station. He will have something I ordered from him and I need it pronto. Now get goin!
/rude I said GO!

stages.description: Sander Pauls sent you to find Mettan Gunderson, he should be in the main lobby of Somerled Station. Go visit him and get Sander's order from him.

nodes.text: /crash Oh hello there, you must be @name. I take it that you're here for the order, huh? Well, it's gonna be 50,000 credits you know! I can't not be making a profit, that would be unwise. I mean DeWinter's just over there, ya know?
/panic Aren't you?! She's terrifying.

branches.text: Well, she is sort of gruff, I guess it would be wise to be scared.

nodes.text: /panic But... no just.. well.. she can have you killed without needing to see or speak to you.

branches.text: Yeah, I'm aware of that. I just have a spine.

nodes.text: That's good, yeah you need to watch out for her, she'll have you in indentured servitude faster than you can say WARP!

branches.text: Yikes, I'll keep that in mind.

nodes.text: Very wise for a such a relatively "young" @profession. Very well, take this and return it to Sander Pauls, I hope you haven't forgotten where he is. DeWinter will be angrier than a Mother Grek after you've raided her nest if this order falls through!

stages.description: Take the order back to Sander Pauls, he's been waiting for it, he might lose focus and forget he sent you if you don't hurry!

nodes.text: /happy2 Welcome back, did you get my order?

branches.text: Yeah, it cost me 50,000 credits. You didn't mention anything about that I notice.

nodes.text: Well you didn't think I was of a mind to give you something for free did you? There is no such thing as a free lunch, @name. /rude

branches.text: What is it exactly that you're going to teach me anyway?

nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, hold yer horses. I still need you to go to Admiral Herrera and take this to him, you need to get it to him then come back to see me.

branches.text: Y'know, I'm really starting to dislike you...

nodes.text: /rude Too bad! Get goin'! Yer on the clock.

stages.description: Oi, now he's made you go take this to Admiral Herrera, time is money... and you're not makin' any.

nodes.text: /happy3 Thank you kindly, @profession. I appreciate you bringing my order to me.

branches.text: You're welcome sir. Thanks for keeping space safe for an enterprising tradesmen like myself.

nodes.text: /wave Here's 50,000 credits for my order, please return the money to 'ole Sander and let'm know that he made my day.

stages.description: ...and now, back to Sander Pauls aboard Earth Station. Hey, at least you got your credits back.

nodes.text: @name, It's about time you got back. /take I'll take that 50,000 credits. Thanks. I needed the profit.

branches.text: Hey! Damn... I'm still out 50,000 credits here, what kinda SCAM is this?

nodes.text: /crazy They say I'm crazy, perhaps I am.

branches.text: Listen up, buddy, I want some compensation for my troubles. If you don't do something, I'll lodge a complaint with DeWinter.

nodes.text: /panic NO! It's okay, FINE... here I'll give you 2,500 credits, and I've had your ship fitted to use it's nanobots to repair your own hull. If you pay attention you might be able to use it to repair your friends in the future... for a price of course.

branches.text: 2500 credits?! ARE YOU OUT OF YOUR MIN.... oh patching a hull? Well that could be useful.

nodes.text: /happy2 That's what I thought. Take what I've taught you and use it for the enhancement of your profit. We'll talk again later.

missions.name: The Final Step of the Shinwa
missions.xml_name: The Final Step of the Shinwa
missions.summary: It is time to recieve your promotion. Speak with Dai'Shao Ohanzee.

nodes.text: Welcome trainee. Now is the time to take your first step into a larger world. You are ready for your first advancement, but first you need a ship that will match that responsibility. Speak with the Shipyard to recieve your first refit. When it is complete, return to me.

stages.description: Talk to the Vishaari Upgrade Yard to recieve your hull upgrade.

nodes.text:
Welcome honored Shinwa, I see you have moved into the realm of D'nai, congratulations! If you will be patient a moment we shall have your ship upgraded to match your new station, it will not take long...
Thus it is done. Fight well, noble warrior.

stages.description: Return to Dai'Shao Ohnazee.

nodes.text:
I see the refit went well, good. Now you are ready. I hereby grant you the title of D'nai, with all the benefits and responsibilities that come with it. Make us proud D'nai @name.
Now you must see Ten'Shao Anala for your first orders.
Dismissed.

missions.name: Learn to Prospect Asteroids
missions.summary: Grants the Prospect skill for Progen Sentinels.

nodes.text: Greetings @name. I am in need of your assistance.

branches.text: What do you need assistance with?
I am too busy to help you.

nodes.text: I am in need of some Iron Ore to repair some Debris Damage to this station. Proceed North of the station, into the Debris Field, and prospect me some Iron Ore.
Come back when you are not so busy.

stages.description: Prospect a few pieces of Iron Ore, North of the station, in one of the Debris Fields.
Refine the Iron Ore, and report back to Tovar Maxe.

nodes.text: As you can see, prospecting is a nice way to get some extra credits. The higher the level of the Ore, the more you receive when selling. Don't forget to go to a Refining Station, this is also very helpful. Also, I believe Fet Rastian is in need of your help.

missions.name: Sha'ha'dem Training
missions.summary: This mission will guide you through your Sha'ha'dem training.

nodes.text: Welcome to the ranks, young aspirant. It is here where you will learn to fight, hide, mine, and discover.

I am giving you a mission to help guide you along your training. Follow it carefully and do your best. 
First speak with Shin-Tzu Li, he will instruct you in prospecting.

stages.description: Complete prospect training with Shin-Tzu Li. Make sure you have your Aspirant's Insignia in your inventory to obtain the mission.
Complete combat training with Sai Siddhun.
Complete review with Sai Siddhun
Talk to Kalas Ben Joseph to continue your training.

nodes.text: Excellent work so far, aspirant. You are now ready to move on to your next section of training. In this section you will learn a new skill that you must use to face your final challenge.

I request that you be at least level 8 before we continue training. Feel free to go outside the station and explore on your own until you have reached level 8 and are ready to report back for more training.

stages.description: Achieve level 8 and complete cloaking training with Kalas Ben Joseph.
Complete your final test with Kalas Ben Joseph. You must be level 10 to receive the mission.
Return the Kalas Ben Joseph to complete your training.

nodes.text: At this note, your aspirant training has come to an end. I have now sent word to upgrade your ship. This will allow you to carry more cargo, and fit another device. It will be finished by the time you are ready to leave.

You deserve it for making it this far. You have received your first hull upgrade. I am pleased to promote you from Aspirant to Initiate.

Before you leave this place, Shin-Tzu Li mentioned he wanted to speak to you about that artifact you found. Also, before you head to the Capella System to explore, talk to me to pick up a mission that will lead you to the Sha'ha'dem leader, Merjan Kathrada. I thought it would be wise for you to converse with her.

                              Good luck, Jenquai.

missions.name: Kill Gorge Larvae
missions.summary: Ketsugo Outpost wants you to kill 8 Gorge Larvae.

nodes.text: Hey there! What are you doing out this way?

branches.text: Looking for a mission, I can fight.

nodes.text: Well, be careful it's kind of dangerous around here...
Better head back to the path, I would hate to have your death on my concience. Fly safe.
So I see. Hey, maybe you could take care of a problem for us?
Ok, come back if you are willing to take a mission. Bye.

Great! We need the sector cleaned up a bit, all sorts of creatures seem to have made nests nearby. Larvae, Spindles, Shusen, and worst of all Zenshai. they mess up shipping lanes and we need to keep them clear.

branches.text: Ok what do you want me to take on first?

nodes.text: Well, lets start with the easy ones. Gorge Larvae can be found wandering around the Net-7 Beacon area. Head to Yokan Beltway 2 and warp towards Yokan, you will bump into it. Kill 8 of them and come back. I will have something for you when you are done.

stages.description: Kill 8 Gorge Larvae out by the Net-7 Beacon.
Return to Ketsugo Outpost to complete the mission.

nodes.text:
Good job @profession! I will make sure the Shinwa know of your efforts. Here is your reward.
When you are ready to take on the next task, just contact us again.
Fly safe!

missions.name: Kill Red Spindles
missions.summary: Ketsugo Outpost wants you to kill 8 Red Spindles.

nodes.text: Hey, welcome back! interested in doing another job for us?

Great! We need you to head out by Yokan Beltway 2, there is a bunch of asteroids just up past the nav. We need you to take out eight Spindles that wandering around there.
I will have a reward when you get back.
Ok come back if you are up for some combat.

stages.description: Kill 8 Red Spindles near Beltway 2.
Return to Ketsugo Outpost to complete the mission.

nodes.text: Your back! I take it you managed to deal with those Spindles?
Fantastic! Here are some creds and I will pass on the good news to the Shinwa.

branches.text: Great! Could use these. See you later.

nodes.text: Not sure, let me check my sources and see if there is something for you. Contact me in a bit.
Couldn't we all! Ok, contact me later to see if I have something more for you.

missions.name: Kill Shusen
missions.summary: Ketsugo Outpost wants you to kill 6 Shusen Bullies.

nodes.text: Hi there @name. We have a bit of a problem with these Shusen buzzing the station every so often. Could you take care of a few for us?
Ah, that's too bad. We could really use the help. Contact me if you change your mind.

Great! Go take care of eight of them for us, ok?
Just come right back when you are done and I will have something for you.

stages.description: Kill 6 Shusen Bullies near the Outpost.
Return to Ketsugo Outpost to complete the mission.

nodes.text: Hey youre pretty good at pest extermination! Thanks for the help.

I bet it was. Anyway, here is your reward. I will be speaking to the Shinwa later so I will mention you helping us out. Thanks again! 
Come back when you have some time, we have a serious problem we need handled.

missions.name: Kill Zenshai
missions.summary: Ketsugo Outpost wants you to kill 6 Zenshai Explosive Nappers.

nodes.text: Ok. We have a serious problem facing us in Yokan. Now, you have done some great work for us in the past but this one is kinda serious. Are you up for it?

branches.text: I really can't help at the moment. Perhaps later.

nodes.text: Sure. Come back when you have time we could really use your help, and I will throw in something extra if you manage to deal with our problem.
Well, we have had some strange ships buzzing the asteroids down past Nav P4. They have attacked anyone coming in range and have a configuration we have not encountered before.

branches.text: Hmmm can't help out right now.

nodes.text: Sure. Come back when you have time we could really use your help, and I will throw in something extra if you manage to deal with our problem.

Great! But be careful. The Shinwa have expressed a concern about these ships, apparently they are very dangerous and shoot first if you know what I mean. Take out six of them and come back to report your findings and I will throw something extra in it for you.
Be careful.

stages.description: Kill 6 Zenshai Explosive Nappers near Saiseki asteroid.
Return to Ketsugo Outpost to complete the mission.

nodes.text: Well?! What were they? Did they leave?

branches.text: Not really. They seem to be looking for something.

nodes.text: Hrmmm. Did you manage to find out anything about them?

branches.text: Yeah they hit like an iron Progen.

nodes.text: Hahaha, I bet. How about armament? Did they use missiles?

branches.text: Energy weapons, nothing I have seen before.

nodes.text: Realy? Thats funny, my scanners detected some massive explosions out that way. Maybe if we try this again you will find out something.
I see. Well, I will download the data from your computer and send it on to the Shinwa, maybe they can make something of this. In the meantime I bet you are looking for your reward?
Ok! Here you go, and a little something extra for your troubles. Had this old Eagle Wing from a trader who passed through a year ago. Might come in handy for you, as well as these creds.

Don't mention it, you did great work, I am sure the Shinwa will agree. 
That pretty much takes care of the problems out here. Of course we would not mind you patroling around if you need to stretch your wings a bit. Can't really give you anything for it unfortunately but the help sure would be appreciated.
Anyway, you take care. Bye now.

missions.name: Nishin Teaches the Build Reactor Skill
missions.xml_name: Nishin Teaches the Build Reactor Skill
missions.summary: Learn Build Reactor from Nishon Si'imr on Paren.

nodes.text: I see in your eyes, you have need of my teachings. What will it be this time?

branches.text: I wish to learn how to build reactors.

nodes.text:
Ahhh. Now comes the time when Sha'ha'dem become Sharim, hmmm?
Very well, my fee of 2500 credits should not pain you much in light of the profit you stand to make with this talent. Speak to me again when you are ready to learn.
Then why did you bother me at all! Shoo.

stages.description: Speak to Nishin Si'imr to learn Build Reactor.

nodes.text: Now you understand the fundamentals of storing and distribution of energy. Many will seek you out from here on as we Jenquai hold the secrets of crafting the best reactors in the galaxy.

Good. GOOD?! It will be magnificent! You will not only profit from this but you will also be able to learn the secrets of technology not yet known. 
Good. BAH! Go now. I am done with you. /rude

missions.name: Nishin Teaches the Environmental Shield Skill
missions.xml_name: Nishin Teaches the Environmental Shield Skill
missions.summary: Learn the Environmental Shield Skill from Nishin Si'imr on Paren.

nodes.text: You again? What is it now? Wait, don't tell me. You wish to know how to shield your ship from the rigours of space, is that it?

branches.text: Nope, don't want anything actually. HAH!

nodes.text: Then nothing is what you will get.

Simple. You have learned everything else I could teach you. Heh.
Well enough antics, let's get to business shall we?

Unlike Scan, this skill relies a lot on trimming and refining your technology. Boosting energy to the shields when needed, jinking to avoid solar flares and so on. But also it relies on your sense of timing. When to boost shields and how quickly you react to the flares, you see?
Hmmm, don't talk much do you?

*Sigh*
Ok, you know the drill, Pay me 10,000 credits.

stages.description: Talk to Nishin Si'imr on Paren Station.

nodes.text: Thus you now know all I have to teach. So I guess you won't be bugging me any more, eh?
Well at least you don't talk my ear off. Off you go then. Go seek the mysteries of the universe, and don't forget who your friends are when you are rich and famous... /laugh

missions.name: A Usefull Colleque
missions.summary: Just being helpful

nodes.text: Oh I didn't expect to see a @race out here. Oh I guess I shouldn't be too surprised. Everyone seems to be everywhere now days. Why just last week I saw......
Yes! Cleaning bots all over the place! They are so cute I wish I had one

branches.text: I could go get you one.

nodes.text: No thanks, but if you really want to help me I could use someone to deliver a message.
Take this message to Shou Tzu. You can find him at Arx Ymir in Aragoth.
Be quick about it.

stages.description: Take Kaitya's message to Arx Ymir

nodes.text: What?!

branches.text: I have a message for you from Kaitya Neely.

nodes.text: Who are you to bring me anything? Are you an infiltrator? What is your true purpose for coming here?

branches.text: I promise, it is only this note for you.

nodes.text: I tell you what. Go out and collect 5 tails from the Castor monsters. Once you have them bring them back. Then I will decide if you can be trusted.

branches.text: All this for a note? Seems a bit odd to me!

nodes.text: Its either this or I have you destroyed! Maybe I should anyways!

branches.text: No, you shouldn't. I will be back with the Tails.

nodes.text: Go!

stages.description: Kill LVL 40 Charon Monsters in Charon. Obtain 5 tails from a Charon Monster
Return to Arx Ymir

nodes.text: Have you returned with what I asked for? Or shall I call upon my henchmen now?

branches.text: I have what you requested Tzu.

nodes.text: Now, what was it that you came to see me about. Make it quick, I haven't got the time for the likes of you!

branches.text: I have a note for you from Kaitya Neely.

nodes.text: So be it. Give me the note and be gone with yourself before you disappear for good.

stages.description: MISSION UPDATE: Return to Kaitya Neely

nodes.text: It's about time, I was beginning to think you gave up.
Here take this for your trouble. It'll let Drostan McClure know you are one of us.

He's over there in the corner. He's a member of the Red Dragons, he has some things that the Red Dragons have designed and manufactured that you might be interested in. Give him my card and he will let you view his stock.
I have to warn you though you can only us it once.

missions.name: "The Sparks"
missions.summary: Discover what the sparkely mobs near Pluto are.

nodes.text: Have you seen those bright flashes over by Pluto? I wonder what's causing them; I see them all day long while meandering around the station here.

branches.text: I haven't noticed Bao-Zhai, seems as though I would have though.

nodes.text: I think they are fascinating no matter what they are, I'm sure you would too if you saw them. I have so much time on my hands here; I bet I could make something pretty fabulous with something that sparkled like that. Would you mind going out and seeing what they are for me?

branches.text: Not at all, it has my curiosity going as well now.

nodes.text: Hurry

stages.description: Fly out to Pluto Path 2 and monitor  Charon Sparks
Return to Bao-Zhai

nodes.text: Oh @name your back. Did you find out what is out there that shines the way it does?

branches.text: I don't exactly know what they are, they seem to gather most near Charon though.

nodes.text: I think we should call these Charon Sparks then. It only fits if you ask me, sparkly cute things. Thanks again for finding out what those pretty colors were. I wonder if we were to get a hold of a few what we could do with them. If it wouldn't be too much of a hassle, do you think you could go get me some samples of them?

branches.text: That seems easy enough, I would like to see what can be done with them as well.

nodes.text: But be careful with them.

stages.description: Collect 10 tails from Charon Sparks
Return to Bai-Zhai

nodes.text: Wow @name I knew getting a @race to help was a good idea. It seems that you have found the source of the sparkle in the tails! You know what this would make. This would make an excellent disco ball!

branches.text: You want to make a disco ball from them?

nodes.text: I will certainly find other uses from them, but the sparkle certainly is magnificent!

missions.name: Strange Things
missions.summary: Strange things are happening around Pluto

nodes.text: Welcome back @race! I see my earlier conversation with you has struck some interest!?

branches.text: I was wondering about the strange things you talked about.

nodes.text: Ahh. I knew you would be back, haven't spoken to anyone yet that wasn't interested in the strange things going on around here.

Well, nobody is certain what is going on. Some have speculated that there is a mysterious ore out there that the Charon Sparks are eating to get their power. Others have speculated that their power is coming from a much larger source, possibly a mother Spark.

branches.text: A mother Spark wouldn't be so bad.

nodes.text: You wouldn't think it would be bad, but at the same time there have been hundreds of people venture out to find the truth that never returned. We know that something is out there, and that the something isn't very nice.

branches.text: I would like to search for the truth.

nodes.text: Did you not hear what I just said.? It wasn't one or two; it was hundreds that have vanished. Never to be seen again. With knowing that how would one want to even go out and explore this forsaken sector?

branches.text: Do we know where they were when the vanished?

nodes.text: I've been talking with a few good friends about this; all we know for certain right now is that all of them had californium ore on them. Most of them were hired hands here at the station, sent to collect the californium to help provide power.

branches.text: So first I need to get californium ore?

nodes.text: If you're willing to accept the fate of the others then yes. Go out and gather californium. I will continue to talk to others around the station to see if I can find anything else out.

branches.text: I will return when I have it.
No thanks I'm not really into ores

nodes.text: And for Pete's sake be careful.
Ok I'll be here if you change your mind

stages.description: Fly to surrounding area and mine 5 californium ore.
Return to Terance

nodes.text: I didn't think you would return. I thought that possibly the fate that others had found would had deterred you from taking on this task. Do you have the californium?

branches.text: I have 50 I hope it's enough.

nodes.text: So be it then. I have spoken to several of my closer friends. All have heard rumors of a creature, a monster of sorts that as been lurking around the inner area of Pluto's Paths. We have advised all of our station help to avoid this area. We think that what is causing the disappearances is there.

branches.text: Should I go and see what I can find out?

nodes.text: You certainly are a brave soul, and I think that no matter what I say now you will find yourself there. If you truly want to find what is causing the disappearances then yes, but I beg of you to be as safe as possible, and run if it dictates.  Unfortunately you'll have to wait to finish this mission.
Yes

missions.name: HELPING TO REGAIN CONTROL
missions.summary: Help Frank Siebeta regain control of Mercury sector.

nodes.text: Welcome to Star Clipper Station young @race. As you can see things are starting to pick up again. In the far past this used to be a booming area. We had everything from miners to scientists running around here.

During the mining on the surface Mercury the mantle, or crust of the surface was damaged and a huge crack was produced. When the crack produced creatures came pouring out and attacked and killed everything in sight. The area was evacuated until recently. Now we are trying to study the creatures and find a way to remove them so that we can take advantage of the resources that are here.

branches.text: What is being done to remove them?

nodes.text: Currently we have scientists on the station that are conducting studies to find out what the creatures weaknesses and strengths are. We are hoping to find a solution soon.

branches.text: Is there anything I can help with?

nodes.text: There is always room for help, and help is always welcomed here.
Speak with Frendlo Mecnavi, he is the leading scientist in charge of studying the creatures. Once you have helped him out then return to me and I will find something more you can help with.

stages.description: talk to me again

nodes.text: Don't take too long
