missions.name: SUN DIVER STUDIES
missions.summary: Help Frendlo Mecnavi study the Sundivers

nodes.text: Savvy to see you around these parts. I see you have met Frank Siebeta, he's the man around here. Nothing happens without that man knowing it!

branches.text: He said you may have something you need help with.

nodes.text: Like I said. the man knows everything. Well. In fact there is something you can help me out with. Currently I'm studying the Sun Divers near the atmosphere of the planet. Hoping to find more out about them, their weaknesses mainly, you know. So we can eliminate them.

Well, since you put it that way, yes. We want to get rid of them. You see that's the only reason I'm here. I used to be a scientist in a lab on earth, was studying the extinction of different species and then got pulled away from that to do the research here. I only want to finish so I can return home.

branches.text: Well, I am here to help.

nodes.text: Let's get straight to work then. In order to find some information out about these Sun Divers I will need you to bring me back 10 of them alive!
Ok. ok. I was pulling your leg. I need samples from them though. There are 4 different types of slop that they release when they are killed. I need for you to collect a sample of each type of slop.

branches.text: I can do that for you easy enough.

nodes.text: Return to me once you have obtained them. They only remain stable for a short time before they are no longer any good to me.

stages.description: Kill Sundiver Val
Kill Sundiver Cal
Kill Sundiver Sal
Kill Sundiver Hal
Return to Frendlo Mecnavi

nodes.text: @name, your back! Let me see the slop samples! I must get these in the tester quick so that I can break down the molecular structure of them before they become unstable.
Outstanding! This is exactly the evidence I was looking for! Thank you very much for helping me with this, you don't know how much of a service you have done yourself and the Highport Authority
I don't have much to give you for your help but here is what I can give you.

missions.name: SUN MINER STUDIES
missions.summary: Help Frendlo Mecnavi study Sunminers

nodes.text: @name, your previous research has left me wanting more. I suspect there is a connection between the Sun Divers and Sun Miners. Would you be willing to help me out once again to retrieve some slop from the Sun Miners that are around the atmosphere of Mercury?

branches.text: I would be more than willing to help.

nodes.text: They contain only two types of slop. They are different from the Sun Divers slop but only slightly. I'm thinking that what was missing in the Sun Diver slop tests will be found in the Sun Miners slop. So get out there and collect the two samples for me. Hurry back though; I fear that these may become unstable quicker than the Sun Divers.

To ensure that you get them back quick enough I'm going to have to put a time limit to get this done. We will set it at twenty minutes. That will only allow me ten minutes to test the samples, but I should be able to get them done in time.

stages.description: You now have 20 minutes to collect the 2 types Destroy SumMiner Lou
Destroy SunMiner Bou
Report back to Frendlo Mecnavi

nodes.text: Now that is some unbelievable work @name. You managed to get the samples and return to me in record time. Ok, let's place the samples in to the tester and see what we get.
Ok. yes. yes. just as I expected. Ohh. ummm.

Well, I thought at first that there were differences between the molecular structures of the individual creature's even if ever so slightly. But it appears that they are identical in every way. That cannot be though. You see every species has something that separates them and makes them unique. If these two are identical then everything about them would be, to include the way they look and react to things.

branches.text: They both reacted to me the same way.

nodes.text: Of course they did, any creature that feels threatened or wants to protect its domain will react that way. I'm talking more about the social habits of them.

I apologize, I tend to get carried away when analyzing something so interesting. I would like to again thank you for the help you have provided me. This certainly will help me find what I have been looking for, and once that is done I can finally go back home to earth.

missions.name: Conducting Covert  Operations
missions.summary: Help Frank Siebeta regain control of Mercury sector

nodes.text: Welcome back @name! I just wanted to thank you again for helping out Frendlo Mecnavi. He was able to find out some excellent information with the samples you provided him.
Well, nothing particularly, although he thinks he may have found out something about when the creatures leave the heated planet and atmosphere then they cannot survive the cold outer space areas.

branches.text: Well that certainly sounds as though it's a step in the right direction.

nodes.text: It certainly is. While you are here, would you mind helping me out with another task?

Out near Helios Major there are some Red Dragon Pirates. They have been disrupting our attempts to collect minerals and harvest the asteroids in the area. It is one of the small area's we have left here to sustain our supplies. Would you mind going out and investigating the area for me? I just want to know what they are up to.

branches.text: I will certainly go out and investigate for you!

nodes.text: Excellent! Fly out to Helios Major and watch the Pirates to see what they are doing then return to me. And be careful, they have already destroyed several others that we have sent to investigate.

stages.description: Fly to Helios Major, and observe Red Dragons
return to Frank Siebeta

nodes.text: @name your back, I was starting to get worried when I didn't hear back from you. I regret even sending you out there now thinking back. Were you able to come up with any good information?

branches.text: They seem to be mining for a certain mineral, it looked like Platinum.

nodes.text: That would make sense. You see, our solar arrays are run partially on Platinum, and we have noticed a diminishing amount available to us even though it used to be in such abundance that it was amazing.

branches.text: What are they going to do with it?

nodes.text: I'm not certain @name. But I intend to keep an eye on them to find out.

missions.name: Reclaiming Helios Major
missions.summary: Help Frank Siebeta Reclaim Helios Major

nodes.text: @name we have generated circumstantial evidence that the Pirates at Helios Major are taking the platinum with the intention of making it impossible for us to power our bots and even this station. At the rate they are going now the platinum available will only last us another few months.

branches.text: Anything I can do to help stop them?

nodes.text: That is the question I was hoping to hear from @name. We need to start disposing of the miners out there. If we can disrupt them enough then this may deter them away from their original plans.

branches.text: I would be happy to go disrupt the miners for you.

nodes.text: You are a godsend @name. If you would I will reward you handsomely. If you could go out and kill just 10 of them it would help the cause.
Return to me when you have gotten rid of them.

stages.description: Fly to Helios Major and kill 10 Red Dragon Miners
Return to Frank Siebeta

nodes.text: @name, again you did the Highport Authority a great service. My miners are already out there informing me that they are accessing the harvestable's much easier now.

branches.text: They seem to be building up their forces with more combat related ships as well.

nodes.text: Thank you for the information, I will tell my miners to watch their backs out there. Hopefully we don't have more problems out there, but I foresee a lot more to come.

missions.name: ENERGY PHOENIXES FOR POWER
missions.summary: Help Srefin Milken in her quest to harness the power of the Energy Pheonix

nodes.text: Yes? Yes? Ok. you have got to stop staring at me that way. Is this some kind of sexual harassment? I've had it with this place and all the sexual harassment!

branches.text: No ma'am. I'm just here to see if you need help with anything.

nodes.text: Is this some kind of trick? People just don't walk around this desolate place asking to help.

branches.text: I'm interested in helping change this place back to what it once was.

nodes.text: I'm touched! Truly touched. So you think you want to help, not sure why anyone would want to help with this place. If you really want to help then go out and get me the tainted remnants from the energy phoenix's. I need 10 of them. I will see how much you want to help when and if you return!

stages.description: Kill Energy Phoenixes until you collect 10 Tainted Remnants
Bring the Remnants to Srefin Milken

nodes.text: Shocked I tell you! I think you're the first person to actually return.  Let me see the remnants. Even more shocked. You actually did what you said you would.

branches.text: I told you I wanted to help.

nodes.text: Well I applaud you for doing so. Still not so certain why you would want to help this place.

branches.text: This used to be a beautiful area from what I understand.

nodes.text: It most certainly was.

branches.text: What were the tainted remants for?

nodes.text: As you probably know, the solar arrays scattered throughout the area require Platinum and Osirium in order run proficiently. I'm working on a way that we can use these creatures as an alternative source for power. I think it will be an excellent way for us to clear some of the clutter throughout our surroundings.
It will be as long as I can get it to work correctly. Thank you for your help and for now you have earned my respect.

missions.name: Return To Frank Siebeta
missions.summary: Complete Frank's mission

nodes.text: Welcome back @name! I see that you have successfully helped out Frendlo Mecnavi. I certainly hope that he was able to find some missing information on the creatures.

branches.text: I'm certain he will. What was all the debris out there?

nodes.text: Those were old solar arrays that were used to power the bots we had doing work on the planet and in the upper atmosphere. When the creatures were released they destroyed most of them though.

branches.text: Is there any efforts to remove them?

nodes.text: Speak to Jonac Frotlin about that one. She has been working on cleaning up, although she has had many problems with the creatures.

missions.name: Testing the Phoenix Bomb
missions.summary: Help Srefin Milken dispose of her bomb.

nodes.text: @name, you have come back just in time. I was working on the alternative source of power and somehow I have created this. It seems to be having some extremely violent reactions. I'm afraid that it may explode at any moment. If this thing explodes then I'm certain the entire station would be destroyed. Could you take it and dispose of it for me?
I would take it out near Clarke Docks and explode it as close to the moon as possible.
Return to me when you're complete.

stages.description: Take bomb to Clarke Docks and detonate it.
Return to Srefin Milken

nodes.text: Ohh thank goodness. You managed to dispose of it before it exploded. I had started to worry when it took you a little while to return. Did the bomb explode?

branches.text: When I jettisoned it out it didn't do anything.

nodes.text: Nothing happened at all?

branches.text: It continued to do the same thing it was, the FreeSpacer's in the area quickly picked it up and that was the last I saw of it.

nodes.text: Very odd, from the reaction that it was having it should have exploded. I must look into this more. And even more strange is the fact that the FreeSpacer's picked it up. Come back and see me later, I may need your help once again.

missions.name: Pirate Vendor
missions.summary: You can now use me

nodes.text: What?

branches.text: Kaitya said give this to you.

nodes.text: Make it quick

stages.description: finish mission

nodes.text: Don't come back
Tell no one about me.

missions.name: Solar Arrays Need Fixin
missions.summary: Help Jurago Ardregen fix the solar arrays.

nodes.text: You know, I can't do much around here but scratch my head and wonder how this place is still going!

All of these solar arrays around here have been completely destroyed by the Sun creatures and they expect me to fix them all. And I for the world of me just can't get it done with the supplies I have.

branches.text: Anything I can do to help?

nodes.text: Well, certainly if you're willing to lend a hand. You see, I have to rebuild the absorption material for the solar arrays in order to get them working again.  There is plenty of it available but I just can't seem to get my hands on enough to even fix one of this things.

branches.text: What is it that you need?

nodes.text: To fix just one solar array I need 200 osirium, not a huge amount but obviously more than I have lying around. You wouldn't happen to be willing to help me out here would you? You know it would be greatly appreciated by the Highport guys around here.

branches.text: I can round that up in no time for you Jurago.

nodes.text: You are a man among. well among a lot of things out there.

stages.description: Harvest 200 Osirium
Return to Jurago Ardregen

nodes.text: Welcome back @name! Were you able gather me up some osirium?

Marvelous my friend! Absolutely marvelous! Now I can get this absorption material made and finally get one of these solar arrays working again. You don't understand how much help you have provided me today! Here's a little something for helping out!

missions.name: Parts Assembly For Solar Arrays
missions.summary: Gather the parts needed make a Solar Array

nodes.text: Hello again @name! It's good to see you back so soon. I could really use your help again!

I created the absorption material that is needed for the solar arrays but I need the parts put together. Could you possibly go out and grab one of the solar arrays for me and bring it back so that I can put it together?

Ok, but I need a certain one first, you see it's the one that provides the main power to the station here. It should just be right outside of the station somewhere. Go out there and fetch it for me please.
Be carefull out there

stages.description: Undock from station and find Solar Array.
Return to Jurago

nodes.text: Now that was fast! Hopefully it wasn't too much of a burden finding it out there!

branches.text: It was a little hidden, but no biggie.

nodes.text: Well, what matters is that you found it and its here now! Ok, let's see here. I need to place this here and just shimmie this in and. You know, this isn't as easy as the manual says it would be. Think you could do me one more favor and put this stuff together?
Ok, here is the absorption material and the solar array, there's a terminal just inside the other room. Ohh... Almost forgot, here's the schematic for building it too. Hurry back now!

stages.description: Take materials to Solar Maker and have Powered Solar Array Assembled

nodes.text: Ok let me have them
All done.

stages.description: Return to Jurago

nodes.text: Oh goodness, you certainly do work with great speed. I only wish at my age I could move so fast and be able to fit such small parts together. My fingers just aren't what they used to be. I will have one of the station workers place this back outside where it goes! Thanks again for your help. and here's a little something for you!

missions.name: Fixin the Solar Arrays
missions.summary: Part 2 of Solar Array Mission

nodes.text: Hello there @class. You look like you're a little pretty @race. I bet you don't much get out and see things. probably have a nice little tidy office that you sit in all day, huh?

And you expect me to believe that, you don't have an drop of grease or dirt on you, huh? A real @race would be covered in filth. Always digging for this, or killing this creature. building this and dismantling that. That's what a real @race does, huh?
So you do. do you? How about this then, I have this here Powered Solar Array that needs to be taken out and hooked up! Think you can handle that with your pretty little outfit, huh?
Well see about that, take this and find the solar array near Clarke's Docks. Swap it out with the Solar Array that's there now, then come back here and let me know how you faired!

stages.description: Take to Clarke's Docks and deploy.
Return to Ugarina Pletu.

nodes.text: So your back are you. Looky there! You have a speckle of grease on your shirt! You might want to go take a shower now!

branches.text: I think I will be ok!

nodes.text: Well @race. I'm impressed. A pretty dressed @race that can actually do some work.  I don't have much lying around here to give you for doing that, so take what I got. If you feel like getting a little dirty again come back and see me! I have more work around here than I can handle on my own.

missions.name: PLATINUM FOR POWER
missions.summary: Collecting platinum to power the station

nodes.text: You came back did you? I never asked you your name, so give it to me, huh?
Well @name, it's a pleasure to have you back, huh? You come back wanting to see what else you could do, huh? I think I have something that's right up your alley, huh?

branches.text: Yes sir, I'm here to offer my assistance.

nodes.text: Well, since you got a little dirty for me before, I got something that will really get you dirty now, huh? I need a stock load of Platinum. These new solar arrays that I'm building here are just taking way too much you know, huh?

Don't get smart with me you pretty little @race. I'm asking you do help me out again here, huh? This time I have a little more to offer you too, huh? I need about 150 Platinum in order to mold these here solar arrays the proper way, huh? Think you can go out and find me that many, huh?

branches.text: Would be glad too. dirty boy!

nodes.text: Don't get sassy with me @name! I'm the one doing the real work here, getting all this grease and dirt all over me. head to toe, huh? Now get out there and get the platinum. I need in before I come to a work stoppage, huh?

stages.description: Harvest 150 Platinum
Return to Ugarina Pleto

nodes.text: Looky there looky there. now that's more how a @race should look. Mining in those fields getting the dust flowing all over! You're starting to look like you're more of a worker each time I see you, huh? Ok, let's take a look here, huh? That will do er, huh?
Yes, it's certainly a start, huh? Well, as promised, huh? Here is that something better I promised you @name. Come back and see me again, just in case I need some more platinum or something, huh?

missions.name: OSIRIUM FOR POWER
missions.summary: Mine Osirium

nodes.text: Welcome back there @name! Looks as though you're starting to look nice a pretty again, huh? You come back to get dirty, huh? If so, I've got just the task for you to help me out with, huh?

Well, you see, huh? That platinum just isn't holding together like it's supposed to, huh? So I need me an equal amount of Osirium to get the mixture just right, huh? Think you could go out and find me some of that, another 150 of that and it will be golden, huh?

branches.text: Like I said, I'm here to help. huh?

nodes.text: You mocking me again @name! I don't take kindly to that kind of hostilities, huh?
Alright then, huh? Just need to be making sure, does us no good mocking each other, huh? Now get out there and get that Osirium.

stages.description: Harvest 150 Osirium.
Return to Ugarina Pletu

nodes.text: Well there you go then! Let's melt that down and add it to the platinum and see what we got, huh? Looks like it's going together perfectly there @name. I certainly do appreciate your help, huh?
Had enough of what. you getting tired of being dirty. I knew you were an office @class.

branches.text: Not at all. Why in the world do you say "huh" after nearly everything?

nodes.text: Huh?

branches.text: Just like that... you did it again.

nodes.text: I'm not sure what you're talking about @name, huh?
Huh?

branches.text: I think I will just be on my way now.

nodes.text: Ok then @name. Well I certainly appreciate all the help you provided me. Keep me stocked up nice and good for some time to come, huh? For your honest days. o dirty day's work I got something extra special for you, huh? Come back and see me again sometime.

missions.name: TRASH CLEANUP
missions.summary: Clean up Mercury

nodes.text: Hey there partner! I've seen you corralling around here for a while now! Think you can help a fellow cowboy out?

branches.text: I'm no cowboy. neither are you!

nodes.text: Thems fightin words son! I will pull out my six shooter and call you to a draw!
That's my pistol! I call her Gloria! She'll blow a hole clean through ya!

branches.text: So will my weapon of choice!

nodes.text: And what's that partner? Some silly little projectile, laser or missile launcher. None of those got anything on good old Gloria!

branches.text: If you say so Jonac, You got anything that can earn a "Cowboy" a few bucks around here?

nodes.text: So that's what you came for, you've been going around the station asking for money, you some kind of station bum cowboy? I tell you what; I got something you can do to earn a nice pretty buck! You up to it?

There's some trash out there close to the atmosphere of Mercury that those Sundivers keep dropping everywhere, been working on getting it cleaned up, but always need some help. How about you go out there, kill about 5 of those Sundiver Croush's and bring thier debris back to me cowboy, and I give ya a shiny nickel.
Then get out there and get it done cowboy! Time's a wasting!

stages.description: Kill 5 Sundiver Croush near Mercury Atmosphere, bring the debris back to Jonac.
Kill 4 Sundiver Croush near Mercury Atmosphere, bring debris back to Jonac.
Kill 3 Sundiver Croush near Mercury Atmosphere, bring debris back to Jonac.
Kill 2 Sundiver Croush near Mercury Atmosphere, bring debris back to Jonac.
Kill 1 Sundiver Croush near Mercury Atmosphere, bring debris back to Jonac.
Return to Jonac Frotlin

nodes.text: I see you managed to get er done there cowboy! Makes me want to shoot my six shooter into the air! Although. might not be the best of idea's inside this here station partner, so I think I'll refrain myself this time. Well, let's see here, I'll just place these right back here, gonna have to figure out how to dispose of these sometime. maybe melt into bullets for me six shooter!

branches.text: If that's what you have to do "Partner"

nodes.text: Just might have to sonny, got figure out a way to get rid of em! Thanks again for your help! If you find yourself back in the neighborhood swing on by and maybe I'll have something more for you to do! Have a good one cowboy!

missions.name: CLARKE DOCKS
missions.summary: Pick up the trash

nodes.text: Welcome back cowboy! Woohoo! Let's go saddle us up some horses and ride off into the sunset!
You ever been to earth sonny?

branches.text: Sure haven't, born and raised in space.

nodes.text: Poor soul! You would love riding a horse, wind in your face! Nothing but nature all around you!

branches.text: Sounds like growing up around the manes. always tried to ride them too!

nodes.text: You tried to ride a Manes! You're no cowboy, your downright insane partner! Well, if your ever down to earth! Look up my partner Jesse. he will teach the ropes of the cattle. So, let's get to business, whatcha here for?

branches.text: You told me there may be more work to do.

nodes.text: That I did partner, at work is all I seem to have right now. Good old Frank Siebeta over there, the Big Guy here on station. Has forced me to change direction and get the area around Clarke's Docks cleaned up A.S.A.P. for some reason. So I have bunches of debris out there, just need to bodies to divert there and get it cleaned up. You willing to help out with that cowboy?
That's the spirit! Head on out there and saddle me up 5 pieces of that debris! That will get things started off just right! Now get out there cowboy! Times a wasting!

stages.description: Harvest 5 debris in the area around Clarke's Docks
Return to Jonac Frotlin

nodes.text: There ya go cowboy! Let me toss these back here with the rest. I'm telling ya, I need to figure out a way to get rid of this stuff! Gonna have to toss this around in my noggin for a little while. Thanks for helping me out cowboy! Here's a little something for your time. Come back and see me, maybe I will figure out what to do with this debris! It's starting to clutter up the station now, only a matter of time before Frank gets on me!

missions.name: DEPLOY TRASH INTO PLANET
missions.summary: Get rid of the trash

nodes.text: Welcome back there cowboy! I think I've figured out what to do with this here debris that's been collecting! Frank has really been on my back about it! You see, all we got to do is jettison it into the atmosphere of Mercury and it will burn up and there you go! Gone!

branches.text: That sounds like a fantastic idea!

nodes.text: I have compressed 5 pieces of debris into 1, so that makes much less work for us. Think you can run one out there and burn it up partner?

branches.text: Would be glad to help out.

nodes.text: Well there ya go then! Makes me want to pull my six-shooter out again! Just get nice an close, then jettison it out and come on back here.

stages.description: Take debris and jettison it into Mercury atmosphere
Return to Jonac Frotlin

nodes.text: Woohoo partner! I could see that flame burning up from here! Almost looked like a bullet shooting through the sky! Well done partner! Come back again to help out later if your feeling up to it!
See ya soon Cowboy!

missions.name: Biorepression Techniques
missions.summary: Jed Raster, (Jagerstadt, Zweihander, Alpha Centauri) has a task for you, visit to find out what he needs. You might even learn something from this if you pay attention!

nodes.text: /shake_fist Oi there! You. Do you hear the voices? /panic They're scary. /not_sure
/disagree1 I don't believe you. /shrug
/laugh1 Because, I don't want to of course. Thought I was crazy, yeah?
/self This is my particular form of Biorepression, but hey, I'm a desk-jockey. It keeps people from giving me extra work, so I just pretend that I'm off my rocker. /shrug

branches.text: Really? What do you actually do for EarthCorps?

nodes.text: /point I train pilots like you for the use of Biorepression. It's a handy ability to give you an edge over any organic opponent you'll meet.
/rude Let's put it this way, it's not something you'd want to be without when facing something large and squishy, like one of those horrid Nagifar creatures found in the Nifleheim Cloud.

branches.text: Well I'm not interested in that anyway.
Alright, what do I have to do to learn this?

nodes.text: Off yer go then. /sick

/clap Well, I'll tell yer what. I like the meat from Gull Wings, so how about you go get me some from the gulls outside and save me hiring someone else for it and I'll let you get around the normal requirements. What do ya say? I'll need at least 10 wings. /laugh2

stages.description: Go get Jed some Gull Wings, he likes the meat and doesn't have the time to come out himself. You'll need at least 10 wings for his planned recipes. He said he'll get you around the normal requirements to earn Biorepression.

nodes.text: Here you go!

stages.description: Return to Jed Raster with his supplies.

nodes.text: /take Thank you for the wings, but I'm afraid I'm going to need you to go get about 10 more. I have to prepare several batches of Gull Wing stew.

branches.text: Hey now, I didn't sign on to be your personal grocer...

nodes.text: /rude Y'know, I don't recall any EXACT terms being specified here other than I'd get you around the normal requirements for earning Biorepression!
/wave Be seein' ya when you get back. Hurry it up though, will ya? I need to get this stew goin' already.
/shock I'm sorry, did you have something to say?

stages.description: Go back out for some MORE Gull Wings. You need 10 more. Mr. Big Space Pilot, Travel the Galaxy the poster says, destroy anything that stands in our way the recruiters say! Here you are hauling cooking supplies.
Back to Jed again! Hopefully this will be enough.. this is getting old isn't it?

nodes.text: /take Thanks again! I could use some more even.
/panic I was just kidding, you don't have to go again. Instead, I need you to go to Earth..

branches.text: Listen buddy, I've had about enough of this, just what IS the normal procedure for earning Biorepression?

nodes.text: /thumbs_up Actually, you normally just need to sign this form. *grin*

branches.text: YOU MEAN I WENT THROUGH ALL THAT?! TO AVOID SIGNING THE FORM?

nodes.text: /panic Hey, no reason to blow your stack @name, I'm just here to train you after all.

/rude Whoa buddy, here I guess you've earned it. /give You'll want to make use of those against any living opponents to make your fights easier. But look, this is an effective lesson. You don't like me very much do you? I've successfully Biorepressed YOU!

branches.text: Fine! You're impossible, you know that?!

nodes.text: /very_bored Excuse me? Are you talking to me? Did you hear that voice?
the VOICES! They're back, can you hear THEM? I can, They are DISTURBED at YOUR presence. Leave me,  I can handle them.

branches.text: You're off your bleedin' rocker. Who'd even eat Gull Wings anyway?

nodes.text: /crazy Oh, hello. Have we met before? You look familiar. /bow

missions.name: Fungus Reconnaissance
missions.summary: Help Master Ayam collect information on the Evil Mushroom using the Cloak skill.

nodes.text: /salute Hello, fellow defender. Before you ask, you are correct. I am the teacher of the Cloak skill. You have come here to learn this skill and become more adept in stealth and combat.

branches.text: Actually I am just exploring this station.

nodes.text:
You know, student, I really like training defenders. It's a perfect source of free labor, tons of young Jenquai are willing to carry out any sort of task to get their skill. I use their labor to combat the conflicts that come up around Yasuragi and keep this place safe. Yasuragi has always been a pretty dangerous place.

Now.. about your mission. A week or two ago, one of the junior Shinwa patrols came across a small mushroom and reported it to Yasuragi as an endangered species of fungus. Now there have been reports that the mushroom is increasing in size and has even started shooting off spores that attack traveling ships. I need the location of the mushroom so I can send a patrol (or a weed killer) to destroy it.

branches.text: I am a dedicated defender who will take on this task!

nodes.text: Well enjoy your time here I guess.. Even if you aren't looking to be trained, there's something I need help with and you would get the skill as a bonus.
I am teaching you the Cloak skill. Use it to avoid the dangers of the mushroom as you attempt to approach it. Then return to me after you have spied on it.
Bah, get out of my sight. I really need help, you can't just shrug it off and expect me to be ok with it.

stages.description: Fungus Reconnaissance Step 1 - Find the Evil Mushroom and use Cloak to approach it.
Fungus Reconnaissance Step 2 - Return to Master Ayam with your findings.

nodes.text: Well did you find the mushroom?
I will analyze the location you have specified. Thanks for the help and I hope the Cloak skill will serve you well as you explore and fight.

missions.name: Learning Scan
missions.summary: This mission is a prerequisite to gaining the Scan skill.

nodes.text: /no Please do not distrupt my meditation.
I will teach you when I am done meditating.
Thank you.
When I take a break for food.

branches.text: How hungry are you on a scale of 1-10?

nodes.text: About a 4. You're going to have to wait until I get more hungry.

branches.text: What do I do until then?

nodes.text: Go do something else for a little while. I must continue meditating.

stages.description: Learning Scan Step 1 - Find something to do while Master Zenzei meditates.

nodes.text: Hello, what brings you here, Defender?

branches.text: I have some time to kill.

nodes.text: Don't we all? I have been meditating here for years but I often feel like I haven't learned anything. It seems like people just expect me to constantly meditate because I am an influential Jenquai Defender. I don't get a lot out of it, but I sure meet some interesting people. Last week a Infiniticorp shipping manager stopped in here to meet with me alone. He wanted to admit his failures to me in the hopes that I could make him better. I guess he thought this base was a big confessional or something. I threw him some words of knowledge I get to come up with while meditating. He sure bought it and was out the door feeling like a new man. He must have gotten something out of the words I told him. I sure don't know why, he could have just opened a fortune cookie or something.

Then the other day a Shinwa came into the dojo seeking guidance. Apparently he had been having dreams about mordanite and kept sneaking out of his Dahin patrol to find some. He wanted me to either break his addiction or help him become Mordana. When he said "break" I got a bit excited as if we were going to fight something, but quickly realized we weren't. I wonder if the directory confused him. This is a combat dojo, not a life counselor's office. If he wanted to break an addiction he should go to Androzari, not here. He was nice though, and I hope he finds happiness. Oh, what were we talking about?

The other day, you know, we had a little "incident" in the dojo. It all started when Master Orosu ate Master Zenzei's rice cake. I'm sure you know by now how precise Master Zenzei's agenda is. To put it lightly he was ready to rip Master Orosu's head off. He kept telling me how his meditation was focused on how to kill Master Orosu in the most painful way. To end the squabbling, I gave Zenzei my rice cake, much to my dismay. They may be some of the most brilliant thinkers of the Jenquai race, but they sure can act like kids sometimes..

So what was it I was talking about before?

So I hear you are trying to learn the Scan skill? What a useful skill that is. You never know what you're up against until you see it so you gotta have a pretty big scan range for that. It's what makes us better hunters than those other races. We can find targets roaming outside the flock that nobody else can see. It's what makes us Jenquai so tactical and precise.

branches.text: Tell me some of your words of wisdom.

nodes.text: Ok, well good luck learning Scan, and I hope you enjoyed talking to me. It looks like Master Zenzei is almost done eating, so go catch him before he finishes.

Well let's see. These ones are pretty deep...
Never catch a Ten-Gu by the teeth. - well that can be taken literally too.
Possessions are like floppy drives. - an old saying that even I don't get.
Friendship is the engine of a ship, if you don't have it, you won't go anywhere
Appreciate what you have while it's there. - I stole this one from a greeting card
Never buy the same beam four times. - it's bad luck, don't you know..
It's not bad if nothing dies. - I think this is the one that got the manager.

If you need anymore, I'm going to publish a booklet of them soon.
Yes it seems so. Hey, it looks like Master Zenzei just finished his lunch. I think you might have some more time to kill.

stages.description: Learning Scan Step 2 - Return to Master Zenzei.

nodes.text: It's about time! I just finished eating and was about to resume meditating. Good thing you got here when you did.
I'm teaching you the Scan skill. It will allow you to-

branches.text: Yes, yes.. I know, get on with it.

nodes.text: Very well. You have now learned Scan. I hope you enjoy it and use it to the fullest.

missions.name: Traitor
missions.summary: Make Good with Meridith Lot

nodes.text: Who are you. who sent you? Stop looking at that!

branches.text: I'm @name, and I'm not looking at anything.

nodes.text: Then what are you doing here? Nobody comes asking me questions without looking for something. So. who sent you?

branches.text: I promise nobody sent me. I just wanted to offer my help.

nodes.text: So nobody sent you. and you want to help me. Let me test that theory. Do me a favor and go to Chernevog Station and talk to Harvey Krum. He has a package for you to bring to me.

branches.text: You want to treat me like that... then do something for you?

nodes.text: You should already be gone!
So be it then... Come back later if you change your mind.

stages.description: Speak with Harvey Krum and Recieve Package for Meridith Lot

nodes.text: Hello my friend. What can I do for you today? Would you like some Ostarae brownies?

branches.text: No thank you. I'm actually here for Merdith Lot. She wanted me to pick something up.

nodes.text: Ahhh. so you're the one. I hope this works out, we could use the help. Here is the package, take it directly to her, don't look at it though.
So long friend!
Dont be upset with me... I'm just helping out!

stages.description: Return to Meridith Lot and give Chocholate.

nodes.text: Let me see the package.
What is this.? You have looked at this. In fact there is a bite taken from my chocolate! Harvey gave you specific directions not to look in the package.
Ok. I will take your word for it. You did what you promised so now I have an important mission for you.
This must remain top secret! Do you promise to never tell anyone about this?

branches.text: I will place my honor on it!

nodes.text: Ok, There are rumors that Shou Tzu wants to start trades between Aragoth Station and the Red Dragons.  This is something that Infinicorp and GetCo doesn't want to happen. But they have left me stranded here for so long now without communication that I'm willing to make things happen.

branches.text: Is that wise to work with the Red Dragons?

nodes.text: I don't know, but the only way to find out is to engage them in their proposal.

branches.text: What would you like me to do?
I'm certainly not making deals with the RD!

nodes.text: Shou Tzu at Arx Ymir has something I need for you to pick up. It has some information on it that will let us know their intent. Go and get it.
I knew you couldn't be trusted.

stages.description: Speak with Sho Tzu at Arx Ymir.

nodes.text: Grrrr. What are you doing here? You're not welcome!

branches.text: Meridith Lot sent me to get a package.

nodes.text: Then so be it! Take this package back to her immediately. It is for her eyes only, let nobody know of this.
Off with your head!

stages.description: Take Package back to Meridith Lot.

nodes.text: What have you done. give me the package. We must hide this immediately. I was contacted by Grand Admiral Tbohner in Earth station and he has heard about what is going on. He was not please and has requested to see you immediately. You must mention nothing about this deal between Aragoth Station and the Red Dragons. Mention nothing!

branches.text: What did you get me into! I'm out!

nodes.text: Report to Admiral Diego Herrera now. Once you finish your questioning by him report back to me for an update and report.

branches.text: I'm not explaining anything! You need too!

nodes.text: Remember... Right back here afterwards!
I'm outta here!

stages.description: Speak with Admiral Diego Herrera.

nodes.text: Ahh. I have been anxiously awaiting your arrival. Rumor has it that you picked up and item from the Red Dragon leader Shou Tzu, and delivered it to Aragoth Station.

branches.text: I have no clue what you're talking about.
I may have... I may not have...

nodes.text: Did you not go to Arx Ymir and speak to Shou Tzu?

branches.text: I stopped in to Arx Ymir under an emergency situation.
Who do you think you are to question me?

nodes.text: It best have been a major emergency!

branches.text: I needed to pick up some ammo.
You have me red handed huh?

nodes.text: That is not what I constitute as an emergency. I can see that you will not crack on this matter. Let it be known that I have people watching you. Be careful in the decisions you make. they could land you in the brig.

branches.text: Do what you must but I have done no wrong.

nodes.text: That is all for now, continue about your business. But remember if I find out that you have been dealing with the Red Dragons me and you will speak again.
I will notify the athorities to come pick you up now then!

stages.description: Report back to Meridith Lot Immediatly.

nodes.text: @name, I have been on pins and needles awaiting your return. What was asked? What did you tell?

branches.text: I was asked about what I was sent to Arx Ymir for.

nodes.text: And what was your answer.

branches.text: Pick up something from Tzu for you!

nodes.text: Excellent, answer. we are always in need of ammo with our small hulls. What else was said?
That's no good. You will have to lay low for a while and stay out of site. Here is something for all your work.  Stay low for a while and come back once things calm down.
You fool! You best leave now before Tzu sends his minions after you!

missions.name: InfinitiCorp Training Seminar - MANDATORY!
missions.summary: Promotional Ceremony for all Terran Tradesmen: Reward: Hull Upgrades, 1000 Combat XP, this starts the TT Upgrade chain.

nodes.text: Welcome young @profession. The time is at hand when you are to learn how to become more profitable for InfinitiCorp and thereby increase your rank, and more importantly your REWARD!

branches.text: Sounds great, what do I have to do?

nodes.text: /shake_fist Well, one of the most important parts of becoming a successful tradesman is learning to read your opponents, both when you have to fight and in a trade situation. You have to learn what they're willing to pay for the items you create. Most importantly, you must ALWAYS take the MOST credits you can get for each item.
/explode Yeah, it doesn't SOUND hard, but given actual application it's a different beast entirely.

branches.text: Alright, so say I do this, what do I get out of the deal?

nodes.text: I was thinking I might just refit your hull to make it stronger and give you a boost to the amount of cargo room you have, but if you're not ready, I can always give it to the next tradesman with ambition who comes along.

branches.text: ... no need to rush now, that sounds good, what do I have to do specifically?

nodes.text: Alright, I need you to go out to Nav Salvage Station 6 and have a look round to see if you can find any survivors. There was a ship that we lost communication with out there a while ago.

stages.description: Louden sent you out to Nav Salvage Station 6 to look for survivors from a ship that the station recently lost contact with while they were working in the area.

nodes.text: ***Decoding Message*** *STATIC*... If you're intercepting this signal be very careful. These drones have malfunctioned and are damaging and attacking any vessel that comes near. I fear we've met our end, but we wanted to leave a warning for any other Terran vessels out here in an acquisition bid for the resources. *Kzzt* *STATIC* Oh my god, here they come! Watch out! *Explosive noises and some more static* *cough* Ehrg, this is Captain Zewlinski signing off... with the final entry in the Captain's log for Terran vessel "Blue Moon"

stages.description: The scans indicated weapons belonging to the Relentless Drones that can be found out here. Destroy at least 5 of them and go back to Louden when this is completed.

nodes.text: Hello again @name, welcome back. It appears that a signed order from DeWinter herself has come through authorizing you for a promotion. It seems she thinks you did a fair job of finding out what happened to that previous trader, and you make excellent bait to boot!

/shake_fist Yes, bait. We used you to lure out what's been attacking our pilots and now we know why those drones have been assaulting us, but it's over now. The man responsible for their reprogramming has been convicted and is sentenced to death by explosive decompression.
/explode er... takin' a long walk out of a short airlock, if you catch my drift.
And that's exactly what you get when you interfere with InfinitiCorp's profit margin. In any case, go see the InfinitiCorp Shipyard in New Edinburgh (Tau Ceti) to get your upgrade completed.

stages.description: Louden has sent you to the InfinitiCorp Construction Yard to complete your first hull upgrade and rank promotion. You can find it in the New Edinburgh Sector. (Tau Ceti System)

nodes.text: Hello Prentice @name, Louden comm'd ahead and told us to be expecting you. He also gave us authorization for your first upgrade at no charge. We're going to commence now. Please do not move for just a few moments.
Good, the retrofit is commencing now. Congratulations Journeyman @name.

stages.description: Report to Executive Mackellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching overall level 30.
Visit the shipyard for your promotion, the InfinitiCorp Construction Yard is located in Tau Ceti, in the New Edinburgh sector.

nodes.text: /wave Welcome Journeyman @name, DeWinter sent us a missive regarding you. She said you'd be here and that we were to upgrade your hull to the next reinforcement grade.
Congratulations, Agent @name. Bring massive profits to InfinitiCorp!

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 50 for another upgrade.
Visit the shipyard for your promotion, the InfinitiCorp Construction Yard is located in Tau Ceti, in the New Edinburgh sector.

nodes.text: Welcome back again Agent @name, DeWinter herself has begun to watch your progress with great interest. I'm not sure if that's a good thing or a bad thing, at least insofar as your profits are concerned. In either case, she's authorized you for another upgrade. Please do not accelerate or enter warp for a few moments while this is completed.
Good, the refit is commencing. Congratulations Emptor @name.

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 75 to begin your next rank up mission.
Visit the shipyard for your promotion, the InfinitiCorp Construction Yard is located in Tau Ceti, in the New Edinburgh sector.

nodes.text: Wow, already? Another rank for you? You going to share any of those profits with me? Damn, @name. It was like just yesterday that you were a new Prentice in InfinitiCorp...
Right, and today with the authorization I've received from the CEO, you are to be promoted. Congratulations Guildsman @name.

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 100 for your next rank promotion and upgrade.
Visit the shipyard for your promotion, the InfinitiCorp Construction Yard is located in Tau Ceti, in the New Edinburgh sector.

nodes.text: Again?! Well, nonetheless welcome back. I see you've been authorized for ANOTHER upgrade to your vessel. Sheesh, I wish my advancement had been *anywhere* near that quick. DeWinter must like you for some reason...
Well Guildsman, it seems that you've been promoted to Magnate by the CEO herself. Only one rank left to go and you'll get the largest share of profit in the company other than being the CEO!

stages.description: Report to Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) upon reaching an overall level of 135 for your final hull upgrade.
Talk to the shipyard again to get your final orders, welcome to the honor of being a Merchant Prince of InfinitiCorp

nodes.text:
***incoming Message Isabel DeWinter, CEO InfinitiCorp, Inc.***
Hello there @name, I have approved a rank upgrade in your honor for reaching the highest tiers of ship size and ability. Now, your job is to drive the profits of InfinitiCorp. One thing we can NEVER have too much of is profit. If you impress me I may reward you well.

Welcome to the executive level of InfinitiCorp, I hope you'll be ready to provide our cut of the profit. And by "I hope" I mean, you had better be. Else I might have to think of something vile to have done to you so I can send the video back to your mother. In any case, congratulations Merchant Prince @name.
This is DeWinter, OUT. *static* ***END OF TRANSMISSION***

missions.name: Terran Rank 3 Promotion Bonus
missions.summary: Visit Executive MacKellan upon receiving your second hull upgrade at level 30 for this mission. Reward: ExploreXP, CombatXP, Item (Exclusive engine)

nodes.text: This isn't finished yet.

missions.name: Terran Promotion Notification 4
missions.summary: Exec. MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) wants you to visit GetCo's chief security officer General Otto in Margesi and knowing her probably others too. Terran Enforcer/Trader Rank/Hull upgrade at level 75.

nodes.text: /clap Well, well, well @name, yer back again. It seems ya ar' meetin' MOST of yer requirements fer yer next hull advancement.

branches.text: Most?! But.. I'm I have the requirements listed in the handbook!

nodes.text: Aye, that ye do. 'owever, I have thing that be needin' doin' and yer here, so yer doin them. Any questions? ter bad. /shake_fist Now, havin' said tha' I'm gonna need you to go to Margesi Station in the Margesi sector of the Proxima Centauri. Aboard the station, yeh'll find General Otto Von Hotenbaun-Bismarck. I need yer ter take this update ter him...

Never you mind, tis somethin' for higher military minds than yers. Besides @profession, you ain't much fer the military in any respect. Jus' get 'em thar, before I have you stripped of rank and beaten wit' a whip instead!

stages.description: Exec. MacKellan sent you to see General Otto von Hotenbaun-Bismarck, he should be found on Margesi Station (Margesi, Proxima Centauri)

nodes.text: Welcome @name, MacKellan comm'd ahead. She wanted me to also have you take some updates to Chernevog Station, there's something interesting goin' on in Aragoth Prime and we really would like to know what it is. Also, carry along some of these Sol Updates now that we've copied them to our files. The person you want to talk to, his name is Krum I believe. A bit odd if you ask me.
/laugh1 Oh, you'll see very soon now, I expect. In any case, on your way, erm.. soldier? trader? eh whatever, just get those updates en route.

stages.description: The General has sent you to see someone named Krum on Chernevog Station in Aragoth Prime (Aragoth).

nodes.text: *reading the data you gave him* Oh, um 'allo there, and who exactly are you then?

branches.text: You mean you don't know? I was sent here by MacKellan and General Otto of GetCo.

nodes.text: /panic I see, they're after my juicy information again huh? Well, if you're wanting it, I might be willin' to part with it for a price. *glances back down at the documents*

branches.text: Uh huh... right, I'm not payin' you a thing, buddy. If anything, you're gonna pay me or I'm gonna pound you one!

nodes.text: /shoot I'm afraid I don't understand your banter, old chap. Maybe try to slow it down a little?

branches.text: But banter's not the same if you say it slower

nodes.text: /point Okay, it's quite simple really. Bally Jerry banged his kite right in the how's your father. hairy blighter dickie berted, feathered back on his sammy, took a waspie, flipped over on his Betty Harper's and caught his can in the Bertie.

branches.text: No... I'm just not understanding your banter at all well, today.

nodes.text: Is there something up with my banter, chaps?

branches.text: Captain Creeps comin' over the briney?

nodes.text: Ok ok, enough banter then, chap. I like you, so you don't have to pay... there's a Red Dragon station around the area that's amassing a huge armada to use for their harrassment of shipping lanes. That's the big news. Take it back to MacKellan, I'm sure she'll take care of everything.

stages.description: Back to MacKellan with the updates. Hopefully she won't ask you to do anything else... sheesh. There may be some credits that need payin' to the right people to prevent her from giving you anything more...

nodes.text: Alrigh' yeh've done wot I asked, now, yeh've gotta do what InfinitiCorp always has need of, stuffin' our coffers.
/rude Exactly, I'm gonna need some money. 100,000 credits oughter do it.

branches.text: A hundred thousand credits? Are you kidding me?!

nodes.text: /disagree1 Not at all, now pay up. First the InfinitiCorp Processing Fee, the Transaction Fee, the per item fee, and the rate discount fees. Each of those come to 25,000 credits. *smiles wickedly*
Thank you, now go see your shipyard and have a new hull, courtesy of InfinitiCorp Inc.

missions.name: Terran Promotion Notification 6
missions.summary: Exec. MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) wants to give you your final upgrade, for a price of course. Didn't think you were getting off that easy, did you? 1,000,000 credits will be required.

stages.description: Talk to Exec. MacKellan on Earth Station.

nodes.text: One mo' I'm finishing somethin' fer Sander Pauls. I'll be wif ya in a sec.

stages.description: Pay the 1,000,000 credit upgrade application fee and get your final upgrade.

nodes.text: /take Fortunately, there are no tasks fer ya. However, in light of that, we'll need more coffers stuffed in the meantime. Do you have the 1,000,000 credits for this upgrade application fee? Good. Thank yer fer yer donation to InfinitiCorp's Nommos Foundation Trust. I'll need yer ter go visit the shipyard for your final upgrade. Be gone n get it done, you deserve it wif all the strife yeh've endured.

missions.name: Terran Promotion Notification 5
missions.summary: Executive MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) wants you to go to Somerled Station (New Edinburgh, Tau Ceti) and speak with Lady DeWinter. Oh dear...

nodes.text: 'oi @name, yer startin' ter shape up, I'd say. In any case, I guess yer qualified fer another promotion and pay rise huh? Well, I have some more things that need doin'. Havin' said that, yer gonna go speak to DeWinter on Somerled for me.
/explode /rude Nah, I definitely'm not, yer outta your bleedin' mind. Now take these to her, before I have you dragged behind a starship with no EVA suit.
/agree Thas wot I thought. Now, I expect yeh'll have this to her yesterday. Catch me drift?
Unfortunately, yer n'er gone fast enough.

branches.text: You ought to be careful, you might hurt someone's feelings.

nodes.text: *glares malevolently at you* I said, BEGONE!

stages.description: You're off to see the wizard... no wait.. the CEO of InfinitiCorp Lady Isabel DeWinter, to give her something that Exec. MacKellan needed couried over to her.

nodes.text: *simultaneously fixes you with a death-gaze as she somehow reads the information you've presented*
*seems to take on an harder stare at you*

branches.text: So, what do I do now?

nodes.text: Oh, you do have a spine then. Well, we'll just have to remedy that. I'll need you to run to Chernevog Station for me and talk with Harvey Krum. I have something that I requested from him. You're going to be the collector. Do not fail me, @profession.

stages.description: DeWinter sent you to collect... something...  from Harvey Krum on Chernevog station. She said not to fail her, I wonder what she meant? *gulp*

nodes.text: Oh hello @name, that dame DeWinter comm'd ahead to let me know you were coming for her package. Please take this back to DeWinter post haste. She'd kill me if it fell into the wrong hands.

branches.text: Wow, armored sails, these are a rarity indeed.

nodes.text: Don't cher be gettin' any ideas there. She'll kill you just as surely as she would me. I mean honestly, I'm a lot more impressive in the scheme of things.

branches.text: er, no... ok I'll get these to DeWinter now.

nodes.text: Good, get goin'. She'll be demanding it any minute. The less I have to deal with that lady the better.

stages.description: Back to Somerled, deliver DeWinter's "package" consisting of a rare engine type that you'd love to have but if you fail DeWinter, well they may never find any trace of you...

nodes.text: /rude How unexpected, you have performed well afterall. In any case, I guess I won't kill you for now. I may however kill you in the morning.
/agree Take this, give it to Cailleach on Earth Station. If this doesn't make it there yesterday, I'll see to it that you're DEmoted. Now, GO!

stages.description: Return to Exec. Cailleach MacKellan on Earth Station (Earth Sector, SOL) to deliver the updates from Tau Ceti.

nodes.text: /clap I'll admit, I'm impressed. DeWinter let me know that yer were able ter perform her task in an acceptable timeframe. That's pretty impressive words comin' from her. Anyway, I'll take the remaining 200,000 credits that InfinitiCorp isn't covering for your upgrade now, thank you. If you'll please go see Admiral Herrera with this, yeh should be set fer an upgrade.

stages.description: Take the symbols to Admiral Herrera, he is aboard Jagerstadt City on Zweihander. (Zweihander Sector, Alpha Centauri)

nodes.text: Hello @name, MacKellan told me to expect you, I see you've completed the promotion trial and your application has been approved for the next rank of Terran Society. In any case, congratulations, you have performed admirably and you will receive a just reward.

missions.name: Takashi Maru
missions.summary: Find out whats happening at Takashi Maru

nodes.text: Who are you and what do you want!? Why are people always walking around, whispering behind my back and talking about me!? What is it with you people!?

branches.text: I've just come to see if I could help.
Sorry to have bothered you, bye

nodes.text: I'm sure somebody is behind this that sent you huh? Seems as though there is always someone watching, waiting for the right time to strike! You see I know things that the average person doesn't around here!
You see! You see! I knew you were here for something!

branches.text: I assure you I'm not, you saying you knew things has caught my attention is all.
It is all in your mind, I can not help you

nodes.text: Ohh. I guess that would be a bit intriguing. Now where were we?

branches.text: You were going to share with me some wisdom that most don't know.

nodes.text: I'm not so certain I should tell you out in the open like this, too many ears about that are yearning for what I know. And if they ever find out then it will be all over for me you see. can never be too cautious.

branches.text: So how will you tell me then if not here and not now?
There is no one hee, you should get out the station more

nodes.text: I'm going to tell you now. Lean in real close though, I don't want to even whisper too loud. There is trouble brewing near the Takashi Maru. And that's all I'm saying for now, I think it would be best if you went out and discovered what is happening for yourself.

branches.text: I will head that way, and come back to you after I am done.
That is a little to close for me

nodes.text: Hurry back now! Let me know what you learn.
If your like this I do not want your help.... Bye

stages.description: Fly to Takashi Maru, Grissom Meteorological Site to Investigate.
Kill 1 Dactuuls for thier Dastardly Stalks.
Return to Anusha Dayakara.

nodes.text: Well? Quietly now. what did you find? Lean in close, nobody else needs to know.

branches.text: There were Dactuuls, and I found these on them.

nodes.text: ohh my! Just as I thought, nobody must find out about this. give me those now so that I can discard of them safely. Do you have any idea what this means?

branches.text: To me it was just another battle.

nodes.text: That is simple for you to say, there is a greater meaning here. I have attempted to give you a glimpse into what is to come and you respond in such a manner. Regardless. you will see soon enough, everyone will see soon enough.

missions.name: Grissom Meteorological Survey
missions.summary: Help the locals at Grissom Meteorological Survey to clear the area of Greater Mantichora.

nodes.text: I see you have returned @name. Do you finally understand what I was trying to show you?

branches.text: If I understood you, I would be scared.

nodes.text: I just don't understand, everyone is always watching my every move, trying to find out information that I'm just not allowed to tell them. I finally find someone who I thought was worth giving some information and the response I get is "Not so much".

branches.text: I'm sorry that I didn't understand what you were trying to show me.
Your a little over bearing huh?

nodes.text: Sometimes sorry just isn't enough. You see, I can't just keep giving information away and still maintain what I am working on here personally. There is just way too much at stake.

branches.text: Is there anything I can help with on the personal side?
I know there is alot at steak... Get it? Steak.

nodes.text: What!? You're beginning to seem suspecious to me again! Why would you want to be involved in anything personal of mine!? Who is the one that keeps sending you to me!?

branches.text: I just honestly wanted to help you, to ease your stress.

nodes.text: Well, you sound sincere. I think there is one thing that you can help me with, but we must keep this to ourselves, and let nobody know of it.

branches.text: I will keep silent about all that I do.
I don't think I'm interested in helping you anymore.

nodes.text: Come in close, I must whisper to you so that others don't hear. Recently it was discovered that we can land on the planet Grissom. They are doing Meteorological Surveys throughout the planet. So far the findings have been scarce due to the overwhelming amount of Greater Mantichora protecting the resources. They know from their scans that there is a high presence of Hydrogen located in a certain area.

It has been nearly impossible to access it due to the overwhelming amount of creatures that are directly in the resource field. This gas is used for many wonderful things. If you were willing to help the organization there, dispose of these Greater Mantichora I would certainly be grateful.

branches.text: I can dispose of them easily enough.
I'm not much of a combatant.

nodes.text: One more thing. Come in close, watch what is being done down near the surface, something just doesn't seem right about it all to me.
That attitude will get you nowhere with me.

stages.description: Travel to Grissom Meteorological Survey.
Kill 5 Greater Manichora.
Return to Anusha Dayakara.

nodes.text: Come quickly @name! I think they are on to us!

branches.text: You are some what crazy.. Who do you think is following me?

nodes.text: I cannot say names! They are here though, I can sense it. Did you speak with anyone while on your journey?

branches.text: Nobody, Just did what you asked and came straight back.
I've had enough of your paranoid self.

nodes.text: Exactly what I wanted to hear! From what my sources tell me you did an excellent job disposing of the Greater Mantichora. I am in debt to you for the time being. Please take this as a token of my gratitude.
I'm not paranoid!

missions.name: Heracles Gravel's Recommendation
missions.summary: Win Editor Heracles Gravel's Recommendation - Given by Heracles Gravel

nodes.text: Reporting here from the safety of Net-7! I want to welcome all of our new listeners. In the local area today there have been reports of Red Dragon attacks on local commercial ships. It's also being reported that throughout vast parts of Aragoth and Beta Hydri they are attacking nearly everything in sight.
Meanwhile, closer to the home front we are again for the first time in years seeing an influx in the amount of travelers. Could this be the sign of a galaxy reborn? I think it certainly is.
Is there something I can help you with @race. I'm in the middle of rehearsing for my broadcast here soon. Or do you just want my autograph?

branches.text: I've always wanted to be a reporter, how did you get into this career field?

nodes.text: It's not easy friend, it takes a lot of dedicated and dirty work. And it always helps to know a few people. To be a true reporter you have to go out there and dig up the dirt in places most would never want to go.

Well, that's entirely up to you my friend. Can you do what I say, and dig up the dirt in the fiercest environments? Can you report news on people that may influence others against you? Sometimes this job is tough that way. You rub people the wrong way sometimes.

I tell you what. I have a story that I need reported on, and nobody is willing to take it. If you could do some investigating for me, and its meets the standards of the Net-7 news then I will give you my highest recommendation.

Sources tell me that the Red Dragons have established a base in Aragoth. I haven't yet been able to yet confirm it, and with the ruthlessness of the Red Dragons it's nearly impossible to find someone to investigate it. Think you can find it for me?
Then get out there you future reporter! This may just be the story of the millennium! You should try to investigate the Red Dragon Carrier, T'ien Lung.

stages.description: Fly to Aragoth and find the Red Dragon Base, Red Dragon Carrier T'ien Lung.

nodes.text: You must leave now, or face your maker.

stages.description: Return to Heracles Gravel

nodes.text: Were you able to find this so called Red Dragon base?
Outstanding! Ok, I need some specifics from you. Hopefully you remember everything you saw there! First, where was it?
Interesting, why would they want to set up a base there I wonder. Did you notice anything else about it?

branches.text: There was strong force around it everywhere that kept me from being able to warp out of the area.

nodes.text: That's certainly not good.

branches.text: No, if I would have been caught I would have certainly died.

nodes.text: I take it there was vast amounts of Red Dragons in the area?
Interesting, I must know more. What Red Dragon faction was it? I know that from earlier reports the group broke into different gangs. It might help us to know who's running the show there.

branches.text: I don't know who was running the show there.

nodes.text: No fear friend! I'm going to need more from you to get this story though, I need you to fly back there and find out what clan is running the show. Also, I heard that there is a Red Dragon Carrier, Tun Mi Lung in the location. We need to verify this immediatly.
Hurry now! This might still make the midnight news!

stages.description: Fly Back To Kuei Station and Learn Which Red Dragon Clan Is Running It. Inspect The Red Dragon Carrier, Tun Mi Lung.

nodes.text: Your not supposed to be here! You best leave before I set your ship a blaze!

stages.description: Return to Heracles Gravel

nodes.text: What did you find out? Is it the Jing Leung Dragons? Or the Red Dragons?
Excellent find, that leads us to know much more about what type of operation they are running there.

Well, we know that they are serious smugglers. They traffic many things and sell them on the black market. It could be a base intended just for this, and as heavily guarded as you say it was. then it seems to me without a doubt that is the case.

branches.text: Wonder if they have anything good there?

nodes.text: Well I can tell you for one. I'm not finding out! The way they have been shredding apart travelers far and near.

missions.name: Retrieve Josher's Money
missions.summary: Help Josher Retrieve his Money.

nodes.text: Scoundrels and scallywags! That seems to be all I deal with now days. Are you here to borrow some money too!?

branches.text: Not at all, just here looking for work.
You sure are disgruntled. I'm out of here.

nodes.text: Looking for work. but you're not looking for money!? So you want to do whatever for me and do it for free!?

branches.text: A little something would be nice of course.
Your too rude! You could offer me 1 million and I still wouldn't help you.

nodes.text: Just as I thought! Well, let's see. You seem to be a big @race. I think I have just the thing for you. That scoundrel Lucius Campano borrowed some money from me a while back, and blew it all at the race track. I need someone to go get it back for me! You think you're the person for that!?

branches.text: I can get that money from him. no problem.
I'm not doing your dirty work.

nodes.text: Now that's the attitude for the job. I'm sure you will find him near the race track up in Glenn. Get my money back from him!
So be it then partner... Was going to toss you a coin if you helped out.

stages.description: Go to Glenn and speak with Lucius Campano about Josher's money.

nodes.text: Well hello there! You here to do some bettin' on the races? Sure is fun watchin' them race around dis track.

branches.text: Josher sent me for his money you owe him.
I do not like to gamble

nodes.text: Ohhh.nooo. You didn't come to do some hurtin' on me did you? I'm tryin' to get his money back!

branches.text: I'm not here to hurt you, just here for the money.
I do not like you, you are a wimp

nodes.text: Well, if you can do me a quick favor then, by the time you get back I'll havin' the money for you.

branches.text: And you best have some for the favor as well.
I'm doing no favors. Just give me his money.

nodes.text: I most certainly will. You see, my friends told me that down in Sheperd there's a place called Pax Swift Star... There's a man down there, that's just givin' his stuff away for free. can you believe that. givin' it away for free. My friend told him that I wanted that that nice set of Chavez duelin' equipment that he has, and he said he would hold on to em' for me. Think you can go fetch em'? By the time you get back I'll have Josher's money and a lil' somthin' for you too.

branches.text: You best have the money when I return.
I dont think I want to help you out.

nodes.text: Don't worry now. I'm certin' this philly will win this time!
Well... That's the only way your getting his money from me.

stages.description: Travel to Shepherd and find Pax Swift Star.
Return to Lucius Campano.

nodes.text: Ohh. no! Did you get my duelin' equipment? I'm thinkin' not huh?

branches.text: You set me up! I was ambushed when I got to the Pax Swift Star.

nodes.text: Well. you must have gone to the wrong place. I'm certin' that's where he was. Maybe he moved on already huh?

branches.text: You best hope that I don't find out otherwise. Now where's the money!?

nodes.text: Here you go. Here you go. don't put a hurtin' on me please.

stages.description: Return to Josher for your Reward.

nodes.text: Howdy there @name. did you get my money from that scallywag!?

branches.text: Have it right here for you Josher.

nodes.text: He gave it right up did he? Last guy I sent to get my money from him ended up somewhere in Sheperd, disable from an attack that nearly wiped him out of existence. Can never trust a guy that is willing to gamble his life away. that's for certain.
I told you he was a scoundrel, didn't I tell you! Did you fall for that old trick!?

branches.text: Well I went. but I handled myself and came back in one piece.

nodes.text: Ohh. boy you are a riot! Here's a little something just for you. Maybe now you can be in those races!

missions.name: Win Oorjit Bly's Recommendation
missions.summary: Win Oorjit Bly's Recommendation to become a Net-7 field reporter

nodes.text: Reporting what no other can, its Jan Blather here. What are those pesky Red Dragons up to now? It seems that there have been an indescribable amount of Red Dragon activity in several sectors, word has it that they have constructed gates leading somewhere! Meanwhile in the news, our very own beloved reporter Oorjit Bly has been hankered down in near Dahin Planet and reports that strange things are going on.

Oorjit Bly is one of the most established, well-liked reporters there has ever been here at Net -7! In fact so much in fact that at our yearly banquet there is an award given out in his name. Of course. I'm still obviously the better reporter.

branches.text: Then why don't you have an award?

nodes.text: Let's not talk about that right now, I have to head to makeup. Getting ready for today's broadcast.

branches.text: But I do work for Net-7, I have even received Hercules Gravel's Recommendation.

nodes.text: You did what!? How did you get that? Ahhh. It doesn't matter. So you think you are a reporter? Ok. I have a job for you then if you're willing to take it on!?
. "would love to Jan". That's not going to get you anywhere with me. with me it's the cold hard facts and the news broadcast that goes out. Got it!?

Now that we have that straight! It seems that Oorjit Bly has been seeing strange things near in Zipe Totec. He has his awards, and well it's my time to shine. I need for you to go there and find out what's going on. Report back to me anything you see!
Then why are you still standing there!? A true reporter would already be half way there!

stages.description: Locate and Speak With Oorjit Bly

nodes.text: Well hello there space traveler! How do things seem to be going out there?

branches.text: They seem fine, I was sent to speak to you.

nodes.text: Well, I'm usually the one sent to speak to others, how odd it is to have someone come to speak to me.

branches.text: Jan Blather was concerned about you, I guess you reported strange things happening around here.

nodes.text: Not really around here, I was out doing my rounds one morning and noticed this odd and mammoth looking thing. Upon further investigation I found that it was some type of maelstrom that had appeared out of nowhere, from one day to the next.
Well, I'm fairly certain that's what it was! There was these crazy hounds all over the place, I got close enough to investigate but had to pull back once those hounds started grouping up on me.
To day the least. I tell you what @name. Would you be interested in finding out more for me? This could be the story that takes us both to fame!

branches.text: What would you need me to do?

nodes.text: Fly to Swooping Eagle. that's the location that I saw this in. See if you can further investigate what is going on there. why this thing has suddenly appeared. Anything and everything at all that you can find out.

branches.text: Now that's something I could certainly do.

nodes.text: Awesomeness! To make things a little easier on you, I'm going to place a recorder on your ship so that I can review and make the perfect report, and don't worry, you will get your credit. After all, in this business you have to give credit when credit is due!
Well, you have my word young reporter! Now go find out what you can! We don't want anyone else getting this story!

stages.description: Fly To Swooping Eagle And Come Within Range Of Maelstrom
Return To Oorjit Bly

nodes.text: Welcome back @name! Did you find anything out while on your journey? The recorder is ok isn't it?

branches.text: Everything is ok, and I think you will like what you see.

nodes.text: Well lets take a look at what we have here. Interesting. Interesting. Wait! What is this? It appears to be a wrinkle in the maelstrom that is releasing these hound type creatures.

branches.text: I managed to terminate a few of the hounds, don't seem like much of a problem.

nodes.text: Well, you know my ship isn't quite built as well as yours; these news reporter ships sometimes get run into the ground and never repaired.
Anyways back to the story here. I think you have recorded some great information here, and I think we will be able to give an amazing story based on this!

branches.text: Excellent! One step closer to being a reporter, just need to report back to Jan Blather now.

nodes.text: What do you mean report back to Jan!? Jan is the one who sent you here? That dirty. no good. Sorry @name. Jan has been trying to steal my stories for years, and to think she almost got away with another one. If you really want to be a reporter take my recommendation, and don't let him know anything.

branches.text: I think that sounds good to me! After all. you even have a reward named after you right?

nodes.text: Well. don't make me bashful here. Ok then, I will get this story written up and submitted the copy press room and hopefully it will be aired throughout the galaxy in the next few days! Take my recommendation, and I will make a call or to on your behalf as well! You could be the next greatest reporter ever!

stages.description: Report Back To Jan Blather

nodes.text: Unbelievable! What has taken you so long!? Were you able to get the story!? This better be good! I have been waiting on you to return for a very long time!

branches.text: Well, wait no longer because I am here!

nodes.text: What did you find out? What is Oorjit Bly up too? I know this is going to be good!

branches.text: When I got there, he was having lunch. Seemed extremely bored. I approached him and he said that nothing had been going on for days.

nodes.text: He was hiding something, I know him. I will have to find out for myself I guess. So much for thinking I could depend on someone else to get the story!

branches.text: I did see some Red Dragons in Freya that were acting suspicious!

nodes.text: Red Dragons smagons! They are an old story! They have been wreaking havoc for who knows how long now! I need something great! And I know that Oorjit Bly has something up his sleeve! Sorry, I shouldn't be so harsh on you, he just always outdoes me and it's driving me crazy.

branches.text: Sorry to hear that. have you ever asked him for help?

nodes.text: Ask for help! Now I know you're bonkers. Here, take this for your time, when you come to your senses come on back and maybe we can give this another attempt.

missions.name: Patrolling the Line
missions.summary: Help the Shinwa keep dangerous forces from crossing the Intzalan Line.

nodes.text: You look like a strong enough warrior. Would you like to help patrol the Intzalan Line?

Ok, so I have received reports of breaches of the line. I need you to go to each of the Intzalan Line nav buoys and make sure no monsters have breached. Use the scanners on the buoys to detect any monsters that have passed by. Then proceed to eliminate the creatures. Return to me when you have checked all four nav buoys.
If you are fearful you will not succeed.
Please come back soon or send your friends. Prasad station is at risk.

stages.description: Check the nav point Intzalan Line I for hostile activity.
Defeat hostiles near -123, -106.
Proceed to check nav Intzalan Line II.
Patrol Intzalan Line III
Check Intzalan Line IV
Eliminate hostiles at -102, 78.
Report your patrol data to Shou Shen.

nodes.text: There you are. How was the patrol?

branches.text: I encountered enemies at navs I, II, III and IV.
I encountered enemies at navs I, II and IV.
I encountered enemies at navs I, III and IV.
I really don't remember where I encountered enemies.

nodes.text: It sounds like there were a lot of breaches. That creates a problem for me. We've experienced one or two breaches of weak organisms, but three? What creatures breached?

Ships can survive crossing the Line for the most part because of their shields, but Oni? Oni could pose a serious threat to trade and safety at Prasad. Well, I will analyze more patrol data and try to come up with a solution to our troubles. Thanks for the help this time. I may need you later.
Well this is no help to me, in order to truly benefit me it sounds like you will have to do another patrol.

missions.name: Security Needs
missions.summary: Help Patrol Venus Sector

nodes.text: Great more people showing up everyday.  Let me guess you're a pirate too.

branches.text: Umm no.  I'm here looking for work.

nodes.text: Work?  I don't have time....Wait I might have something for you.  Want to make a run for me.  I really don't have time.
