branches.text: No, No I don't think so.

nodes.text: Get off my station.
Great.  Run over to Neptune and tell anyone over there that we need help.  Pirates are starting to over run this area.

branches.text: No problem I'll make it as quick as I can.

nodes.text: Yes, Yes please hurry.

stages.description: Fly to Neptune to get help.
Return to Grenda Pien

nodes.text: What back already.  That was fast.
I'm sorry, but what?
Closed?  The gate was closed?  How can that be?  /anger  I can't believe they closed the gate.  How are we supposed to get this area cleaned up?
It's not like we have a secrurity group....What? You'd help?
/excited That would be great.  Can run a patrol of the area?
Kill any Pirates you can find.

stages.description: Patrol Venus Nav Mercury 1
Patrol Venus 2  Nav Commerce Lane 3
Patrol 3 Nav Ceres 1
Kill five 4th Circle Chavez Mechanics
Return to Grenda Pien

nodes.text: Out standing job @name.  You've been a great help.
Here's a little something for you're trouble.

missions.name: Patrol Mercury
missions.summary: Help Patrol Mercury

nodes.text: Look I really don't have time to chat.  I've got too many pans in the fire right now.

branches.text: Sorry I'll be on my way.

nodes.text: Maybe you can.  I've got to get some patrols set up and no one seems to care.  Everyone wants this area secured but they sure aren't willing to help.

branches.text: Well I'm not busy.  I can help.

nodes.text: Well bye then.
You can?  Great @name  I could use someone to patrol Mercury.
It is, but still there are alot of pirates around so you have to be carefull.
Great.  Reort back to me when you're done.

stages.description: Begin Mercury Patrol at Star Clipper 6
Patrol Mercury locate Starclipper 1
Patrol Mercury locate Nav Mercury 1
Patrol Completed report back to Bargatate Stet Venus Sector.

nodes.text: Wonderful job @name how did the patrol go?

branches.text: Not bad.  Got kind of hairy though.

nodes.text: What do you mean?

branches.text: Ran into some Red Dragons up near Helios Major.

nodes.text: So that's where they're coming from.  They've been showing up all over our sector we just couldn't figure out from where.

branches.text: Maybe you should start some kind of security force for this area.

nodes.text: A Security Force for the Sol System?  Not a bad idea @name.  This needs some more thought.  Thanks for the help.

missions.name: Honor the Memories
missions.summary: Honoring the Path of our Ancestors

nodes.text: Welcome traveler. Have you come here seeking solitude? Have you come seeking to find yourself? Or have you come to learn about your ancestors?

branches.text: I have come to learn of all.
I do not care of the past.

nodes.text: Indeed you have. You will now take the path of enlightenment. This consists of four stops within our galaxy and within our souls. If you do indeed want to take the path, then you will know what needs to be done next.

branches.text: I know what must be done.

nodes.text: Then proceed. Once you have reached enlightenment return to me.
When you want to learn, come back to me to see the knowledge.

stages.description: The Progen Path

nodes.text: The Progen ancestors were a humble people. Willing to share what they had with everyone. Then the betrayal began, and they were forgotten about. Only to defend themselves against the Jenquai and Terran who wanted to make what they had built theirs.

stages.description: The Terran Path

nodes.text: The Terran ancestors were also a humble people, whose greed and need for power sometimes got the best of them. Their hunger for that power and money has lead them to what they are today-- A Powerful race with technology that is advanced for their cause.

stages.description: The Jenquai Path

nodes.text: The Jenquai ancestors may be the most humble of them all. The journeyed out to the farthest reaches of our galaxies. To only be turned on by their own kind. They have remained secluded, watching every move that is made by both the Progen and the Terran alike."

stages.description: The Path of Shared Memory

nodes.text: Shared Memory brings us the remembrance of what once was. It reminds us that we have all evolved from the same place, being Earth. The journey of time has drifted similar people to great depths apart. One day, what has drifted apart will once again return.

stages.description: Speak to Curator Gloria Whitley

nodes.text: Did you follow the path and find enlightenment?

branches.text: I have followed the path, and learned many great things.

nodes.text: I knew that you indeed would find what you seeked. Enlightenment is yours now. Go forth and teach others what you have learned, and do what you can to fix what has happened in the past.

missions.name: Gathering Magnetic Wave Data
missions.summary: Gather  Magnetic Wave Data for Science Officer Sharik

nodes.text: Fine day isn't it traveler? Seems the stars are working in our favor.

branches.text: Indeed fine day, what do you mean by stars working in our favor?

nodes.text: During my research I have found that some days the magnetic waves from the sun is so overwhelming that I cannot conduct my research. The more magnetic wave's the more my research goes haywire.

branches.text: How do you know how bad the Magnetic Wave's are?

nodes.text: That is simple my friend. I have placed Satellites in a few locations that take the protons and neutrons being forced away from the sun and determine the magnetic wave output. Sounds fairly simple, but believe me, it took years just to get this far.
It certainly is, and that is only the beginning of my research. Like I said before, I just have to get past the magnetic waves to start my real research.

branches.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

nodes.text: I'm thankful that you have asked. It would certainly help me if you were to go out to the satellites and gather the data for me, bring it back. Then I can analyze it and determine if today's a good research day or not.

branches.text: I can do that easily enough.

nodes.text: You make me proud to be a Science Officer! Head on out now, I need you to travel to all four of the Data Satellites and retrieve the data from them. I had my engineers modify your ship so that when you arrive at each location the data is automatically uploaded to your ship. Once you have it, return to me with the data.

stages.description: Travel to and scan all four Data Satellites orbiting the system sun
Speak to Science Officer Sharik

nodes.text: Were you able to retrieve the data from the satellites?

branches.text: The engineers are removing the data from my ship as we speak.

nodes.text: Excellent! As soon as I run the data information I can begin my research for today.
I'm doing research on Crystal Life. Give me some time, and if the data comes back positive for today then I can certainly use your help once again.

missions.name: Finding Crystal Life
missions.summary: Find Crystal Life and bring sample to Science Officer Sharik

nodes.text: Welcome back @name! Seems as though the data you have retrieved from the satellites has given us the perfect information we need. We have an all clear to conduct our testing today.

branches.text: Excellent! I was hoping to find out about the Crystal Life.
I am not a test subject

nodes.text: Well my friend. Today you will embark on the task of finding crystal life. We have reported sightings in Grissom near Baikonur Resource Field. We don't know for certain if you will find any there. We have been on several wild chases. Certainly not a good day when it's as perfect as today and we fail to find crystal life.

branches.text: I'm certain I can find them.
I am sorry I am not a searcher

nodes.text: If you are able to find them, I need for you to bring me back samples. Not certain what the sample would be, but if you destroy only a few you should be able to pull something from their corpses. Anything that we could study would be indeed fantastic.

branches.text: I am not going to kill the crystals

nodes.text: Sorry to hear you don't want to test or kill.

stages.description: Kill 3 Crystal Ring Fiends
Return to Science Officer Sharik

nodes.text: Well @name. Were you able to find any crystals?

branches.text: I was certainly able to, even was able to retrieve these for you.

nodes.text: I tell you what friend! This is truly a fantastic day! Were you able to take a picture of them?

branches.text: I didn't know you wanted a picture!

nodes.text: Well. I didn't exactly tell you I did, but then again I never imagined that we would actually find one of these crystal life forms. Today is most certainly a day to celebrate. We will embark on the next step of our research. It has taken us over 20 years to accomplish what you have today. I have a great deal of gratitude for what you have done.
Anytime you're in need of anything, feel free to return here, I will do whatever I can to help.

missions.name: Dzurai Trophies
missions.summary: Help Arno Suiliman Get Rid of the Dzurai's.

nodes.text: Welcome to Friendship 7 @race. You seem the type that loves adventure, endures the fame and respect received from accomplishing daunting tasks. Is that the type of @race you are?
I thought I recognized that glimmer in your eye. What's your name friend?

Well @name. Let's work things up a bit. You want that fame and respect don't you? Well, I have a few tasks that you can help with that will leave you looking like a hero, even to some of those so called top dogs, executive types.

Lets start small. It seems that the Dzurai are wreaking havoc down in Slayton, near the Nav's Soyuz Passage One and Two. The experts in the region seem to think if we can take out the Dzurai Adult Runt then we can easily take out the other's without them reproducing.

branches.text: I can take out the Dzurai Adult Runt, and anymore you want me too.

nodes.text: Then get on it @race. Get this done, and to those working in the area, you will be a hero.

stages.description: Kill a Dzurai Adult Runt
Speak with Arno Suiliman

nodes.text: Welcome back @name! Reports coming back in from the field are very positive. Seems the Dzurai are diminishing more and more every moment. I did although get notification just moments ago that your skill is needed once again. There seems to be an uprising in Glory's Orbit. We were notified of a very large Dzurai Pod Mother, which may just be what needs taken out.

branches.text: The Dzurai Pod Mother? Sounds pretty mean.

nodes.text: I guarantee this one's a mean one. If it's truly the mother, than this will finally eliminate them for good.

branches.text: I will go and rid us of the infestation.

nodes.text: Go forth, and get the fame you deserve! Its located near Data Satellite 2 in Glory's Orbit.

stages.description: Goto nav Data Satellite 2
Kill 3 Dzurai Pod Mother
Return to Arno Suiliman

nodes.text: Fantastic @name! You have made some serious strides in the removal of these pests! Not only are you the hero of the local settler's in the region you have gained my respect as well.

branches.text: I'm glad that everyone is pleased.

nodes.text: Pleased is an understatement. They've requested that I give you this as a token of their gratitude.

missions.name: Tourist Rescue
missions.summary: Rescue the Tourists from the Red Dragon Clan.

nodes.text: We have a situation on our hands. Reports are telling me that a Cruise ship fell under attack from some Red Dragons down in Glory's Orbit. The tourists escaped in their escape pod just moments before the ship exploded.

branches.text: That sounds tragic! Are they ok?

nodes.text: From the reports I'm hearing I cannot confirm that they are ok. It seems that the Red Dragons that attacked the ship pulled the tourist capsule into their ship and they are holding the tourists hostage.

That's exactly what I was hoping for. I can't say for certain which Red Dragon is holding them hostage but the ship was near Nav Glory's Orbit 1 when it was attacked. Reports have come in that almost straight to the north of that location there is a large harvest field that the Red Dragons are hiding out in.

branches.text: I'm heading out now to save them.

nodes.text: You are truly a blessing. Hurry now, the Red Dragons could do anything to them.

stages.description: Goto Nav Glory's Orbit 1
Defeat Red Dragon to save Tourist
Return to Arno Suiliman

nodes.text: Excellent work once again @name. It seems that you are quick to head out to make a rescue and save the day.

branches.text: I'm always willing to help those in need.

nodes.text: And that is a very admirable trait to have. The tourists are recovering now in the medical center. They told me to pass on their greatest respect for you. They also gave me this for you. Please come by again soon, you never know when your help might be needed.

missions.name: Jenquai Rank 4 Upgrade
missions.summary: Councillor Uje'da has authorized the Paren Ship Yard to improve your hull. You will also be advanced to your next rank.

nodes.text: /clap You return, Jenquai, and you have become much stronger. I hope you have learned much in your experiences thus far.

Excellent. Althought you are much stronger than you were at the beginning, there are many new challenges you will have to face as you progress. To help you deal with these trials I have authorized the Paren Ship Yard to upgrade your hull. Upon upgrading, you will have to pay a fee of 100,000 credits to cover the costs of upgrading your ship. You will also attain your next rank. Proceed to Paren Ship Yard in Kailaasa, Capella, when you are ready.

stages.description: Head to the Paren Ship Yard (Kailaasa, Capella System) and pay the 100,000 credit fee.

nodes.text: Greetings, @name. What are you here for?

branches.text: I was sent by Councillor Uje'da to receive a hull upgrade.
I want to be an engineer!

nodes.text: Very well. Your hull has been upgraded and you have achieved your next rank. Enjoy your new hull and harness your new capabilities.
That's very nice and all, but there aren't any openings at this shipyard for new engineers. (*whispers* sure isn't gonna take MY job!)
Wouldn't you prefer cruising around with a stronger and better looking ship? You're ready for an upgrade, just let me know when you want it.

missions.name: Jenquai Rank 5 Upgrade
missions.summary: Councillor Uje'da has authorized the Paren Ship Yard to improve your hull. You will also be advanced to your next rank.

nodes.text: Back once again, but there is still much more advice to give you. As you learn and grow, reflect on your experiences. There must have been many who helped you along the way. There have also been times when you simply wanted to give up. Reflect on your successes and failures and you will become stronger and more focused.

Now it is time for advancement. Go to the Paren Ship Yard in Kailaasa, Capella. The Jenquai there will upgrade your hull to aid your self-improvement. Also, do not forget to bring 25,000 credits to cover the fee.
That is not the patience of a true Jenquai. Return when you have settled your conscience.

stages.description: Head to the Paren Ship Yard (Kailaasa, Capella System) and pay the 25,000 credit fee.

nodes.text: @name, you return! Undoubtably here for your next hull upgrade I am sure.

branches.text: We are friends now? You wouldn't offer me a job!

nodes.text: Well then, your hull has been upgraded to your fifth upgrade. Your rank has also been advanced. Enjoy your new ship. I hope it makes it easier for you out there.

Whoever said we were friends? If I call someone by their name does that automatically mean we are friends?? It's the kinds like you that make Jenquai helpers have to act so impersonal all the time... I step out of the box just once and some Jenquai assumes I am their friend. I'm just doing my job alright?

missions.name: Final Jenquai Rank Upgrade
missions.summary: Councillor Uje'da has authorized the Paren Ship Yard to improve your hull for the last time. You will also be advanced to your final rank.

nodes.text: Here you are, @name, @race @class. It is time for your last hull upgrade. Are you ready?

Do not worry, this is not the end of your travels. There is much more to explore that has been far too dangerous for you before. With this hull I hope you can survive long enough to unlock the mysteries of the universe waiting for you.



Travel to Paren Ship Yard, pay the 25,000 credit fee, and receive your final hull upgrade. It is time.
I implore you, fear not, there is nothing to lose but everything to gain. Return to me when you are ready.

stages.description: Head to the Paren Ship Yard (Kailaasa, Capella System) and pay the 25,000 credit fee.

nodes.text:
Hello, friend. At this point in your growth as a Jenquai I can't help but call you a friend.




It is time, huh. Time for your final hull upgrade.

You have now received your final hull upgrade as well as your maximum rank. Your hull is now as tough as it will ever be and you now have your final equipment slot. Your help will be of much greater demand as you will help defeat the strongest of the strong. Enjoy your new power and continue to become stronger. This is as far as I can help you. Good luck, @name.

missions.name: 100,000 credits for a hull upgrade or do a mission [Version 2.2.-]
missions.xml_name: 100,000 credits for a hull upgrade or do a mission [Version 2.2.-]
missions.summary:
Contact Proconsul Dionysius Kerr when you are ready to upgrade to level 4 Hull.  Please note you have a choice - pay or do a mission.  You will only be able to obtain the hull upgrade once.
For the mission speak to Speak to Andronicus Tyr in Arx Spartoi.

nodes.text:
I see you are ready for your next Promotion. 

Again, you have a choice.  Visis the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus when you have 100,000 credits, or contact Andronicus Tyr in Arx Spartoi.  

Remember, you will be unable to do Tyr's mission if you already have the level 4 hull upgrade, but if you do Tyr's mission you will be unable to get the hull upgrade by paying for it.

branches.text: I have the credits, I'll pay the 100,000 credits.
I volunteer to do the mission for the Progen Republic.

nodes.text: Paying your way means you do miss out on helping the Republic, @name.

@name.

Your reputation goes before you.  Andronicus Tyr is waiting for you in Arx Spartoi.  I don't expect to see you fail this mission, but if you do, return to me and I'll send you to the Tiberius Shipyards to pay.

stages.description: Contact the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus when you have the required 100,000 credits.

nodes.text: Your a little earlier than expected, but my team will get right on it.  You are in a hurry aren't you?
Heres you new hull then, @name.

missions.name: Scuttle Bugs
missions.summary: Help with clearing the area from Scuttle Bugs.

nodes.text: Hello there @name. I heard you were wondering around these parts.

branches.text: I really did not want everyone to know me

nodes.text: Yes, word around here travels pretty quickly. Seems you have been doing some good work for a few of my close friends. And from what they tell me, you still looking for some work?

branches.text: Always looking for some good paying work.
no I am not looking for work

nodes.text: Well, then look no further. I have something that needs to get done, and it too pays well. The Glenn Commission several years ago decided to fund research on the Scuttle Bug. They managed to tame several and make them pets for their homes. But taming them has proven to be extremely difficult.

branches.text: Who would want a Scuttle Bug as a pet?

nodes.text: I understand you more than you know. But my position requires me to not take sides in this matter. You see, down in Shepard the research team put in place some breeding grounds for the Scuttle Bugs. Not knowing that the reproduce at an extremely rapid pace. It didn't take long before the researcher's were run out of the area as well.

branches.text: So they have just been there. Reproducing?
Where can I find this pet, like to bring it home

nodes.text: That is exactly what has been happening. And now they have come to me asking for help to. lets say slim out the population. Now, if what my friends have told me is true, then you are just the person to help out the Commission.

branches.text: I can certainly help. they are just bugs.
I do not want to work for the Commission

nodes.text: They may be just bugs, but they pack a punch if you know what I mean. At last count, which was some time ago, there were nearly 100 bugs located at the Pax Swift Star, which is one of the first breeding grounds that they created. We need to eliminate as many as possible.

branches.text: You want me to eliminate 100 of these bugs?
you want to send me to a place filled with Bugs... no way

nodes.text: Not 100, no. That would be a daunting task. Let's start out with a lower number. Let's eliminate 10 of these bugs and see what happens from there. I think that would be a good start, and the Glenn Commission is willing to pay you handsomely for your help.

branches.text: I will return to you once they have been eliminated.
Glenn Commission is not able to pay me enough for this job

nodes.text: Hurry now. There are many people awaiting your return. A lot depends on your success.

branches.text: I am not so sure I can handle this

nodes.text: Better you leave me alone then.

stages.description: Travel to Shepard, Pax Swift Star.
Eliminate 10 Scuttle Bugs.
Return to Monty DuChampe.

nodes.text: I have already heard reports that you were successful. It seems the research team has already moved into the area to start cleaning up the remaining scuttle bugs.

branches.text: There were still many more and they reproduced nearly instantly.

nodes.text: I hope the research team knows this, I told them to wait for your return so that we could get a full report. I'm sure they will see and not move in. Were there many Scuttle Bugs in the area?

branches.text: Many more than the 100 that was last reported.

nodes.text: That is not good, it seems as though we may have much more work ahead of us. Well, as promised by the Glenn Commission here is your reward for your work. The Commission and the research team are grateful for your help. Maybe you can return later, if what you have said is true there is much more work that needs to be done.

missions.name: Scuttle Bug Elimination
missions.summary: Help Eliminate the Scuttle Bugs

nodes.text: Welcome back @name. It appears that my fears before were correct. The research team rushed out way to quick after work of your previous success. They became overwhelmed after they rushed in without an ounce of caution. And now, the Commission is holding me responsible.

branches.text: Why would they hold you responsible?

nodes.text: It was me that gave them the go ahead after I heard of your success. There were casualties, and they hold me ultimately responsible. I too hold myself responsible.

branches.text: There is nothing you could have done.
Then why you talking to me?

nodes.text: Maybe not, but I could had insisted that the research team remain here until your return. That way we would have known that the area was so overrun. Instead, in my haste and theirs I let them run off to start working on the area again.

branches.text: I think you're being a bit harsh on yourself.
you want to me to kill more?

nodes.text: Even if I were, the loss of my friends on the research team is hard to bare. On to business now though, we have been directed to remove all the remaining Scuttle Bugs from the area so that our security can set up a war front office at the Pax Swift Star.

branches.text: You have to find someone else I am not gonna kill those pets

nodes.text: I was hoping that would be your response. I have several other independent workers headed that way now as well. With the combined effort we will be able to dispose of these wretched bugs.

branches.text: How many should I dispose of?
So you hired other people huh

nodes.text: Everyone I have asked for help as agreed to eliminate 15 of the bugs. With everyone doing that I'm sure that Shepard will soon be free of them.  Go now; I'm sure the other's that are already there could use your help.
You feeling guilty now for killing them?

stages.description: Travel to Shepard, Then to Pax Swift Star.
Eliminate 15 Scuttle Bugs.
Return to Monty DuChampe.

nodes.text: Outstanding! Everyone is returning; there have been hundreds of Scuttle Bugs eliminated already! The work that you guys are doing is fantastic. @name, were you able to eliminate the agreed upon 15 Scuttle Bugs?

Ahh. this is a glorious and fantastic day. With the way you and others are wiping these wretched bugs out we will be completely rid of them in no time. The commission has requested that I pay an extremely handsome prize for your hard work. It seems that if it wasn't for you then we would have never had the information we needed to defeat them.
Well here you go then @name.  Your reputation here has certainly surpassed itself. We all owe you a debt of gratitude.

missions.name: Roland Holmes and His Henchmen
missions.summary: Help with the capture of Roland Holmes and his Henchmen.

nodes.text: Wenton Ness here! Do you have an access badge? This area is off limits to those without access badges.
Then I must ask you to move along.

branches.text: What is the big secret over here?

nodes.text: There is no secrets. I'm head security for Friendship 7 Recreation Port.  I run a tight ship around here, and that is that. Why exactly are you asking questions?

branches.text: You just seem pretty uptight is all.
If there is no secret there is no point talking to you.

nodes.text: You would be uptight too if. oh.

Oh. now I have gone and done it. Fine, if you must know. That Roland Holmes has been randomly attacking our tourist ships and has made direct threats towards Friendship 7. I've had my best guys try to place him under arrest but they have all been killed attempting to do so.

branches.text: Sounds as though you could use some help.
So that is not my problem then good luck.

nodes.text: This really isn't something you should get involved with. I do appreciate your willingness to help though. This guy is one of the worst villains to ever be seen in Beta Hydri.

branches.text: It truly wouldn't be a bother, in fact I would really like to help.
No problem then I will not get involved

nodes.text: I guess I could hire you on the side, but I'm warning you now, if anything happens to you. I knew nothing about this. Ok, let's see. You will need some intelligence input. He was last reported as being seen down in Slayton, reports say that he has a hideout down there near Soyuz Passages.  Reportedly there are several of his followers that are always at the hideout as well, so gaining access has proven to be a problem.

branches.text: I think I can get him for you.
I am not a hired gun, I do have some brains.

nodes.text: Go then friend. If he is not there, then try to take as many of his henchmen as possible into custody. Slimming out his clan will certainly help as well.

branches.text: If your not sure he is there what is the point for me to go there

nodes.text: Go in peace then my friend

stages.description: Defeat 5 Holmes Henchmen.
Return to Wenton Ness.

nodes.text: Were you able to apprehend Holmes?

branches.text: Holmes wasn't there when I arrived, but I was able to defeat 5 of his henchmen.

nodes.text: That is certainly a start. That will slow down his rampage on our tourists for a short time at least. I can't give you the full reward, since obviously you didn't capture Holmes himself. But here is something for what you have done. I am certainly appreciative of what you have done to help, as well as the Glenn Commission.

missions.name: Slowing the Chavez
missions.summary: Assist Portia LaPointe with the Chavez.

nodes.text: Sans maitrise, la puissance n'est rien.

Oh. my... I'm sorry. Sometimes I speak in my native tongue. That means power is nothing without skill. More often than not around these parts you find that these space travelers think that just over powering others will give them an immediate victory.
So you have seen it as well. Arrogance will get these people no where. What kind of person are you?

branches.text: That depends on the situation and circumstance.

nodes.text: Say there was some Chavez terrorizing the local area. You know the location they are in, but you also know there are a large number of them. What would you do?

branches.text: Try to take out the largest one first.

nodes.text: That doesn't sound like to bad of a method. Take out the big guys so that the others don't have a leader. Hmm. not certain though, if that falls into the over powering or using your brain category though.

branches.text: I think the one leads to the other in this case.

nodes.text: Well it just happens that this is a true scenario right now. It seems the Chavez have been harassing local tourist ships and travelers here in Glenn. They were tracked back to a supply depot, but nobody has been able to get close enough to them due to their cult having so many.

branches.text: And you would like for me to take out the largest in the group, in hopes that it disorganizes them?

nodes.text: This is indeed what I would like for you to do. It will take power but it will also take something more in order to achieve this task. Go forth and kill the Chavez in charge of this supply depot.

stages.description: Defeat the Chavez Blood Initiate Commander.
Return to Portia LaPointe.

nodes.text: I see you have found a way to be cunning yet powerful. It was no easy task heading out there, one against an army per say. It took tactic, stealth and knowledge to get in there and complete the task.

branches.text: Honestly. I went in guns a blazing.

nodes.text: So you are one who thinks Power is more important than skill.

branches.text: Not at all, the Chavez don't require skill to defeat though.

nodes.text: To some they may not but to other's they may. For now though, you have helped in diminishing the Chavez resistance here in Glenn. And for this I am grateful. Let's hope that your success, regardless of how accomplished. Is enough to deter them from further assaulting anyone visiting Glenn.

missions.name: Cooper Creatures
missions.summary: Help Belulah Lee inspect the Tada'O Gate and the Ten-Gu

nodes.text: Things are crazy around here. just crazy.

branches.text: What seems to have everything in an uproar?

nodes.text: It seems that down in Cooper there are some horrific creatures stirring around. People have already named them Ten-Gu, but who knows what they really are.

We don't know for certain yet, we are investigating the area still but its taking some time due to these Ten-Gu being all over the place. The only thing we have found so far is a new type of gate, we're not sure who built it but it almost seems as though the Ten-Gu are coming out of it.

branches.text: Would you like for me to investigate anything?
I like fish, fried or baked

nodes.text: If you would be willing to enter into Cooper then you could prove to be a value to me and the rest of mankind. You see, we need more people in there to find the source. Once we find the source we can look at closing the doors to it, only then we will be able to begin our normal operations in Cooper.

branches.text: I am not going there, too dangerous

nodes.text: There are a lot of valuable resources in the sector, and we run tests in that area as well.

branches.text: So what is it you would like for me to do?
you want me to prospect there, while I can do it at safer places?

nodes.text: I guess the first thing we should do is inspect that gate, we need to know who built it, where it came from. Go to it and see if there is any information you can obtain from it.

branches.text: you want me to look at a gate? ermm....... no thanks

nodes.text: Be safe, it's a dangerous place there.

branches.text: Safe i would be at a lot of differend places.

nodes.text: I am not in the mood to talk now.

stages.description: Inspect the Tada'O Gate in Cooper.
Return to Belulah Lee.

nodes.text: Your back! We have found out a lot of useful information since you left to go inspect the gate.

branches.text: The gate says something about Tada-O on it.

nodes.text: It does? That would seem to confirm the rumors that are spreading throughout the galaxy as we speak. It is in the rumor mill that Tada-O ran an experiment to build a new gate. It appears that the gate was a success but at the same time once it opened the TEN-GU started leaking out and quickly overwhelmed them.
It appears that they aborted everything and high tailed it out of there. Unfortunately the gate remains open, we don't know how to close it.

branches.text: That doesn't seem to be too promising.

nodes.text: Not at all. I have another request of you if you're willing to travel to Cooper once again.

branches.text: Give me my orders. these monsters must be stopped.

nodes.text: I need so specimens from the TEN-GU. I want to see if I can track down where they are coming from. This is a highly dangerous thing I'm asking of you, but I want you to go and collect 10 Signed Ten-Gu Hide from the corpses of the Ten-Gu. If you do this for me I will have a great reward for you.
Again, be safe out there. We don't know what those things are capable of yet.

stages.description: Kill 5 Ten-Gu Blight and bring back the Singed Ten-Gu Hide from the Ten-Gu.
Return to Belulah Lee.

nodes.text: Do you have the specimens?
Interesting. I wasn't expecting anything like this. This will take some time to analyze.

branches.text: Do you have any clues from this?

nodes.text: I'm certain there are clues, but it will take some time to decipher through the specimens. Come back and see me later, I might have more for you to help out with. Oh. and here is your reward for helping me out.

missions.name: Strange Rumors
missions.summary: Help Anusha Dayakara with some rumors.

nodes.text: Hello there @race. What brings you around these parts. Can't say I've seen you around here before?

branches.text: Just out and about looking for work that needs to be done.
I was looking for the exit

nodes.text: Did someone send you here? Who was it? Was it those darn.. Oh never mind. Just who was it?

branches.text: Nobody sent me, honestly here just looking for work, and to lend a hand.

nodes.text: Something seems very fishy about this! But if you're here for some work then I'm the person to talk to, I'm in dire need of some help.

branches.text: I'm more than willing to help you out.
I would not work for someone like you

nodes.text: Good. Well I think that them. I can't say it too loud, so I won't say their names at all. Have been sneaking around trying to steal my secrets.  Well, I think its time for me to start snooping in their business.

branches.text: You seem pretty upset, who are you talking about?

nodes.text: I just said I wasn't going to say! You're going to find out soon enough anyways. Don't be so hasty.

branches.text: Sorry, wasn't trying to be hasty.
If you do not like hasty I am the wrong person for the job

nodes.text: That is fine, it's a good characteristic to have sometimes. Now, where were we, that's right. I've been hearing rumors about a few places, and I want you to check them out for me. Are you willing to do that?

branches.text: Of course I'm willing to help out.
You want me to check things out based on rumours?

nodes.text: Good. Let's see now. The first place isn't to far away at all, but I've heard some rumors about a strange ship around the location. Head out into Carpenter, near Lagrange 4 Point. I've head of a mysterious ore that has been popping up there, and that the place is being overrun with scavengers looking for it.

branches.text: First place? Oh my.. I am not going to fly across the galaxy for your rumours

nodes.text: Not that I'm aware of, or at least I haven't heard any rumors of them being aggressive yet. Head out there and let me know what's going on, when you get back I have another location that is even more intriguing that we need to see.
Fine be that way... Bye

stages.description: Travel to Nav Lagrange 4 Point and inspect the area.
Return to Anusha Dayakara.

nodes.text: Well, was it as hopping with scavengers as what I was told?

branches.text: I didn't see a single scavenger, just some Claimjumpers.
I almost got killed while you said they were not aggresive

nodes.text: Claimjumpers. Scavenger's. same difference. I wonder exactly what they are up too. I think I have someone for that job in mind though. As I said, I have another place, not so easy to find that I have been hearing rumors about.

branches.text: I can certainly help again, this sounds interesting.
If you can not see the difference between scavengers and claimjumper I would be scared to continue

nodes.text: It should, from what I am hearing, the Glenn Commission had an experiment with some nasty bugs.  And of course, like most things they do, it turned into chaos. I guess these nasty little bugs have overrun the place. But of course I've heard conflicting stories as well. Some say that it has been a success, and that they are breeding war fighting bugs.

branches.text: War fighting bugs? That sounds like non-sense.
You base your fact on hear say? Like the scavengers huh

nodes.text: Non-sense or not, we must find out the truth don't you think? After all, a enemy such as that could be devastating to anyone who took it on.

branches.text: The truth is in the eye of the beholder

nodes.text: Ok, come in close, if rumors get out about this before we find out the truth then things could get really bad. besides I know someone is listening to our every word.

branches.text: But nobody is around to be listening to us.
hearing, rumours they listening in.. whats wrong with you

nodes.text: They are there, we may not see them but they are there.  Now come over here, so I can whisper.. Ok. The location is the Swift Pax Star. It's supposed to be an experimental site for working with these bugs. We need to find out exactly the truth before the wrong word gets out.

branches.text: An experimental site? You know what is out there, if not I am not the right class to shoot experimental bugs

nodes.text: Hurry back once you find out the truth about what is happening there. And don't say a word to anyone, and try to be as secretive as possible. I have uploaded a few other places for you to visit first, just in case someone is trying to follow you.
No problem I will find someone else then

stages.description: Travel to the GETCO Mining Rig, Shepard.
Travel to Geezer Rock, Shepard.
Travel to Pax Swift Star, Shepard.
Return to Anusha Dayakara, tell what you have learned.

nodes.text: Were you able to find the Pax Swift Star? What did you learn? Come whisper it to me.

branches.text: It seemed overrun by the bugs. although they did seem quite vicious.

nodes.text: Was there anyone around. that maybe seemed to be training them?

branches.text: I did not see anyone that would have been training them. maybe disposing of them.

nodes.text: That is certainly a good sign. that would mean that the rumors of super bugs being created for fighting in wars was wrong. I must inform the seniors of this quickly before anything else happens.
Yes, those are the ones always listening. Please, take this for your time and effort. Please come back again sometime, your one of the few I can trust.

missions.name: Emergency Delivery
missions.summary: Pickup an important package for Anusha Dayakara.

nodes.text: Hey. Over here for a second.

branches.text: I do not have a second

nodes.text: You most certainly can. Of course only if you can be trusted.

branches.text: I'm the most trusted person around.
Ofcouse I can not be trusted I am a trader

nodes.text: That sounds as though it has potential. I have a request for you. Do you have some spare time?

branches.text: I'm sure I can squeeze some time in to help out.
Spare change I have but no spare time

nodes.text: I have a friend at Chernevog Station named Harvey Krum. He has a package for me. A very important package!  Would you be willing to travel and get it for me? I know it's a ways off, but I would be forever indebted to you.

branches.text: I'm sure I could mossy down and get it for you.

nodes.text: Excellent, it is very fragile, so please be very careful. Harvey may require some kind of deposit; try to talk him out of it, if he insists though I will reimburse you when you get back.

branches.text: At second thought I do not want to warp half the galaxy to do parcel services

nodes.text: Fine.. then move along

stages.description: Travel to Chernevog Station, Aragoth Prime and speak with Harvey Krum.

nodes.text: To who it is. is what it does! What brings you around these fine parts partner?

branches.text: I was asked by Anusha Dayakara to come pick up a package.
You gonna ask me for credits right? I don't think so

nodes.text: Oh, you were now. well, did she tell you exactly what the package was?

branches.text: No, only that it was extremely important.

nodes.text: Now that Anusha. has to be the most paranoid person I know. About this package now, I'm sure she told you, I don't hand over anything without some insurance. This is going to cost you 1500. you know, for insurance and my time.

branches.text: I'm sure we can wave the fees this time around.
What!!!!! I do not have any credits you should give me some

nodes.text: Well, I'm sure you can return to Anusha without her "important merchandise" then huh!?

branches.text: Fine. the 1500, and give me the package.
I am not going to pay you she will have to find another

nodes.text: Well, lets not get carried away partner. I'm just doing a service here just like yourself. Ok now. where did I put that thing.? Ok... here you go, now hurry and get this to Anusha. its kind of unstable.
Maybe your just a bum go away

stages.description: Return to Anusha Dayakara with the important package.

nodes.text: Were you able to get the package? Do you have it?

branches.text: What would you want with this thing?

nodes.text: Why are you asking so many questions. all I asked you for was to pick it up. There's no reason you should need to know what I'm doing. Are you sure nobody sent you to intercept information from me?

branches.text: Nobody sent me. I was just curious, no need to be offensive.

nodes.text: I'm not offensive, my research is just very important and any leak of information on what I'm doing would be disastrous. I apologize if I was out of line, please take this for your time and for all your help.

branches.text: Before we part ways as well. Harvey charged me 1500 for his service.

nodes.text: I figure he would, he's only in it for the money. This should cover your it, added 1500 credits to your reward

missions.name: Secure Neptune Gate
missions.summary: Neptune Gate has been closed due to Aggesive Red Dragon movements.   Help resecure the gate in order to open Neptune.

nodes.text: YOU @race !!!  You need to get out to Uranus and help get those Red Dragons out of there.
Neptune's gate is closed.   We've got to get it open.  Get out there and destroy those pirates.
Destroy them and take no prisoners.
You coward!!!!

stages.description: Destroy 5 Red Dragons  Initiates
Report back to Admiral Jimmy Venus Sector.

nodes.text: Five?  Five is all you could get?  Are you too weak?  Are you scared?
Do I want more?  Can you get in the gate yet?
Then go destroy them.

stages.description: Destroy 5 Red Dragons Novice
Destroy 5 Red Dragons Veterans
Report back to Admiral Jimmy Venus Sector.

nodes.text: Now that's better.
You may one day make a good fighter.
Here's something for your trouble.

missions.name: Recover Neptune Gate
missions.summary: Regain control of Neptune's gate

nodes.text: Ahh finally a @race.  We need your help.  Neptune has closed their gate do to all the Red Dragons in the area.
Yes now keep up with me.  We need your help to clear out the pirates and get that gate open.   Can you do it?

branches.text: Um no I'm kind of busy.

nodes.text: Great go to it.
Too bad it'll just be that much longer then.

stages.description: Travel to Uranus and destroy 5 Red Dragons Initiates
Destroy 5 Red Dragons Novice
Destroy 5 Red Dragons Veterans
Return to Ayusaki

nodes.text: Awesome.  You did it.
That's cool.  You thinned them out.  It'll help a lot in getting that area secured again.

branches.text: Thank you I did my best.

nodes.text: Of course you did @name.  Here take this for your help.

missions.name: Scanning the Sites
missions.summary: Check out the areas for Arno Suiliman's travels, to ensure the dignitaries safety.

nodes.text: Hello @name. I could certainly use some help if you're willing.

branches.text: That would be the reason why I'm here Arno.
Willing I am, able is another story

nodes.text: Excellent. Here in a few hours I have to take a few dignitaries on a tour, and the worst part is that it's a tour of Capella. I don't know much about Capella, but from what I've heard it can be a mighty rough place in parts. I'm willing to pay you generously if you check out the places before I have to head there, that way I know its safe.

branches.text: I can do that for you Arno, shouldn't be too hard.
You want me to tour an entire sector, I am not willing anymore

nodes.text: Fantastic my friend. I will update the sites in your computer. All I need to know is that I won't be in danger, and my dignitaries won't be in danger.
I am sorry to hear that, maybe come back later when you are willing and able and want a not so dangerous mission

stages.description: Travel to the Veil Trader's Beacon, Kitara's Veil.
Travel to Hau Field Beacon, Dahin.
Travel to Paren's Beacon, Kailaasa.
Travel to Ketsugo's Observation Outpost, Yokan.
Return and speak to Arno Suiliman.

nodes.text: Welcome back @name! Well. hopefully those areas weren't too dangerous. I'm really shaking in my boots right now, I have to take them on a tour and not even certain about the areas.

branches.text: I searched each area, and all seems safe.

nodes.text: That is so relieving to hear. I've heard so many dreadful stories about Capella, the Mordana and everything else. I would have been sent to prison for life if the dignitaries even got a scratch.

branches.text: Must be some pretty important dignitaries.

nodes.text: They most certainly are but I'm not allowed to say who they are.

branches.text: That makes no sense, I could easily follow you now, I know where you're going.

nodes.text: Good point, but if I tell you, you have to promise to tell no one else.
It's my mom and dad. they have been on me for years to take them on a scenic vacation, if anything happens to them, I will never live it down.
You may think its funny, my parents are a nightmare. Thanks again for helping me with scoping out those areas. And do me a favor and keep this a secret, I'm using the company ship for this one.

missions.name: Top Secret Delivery
missions.summary: Arno Suiliman has a order for a Top Secret Deliver. Follow his directions.

nodes.text: Welcome @name! Good to see you still around. Things been treating you good?

branches.text: Things have been ok, just looking for work as usual.

nodes.text: Looking for work huh.. I think I have just the thing for you.

branches.text: Excellent, always love doing work for you Arno.

nodes.text: Well, this one is probably the most important I've had you do. And with that, I have to have your word that you will tell nobody about this. It's a little out of the normal for me to even have anyone do this, but it's extremely important.

branches.text: You have my word Arno. no one will know.

nodes.text: Good. I've been asked to find someone to pickup and deliver a package. I'm told its nothing to serious, but important enough I would say. Travel to New Edinburgh, Somerled Station and speak with Spetsky. He will give you further directions. That's pretty much all I know from my end.
Arno - I've been promised that there will be a hefty reward for doing this. So come see me when it's done.

stages.description: Travel to New Edinburgh, Somerled Station and speak to Spetsky.

nodes.text: Hello there traveler! Hopefully things have been treating you good!
So what brings you to these parts? The beautiful scenery, lovely flowers?

branches.text: I was told to come for a package from Arno Suiliman.

nodes.text: Ohh. well why didn't you say so. Didn't expect to see you mixed up in this. especially as a courier.

branches.text: I'm starting to wonder why I'm mixed up in it too.

nodes.text: Well, no fear. You're tied to it now. I don't have the package; I'm just another stop on the way. I was told to tell you to go speak with Alexa Richter, Alpha Centauri, Zweihander, Earth Corps High Command. You will get the package from there.
Hurry, now. Were losing time.

stages.description: Travel to Alpha Cenauri, Zweihander, Earth Corps High Command and speak to Alexa Richter.

nodes.text: Welcome @name. Spetsky sent a transmission saying to expect you. I have the package here for you; he said you would be happy to hear that.

branches.text: I'm certainly happy to hear that.

nodes.text: So, would you like some insight into what the package is?

branches.text: I'm not sure, from what I've been told this is pretty much top secret stuff, and what I don't know wont hurt me.

nodes.text: Well, it's not as top secret as you might think. The package contains a Birthday Cake and Ice Cream. You see, its Arno's birthday today.

branches.text: You're kidding me. all this for that.

nodes.text: Why certainly. Arno has been a huge help to all of us at some point or another. He hires out all the help that we need, and ensures that the jobs get done. He is a true asset to the future of everything we stand for.

branches.text: I can see that, he is a truly good guy.

nodes.text: Ok, now here's the thing. With this being Birthday Cake and Ice Cream it wont last long so you have to get it to him quick. and give him a big Happy Birthday.
Well. I give it no more than thirty minutes before the Ice Cream melts. and the cake icing begins to melt as well. So here it is. get it to Arno as quick as you can.

stages.description: Return to Arno Suiliman with the Birthday delivery.

nodes.text: I see you have returned. how did the package delivery go. well never mind. As top secret as they treated it I'm not sure I want to know.

branches.text: Here it is. and Happy Birthday.

nodes.text: Oh. you guys! You knew about this the whole time didn't you? Oh. thank you so much. I have to get a hold of everyone and let them know how grateful I am.

branches.text: Everyone wanted me to give you the best wishes ever for your birthday.

nodes.text: Well. this has certainly made my day. How did you know it was my birthday. oh never mind, it's just amazing that. well that everyone thought of me. Well, they told me to give this to you. I guess maybe to cover your gas costs, so here you go. I hope you have as wonderful of a day as me.

missions.name: Reliving the Past
missions.summary: Follow Curator Gloria Whitley's path to reliving the past.

nodes.text: Now that you have honored the memories of those that came before us, it is time for you to see what can happen to us in the future, at least if things continue on their current route.

branches.text: The future cannot be that bad.

nodes.text: You see, the future is every moment that we are here. The signs of this are located nearly everywhere we go. You can see our failures, you can see what has lead us to be what we are now, and you can see that there is no change to this.

branches.text: I would like to see all of this as well.

nodes.text: Then you shall my friend. I am going to direct you to a few places, each place has its own story. Some are sad; some are of victorious warriors that finally met their doom. Some are of the greatest explorer's every known, who too journeyed to far out, way to early. Then there are those that traveled to far out, in order to get that one thing that everyone has searched for.

branches.text: Sounds like this will be some sad travels.

nodes.text: It is not meant to be sad, it is meant so that everyone that takes this route will know what is coming. For what is known can be prevented.  We will start with a distant travel, a travel back in time to when the first Progens began to settle on Neptune. I will need you to travel to prog_cap_wreck1 . Here you will find that nothing remains but the destroyed remains. A first sign of what is to come.

stages.description: Travel to Neptune and inspect the wrecked Progen ship, it is hidden and not easily found.
Return to Curator Gloria Whitley.

nodes.text: You see the carnage that once was there? This is what we have done to ourselves; we are the same you see?

branches.text: But we are not the same, we have many differences.

nodes.text: Many differences on the outside, inside we are all identical. It seems as though you need to see the part of your path. This place is dedicated to Ngozi Maru Memorium. It is the destroyed ship of a Jenquai warrior. Thought to be the most intelligent of all the races. Although they are the type to sit back and observe, they too have contributed to what now is.

branches.text: The Jenquai don't seem the type to do this.

nodes.text: We are all part of what has become and what will happen in the future.  Now, travel to Ngozi Maru Memorium. You will find the destroyed ship of a Jenquai. One that while was observant, failed to see the dangers that were right there.

stages.description: Travel to Jupiter and inspect the Ngozi Maru Memorium.
Return to Curator Gloria Whitley.

nodes.text: Did you see? The carnage that was left. Now it is nothing more than a memorial that was left behind to show those who follow of what had happened. A warning of sorts, a warning against the future.

branches.text: I saw the carnage, it was devastating. What could have done that?

nodes.text: I can only lead you down the path and provide the direction. You will see for yourself what has done this.

branches.text: I think I may already know.

nodes.text: I think that you may have started seeing the obvious. There is one place that I would like you to go, the last part of the path. You have already visited the remains of a prestigious Warrior Progen, and have seen the remains of what was once a great Jenquai Explorer. Now you must travel closer to where we have all come from.

branches.text: I must travel near earth, where all mankind originated from.

nodes.text: You felt that inside did you not? Yes, Earth is the next stop on your journey. The Terran's, have always seeked money, have seeked power. They have claimed the Earth world and the surrounding areas as their own. Do you think that this happened easily?

branches.text: I think that they must have done something to call Earth home.

nodes.text: Yes they have, you see, not unlike the Progen and Jenquai, they have made their mistakes as well. This part of the path will lead you to Neptune. As you said before, the terr_cap_wreck1 is located in Neptune, near Earth. He was too a powerful Terran, whom had the success that all Terran's seek today. But like the other's you have seen wasn't prepared for the future.

branches.text: I will go now and finish my path.

nodes.text: Keep in mind, that this may be the most brutal one that you have seen, as for this one has happened much more recently.

stages.description: Travel to Neptune and inspect the wrecked Terran Ship, is hidden and may not be easily found.
Return to Curator Gloria Whitley.

nodes.text: Did you see the carnage? The carnage that was left of this mighty Terran? You see, now you have visited memorials for all three of the classes. All of which were wise, powerful and cunning. And that all met the same fate.
So now do you understand, what this path has taught you?

I believe you think you now understand. What you may not understand is that all of these people, the Progen, Jenquai and Terran were all destroyed by one another. For many years now, each of the races have fought for supremacy. Have fought each other. These memorials that you have visited are memorials that are there to show each and every one of us that this is not the way things should be.

branches.text: I now fully understand, and I do not want to follow the same path.

nodes.text: That is indeed a wise decision. But remember; while you are out there that there are other's that do not see things as we do. Always be prepared for anything that may come your way. For what comes your way may be there to do nothing more than destroy you.

missions.name: Focus on the Enemy
missions.summary: A Warrior needs to be able to inflict critical shots on the target.

nodes.text: @name, I'm glad you are still here.

branches.text: I take it you have a mission for me?
I'm actually on my way out!

nodes.text: Yes @name, I do.  I am going to give you an upgrade to your targeting systems of your ship, in exchange for accepting this mission.
It is called Critical Targeting.  This enhancement, will allow you to pinpoint your shots so you can inflict greater damage to your opponent.

branches.text: I like the sound of this.

nodes.text: Good. I need you to go on a Patrol in between our station here and the Primus Gate.  After undocking proceed to Nav Brattus 1.  After you have scouted the Area around that Nav point, proceed to the Tarsis Resource Belt to conclude your patrol path.

branches.text: This mission is going to be a bore.  *yawn*

nodes.text: Watch your tone @name!  You might not think this assignment is important, and I do not care.  I need you to follow orders or get out.  The other Progen Warriors that I've sent on other patrol paths did not talk back to me.  You should follow their example.

branches.text: Yes Maam.  I'll head out now.
I don't want to hear it. I'm out of here!

nodes.text: Ok, Good luck!  If you encounter any of those Shang Lo Red Dragons, avenge our fallen comrades on the Pax Regalia and annihilate them.
Come back when you are ready to take my assignment.

stages.description: Proceed to Nav Brattus 1 to begin your Patrol.
Patrol around the reasource field and kill at least 4 hostiles (Shang Lo).
Proceed to the Tarsis Resource Belt, to see if the hostiles (Shang Lo) are there as well.
Return to Lancearate Fortunatis to report hostile contacts.

nodes.text: Welcome back @name.  Tell me of your findings.

branches.text: I came into contact with Shang Lo Red Dragon pirates.

nodes.text: At both Nav points?

branches.text: Yes. They have even started up a mining operation.

nodes.text: Ok. Thank you for your report.  The other Progen Warriors that I sent out should be arriving in a few minutes, to hand me their patrol reports.

branches.text: Do you need me for anything else?

nodes.text: I may need you for another assignment.  Come back to me in a few minutes and I'll see what I have available.

missions.name: Tovar's Trap
missions.summary: Talk to Tovar Maxe to become more stealthy, Sentinel!

nodes.text:
Greetings @name, I am Tovar Maxe and  it is time for you to be stealthy.  
Do you want to learn how?

branches.text: I thought we had no means of Stealth, Tovar!
I prefer not to be stealthy, a Progen is meant to die in battle!

nodes.text: My little joke, no we operate by means of shutting down all but minimal ship power, to fool the foe you are just debris and not worthwhile investigating.

The skill is called Power Down, because that is what it does.
Your signature is reduced and all your equipment is offline.  However, you can observe in this static mode to plan your next move.

Now, usually you would have more experience under your belt to use this skill, but I have a little task that I want you to do.  In exchange, I will provide you the skill over a secure transmission at your target location.
Are you interested?

branches.text: Tovar, I will do what you want.
I have no need of this skill.

nodes.text:
Excellent.
/Salute  I want you to go to Nav Brightside 6, near to a wrecked progen vessel and Power Down. I have intelligence from our Privateers that a Red Dragon spy will attempt to make contact with a Red Dragon ship.  My engineers will fit a recording device to your sensor array to obtain the evidence.

branches.text: Sweet, I'd like to destroy some Red Dragon Scum.

nodes.text:
/Shrug  Ahh.. Unfortunately you will have to wait and observe.
We will get better intelligence if our adversaries do not know of this.  Also, best not to tell Centurion Minda.  She'll just want to ruin a good operation, @name.

branches.text: You can Count on Me, Tovar !
Count me out, I can survive without Power Down

nodes.text: I'll be waiting for your return, @name
You'll be back, @name

stages.description: Go to wrecked progen ship near to (Nav Brightside 6, Mars Beta) to gain Power Down skill by secure transmission from Tovar Maxe.
Activate Power Down Skill.
What are you going to tell Centurion Minda?

nodes.text: Hail @name .  How may you assist the Republic?

branches.text: I have some data that may interest you.

nodes.text:
What!
Rest assured your assistance will not be unrewarded.  Tovar should learn not to mess in the ways of the Centuriata.  We will deal with the Red Dragon Scum, ourselves.

I'm busy planning patrol routes and you come and bother me?  
/crash /crash  Begone.

stages.description: Collect Reward from Centurion Minda

nodes.text: @name, for your service to the Centuriata accept this reward.  You should have been a warrior!

stages.description: Return to Tovar Maxe to get reward for Mission

nodes.text:
Well done, @name.
This information correctly applied could advance our tactics against the Red Dragons.  You didn't speak to Minda did you?

branches.text: No - I spoke to Minda because she needs to Know

nodes.text: You should learn that we all report to the same command structure, eventually.  Minda has enough on her plate with planning patrolls.  I hope your actions have not caused the Republic to loose lives this day.

stages.description: Return to Tovar Maxe to get rewards for Mission

nodes.text:
Well done, @name.
This information correctly applied could advance our tactics against the Red Dragons.  You didn't speak to Minda did you?

That's good.
She should be left to concentrate on our patrols and stratagies.  This information would just get in the way.

missions.name: Critical Targeting for the Progen Sentinel
missions.xml_name: Critical Targeting for the Progen Sentinel
missions.summary: Critical Targeting for the Progen Sentinal

nodes.text: I am Andronicus Tyr, and I will now teach you Critical Targeting.

branches.text: I am @name, and eager to learn.

nodes.text: You are expected to kill a total of 3 Rogue Progen Heros. After your 1st kill, you will then level your Critical Targeting Skill. You may find them in various areas of the Sector, but the closest would be on the NNW side of planet Endriago, opposite a Progen Strike Force we have there.
At that point, you will need to kill 2 more. After those 2 kills, report back to me for your reward.

stages.description: Locate and Destroy 1 Rogue Progen Hero
Destroy 2 more Rogue Progen Heroes after upgrading your Critical Targeting.
Report back to Andronicus Tyr at Arx Spartoi for your reward.

nodes.text: You now have Critical Targeting. This will help with damage from your weapons as you level the skill. Take the reward for this task and be gone !

missions.name: PROGEN  Bonus 100   [Version 0.0.W]
missions.summary: Bonus mission to be assigned when conditions requiring owner of mission build completions.  Weapons.  Ammo and also unique loot given.  0.0 means not coded.

missions.name: Progen Sentinel Scan [Version 5.5.S]
missions.summary: Scan Relay En0898 is analyzing an Alien Core, the research project is controlled by Vinda on Pourvenir Mons (Endriago Planet).

stages.description: Scan Relay En0898 is analyzing an Alien Core, the research project is controlled by Vinda on Pourvenir Mons (Endriago Planet).

nodes.text:
WARNING

You have entered a restricted zone.  Please show your Authorization.

branches.text: I am here to learn scan.

nodes.text:
You are not authorized.

Gate Turrets have been alerted to your presence.
Speak to Vinda on Pourvenir Mons (Endriago Planet) to update your classification.

branches.text: What? I will have to go to Vinda then.

nodes.text:
TRACKING INTRUDER

Name:  @name
Race:   @race
Class:   @profession

Authorizing Termination.

Updating Information:  @name: Terran Spy - Kill on Sight.

branches.text: I'm @name, a @race and I'm not a spy!

nodes.text:
Terran Spy.

That is for Vinda to determine.  I suggest you speak to her.

stages.description: Speak to Vinda [Endriago Planet / Porvenir Mons]

nodes.text:
Aha!

Your the Terran Spy that the Scan Relay has detected.

GUARDS!
GUARDS!

Arrest this Spy and confiscate their ship.

branches.text: I'm not a Terran Spy - I'm a @profession called @name!

nodes.text:
Lets see,

@name - Terran Spy    ERROR 10101010101

Aha!
It appears you have a small corruption, I'll reset it if you agree to assist me.

The relay is assisting a scientific project that could eventually strengthen the Progen race.  I, erm, WE may need this to survive.  Your arrival may have caused errors in it's calculation.

branches.text: I would like to assist in the project to rectify the situation.

nodes.text:
Well @name, this is your lucky day.

I was expecting some project engineers to scan the alien core, but they were all diverted to some other project.  I was about to ask Ardos Klor  who is our resident non-weapon equipped items specialist.

However, he is no expendable, unlike you.

branches.text: Your not making any friends here.

nodes.text:
I didn't enter politics to make friends, @name.

Go to the Scan Relay.  I will provide it with your authorisation.  There is no need to involve Ardos Klor now in this part of the research.

I am in charge of this project and I make the decisions.

Ardos Klor does not need to be involved - his loyalies lie too close to his Privateer kin anyway.  Unlike him, @name, I will not cut corners.
Follow Vinda's Orders

stages.description: Goto Scan Relay En0898

nodes.text: ATTENTION.   Unauthorized vessel, you have entered a restricted zone.  Please obtain authorization from Vinda.

Authorization Granted.

Prepare to receive the Scan skill upgrade and procede to the alien core.

stages.description: Scan Alien Core then return to Endriago and speak to Vinda.
For your loyalty to Vinda, speak to her on Porvenir Mons.

nodes.text:
For the service to the republic any myself, @name, I have a small reward for you.  It is a occulum primoris, a token scanning device.

It should increase your scan range.

missions.name: Troublesome Times - Menace Skill [Version 2.0.S]
missions.summary: Talk to the Reclaimer Nayol Wat on Arx Magister as to how you can help the construction of the Menace Training Zone.

nodes.text: Well aren't you a fine one, whats your name?

Well, @name.

We have a small training issue here.
I'm sure you wanted to gain the Menace skill, but there is a small problem....

We have yet to build the training zone!

Anyway, what I need from you to assist the construction of a zone that will contain drones to be used by the menace trial is two stacks of raw topaz.  

It is a level 1 un-refined ore and from a friend I hear the nav paths through Primus have excellent Raw Topaz deposits.

I know.

This training area is going to cost quite a bit.

You should be glad your not a Privateer, I'm going to get them to make components that cannot be brought off component venders!

stages.description: Give 600 (2 stacks) of Raw Topaz to Reclaimer Nayol Wat in Arx Magister.  He reccomends Primus as a place to locate a high yield!

nodes.text:
Thank you @name for the Plutonium. Should make things interesting.

Here is your skill.  Enjoy!

missions.name: Aquire Menace [Version 2.2.P]
missions.summary: Help Reclaimer Nayol Wat build a menace zone.  Supply him with the mob dropped or loot only components he tells you to get.  There are three of them.

nodes.text:
What do you want?

Can't you see I'm busy?

branches.text: My name's @name and I'm here to learn Menace.

nodes.text:
Well, @name.

We have a small training issue here.
I'm sure you wanted to gain the Menace skill, but there is a small problem.

Anyway, what I need from you to assist the construction of a zone that will contain drones to be used by the menace trial is the following components:

10 x Athanor Standard Mount
10 x BlackBox G12
10 x Cyclo 50gHz Modulator  

Even you can do this.  Don't forget to write these down somewhere, I will not repeat them.

branches.text: Can you repeat yourself, I have not written this down!
I will get 10 of each of these components.

nodes.text:
I know.

This training area is going to cost quite a bit.
You should be glad your not a Sentinel, I'm going to get them to obtain 2 stacks of raw ore for me.

stages.description: Have you got 10 of each component for Reclaimer Nayol Wat?  Manufactured by Athanor, BlackBox and Cyclo.  Full description was in mission text.

nodes.text:
You have it all.

Good.  Hold on for those for me will you?

Here's you skill.

missions.name: [TEMP:  Progen Sentinel:  Grav Link]
missions.summary: This is a temporary mission to unlock the Gravity Link skill.  The actual skill may not be in the game.  Go to Jenya Erelius (Porvenir Mons) for further instruction.

nodes.text: I'm a little busy so I'll keep this brief.

@name.

THIS SKILL MAY NOT BE IN THE GAME.

branches.text: Erm, ok.  I'll be interested in doing the mission though.

nodes.text:
Fine.

I have given you an implant, but the skill is not in it.
In order to obtain the skill you need to kill a Glowing Mane which is a level 6 mane.  When it dies it transmits a help me message from which the skill it obtained.

branches.text: I will kill this and get the skill

nodes.text:
Don't return.
I'm busy.

stages.description: Kill a Glowing Mane (Level 6)

nodes.text: Kill mane

stages.description: Find a Glowing Mane (Level 6) and use the gravity link skill on one.

nodes.text: Well done.
