missions.summary: Sabine are in need of Centuriata Consul Gene-Maps.

nodes.text: Do you have five Centuriata Consul Gene-Maps?
Well, don't just stand there.  Talk to me again, and hand them over.
Come back to me once you have aquired 5 Centuriata Consul Gene-Maps.

stages.description: Hand over the five Centuriata Consul Gene-Maps.

nodes.text: Gimmie the Gene-Maps!
Thank You, Explorer.

missions.name: Centuriata Proconsul Gene-Map Recollection
missions.summary: Sabine are in need of Centuriata Proconsul Gene-Maps.  test on repeating missions.

nodes.text: Do you have five Centuriata Proconsul Gene-Maps?
Well, don't just stand there.  Talk to me again, and hand them over.
Come back to me once you have aquired 5 Centuriata Proconsul Gene-Maps.

stages.description: Aquire five Proconsul Lancearate Gene-Maps.

nodes.text: Do you have five Centuriata Proconsul Gene-Maps?
Well, don't just stand there.  Talk to me again, and hand them over.
Come back to me once you have aquired 5 Centuriata Proconsul Gene-Maps.

stages.description: Hand over the five Proconsul Lancearate Gene-Maps.

nodes.text: Gimme the Gene-Maps!
Thanks!

missions.name: Way of Collegia
missions.summary: A Warrior needs to be able to create their own ammo for superior combat capability.

nodes.text: Young Warrior! /wave Are you interested in manufacturing your own ammo, instead of relying on those vendors in the room behind me?

branches.text: Yes, I hate those wussy Vendors.

nodes.text: Good.  I don't like them either.  All they do is hide behind their boothes, like the sissies they are.

As you already know, recently the Red Dragon pirates infilitrated this sector.  Our scouts have reported that these Red Dragon pirates are wielding superior beam technology.  I need you to go out and "aquire" one of these Angry Gaze beams, that they are using.

branches.text: Do you know which of the Reds have them?

nodes.text: No, but the last scout patrol was ambushed by the Shang Lo Advanced Red Dragons over behind Brattus, by the Red Dragon Camp and the Casca's Vault Nav Point.
Good Luck.
Come back later when you "feel" you're ready.

stages.description: Kill the Shang Lo Advanced Red Dragon Patrols at Casca's Vault and the Red Dragon Camp, till you aquire an Angry Gaze.
Bring the Angry Gaze back to Lancearate Fortunatis.

nodes.text: Did you aquire one of those Angry Gaze beams?
Let me examine this beam laser.
*a few minutes go by*
Ok. Done.  Very interesting.  I will have my manufacturers take a look at this data, so we can create new shield systems against these Shang Lo.

As promised I will teach you how to Build Weapons and give you a Sparta Prosecutor Alpha as one of your first weapons to analyze. The analyze terminal allows you to learn a "recipe" where as the manufacture terminal allows you to build a "recipe."
Your welcome and enjoy.

missions.name: Progen Sentinel  [Build Devices]
missions.summary: Callipe Gans (Arx Spartoi, Endriago) would like you to go to him to learn how to build a level 1 Mining Device.  Once learn't he'd like you to return the rebuild device so you can prove you know how to do it.

nodes.text: If you are interested I can give you an Implant on how to build devices and a blueprint for a Miner 1 device.  You will have to build this device.
Talk to me.
Come back when you are ready.

stages.description: Take your reconstructed Miner device back to Callipe Gans (Arx Spartoi, Endriago)  to prove you have it.

nodes.text:
Well that's a fine looking device, @name.  

Keep it.  It'll help you.

missions.name: Progen Sentinel [Build Shields]
missions.summary: Place Holder for the PS Build Shields Skill.

nodes.text: I can give you an implant on how to build shields.
Talk to me again.
Come back when you are interested.

stages.description: Talk to Cestum Talus

nodes.text: Here you go.

missions.name: Build Reactors [Version 1.1.P]
missions.summary: Privateers, its time to learn how to build components.  Report to Deschide Poarta in Arx Emporos (Altair III).

stages.description: Speak to Deschide Poarta (Colleagia Master-Crafter) in Arx Emporos Altair III

nodes.text:
Welcome @name, I see you are a fine @class.
Just let me finish my drink and I'll be right with you.

branches.text: Where do I go to learn build reactors?

nodes.text:
Where do you think?

Try Enverro Verri.

stages.description: Deschide Poarta instructs you to speak to Everro Verri the Reactor Builder in Arx Emporos.

nodes.text:
Welcome back, @name, we have a small situation.

Some of the reactors we are getting are sub-standard.  We really need to equip the fleet with Progen Built reactors, and I'd like you to go to Arx Tiberius and speak to Markus Khan to obtain the schematics.
Safe travels @name.

stages.description: Go to Arx Tiberius (Tarsis) and speak to Markus Khan to get the recipy for the reactor.

nodes.text:
@name.

The plans were stolen by some Rogue Progen on the way to Arx Emporos.
I need you to kill them, check their stronghold 100K North behind Endriago Planet from Arx Spartoi.   I've also heard they exist in Altair III.

Kill 6 x Level 8 Rogue Progen and they may get ths hint to return the plans.

branches.text: I'll put the muscle on them boss.

nodes.text: Come straight back to me after killing them.

stages.description: Go and Kill  6 x CL 8  Rogue Progen to apply some pressure to them returning the schematics.  These can be found NE or N of Endriago Planet Space or Route to 61 Cygni in Altair III
Return to Marcus Khan  (Arx Tiberius in Tarsis)

nodes.text: I'm proud that you are a Progen!

stages.description: Take ta Nero Primoris to Deschide Poarta in Arx Emporos (Altair III) to collect your reward.

nodes.text:
@name.

You've returned, no problems I hope.

Well done.

Here is your reward.

missions.name: Build Shields [Version 1.0.P]
missions.summary: Talk to Deschide Poarta in Arx Emporos to learn how to build shields.  Just be wary, she can be a little short with you.

nodes.text:
So your after training in building shields are you?

Well, as you can see I'm fairly busy here, fixing this station.  Yesterday, we had the docking bay shields go down.  In fact i'm going to upload the blueprint into your build list inorder to build for me.

Interesting you say that, @name.

This shield requires 2 components that are easily brought.  However, one of them is hard to obtain - it only usually drops from enemies.  If you retro-analyze the level 2 shields located in this station the CE3K II component may be obtained.  

You will need to spend skill points in Build Shields order to get past this stage.

branches.text: Heh, you are a little short arn't you.

nodes.text:
/laugh

@name - I like you, you make me happy!  However, if you don't bring a Falkirk Alpha back to me you'll wish you'd never been created.

stages.description: Build a Falkirk Alpha using the pre-loaded blueprint, then return to Deschide Poarta (Arx Emporos, Altair III) to complete the training.

nodes.text: Back again are we @name?
Well what you know, a fully functioning shield.  This will look rather nice in my run-about.  I'll let the other trainers know that you're a competent student.

branches.text: Can I ask why no one is in the lobby?

nodes.text:
@name, thats simple!

The lobby can be used now for the Privateers, Warriors and Sentinels to trade their wares.  Both me and Sub Commander Frank prefer the bar.  You get more done there.

missions.name: Build Components [Version 1.0.P]
missions.summary: Privateers, its time to learn how to build components.  Due to the current upgrading of Arx Emporos in Altair III, you will be reporting at level 15 to Jay Xavier (Trade Vender).

nodes.text:
Hail @name.
Everro Verri has mentioned good things about you.
/wave.  Hi Everro.

Just call me Xav, @name we Privateers don't stand on formality.

Components are the quality behind all builds.  Without quality components you will fail to create high standard equipment.  Some builds use components to upgrade equipment.  Other builds are created from scratch.  For your components you will need to acquire some raw and refined ores in order to build them.

I have uploaded the information to your build terminal.  You will need to spend skill points in Build Components order to get past this stage.

I will say this only once, if you have not got written this down, tough.

branches.text: Ok I have written it down.

nodes.text:
What I want you to do is to create your components then use them to build a Falkirk Alpha.  Deschide Poarta has been bragging how her run-about is better with this in, and Warden Orphant in Detention Centre Onorom (Asteroid Belt Gamma / Sol) wants one too.

Take your shield to him to complete the mission.

stages.description: Deliver your rebuild Falkirk Alpha to Warden Orphant in Detention Centre Onorom (Asteroid Belt Gamma)

nodes.text:
Greetings, you must be @name.
Where's the shield then?
That's a fine looking piece of kit.  I'll have it installed immediately.  I'll also let Xav know you got it to me on time.
Oh, Deschide Poarta says return to her when your level 30 to learn how to build reactors.  We Progen need to create these, otherwise we'll be reliant on our foes.

missions.name: Enrage [Progen Warrior]
missions.summary: For the Progen Warrior - Place Holder only   Note think this was abandoned mining station in Odin Rex - Iron Vultures.

nodes.text: I have an Implant that teachs you how to Enrage.
Talk to me again.
Come back when you are ready.

stages.description: Talk to Trainer Helos again.

nodes.text: Here you go.

missions.name: Critical Targeting [Version 1.0.P]
missions.summary: Report to Sub Commander Frank in Arx Emporos (Altair III).  You should find him in the bar, having a drink.  It gets too crowded in the lobby.

nodes.text:
@name.

Well, its time for you to learn how to find your enemies weak spots.

Every foe has a weak spot, and with Critical Targetting you will discover where it is.  I will not tell you this again so write it down somewhere.

Kill one CL 10 Rogue Progen - they can be found near the gate to Altair III, in Altair III near nav to 61 Cygni.  They are in greater numbers behind Endriago Planet, 100K North of Arx Spartoi.

Kill one, then I'll send you your skill over secure transfer, and kill more and compare your damage!

branches.text: Ok I have memorised this, but why should I?

nodes.text:
We are part of the Progen Republic and careless talk costs lives.  You have memorised the mission, if you didn't then let this be a lesson for you.  

If you don't listen to the instructor you could die.  
Space is dark, empty and lonely, your genemap could easily degrade over time.

Well.
If you don't listen to your instructors @name, then we may prevent recovery your genemap, or approve it for experimentation.

Return to me when your done.

stages.description: Go and fight one Rogue Progen Level 10.   See how much damage you are doing.
Now put some points in the Critical Targetting, kill 2 more level 10 Rogue Progen.
Return to Sub Commander Frank (Arx Emporos / Altair III) and accept your reward.

nodes.text:
Well done.
Have a reward.

missions.name: Aquire Shield Inversion [Version 2.0.P]
missions.summary: Converse with the retired warrior Intuneric Vigoare stationed at Nostrand Vor who will instruct you in the fine art of Shield Inversion.

nodes.text:
Hello @profession.

So you're visting the old warrior then?  What can I do you for?

Shield inversion eh?  

Well @name, you first of all have to learn shield sap.  Go and find some Gleaming Manes and kill 6 of them after activating the skill.  Cone back to me when you have done it.

stages.description:
Go and find some Gleaming Manes and use the Shield Inversion skill on them.
Kill 6 of them and return.  Our scouts have reported that there are large numbers of them about 15K South-West of Nav Outer Endriago 4 in Endriago Space.
Return to Intuneric Vigoare (Nostrand Vor) to describe your battles.

nodes.text:
Well if it isn't @name.
Welcome back!

And how did they die?

Quick n easy.  
There was a time I remember when the Jenquai used to die that way too.  Back in the good old days, none of this phoney war, everyone at peace.  Bah! I hunger for the old battles, the smell of Archos and Mortars....

Yes @name, do that for me.

Now I'm stuck here, too valuable to risk in battle they say.  Just one word to you, @profession, A progen is battle-born.  Your hull is your strength.

From the Fire and into the Fire, Slay your foes.  No surrender, No Retreat.

missions.name: Spare Mission for Progen Characters.
missions.summary: Spare Mission for Progen Characters.

missions.name: Drain Those Halabytes
missions.summary: A Warrior needs to learn how to drain their oponents shields, to replenish their owns.

nodes.text: I need you for another assignment, @name.
I need you to south of the station, to the Docking Bouy. Once you arrive there, kill a few of these creatures that invaded our space.  After you finish clearing the place out, report back to me.
For this assignment, I'll teach you the Shield Sap skill.  Shield Sap allows you to drain your oponents shield to replenish your own.  But beware, it has a bit of a cooldown.
Come back when you are ready.

stages.description: Proceed south of Arx Forgus to the Docking Buoy and kill 4 Ancient Halabytes.
Return to Sub-Commander Trask, on Arx Forgus.

nodes.text: Have you finished my task that I assigned you?

branches.text: I've completed the task you assigned me.

nodes.text: Good. Report back to me when you have more Experience (Level 10).

missions.name: Self Destruct for the Warrior
missions.summary: Pay 25,000 credits, to aquire the Self Destruct skill.

nodes.text: I have an Implant that teachs you how to use the skill Self Destruct, for the cost of 2500 credits. If you don't want to cough up the credits for the skill, I have a contact that needs a favor.

branches.text: I'm more interested in this contact, of yours...

nodes.text: Talk to me again and I'll have the implant ready.
My contact is a Jenquai. I know, I know, why would I be working with a  Jenquai... Well the answer is; He is working with the sabine to improve our "Call Forward," for when we need to be resurrected.

branches.text: Forget it. I hate Jenquai with a passion!

nodes.text: Report to Havyair Amen-Tol, in Arx Ymir station, in the Jotunheim Sector. Tell him I sent you to give him a hand. Feel free to use him as a punching bag, just do not kill him. Jenquai can't be resurrected, like us Progens.
If you won't help my Jenquai contact, then come back again when you have the credits.

stages.description: Talk to Trainer Helos again.

nodes.text: The implant is ready, here you go.

missions.name: Build Weapons Training
missions.summary: Master Lao-Tzu wants to teach you to build weapons. Go get him the components he needs so he can teach you.

nodes.text: Hello Shinwa, I am Master Lao-Tzu.

branches.text: Can you teach me about building weapons?

nodes.text: Certainly, that's what I'm here for. Well that and to explore the mysteries of life by remaining motionless and meditating for days at a time. The longer I go without food and rest, the closer I get to answering life's questions. Perhaps when we all reach the state I aim for there will be global harmony and happiness.
Oh, so you want me to talk about it more, huh?

branches.text: Please don't, we can talk later!

nodes.text: I believe that in essence we are all the same.
That the only things that create good and evil are our experiences in life.
That to have a truly perfect world we would have to have no world at all. But wait, that wouldn't work!
Oh fine, we can talk later.
Very well then. Go fetch me the following items from the bazaar on Joves Fury. The items will be listed in your mission data.

stages.description: Purchase the following level one components from the Joves Fury Bazaar: Mi Graphite Shell Casing, Ultra Boost, Vortex Uranium Slugs. Then return to Master Lao-Tzu.

nodes.text: You are back.

And so begins your tutorial on building weapons. By the way, the realm of weapons building also incorporates ammunition building.

To build weapons, similarly to other build skills, you must first analyze the item you want to build. You do this by taking the item to an analyze terminal and successfully analyzing it. After analysis, you must find the components needed to build the item, which are listed in the manufacturing terminal. Bring the items to the manufacturing terminal and you will be able to create an item of varying quality depending on your build skill. You can only build weapons of your build weapons skill level or below. Does that make sense?

In your case I had you gather the components for the Ninja's Hoko Projectile Ammo. To build this ammo, you need to head over to the Yasuragi bazaar and pick up a round of Ninja's Hoko Ammo to analyze. Make sure you have at least one point in weapons building before trying to analyze. Follow what I taught you and you will be fine, if you forget, ask around.

missions.name: Training for Business
missions.summary: Since you will have to buy from her, Jade Jango will teach you to build weapons.

nodes.text: Hey, you're a Jenquai Seeker, right? I have a wonderful offer for you!
Yes! I will teach you how to build weapons. It's a one time offer you can't refuse! And as a bonus, I will throw in a bit of experience! Whaddya say?
Ok, all you need to do is buy some of my White Dragonfly Explosive Missiles. Once you have them, let me know when you are ready to continue.
When I said offer you can't refuse, I meant it. You should read the fineprint. Now go buy some of my White Dragonfly Explosive Missiles.

stages.description: Buy a few White Dragonfly Explosive Missiles and talk to Jade when you are ready to continue learning.

nodes.text: Ok now what you are going to do with the missiles is take one to the analyze terminal in the main lobby there. Analyze one, then you can build White Dragonfly Explosive Missiles with the right components. Also remember, you cannot dismantle ammo.

branches.text: I understand, thanks for teaching me.

nodes.text: I make money, you get trained, talk about a good deal! Now go analyze that missile.

stages.description: Analyze a White Dragonfly Explosive Missile. There is an analyze terminal in the main lobby of Azmundi Maru.
Return to Jade Jango.

nodes.text: Good job, @name. To manufacture the item you just analyze all you have to do is bring the item's components to the manufacturing terminal. But I'm sure you already knew that.
Thanks for the business. Come back anytime to the weapons vendor who really cares about her clients. Have a nice day!

missions.name: Repair Equipment [Version 1.0.W]
missions.summary: Temporary Mission.

nodes.text: I have an Implant that teachs you how to Repair Equipment.
Talk to me again.
Come back when you are ready.

stages.description: Talk to Trainer Helos again.

nodes.text: Here you go.

missions.name: 1,000,000 credits for a hull upgrade or do a mission [Version 1.4.-]
missions.xml_name: 1,000,000 credits for a hull upgrade or do a mission [Version 1.4.-]
missions.summary: A payment of 1 million (1,000,000) credits is required for your maximum hull upgrade.  However, you can do a mission for Gratis Augustus Var and get it for free.  Your Choice.

nodes.text:
Hail @profession @name.

Either go and visit the Tiberius Shipyards and have 1,000,000 credits to pay for your hull upgrade, or go and speak to Gratis Augustus Var in Arx Tiberius who has a proposition for you.

branches.text: I will visit the Tiberius Shipyards to pay for my hull upgrade.
I am up for adventure and will speak to Gratis Augustus Var

nodes.text: The Tiberius Shipyards are in Primus Space.  They are waiting for your custom.
Gratis Augustus Var is in Arx Tiberius, he is expecting you.

stages.description: Visit the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus for your final refit.  You will need 1 000 000 credits.

nodes.text: Kerr has given me permission to do your final refit.
This should carry you quite well @name.

branches.text: This will do nicely, thank you.

missions.name: 300,000 credits for a hull upgrade or do a mission [Version 3.3.-]
missions.xml_name: 300,000 credits for a hull upgrade or do a mission [Version 3.3.-]
missions.summary: A choice to pay 300,000 credits at Tiberius Shipyards or to work it off doing a mission.

nodes.text: Hail @profession,

branches.text: I would like to pay 300,000 credits like a Terran
I would like to serve the Republic with a mission

nodes.text:
Skulk off to the Tiberius Shipyards with your 300,000 credits if you wish to pay for your hull upgrade.  

Do not select this if you have already done the other mission hull upgrade else you will just get hit with a credit debit of 300,000 cr.
Check that no one is listening into the conversation and go and talk to the Reclaimer in the Bar, called Nayol Wat.  He is authorised to tell you what is going on.

stages.description: Take 300,000 credits to the Tiberius Shipyards (Primus) so you can pay for your hull upgrade.

nodes.text: Hello @name, I hear you are here to get a Hull Upgrade?

branches.text: I have the 300,000 credits here for the hull upgrade.

nodes.text:
Here is your level 5 hull upgrade.
However, there are missions that you have not done, that are not available to you anymore.

missions.name: Joint Class Operation I of III [Version 3.3.-]
missions.xml_name: Joint Class Operation I of III [Version 3.3.-]
missions.summary: The background to the dissapearance of the PAX Decima Gemina. Talk to Reclaimer Nayol Wat in Arx Magister, where you will learn a story.  It may be best to write some of this down.

nodes.text:
In accepting this mission @name, you have just signed a clause not to tell any hostile foreign space power. I don't want the Terrans or Jenquai to know. You will not be reporting back to me after this conversation. Too many eyes and ears on Arx Magister.

Also you will be required to supply some items yourself.  If you are unable, this mission may not be for you.

branches.text: I am not prepared to agree.

nodes.text: The PAX Decima Gemina under supervision by Intuneric Vigoare in Norstrand Vor, loaded security cargo from 61 Cygni.  His crew was to take the PAX Decima Gemina through Mars Gamma to Detention Centre Onorom (Asteroid Belt Gamma), via Mars.

branches.text: Hang on I may want to write this down.

nodes.text: For some reason the PAX Decima Gemina was unable to go through any of the Progen class restricted gates.  In order to provide security, the PAX Decima Gemina was placed under the command of Gratis Augustus Var, and to be sent to Arx Tiberius (Tarsis) and assigned Centuriata Marines for the trip, via Akeron's Gate.

branches.text: Probably didnt want others to know.

nodes.text: It never arrived at Detention Centre Onorom. Warden Orphant raised the alarm after the PAX Decima Gemina was overdue by three days. He is concerned as to the fate of his shipment.

branches.text: Don't you think 3 days was too late?

nodes.text: Sentinel salvage teams are being formed up on Endriago Planet.  Vinda in Porvenir Mons will be arranging the salvage.  She can be a little touchy, try not to irritate her.
Your contact for this mission will be Warden Orphant in Detention Centre Onorom.  He is awaiting your arrival.  Do not displease him as he could throw you in the brig!

I'm sorry to hear that, @name.
You best go and tell the Proconsul you will be paying for the hull upgrade.

stages.description: Go and speak to Warden Orphant in Detention Centre Onorom (Asteroid Belt Gamma).

nodes.text: @name, make yourself at home and I'll tell you what I know.
So you're the one who is here to locate my creature samples?  I was looking forward to their arrival.  I would have gone looking myself, if I wasn't tasked to detain these degenerates.
Genetic research is not just about advancing ourselves with known information - you have to obtain samples from other sources.  Living material is preferable as you can breed offspring.

There was a wide sample of space creatures including manes and bio mobs.  The primary reason is these often contain remains that they have consumed.  You get two sources for the price of one!

This is restricted information - only the Proconsul Dionysius Kerr knows.  People may not understand if it got out.

branches.text: I kind of agree with that.

nodes.text:
When you are ready to locate the PAX Decima Gemina, come back to me.  I spent three days trying to decode a corrupted distress signal carried by the NET-7 relays from this vessel.  I think I may be able to discover, with your help, where it is.

For now, go and talk to Intuneric Vigoare in the planet base on Nostrand Vor.

stages.description: Go and speak to Intuneric  Vigoare in the planet outpost base of Norstrand Vor

nodes.text: The PAX Decima Gemina was activated after being decommissioned five years ago and used by ourselves to transport goods between Altair III and 61 Cygni.  It is severely overdue a full refit.   Parts of the ship do not react well to aggressive handling.

The cargo was classed as security cargo.  This meant that few people were present when it was loaded here by specialist front line forces from 61 Cygni.  I don't know what was inside, but it sure was angry!

branches.text: You know I somehow knew you were going to say that...

nodes.text: The ship could not cope with travelling through home sectors, it was almost falling apart.  We signalled Warden Orphant at Detention Centre Onorom about the change of plan and simultaneously we were informed to divert to Arx Tiberius to take on marines.  My crew have not returned.

branches.text: So what do you want me to do?

nodes.text: @name, I'd like you to go Gratis Augustus Var and enquire what has happened to my Crew.

stages.description: Go and speak to Gratis Augustus Var, Centuriata Commander of Arx Tiberius in Tarsis.

nodes.text: Hail @name, time is short.

branches.text: Hail Gratis Augustus Var, Intuneric was asking after his Crew.

nodes.text: We exchanged the Privateer crew with a full Centuriata contingent.  There was some altercation with those unruly Privateers and they have been detained in the Brig.  Military discipline should be maintained at all times.

Knowing we would have to venture outside Progen Territory, we did an emergency ship upgrade at the shipyard.  This upgrade has produced a huge backlog on all other work by the shipyards.  It was to disguise the PAX Decima Gemina as it is too well known and it would be an easy target in neutral territory.

Whatever happened to it must be dire - I lost a large compliment of troops.   I am keen to discover their fate.  By the way, did you know that Vinda is asking after you?

It's best that you go and see her on Endriago Planet..... now.

stages.description: Go and speak with Vinda in Porvenir Mons on Endriago Planet

nodes.text: I will try to assemble a full team and equipment for this situation.  It all depends on you locating the PAX Decima Gemina in time though.  The sooner we find it then the quicker we can return with it.
If it is damaged we may to completely refit the ship.  Your build skills are your greatest asset here.  Once you have found the ship and reported back then we will know what needs to be done.

branches.text: But I can't Prospect or Build Anything.

nodes.text: We'd also need to have an escort, but don't worry about providing that.  Once you find it we'll take over, and the Centuriata will probably want to escort us anyway, they've been eagerly practising boarding I've heard.

branches.text: Yes, Var seemed a little keen.

nodes.text: Warden Orphant wants to speak with you, @profession.  I often wonder what he has in his 'special cargos'.

Ah, you were told at the start that you may be required to contribute equipment to the repair of the ship.  It all depends on how damaged it is - it may just require a few refined metals.

You may as well go and pay credits for the hull upgrade.

branches.text: I didn't read the text and will be unable to supply stuff.
I understand by continuing the mission I may not be able to complete it.

nodes.text:
Thats a shame.  

By selecting this option you will not be able to continue this mission.  If you want to try again, speak to Nqyol Wat to retake it.

branches.text: Ok I understand and will have to pay.

nodes.text: Well, that is how things are.

stages.description: Return to Warden Orphant in Detention Centre Onorom

nodes.text:
@name.

Can you hold on for a minute?  I've just got some interesting readings that may help us find the PAX Decima Gemina.  And I also need to get a prisoner released on special assignment.

I'm a little busy.
Speak to me again when you are ready.

missions.name: Joint Class Operation II of III [Version 2.2.- ]
missions.xml_name: Joint Class Operation II of III [Version 2.2.- ]
missions.summary: Speak to Warden Orphant in Detention Centre Onorom to aquire his plan as to how to locate the PAX Decima Gemina and discover what happened to it.   To make sure you hit navs, clear nav and retarget.

nodes.text: Right @name, here is the plan, and the others have authorised me to do it this way.  Do not contact the others, they are busy trying to get ready to support the salvage operation.

What has been agreed is we will be using a specialist in the field of intrusion.  She is a Red Dragon and is currently detained here.  Keep an eye on her.  We have provided an incentive for her to go on this mission - a more relaxed confinement.
And of course, if captured we can deny anything.

missions.name: Yin-Yang of the Soul
missions.summary: Master Jubei's test to see if you are worthy of Psionic Shield.

nodes.text: You are a warrior of decent experience and talent. Why is it you come seeking more power?

branches.text: I want to do better for the Shinwa.
I want to reach my full potential.

nodes.text: That is a worthy cause, but life is not about honor and loyalty. The Shinwa usually fly the path of righteousness, but to follow them blindly is not the best course for a warrior like yourself. It is not about the Shinwa.
Excellent. Self improvement is exactly what this training is about. Are you ready?
Helping others is a good cause, and this skill will allow you to do just that, but before I teach psionic shield to you, you must learn more about yourself. Are you ready?

To defeat an enemy you must do two things. You must end its life, and you must understand why you are ending its life. The first portion is active, it involves firing your beams at the creature. The second portion is passive, you must contemplate for yourself. Are you prepared to face your greatest enemy?
Proceed to the Jade Yaw.

stages.description: Defeat your greatest enemy.
Return to Jubei at Point of Tranquility to contemplate.

nodes.text: Why did you kill your greatest enemy?

branches.text: Because I wanted to improve myself.
Because I wanted to protect my friends.

nodes.text:
It is not up to me to decide for you. I am not you, I am merely your teacher. You must think about the reason you kill whenever you kill. For a monster it might be easier, the reason might be because it possesses a nice beam. However, often you will be forced to kill another pilot, a fellow Shinwa gone rogue for instance. In this case you must think more deeply about the reason you did it. 
I bestow upon you the power of psionic shield. Use it well.
You must never take life for no reason or the world may be thrown into chaos. For every active strike there must be passive thought to keep the world in order. THAT is the Yin-Yang of the soul.

One must never kill for the sake of killing. That is action similar to the progen dog soldiers' massacre of civilians in Joves Fury. I will NEVER have a student participate in that sort of senseless bloodshed or I will come hunt them down myself.

missions.name: A Time to Die
missions.summary: Through helping Havyair Amen-Tol, you will learn the Self Destruct Skill.

nodes.text: Come to goggle at the Jenquai, have you?

branches.text: I'm here to punch your face in!

nodes.text: Oh? Friends put you up to it, did they?
Are you serious? I'm a Jenquai. In a Progen station.

Think about it. One Jenquai. Lots of Progen. With plenty of pent-up aggression. I'm an obvious target, Progen! Whenever one of your warriors gets the urge to die in battle, why leave the station? There's a convenient fight standing right here! One problem, though. There's no Call Forward for ME, if they crack open my skull. Avoiding fights is something of an art. Did you know that? I didn't, until I came here. I'll tell you, Progen, it's never dull in Arx Ymir.

I do important work here, Progen. Vital to your Republic's pursuit of 'perfection.' Not that I agree with your particular definition of 'perfection,' but they don't pay me for my opinion. Now, speaking of work... I should get back to it. Stand idle for more than a few moments and one of your warrior brethren will likely take notice. And around here, an idle Jenquai is just a battle waiting to happen.

branches.text: Speaking of which, Trainer Helos told me to come see you.

nodes.text: Helos... Ah yes, I know him. The only Progen who has a sense of intellegence, unlike you others.
/shocked Wait... wait! I apologize for taking advantage of you, like the Progen here do to me.
Yes... yes... the task.  Well in order to help the Sabine in "perfecting" your genes, I'll need you to go to Odin's Rex to get a certain piece of material for me.

In Odin's Rex, there is a facility near the moon Vali.  This facility was overrun by some creatures known as Iron Eaters and Iron Vultures. What I need you to do, is to go to that destroyed mining facility, and aquire the Heart of one of these creatures.

branches.text: Nevermind. I'll just punch your head in!

nodes.text: Hurry up before one of these Progens decide to use me for a punching bag, again.
/shocked Get away from me!

stages.description: Proceed to the moon named Vali, in the sector of Odin's Rex.
Kill Iron Eaters and Iron Vultures till you aquire an Iron Heart.
Return to Havyair Amen-Tol, in Arx Ymir, in the Jotunheim Sector.

nodes.text: Did you aquire the item that I asked you to?

branches.text: Yes, I have it right here.

nodes.text: Such a shame. I was begining to think you showed some type of intelligence.
/shocked Oww!

branches.text: Ha. I love beating jenquai. Here is your lousy item.

nodes.text: Thank you. Here is a few credits as a reward for doing this task.
My head hurts. Take these credits as your reward, even though you don't deserve it.

missions.name: Supply the Grissom Space Patrol [Version 4.0.-] [HU]

nodes.text:
Hail @profession.

The Proconsul has sent you to me?  You?  Are you capable of this task?
Make sure you have a empty slot in your cargo.

branches.text: Yes.  My name is @name and I'll do it.

nodes.text:
We'll see.

Andros Ilyuctas in Arx Ymir has requested a crate of Progen Weapon Technology to be taken to him, so he can build shields for the Grissom Space Patrol.  Quite a lot of our centuriata become Grissom Space Patrol, they seem to have a high turnover rate.

Of course you'd not know why, @name.

Strange.  All they have to contend with is the occaisonal inferior Red Dragon.  You may like to look for a career in the Grissom Space Patrol.  They have all the decent Progen equipment.

Please note that should you fail this Mission, talk to Proconsul Kerr again.  He'd want you to kill more Red Dragons though!

stages.description: Take 1 crate of Progen Weapons Technology to Andros Ilyuctas in Arx Ymir.

nodes.text:
Well, @name,  where are my Phosphates?

I can't do this tricky upgrade with out it!  I can't believe you didn't stop at Endriago and get some from the Sentinels there ... the place is crawling with it.

Return to me with half a stack of Phosphates and then we can continue.

branches.text: Phosphates?  I thought you wanted Refined Phosphorous!

nodes.text:
I used to want Refined Phosphorous, but I've got a lot of it now, plenty have been got by Sentinels and Privateers.

Sorry, you should have got back to me earlier with the Refined Phosphorous.  Currently, I need the Phosphates.  I've discovered the Refined Phosphorous is not what I need!

branches.text: But I've spent ages getting this Refined Phosphate together!
But I can't supply you with the Phosphates.

nodes.text:
Well, I don't want that Refined Phosphorous.

It appears that some traders have been doing their best to rip Phosphates from components, but what I have is contaminated.  I'll only trust miners now to supply what I need.

branches.text: I'm not a miner - where can I get Phosphates?
Don't worry, I can supply the Phosphates.

nodes.text:
Hmm,  Thats a tricky situation.  I'll have a look at my console here.  

Thats interesting old James tucker on Nostrand Vor has some Phosphates in stock.  Unfortunately, currently he's not speaking to Sentinels.  He'll want you to give an insurance premium of 10,000 credits though.

It seems Vinda meddled with one of his favorite warriors and now this warrior can only chat in words less or equal to five letters.  He's speaking to Privateers and Warriors, and if they do a task for him I'm sure he'll give them the required Phosphate Ore.


And the premium is to cover for people abandoning whatever mission he sends them on!

branches.text: Look can't you just take this Refined Phosphorous?

nodes.text:
Either way, @profession @name, I want my half a stack ofPhosphates.
I'll get one of my contacts to refine it.

nodes.text:
Well, look at this, @name, Phosphates.

Quick hand it over, because we're now a bit late.  I do hope you can get to Friendship 7 on time.

You mean you weren't told?

station officer, and your training officer for the time being.

nodes.text: As you can see there is a lot to do around here, even for a young one like you.

branches.text: Is there anything that i can help with?

nodes.text: Yes there is an assignment I can give to you.
Come back when you are ready.

A trainee squadron was ambushed by an unknown force. We have dispersed a Centuriata Patrol to search for what massacred the trainees. I need you to proceed to Nav Brightside 3, and recover the Gene-Maps of any trainee wrecks, that you can find.

nodes.text: Were you able to recover the Gene-Maps?

nodes.text: Savant @name, I require your assistance.

branches.text: What is the task at hand?

nodes.text: Come back soon, before I hand this off to another Savant.

nodes.text: You are Progen, those measily manes should be no match to you.

Prospect a piece of Copper Ore from any of the Debris Fields.

nodes.text: Did you manage to find a piece of Copper Ore?

Prosperct a Diridium Crystal.

nodes.text: Did you retrieve a Diridium Crystal?

nodes.text: Great. Thank you for your help. Here is a few credits to spend on yourself. Tovar Maxe might have another assigment for you.

nodes.text: @name, I am need of your help.
Come back when you are willing to help.
My favorite ship was stolen, and I need you to find it. I really loved my little ship. It was my first ship I was able to purchase on my own.

branches.text: How am I going to find your ship in such a huge sector?

nodes.text: Simple. We recieved a report of a derilict ship North of Debris Field Gamma. Head over to there, and see if that is my precious ship. If it is my Reclaimer, come back and inform me.

nodes.text: Have you found my precious ship?
Thank you for finding my favorite ship. You have my deepest appreciation. I have another assignment of great importance, when you are ready.

missions.name: Leaving your mark. [Version 5.2.-] [HU]
missions.summary: The Jenquai have got a new sector, Castor off Dahin.  I want you to scout it out, dock at any station and sub-sectors, and generally make yourself at home.

nodes.text: Hail @name, I hear your after a scrap.

branches.text: Hail Gratis Augustus Var, I'm ready for anything.

nodes.text:
Its simple @name.

In the gate war we were feared.  Now I feel the Jenquai are getting far too arrogant.  We've detected they have a new sector off Dahin, and I'd like you to go and cause

Well ..

Trouble.  Show them whos boss and that kind of thing.  
We can't officially do this what with the troubles in 61 Cygni, but someone non-affiliated with the official Progen fleet could become enough of a thorn in their side in order to stop them having delusions of granduer.

They're starting to encroach on our borders and I'm not liking that.

stages.description: In this new Jenquai sector of space, you seem a little out of place, dock at a station and try to make conversation with someone sympathetic to the Progen Republic.

nodes.text:
Well hello @profession, my name is Aoladur, 

I don't see many of my own kind here.
Became a POW in the last gate war, they didn't know what to do with me so I stayed.  Actually, you could do me a favour, if you could send a message to Augustus Var, I may get off this rock.

branches.text: Augustus Var sent me here, so I may be able to help you.

nodes.text:
@name,

Augustus Var will remember me, and he'll remember what you give him.  I'll want you to go in the system and check out the Sundari Weapon Factory.  See what they are truely up to.

branches.text: They're up to their old tricks again.

nodes.text: Return to me afterwards, and we'll try and figure out what to do with the information.

stages.description: Check out the Sundari Weapon Factory in Ishuan and then Return to Aoladur with your findings.

Seems like they're getting ready for War.

In that case, I'd want you to take this back to Augustus Var.  Don't go through Mars, they'll try and ambush you there.  I suggest you head through Akeron's gate and go back the long way.

We tend to use the asteroid of Markham as a dead drop zone, to hide further orders if needed.  Be careful, the Jenquai may know and may have set a trap.

Safe travels.  Guard this with your life.  I've hidden the data in this Nutritional Supplement that was being stored in this station.  

Keep it safe, its a bit leaky so put it next to an empty slot.

Yes @name,

What the hell is that in your Cargo Hold?
It seems to be eating your ship!

We can't upgrade your hull until you jetterson it, safely.

Aoludar 

Prisoner of War!

Hah!  He likes to pull that one on travellers.
He wasn't even created then.

Hes' there on my order to keep watch on those Jenquai.  Its a pity that thing in your cargo damaged the reports - but you were there first hand so you'll be able to tell me what happened.

branches.text: They're starting to stockpile munitions and gear.

nodes.text:
I thought so, we may have to keep an eye on them.

As to your stowaway.
I'm sure i've seen something like that but can't quite remember.

Try Niftheim Cloud, if you get near Modi's Fist it may leave on its own free will.

missions.xml_name: Ioanna-J Deinon's Research [Version 4.2.- Part One of Two]
missions.summary: Visit Ioanna-J Deinon in Porvenir Mons, Endriago, Gallina and see how you can help her.  Return to Ioanna-J Deinon after Part One.

nodes.text:
Welcome @profession to Porvenir Mons.
How may I help you?

branches.text: I was sent to speak with you, I am @name.

nodes.text:
@name.
I want you to bring two crates of Nano-Bots from Arx Ymir.  I was expecting them a few hours ago but they are late and I'd like you to go and collect them for me.

branches.text: Your crates will be back in no time.

nodes.text:
Please ask Hayvair at Arx Ymir why hs has failed to send me them on time.
Thank you for volunteering to collect them for me.

stages.description: Obtain 2x Crates of NanoBots from Havyair Amen-Tol (in Arx Ymir).

nodes.text: Ah @profession, a new visitor to Arx Ymir?

branches.text: My name is @name, Hayvair and I'm here for the crates for Ioanno-J

nodes.text:
I'm sorry @name but the crates never arrived.  
The freighter that was carrying them has been reported wrecked 3k North West of Vali in Odin Rex.  I'd like you to investigate its' fate.

branches.text: And what do I get in return?

nodes.text: When I learn its fate I'll provide you with replacements for free.

stages.description: Find the wrecked transport about 3 K North West of Vali in Odin Rex and investigate what happened to it.

nodes.text:
@race
Your leaders are following a dangerous course.  It will lead to the contamination of our race.

We are guardians of the genomes.
We will remove all impurities of the Progen Race.
The nanobots were being used by the Traitors to corrupt the whole Progen Race
Are you with us?

This freighter was crewed by  Ionna's lackeys.
This is a warning to you, we will eradicate all who try to corrupt the genome.
If you get in our way, we also will destroy you.
If you go down this path we will destroy you when you least expect it.

stages.description: Return to Havyair Amen-Tol in Arx Ymir about the fate of the transport.

nodes.text:
Welcome @name,
What happened to my freighter?

branches.text: It seems you have opposition from some Progen degenerates

nodes.text:
They destroyed my freighter?  

I'll not get any insurance on that!  I've lost a shipment and have a loss.  How am I meant to make a profit these days.  They may be behind attacks on my other assets too!

Look, can't you give a little reward to compensate me for my loss?
I'll be able to source you some Crates of Nanobots easier then

branches.text: No.  That was not the agreement.  Give me the crates now.

nodes.text:
Typical @race.

Aggressive and to the point.  Here.  Have these crates.  I've lost a lot of profits on this trade.  I have a family you know and you're making it harder to make a living.

stages.description: Take the 2x Crates of Nano-Bots to Ioanna-J Deinon in Porvenir Mons, Endriago, Gallina then discover what she wants next.

nodes.text:
At last, @name.
What kept you.

branches.text: Had to take care of something. Here are your crates

nodes.text:
Some damage but they look all right.
Wait while I check them off

Those look fine,  
next.


These look fine too

I need some samples for these Nano-bots to be used on now.
More DNA for Progen advancement.

Please acquire some cortexes from Greks, Mist Lords and Shakaku and give them to Sturmer in Trader's Fort in Ragnarok.
Sturmer is expecting his samples, he will be able to extract genetic information from the three cortexs you bring to him.

stages.description: Give a Grek Cortex (New Edinburgh) to Sturmer (Traders Fort) for processing.

nodes.text:
Did you know the Grek are the Terran's favorite hunted animal?

Have a look around this station.  If you remain by me people may get too interested if you understand my meaning.

branches.text: Ok, I'll try not to raise suspicions.

nodes.text: Don't forget to come back to me, @name.

stages.description: Spend some time with Cleri Maste.

nodes.text: /salute Welcome @name. The @race race is always welcome at my booth, you should check out my weapons supply!
/give Thanks, and come back soon!

stages.description: Give a Mist Cortex (Freya),  to Sturmer (Traders Fort) for processing.

nodes.text: Ah, the fabled Mist Runners and Mist Lords, this will provide excellent material for my research, after all everyone wants to move faster don't they!
Its' almost ready but I think these walls have ears so go and trade something.

stages.description: Spend some time with Burgen Lorensal

nodes.text: /salute Welcome @name. The @race race is always welcome at my booth, check out my supply of engine's, equipables, reactors and shields!
/give Thanks, and come back soon!

stages.description: Give a Shakaku Cortex (surface of Planet Dahin) to Sturmer (Traders Fort) for processing.

nodes.text:
The Shakaku, share their life with the Jenquai, more genetic material for Vinda.

Ah.  Yes, @name.  You know what this means don't you?

No.
It means the Progen race we know will be obsolete.  You will be a redundant model.  Your genome will be in a library, extinct.  Doesn't this worry you?

branches.text: We strive for advancement and the Progen cause.

nodes.text:
You're blinded by science.

It'll end in tears.  
Yours maybe.  
Too much advancement causes too many Problems.  I'll do this for Ioanno-J, but she's crossing the line.  Many Progen feel this, watch her @name, she may cause an abomination.  I'll transmit the information to her.
Go and let Ioanno-J know I will give her the genetic samples.

missions.name: Ioanna-J Deinon's Research [Version 4.3.- Part Two of Two]
missions.xml_name: Ioanna-J Deinon's Research [Version 4.3.- Part Two of Two]
missions.summary: Visit Ioanna-J Deinon in Porvenir Mons, Endriago, Gallina.

nodes.text: Back already?

branches.text: Sturmer has your samples, he'll let you know when they're ready.

nodes.text:
Sturmer.
He's too old fashioned, too attached to the past.  

I'm more worried about these mysterious ships that have attacked my shipments.  Go and tell Markus Khan in Arx Tiberius about them.  They are restricting our development,
Remember, @name, you advancement depends on our science.

stages.description: Warn Markus Khan in Arx Tiberius about the mysterious ships.

nodes.text: Hail @profession, what can I do for you?

branches.text: Ioanno-J is having problems with unknown ships attacking her shipments.

nodes.text:
What!
And do you know why this is?

branches.text: They sent a message that they did not want to corrupt the genome.

nodes.text:
Degenerates.
We strive for perfection.  That is the Progen Way.
These miscreants should be eradicated.

I have just authorized a small task force to restrict their movements to the back of Endriago Planet.  @name, you are authorised to eliminate any of these renegade Progens you see.

branches.text: Do we know what they are called?

nodes.text:
There seems to be some kind of Heirachy.

The Rogue Progen and Merus Milia appear to be working together in a co-ordinated assault on our progen development.  The task force in Endriago should restrict their movement.  I've conscripted some Sentinels and Privateers  for this task also.

Go back to Ioanno-J with my assurance we will eradicate these Degenerates.

With my task force restricting the Rogue Progen movements in Endriago Space, her research should continue uninterrupted.  There is the Merus Milia to contend with though, these I instruct you to kill as many as possible.

stages.description: Let Ioanna-J Deinon know of Markus Khan's plan.

nodes.text: Well, @profession, what did Markus say?

branches.text: He's assigned a small taskforce to restrict the Rogue Progen in Endriago

nodes.text:
Be careful,
With Marcus hunting them down they could strike at any time

stages.description: Go to the Mutation Laboratory in Asteroid Belt Gamma and confront the Merus Milia.  Kill some Merus Milia Fighters first
Exert your authority.  Make them pay - terminate with extreme force 6 Merus Milia Bombers.
Punish the Merus Milia Captain by making sure his genemap will never be found.  Exterminate him.  It is reccomended to have friends clear the area!
Obtain the genetic sample for Ioanna-J Deinon from Warden Orphant.  Make sure you have a slot available and do not sell this.

nodes.text:
Ah @name, I've been expecting you
I watched your battle - they clearly were no match for you.

branches.text: Do you have what I require for Ioanno-J?

nodes.text:
Yes.
I've stored it in this trade good.  It is heavily encrypted and this way Ioanno-J can extract it even if you don't survive, @profession.

Try not to sell it.

stages.description: Take the genetic sample back to Ioanno-J Deinon (Porvenir Mons) for your reward.

nodes.text:
Excellent
I will be able to update all our genomes with this information!

branches.text: Do you have a reward for me?

nodes.text:
Hmm.
I authorise you to have your hull upgrade, you will have to visit the Primus Shipyards.  You will need 10 000 credits to complete the hull upgrade.

branches.text: 10 000 credits!  I thought you'd give me more of a reward!

nodes.text: What I will do is to make it optional for you to do further missions for your hull upgrade.  From now on you may pay the credits and not do the mission, or do a mission and not pay the credits.   I will exert influence on these missions for the Progen Republic, to suitably reward you.
Remember.  You will only ever be able to upgrade your hull once.  If you select to pay, you will never able to do the associated mission.  However, you can always drop this mission

I like you, @name.
That does why I'm going to recommend future rewards should you do the Missions for the Republic.  I'll be watching your advancement @profession, with interest.

stages.description: Go to the Tiberius Shipyards in Primus for your Level 30 hull upgrade.

nodes.text:
@name.

Ioanna-J Deinon has supported your hull upgrade and we will now upgrade your ship.  Her request to let you choose to pay or do a mission for further upgrades is a little unauthodox, but we will honor it.

There's your hull upgrade.

I bet you thought Ionna-J had forgot about you.  She likes suprises.
She wanted you to have this Shield of the Optimal.  Its a really nice level 4 shield, something she says you will 'grow into'.

If you don't want it I'll take it off you!

missions.name: Catch the Jenquai Spy
missions.summary: "Take Care" of the Jenquai Spy.

nodes.text: @name, I have a special job for you.
Come back to me if you change your mind.

Here is the plan... We have received reports that a Jenquai ship has been spying on Detention Center Onorom, at the Gate to Onorom Prison. This appears to be a "retaliatory" response to your previous actions. I need you to go there and stop his "spying."
Enter Asteroid Belt Gamma and proceed to the Gate to Onorom Prison Nav point, which is south of Saturn Gamma Navway 5.
Don't let that Jenquai Spy escape.

stages.description: Proceed to Onorom Prison Gate, in Asteroid Belt Gamma.

nodes.text: It's an Evil Progen, kids run to the back of the ship!  Please don't kill us Evil Progen man.

stages.description: Slaughter the Jenquai Spy, to prevent him from spying!
Proceed back to Zieg on Arx Magister, Mars Sector.

nodes.text: Is the Jenquai Spy dead?
Good job. I have another assignment for you, when you're ready.

Come back to me if you change your mind.

Here is the plan... A Civilian Jenquai Protester is spreading filthy Jenquai propaganda material, about your recent actions in Jupiter. I need you to exterminate this civilian before he catches the attention of the Net-7 news reporters.
Enter Asteroid Belt Gamma and proceed to the Mars Junction Nav, which is the first Nav point North of the Mars Gate.
We do not need the Terrans imposing economic sanctions on us, make sure he does not escape!

missions.xml_name: Safe Guarding the Future from the Jenquai

Here is the plan... A Day Care Shuttle filled with young Jenquai children, are enroute back to Jupiter after visiting Earth. Since these young Jenquai will be brainwashed into combatants in a few years, I have determined that they need to be "taken care of" immediately.

branches.text: You can count on me to "take care of" these Jenquai!

nodes.text: Shhh... We do not want any eavesdroppers to overhear our conversation, which could jeopardize our rank. They are enroute to Saturn Gate, from the Asteroid Belt Beta Gate, along the Gamma Navway in Asteroid Belt Gamma.

branches.text: Can I have some "fun" with them?

nodes.text: Yes. I need you to fulfill your duties as a "True Progen" and protect us, from the future threat of these Jenquai.

missions.name: Destroy the Swarm [Version 1.0.P]
missions.summary: The Critters are swarming.  Kill the Queens - the Suicidal Critters before they lead a swarm to attack the station.  Killing 10 should be enough.  You have 20 minutes to complete this mission.

nodes.text: @name, we may have a problem here, it may be Arx Omega all over again.  The Critters are starting to swarm, and the capital ship has not been supplied with enough ammunition to deal with this threat.

branches.text: What is needed for the Capital Ship?
Why should we worry about Critters?
I don't need to know the details, let's kill them!

nodes.text: Arx Omega, the original station in the shunned sector Mars Omega.  Omega, after the member of a wolf pack that is always on the outside, the lowest of the low.  A corroded hellhole in a deserted sector, abandoned by Centuriata and Sabine.  Perfect for the Collegia.

branches.text: What can you tell me about the Critters?
Why didn't the Centuriata like Mars Omega?
Why didn't the Sabine like Mars Omega?

nodes.text: The capital ship has had most of it's resources diverted to the fronteir of 61 Cygni.  The Centuriata control our battlelines and they determine where the battles are going to occur.  Its' got basic life support, and some long range weapons - toltally useless for killing Swarms.

branches.text: What is needed to supply the ship?
Less talk, more action,  Lets do this!

nodes.text:
The critters are docile until some of them evolve.  You can blame Vinda for these, the original centuriata stationed here got a little bored and wanted something to fight - she coded these.  Genetic experiments that have got out of hand.  Visit the Mutation Laboratory by Detention Centre Onorom to see more.

The highest evolved critters are called Suicidal Critters which have a combat rating of 3.  It is these that cause the critters to swarm, and now there are at least 10 out there.  We need you to quickly kill 10 of them, if any more evolve then it could be too late for this station!

We don't have much time.  The station scanners have detected that in under 20 minutes the population is destined to evolve.  That is when they swarm.  Level 3 Suicidal Critters feel the urge to attack the nearest piece of metal, and call in any fellow critters to help!

branches.text: Why can't the Capital Ship defend Arx Bursa?
No more talking, its' cloberring' time!

nodes.text:
@name, this sector was once called Mars Omega, well that was until the swarm of the Critters.  They actually consumed Arx Omega in their attack, using the station to breed.  Centuriata dog soldiers had to eterminate their brood sacks in the remains of the derelict station.  

It caused too much of a ruccor and after the Critters were driven away, this sector was renamed to Mars Gamma.  The original station was refined by the Sabine so no traces remained.  However, the critters are now here to stay and are threatening the current station.

branches.text: So thats' why we have a capital ship here!
Tell me more about the critters.
I think my weapons are siezing up, I need to kill something now!

nodes.text: The Centuriata got easily bored of Mars Omega as there wasn't enough enemies for them to fight.  They decided to transport experiments to this sector to fight.  These Critters are the result of some of these experiments, and have bred while the Centuriata were recalled to the 61 Cygni Fronteir.

branches.text: So tell me about the Critters.
So why did't the Sabine like Mars Omega?

nodes.text: After 200 years Mars Omega Sector had been completely mined by the Sabine order.  There is now no longer any ores for them, put a Sabine here and they quickly become disilusioned.  Vinda knew this, and the Centuriata used it as leverage to ask for genetically created creatures to fight from her.

branches.text: So tell me about the Critters.
Why didn't the Centuriata like Mars Omega?

nodes.text: The capital ship will need completely restocking with ammunition and other equipment.  If you succeed with this task, then I will convince thier commander to place an order with you.  Hes' an ex-dog soldier and has experience of the critters back in the days Sabine and Centuriata were based here, in what was known as Mars Omega.

branches.text: I'll do this for the Republic!!

nodes.text:
I'm glad that you have offered to do this task, we will be watching you.
If you are ready, let me know.  you've already wasted some time speaking to me!  You will be well rewarded for this task in experience, credits and faction.

branches.text: Yes Sir.  I'm on my way now.
Can you please tell me everything again.
I wish to forfit this mission now.

nodes.text: Go and kill those 10 Suicidal Critters before a swarm can occur.
Well, luckily another @profession is available to do this mission.  Come back to me later, you never know when another swarm will happen!

stages.description: Eliminate 10 Suicidal Critters before they can raise a swarm.  There is a time limit to this mission!
Quickly return to Chrones Christopher

nodes.text:
Well @name, just in time.  
This station is safe!

branches.text: That was a little hairy at times!

nodes.text:
Yes, they can be vicious these critters.
I was watching your tatics from here, you quickly adapted your tatics.  However, if you ever have time to consider a battle strategy, I recommend using a long range weapon or skill to lure a choice enemy from a swarm.

Plenty of things swarm out there.
Critters are mostly harmless, but remember there are other pests that swarm.  Infiniti-Corp traders for one.  Think of them as a pest species like the critters and you should develop tatics to erase them.

There are plenty of suggestions I have.  Even though your choice weapons for progens are Projectile, at your level I suggest a couple of points into Missile.  Some missile weapons are known to enhance projectile weapons - I hear some of the merius militia mutants use these.

You will also gain skills as a progen that allow you to withstand damage and tank more.  Your skills will tend to alter a mobs speed, slow them down or speed them up.  Using these skills can actively detatch a single creature from the rest of the pack should you keep switching targets.

Just remember your original target.  As a Progen you will eventualyl become known as a 'tank'.  Just remember the lesson learned today, sometimes it can go a bit pear-shaped.
Here is your reward.

This fuel is what I need to keep my robot running all night.  I'm going to have so much fun with this tonight.

@name

Keep your mind out of the gutter.  Get me some Aluminium and don't dissapoint me.

@name.

All I hear is explosions and grunts.  The walls keep shaking and the floors rebound.  What is he doing?  Can I sleep tonight?

Aluminum is made from refined aluminum ore.

Hang on, he hasn't created it again has he?  I used my musket on the last one he created!

nodes.text:
Fantastic!

Lighweight and durable.  Perfect for my battle-bot.

Yes, a upgrade to my Mark II assassin robot,  you should get one.  Have it attack you when you are least aware.  It keeps you on edge.

I may call this one Kato.

Yes.

Sometimes I wonder what kind of new progens we are creating nowadays.  Your here for the good of the Progen race.  Thinking and Fighting.

I wonder if you had the sense to analyze the level 1 components in this station, or did you have to beg on the marker like a Terran Dog.

Eitherway, here is your reward.

Grissom Space Patrol.

nodes.text: Thank you for your ontime shipment.

Good. Speak to me again for your next assignment.

nodes.text: @name, I am in need of your assistance.
I need you to retrieve a Nebiros Reasource shipment out of the wreckage of a transport ship in the Refuse Area, South East of Hadean.
Come back when you are in need of an assignment.

stages.description: Proceed to the Refuse Area, South East of Hadean.

nodes.text: Halt! This area is under our control. The penalty for trespassing is Death!

Click on the Refuse Area Nav to retrieve the Shipment.

nodes.text: *Retrieving Materials*

stages.description: Return to Synjin Talbot in Ishuan Station.

nodes.text: Did you get the Shipment for me?
Good. Speak to me again for your next assignment.

missions.name: Meet the Typotl Maw
missions.summary: To familiarize you with the Shinwa Fleet, Kigoshi Saruta sends you to the Typotl Maw.

nodes.text: /wave I am Kigoshi Saruta, aspiring Shinwa teacher. I'm already well known within Jenquai society, so surely you know me.

branches.text: Of course, you are the legendary missile instructor!

nodes.text: /rude Then why are you here? You just want to hear a funny story or something? I am not the kind of person to entertain someone as uninfluential as yourself. Now excuse me, I am busy.
Yes I certainly am. And are you one of my pupils?
Wonderful! So let us start. Because part of being Shinwa is working with Shinwa Forces, I want to to become familiar with them.
Well that's a shame.

The Typotl Maw is one of the Shinwa capital ships. In dire situations you may have to fight with the fleet against our enemies. It may end up being the Progens, the Terrans, or something else. The ship is in this sector, find it and talk to the commander.

stages.description: Talk to the Typotl Maw.

nodes.text:
Greetings, Shinwa. I received a message from Kigoshi Saruta that you were coming to visit us. Commander Grayfeather is busy today, so I will be speaking to you.



I am glad to see you. We don't get a lot of visitors out here and nothing exciting has happened recently, so visitors are always welcome. Do you have any questions?

This is the Typotl Maw, a flagship of the Jenquai. It is a powerful and symbolic ship that is run by Kokura and Shinwa forces in cooperation. It is lead by Commander Grayfeather, a valiant Kokura warrior who aided the Shinwa in the Gate War.
Do you mean me, or the ship itself?
I am in second command of the Typotl Maw, so I take over when the commander is absent.

The ship handles any breaches of security in Sirius or other Jenquai systems. It has pretty much been at rest since the Gate War. We are stationed here in Swooping Eagle for now. We considered basing in Xipe Totec, but another Shinwa capital ship has since moved there to guard the station from foreign creatures.
Thanks for the company. You can now go back to Yasuragi and complete your mission. Goodbye.
Suit yourself.. Well I'm glad we got to know each other *snicker*. You can return to Yasuragi and complete your mission now.

stages.description: Tell Kigoshi Saruta you talked to the Typotl Maw.

nodes.text: Another trainee returned safely. Did you enjoy your mission?

branches.text: Would you fail me if I said I didn't?

nodes.text: I'm glad to see you got something out of it. Now to get what you were really looking for, missile weapon training. You are now allowed to use missiles. Have fun learning them and try not to blow yourself up.

No, however I am disappointed. It's mostly your fault. What you get out of training doesn't reflect my overwhelming competance as a teacher. You only get out what you put in. Now enjoy your missiles and try not to blow yourself up, ok?

missions.name: Juoona Revolt
missions.summary: Help the Shinwa counter juoona aggression by killing a patriarch.

nodes.text: Hello, defender. Would you like a job to do?

Humans and the juoona creatures have lived in peace for a good amount of time, but some of the juoona have been becoming aggressive lately. Research indicates that the only kind of Juoona that is causing the problems is the Juoona Patriarch. When humans are around, the patriarchs tend to incite other juoona to attack the humans. Could you please eliminate a patriarch to calm the aggression?

branches.text: I'll pass. You're on your own.

nodes.text: No worries then, just be careful about the juoona. They are getting out of hand.
Proceed to Swooping Eagle sector and eliminate one then.

stages.description: Return to Master Orosu.

nodes.text:
Thank you for taking care of the problem. Hopefully we can eliminate the patriarchs and return the juoonas to peace.




If you ever need guidance, ask one of us masters. We are always available to help.

You are now able to repair equipment. After tough battles, this skill will be greatly useful. You will need it if you take hull damage in space because there is a great risk your equipment will be damaged. Incapacitated travelers will also need your assistance after a jumpstart. This skill allows you to be a much greater asset to your group. Enjoy it.

missions.name: All in a Day's Work
missions.summary: The life of a Sharim often means making components then making equipment. Learn to do just that.

nodes.text: Why are you here?

branches.text: I am a trader wanting to learn the tools of my trade.

nodes.text: Too bad! I have nothing to teach you.

branches.text: Well let's talk about you then.

nodes.text:
What is there to talk about? I guess I could say a few things..





I used to be a Sha'ha'dem explorer and life was good. However, as I lived as an explorer I noticed some of their flaws. Explorers are in a nonstop persistant search of knowledge. They forget their morals and often risk the deaths of themselves and others. Recently the Sha'ha'dem opened an ancient gate that leads to the Antares system. This system is full of dangerous creatures that could threaten all of Capella.

branches.text: But... but.. I trade in Capella!

nodes.text: Not only that, the majority of the Jenquai population resides in Capella. The Sha'ha'dem are risking all of the lives of those inhabitants and haven't done anything. Smart people can sure be idiots sometimes. Anyway, I left the Sha'ha'dem when I saw an opportunity to help out the new trading branch of the Jenquai, the Sharim.

branches.text: Why didn't you join the Shinwa?

nodes.text: Well Goodbye. Next time don't bug me, I don't have time to chat.

Isn't it obvious? I don't like killing. The Shinwa follow their leaders blindly and are willing to kill at any command. They are not a group that think before they shoot. Nor do they have any compassion at all.
/threaten Why do you disagree? Are you ignorant?

branches.text: I think the Shinwa are honorable.

nodes.text: They are certainly honorable, but that doesn't mean they are good people. Just because you do what you think is right does not mean it is right. Now if you excuse me, I am quite busy.

You haven't been a Sharim very long, have you? In my eyes the Shinwa look down upon us. They view us as weaklings who offer nothing to Jenquai society. That's why I use so many harsh words against them. Perhaps you will see it the way I do, perhaps not. Anyway let's get started.
Your training of course.

branches.text: You said you didn't train people.
But I just wanted to talk.

nodes.text: I lied. Now get to work. Go find a miner and get some refined minerals and bring them here.
Well too bad, now you are going to be trained in the art of building. Building what? You'll find out. Now go get me some refined minerals. You may need to buy the materials from a miner.

branches.text: You sure aren't very straight forward.

nodes.text: /agree I like to tease my trainees. Part of being a Sharim is to wear people down. Then you can sell to them for more.

stages.description: Obtain the refined materials for a Turbo2 Wiring Harness then talk to Synjin. You will need Lead, Nickel, and Silicon.

nodes.text: That task sure took you awhile.. what are you, a Progen?
Now you're just asking for it. I should lead you astray just so you can't follow me blindly like a Shinwa.
I guess so. If I led you astray, you'd probably never figure it out. Anyway, nonsense aside, here is the part I want you to build soon. Please analyze it.

stages.description: Analyze the Turbo2 Wiring Harness. If it breaks, you will have to find another.
Talk to Synjin for the next step.

nodes.text: You're doing well, so I'll stop giving you a headache.

Thanks? You should be praising me and bowing at my feet! I was about to save you some time, but now I must reconsider. Now that you have the Turbo2 Wiring Harness analyzed, it is time for the next step. Taking that component and making equipment. You have the first component for an engine. I will give you the other components and the blueprint, so go make me the engine.

Now you are worshipping me? Get back to work. I'm going to give you an engine blueprint and several parts for that engine. The wiring harness you just made is one part. Go build that engine for me and come back.

stages.description: Build a Damaged Shaitan Motivator and return to Synjin.

nodes.text: Did you figure it out or are you still wandering aimlessly trying to understand what I told you to do?
Well then, you deserve more praise than I thought. But honestly, you did a good job and I am proud. Now give me that engine.

branches.text: I don't get to keep it?

nodes.text: Very well, just go. I am very busy.
/thumbs *Wink*

missions.name: Revenge: In Triplicate...
missions.summary: Louden's got another job for you, this time he wants you to take his semi-quarterly inventory report to DeWinter.

nodes.text: Hello again, @name. I've got some more work for you.

branches.text: Again? How much do I get?

nodes.text: /very_bored Of course of course, straight to the reward. I shoulda expected no less of ye'.

branches.text: How very right you are. I want money, what kind of @profession would I be otherwise?

nodes.text: /agree Fine, fine, anyway, I need you to go out to deliver this here semi-quarterly income/loss datacube to Lady DeWinter and make sure she knows it's from me. *mumbling softly* Tha' arse deserves it.

branches.text: Got it, on my way. Be thinkin' about that reward.
What'd you say... at the end there, you sort of trailed off..?

nodes.text: Good on yer, when you get back the rewards will be worth yer while.

branches.text: They better be... they better be.

nodes.text: Oh, nothing ye need be concerned with, Maybe I'll tell ye later, if yer prove ter be useful.

branches.text: Well, you know what they say, information is power. Power is money. I want money.. so I'm in.

nodes.text: Off with ye, then.

stages.description: Deliver another report.. quarterly or semi-quarterly or something, oh what does it matter, you're just in it for the money. Lady DeWinter on Somerled Station (New Edinburgh, Tau Ceti is who he told you to take it to. Get it there, get it done. Time is money.

nodes.text: /take What have you brought me?

branches.text: Some semi-quarterly Income/Loss report from MacEwen.

nodes.text: /shake_fist MacEwen huh? Well he always was a bit of a failure. Never able to turn his paperwork in on time. If there's one thing I detest it's inefficiency in my organization.

branches.text: Paperwork? But he seems so dilligent.

nodes.text: /not_sure Are we talkin' about same MacEwen here? *checks her datapad* According to my records his reports have been missing 73 out of the last 78 times he's supposed to have submitted a report.

branches.text: Well, I've personally delivered two for him and I've only been with InfinitiCorp for a short time.

nodes.text: /point Well, maybe he's found a good partner, in any case take this to my assistant. Fergus MacGregor, he'll take care of the report. *attaches a note to Fergus to make sure all of the data is copied*

stages.description: Take the report over to MacGregor as instructed...

nodes.text: /take Oh joy, another Income / Loss report these are always fun.
MacEwen you say? Well, I'll take care of this real quick-like. *starts to put the report in the shredder*

branches.text: Don't you think you ought to read that?

nodes.text: This is my business @profession, deal with it and don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong... /shake_fist

branches.text: But... deWinter... she left a note on it for you.

nodes.text: /disagree3 I don't believe you. *stuffs the report into the shredder*

branches.text: Oh well, it's your arse in the sling, not mine.

nodes.text: /explode Get OUTTA here before yer make me angry! /rude

stages.description: Return to Louden MacEwen aboard Loki Station. (High Earth, Sol)

nodes.text: Ah, welcome back @name. I hope yer journey was profitable. In any case, have ye taken care o' what I asked of ye?
Good, good. You've done admirably, so what happened when you gave it to DeWinter.

branches.text: She made me take it over to Fergus to log it.

nodes.text: /clap Thas' great news tha is. Glad ter hear it. Yeh've done a good job and yeh will be granted some credits fer yer troubles.

branches.text: Well, I'm a fan of money...

nodes.text: /agree I feel much tha same bairn. Hoots! Off ye be goin'. Your reward has already been given.

missions.name: Relentless Drones: A constant problem for Tradesmen
missions.xml_name: Relentless Drones: A constant problem for Tradesmen
missions.summary: Louden needs you to take care of some Pesky drones that are causing hell for the InfinitiCorp Scavenger crews.

nodes.text: /point Oi @name, I have som' work fer ya if yer interested.

branches.text: Sounds good, what do I need to do?

nodes.text: I'm uploading it ter yer PDA. Please review the details thar, go out an' do wot I've asked then come back ter see me.

stages.description: Kill 7 Relentless Drones at Nav Salvage Station 6.
Return to Louden to check with him and most importantly, to extort him of a few well deserved credits!

nodes.text: Did you do what I asked? Good, here's a reward.

missions.name: Exterminate Scuttle Nymphs
missions.summary: You've talked to Holly, she said something about a secret spot north of the EarthCorps Sector Command Post here in High Earth. She wants you to take care of a problem there that is interrupting her profit.

nodes.text: /point Hey, @name. You have a moment? I've got some work that needs doin'

branches.text: Wha? How do you know my name?

nodes.text: /rude Thas' none o yer business, as my friend Louden might be sayin'. In any case, I have need of a pilot to go out to a little spot I know of to clear up a little problem I've been having with scuttle nymphs.

branches.text: Are they difficult? I know they say risk vs. reward, but I prefer plain reward myself.

nodes.text: /crazy Well, I'm afraid I can't give you any information until you sign the contract. *grins mischeivously at you*

branches.text: I'll not be signing any contract with you today.

nodes.text: /thumbs_up Spoken like a true @profession, I need you to get out there and kill some Scuttle Nymphs as I mentioned, there's a little spot that I have some "side projects" going on at. I'll tell you where it is once you sign this here NDA. I can't have my secret get out to the public, I'd never see another dime.

branches.text: Aren't I a member of the public?

nodes.text: /shoot As you wish, but you'll be sorry! /smash
Perhaps so, /shoot but after you sign that paper, if you reveal my secret, you'll be my new source of income. *wink*

branches.text: I don't like the sound of that.

nodes.text: They rarely do, so, you in?

Good, the spot is north of the EarthCorps Sector command post, it's a little off the beaten path, but if you get close you'll find a pair of decommissioned solar arrays that don't appear on any star charts. If you'll take care of the scuttle Nymphs I'll reward you pretty well.

stages.description: Holly asked you to go take care of a little problem a few klicks north of the EarthCorps Sector Command in High Earth sector (High Earth, Sol). You are to kill 10 Scuttle Nymphs
Return to Holly to get a reward, remember, she's a bit shady and could be tricky. She's a known thief, or so Louden told you.

nodes.text: /bow Welcome back @name, sign here please? *slides a nondescript form in front of you*

branches.text: What exactly is this I'm signing?

nodes.text: Ha-ha! You get nothing, signed it all over to me, you did. I'm happy, come back to me the next time you'd like some work. I tend to profit tremendously. Thanks for your patronage! /bow
I did indeed, and I must admit, it's some of my finer work. Good bye!
/shoot Well, er, I didn't expect you to ask that. Um, just sign it will ya?

branches.text: I'm not signing a damn thing until you tell me what it is!

nodes.text: /bow Ok fine, you got me, it's InfinitiCorp Form EECXLSII, a form used to waive your rewards. You win, I'll pay you, for now.

Louden needs some supplies from Earth Station Earth, Sol 

System.
