Terran Rank Insignias and O2 canisters fer our spacewalk scavengers. 

I need som' supplies, can ya get 5 of each of these for me from 

Earth Station. It may be a little expensive but I'll take care of

I should hope so. It's just Earth afterall. /laugh1

supplies.

we're doin a lot of promotions around here and I was running quite 

low on rank insignias. And we're always in need of the O2 

canisters.
Fine fine, what was the price?
Here's your credits, thanks fer ye help!

missions.name: Destroy the Intruders
missions.summary: Markus Kahn has tasked you to eliminate the Advanced Shang Lo Red Dragon's along the Nav path, east of Brattus.

nodes.text: @name, get over here.
And you call yourself a Warrior? Get out of my sight!

As you might already know, Tarsis has been invaded by the Shang Lo Red Dragon Tong. What I need you to do, is to annihilate a couple of these Advanced Shang Lo Red Dragons. Six should be enough. I want to send them a message, that the Progen Republic is not an entity to "push around."



So, will you partake in this mission?

branches.text: No, I'm busy on another mission.

nodes.text: Then get out of my sight.
Proceed to the Eastern Nav Path and hunt down those Advanced Shang Lo Red Dragons.

stages.description: Destroy 6 Shang Lo Advanced Red Dragons scattered along the eastern Nav Path.
Return to Markus Kahn to inform him of your success.

nodes.text: Did they get THE  message?

Very good job, @name. 

If you are interested, I have another task for you, after you have gained some expierence first.

missions.name: Elites are not so Elite!
missions.summary: Markus Kahn has tasked you to eliminate the Elite Shang Lo Red Dragon's at the Red Dragon Camp, by Octavius' Rise.

missions.name: Jenquai Rank 2 Promotion Bonus Part 1
missions.summary: Assemble the Inspiration of Elias ben Joseph to aid the Sha'ha'dem Explorers.

nodes.text: /clap AHH.. Wonderful! I'm glad you are interested in helping the Jenquai. I will make sure you are rewarded for your future efforts.

/point You will find out, @name. Now then. Your first assignment is to get your hull upgrade. It will help you help us, so take care of that immediately. Councillor Uje'da will aid you with that. After that, Councillor Uje'da told me to send you to Fenris Prime Observatory. They should have some documents for you. The documents are fascinating Terran reports about the Shinwa, so do not lose them or I and other historians will castigate you. Got it?
/chuckle I know I do, and it sure makes my job more fun. Now get going.

stages.description: Receive your second Hull Upgrade.
Talk to Councillor Uje'da for your mission details.

nodes.text: /thumbs So you have chosen to help the Jenquai? Wonderful. Prepare yourself, for this is a long mission, but by completing it you will be rewarded greatly.

I am not the best one to explain what you must do, but I can help you get started. One of your greatest allies will be Loremaster Daiki-ya. So to begin your work it would be kind to bring her a gift. I have the gift arranged to be picked up at Fenris Prime Observatory. Good luck, Jenquai. I'm sure you will do fine.

stages.description: Head to Fenris Prime Observatory and talk to Liam O'Faolain to pick up documents for Loremaster Daiki-ya.

nodes.text: /wave I heard someone was coming for these here documents, are you them?

/give Good, I wanted to get rid of them so I could get back to my work. Oh but before you go, Uje'da told me to let you know why I'm giving you these documents. I'm sure you have heard of the woman by the name of Daiki-ya. She is very intelligent but a bit loopy so Uje'da figured if you gave her these documents she would be more willing to trust you. So go give the documents to her on the Tokai Saikutsu in Dahin. And... be careful...

stages.description: Talk to Loremaster Daiki-ya on the Tokai Saikutsu. Do not forget to deliver the documents to her.

nodes.text: /point YOU.
/shocked Who sent you?!
/rude A cunning plot. But it will not work! You are here to assassinate me! Get out of here you con artist!!

branches.text: But I have documents for you.

nodes.text: /no I am not interested in taking part in your trap.

branches.text: But I must deliver them or I cannot complete my mission!
Ok I'm just going to leave.
But they are really interesting and about Shinwa!

nodes.text:
/agree Oh that's much better. So you're a Progen assassin sent to kill me...





/threaten No. I refuse to be killed! Security! Save me from this berserk Progen spy!
So you're not only going to kill me, you're going to steal my wallet too? Outrageous! You cannot silence my research! Leave now! /rude

/no I will not accept these "documents" as you call them. In reality I know they are either a bomb or some dangerous material meant to silence me. Your evil plot will not succeed. I'm reporting you to Jenquai authorities!
Wait... you're just going to leave? /shrug That seems awfully suspicious. Let's talk. What are you doing here?

branches.text: Well I wanted to deliver documents.
It doesn't matter now. I'm leaving. You're obviously not interested.

nodes.text: That will not fly, Progen spy. /rude Now go back to your Progen warlords and report your failure to assassinate me.

Do not leave yet. If you take that stance, you couldn't be trying to assassinate me... yet. I will have my guards retrieve the documents and make sure they are not dangerous. /take



These documents are interesting. How did you know I was interested in the history of the Shinwa?
/no This still seems fishy, but there is a way for you to prove you are not out to kill me. Prove your loyalty by finding me the First Inspiration of Elias ben Joseph.
It is an old Jenquai momento that was stolen by Progen Dog Soldiers during the Gate War. Us Sha'ha'dem have been unable to locate it since.

branches.text: Oh I can find that easily.

nodes.text: Not without my help you can't. Some historians say that the Progen brought the artifact back to Endriago. However, I believe the Progen who stole it never made it out of Jupiter. So my only lead is to go examine near the Ruins of Jove City. Find it and I will believe you are not out to kill me. Don't come back without it.

stages.description: Find the First Inspiration. It should be somewhere by the Ruins of Jove City.
Return to Loremaster Daiki-ya with the First Inspiration.

nodes.text: /shocked Back again? I told you not to come back without the- OH! You found it! Thank you @name! So you really are here to help me.. interesting.

branches.text: I told you I meant well.

nodes.text: /take Well then, let's talk for minute. To complete your mission you need to help me find all the inspirations of Elias ben Joseph. The inspirations are very important to Jenquai culture. It is through the inspirations that the Jenquai cause was created. There are four inspirations. We have one.

branches.text: How do I find the next one?

nodes.text: I have a friend on Mercury Station who I believe has some knowledge of the second inspiration. Talk to her and hope she can give you a lead. Perhaps she also might be interested in those Jenquai Documents, so bring them along if you will.

stages.description: Talk to Curator Whitley aboard Mercury Station for information about the Second Inspiration.

nodes.text: Hello? Who's there?

branches.text: I'm a Jenquai guy looking for information.
I'm a Jenquai girl looking for information.

nodes.text: /wave Oh, I'm SO glad you came! I'm always happy to see a big strong man come to Mercury. We don't get enough of those here. I get a little... lonely. So big boy, whatcha need?

branches.text: Do you know anything about the Second Inspiration?

nodes.text: /rude Oh... Why are you here?

branches.text: Do you know anything about the Second Inspiration?

nodes.text:
/chuckle Of course! You came to the right place, I happen to be an expert.





The Dog Soldiers who stole the second inspiration headed for the Ragnarok sector, in Aragoth system.
/threaten Yes, not that I should tell you. You pretty young woman.. trying to steal the men away from me. It's not going to work. I'm attractive AND smart.

branches.text: Just tell me where I can find it so I can get out of here.

nodes.text: /agree Any time! Come back soon and we can chat some more.
Fine. Go to Ragnarok sector. Now leave.

stages.description: Search for Progen Dog Soldiers in Ragnarok, Aragoth System.

nodes.text: /bow Hey there, the name's Tarnish.
Lookin for something?
/shrug Yeah actually, I have it. Though it's pretty important to me, and I won't give it away easy.

branches.text: What could I do for you to pay for it?

nodes.text: We're having a bit of a rogue problem round here. Could you help keep some traders safe by killing some of 'em?
/shoot They're pests, please shoot 'em up good for me.

stages.description: Kill 5 Rogue Bandits for McHollis.
Return to Tarnish McHollis.

nodes.text: /bow 'Lo again.

/agree Ahh, well then. I have a story to tell ya before I give you the inspiration.





I used to be a Somerled inhabitant but I was having some troubles makin money. So I decided that I would be a miner. I took a risk as well as a loan and bought a little mining ship and headed for Ragnarok. I found a great bit o' luck in the fields and was makin a good chunk of change. Then one day about two months into the job I ran into a lone Chavez. He knew my hull was full of ore and he came after me. I turned my engines on full blast but couldn't outrun him. I thought I was a goner till a Progen Dog Soldier jumped in and blew up the Chavez, saving my life. I didn't know who he was until we met again on Trader's Fort. /drink I treated him to a pint of MacGregor's Lager for saving me.  After the drinks he gave me a little cube and told me to keep it. I found out later it was the second inspiration. I still don't know why he gave the cube to me.

branches.text: That seems a bit odd to me too.

nodes.text:
Maybe he just didn't want to deal with it. /give Anyway here ya go. And do me one more favor, will you? /no Tell the Jenquarum that not all Progen are bad. If it wasn't for that Progen, I wouldn't be here today.



I do know a bit more that might be useful to you. Working here at Trader's Fort I hear about a good deal of stuff. A while ago, some Red Dragons were talking about how they captured a Dog Soldier. They said he had a cube on him. I'm gonna guess they were talking about the Third Inspiration. They were from Asteroid Belt Beta, so I'd go search there for more info.

stages.description: Search the Asteroid Belts for Red Dragons who might have the Third Inspiration. The Research Vessel might have it.

nodes.text: What do you want?

branches.text: I'm looking for the Third Inspiration of Elias ben Joseph.

nodes.text: /agree We have it and will sell it to you for a price. 20,000 credits.

branches.text: I'm sure plenty more people have one.. 7,500!

nodes.text: /no 10,000 is as low as we'll go.
10,000 credits it is. /smash Pay up or I'll alert the other Red Dragon's you are here.

stages.description: Pay the Red Dragons 10,000 credits in exchange for the Third Inspiration.

nodes.text: Do you have the cash?
/give Well that was an easy 10,000 credits. We had no use for the cube anyway.

stages.description: Return to Daiki-ya with the Second and Third Inspirations.

nodes.text: /take Three down, one to go. /shrug Unfortunately I have evidence that the fourth inspiration has been shattered into four parts. We must find each part and assemble the fourth inspiration back together.

Well we have to start somewhere. I have info on the whereabouts of the first fragment. It is with a famous Terran Tradesman by the name of Monty duChampe. Go talk to him at Friendship 7 Recreation Port in Glenn.

stages.description: Seek out the thrify Terran, Monty DuChampe to get his fragment of the Fourth Inspiration.

nodes.text: /bow Hi, I'm Monty, owner of a multitude of shops and things for the needy traveler. What can I do for you?

branches.text: Can I have your fragment of inspiration?

nodes.text: /no It's not for sale.

branches.text: Pretty please with a cherry on top?

nodes.text: /bored Now we're getting down to business. I'll let you know I sold one of these the other day for 50,000 credits. I would not expect any less than that.

branches.text: I'm calling your bluff. There's only one of them...

nodes.text: ... Well then. 10,000 credits.
8,000. Take it or leave it.
/give Neat. It's been a pleasure doing business with you!
/threaten Good luck finding a better offer..
/no It's not for sale.

branches.text: Pretty please with a cherry on top?

stages.description: Return to Daiki-ya for more information.

nodes.text: What news do you bring me? You have retrieved the first fragment? Excellent. Take note though, that I am not responsible for reimbursement of however many credits the greedy Terran wanted.

branches.text: Great... Now where do I find the next one?

nodes.text: /shrug I'm sorry to tell you that I have no idea where the second fragment of the Fourth Inspiration is. However, maybe my friend Master Jhola on Yasuragi would know. Hopefully the spies have not gotten to him yet.. Anyway, I have prepared a translation of the First Inspiration for Jhola. /give Please deliver it to him so that he may bring you guidance.

stages.description: Relay Daiki-ya's translation to Master Jhola on Yasuragi, Swooping Eagle Planet, Sirius System.

nodes.text: /bow Hello there. Are you looking for training?

branches.text: No, I have a message from Loremaster Daiki-ya for you.

nodes.text:
Oh, you are the message carrier? She sent me a transmission to say you were coming. /take Anyway, let me see that translation.




/agree Well, in the translation are some of Elias' words. He was a very poetic and obscure man, but so far I haven't seen anything that could point you to the next fragment. Daiki-ya wrote as a side note something about the Dog Soldiers still being alive and trying to kill her but I'll dismiss that. She is a bit paranoid.

Give me a moment to think about the translation and what it could mean. While I meditate on it's meaning, why don't you meditate too? /agree Perhaps the statue of Shigehiro Yasuragi could bring you guidance.

stages.description: Jhola suggests you meditate at the statue of Shigehiro Yasuragi.
Return to Daiki-ya for any information.

nodes.text: /agree I see you found the second fragment. How did you come across it?

branches.text: I pulled it out of my hat.
It appeared in my hull after I meditated at the Yasuragi Statue.

nodes.text:
/crazy I'm not even going to ask... But it doesn't matter really. You have the fragment and are still alive.




This time I do have information on the next fragment. Sources tell me that it's somewhere on Zweihander Planet.

branches.text: Is that all you know? Great..

nodes.text:
/shrug That's strange. I wonder how it got there. Yasuragi was a strange guy..





Now, I have evidence that the next fragment is on Zweihander Planet.

branches.text: Is that all you know? Great..

nodes.text: /agree I'm afraid so. But you have completed the first part of the bonus mission. Talk to me when you are ready to start part two.

missions.name: Jenquai Rank 2 Upgrade
missions.summary: Councillor Uje'da has allowed you to proceed to the Paren Ship Yard in Kailaasa to receive your hull upgrade. Please note that after completing this mission you cannot obtain Jenquai Rank 2 Promotion Bonus Part 1.

nodes.text: You are making good progress, young one. I'm sure by now you have explored much, defeated many, profited greatly and have much experience in the universe. If not, there is always room to do so in the future. But now it is time for the Jenquai to help you improve.

Very well, but before I send you to receive your hull upgrade, I want to inform you of a mission opportunity. The Jenquai need your help to recover a lost artifact taken by the Progen Dog Soldiers. The mission is tedious but worth it if you are interested. If not, go ahead and receive your hull upgrade. You will not be able to complete this mission after your upgrade but you will be able to move on with your exploration and experiences. It may be a difficult decision. Please take a moment to think.





Now then, if you want to take the Jenquai Advancement Bonus Mission, do so now unless you already have the mission. If you have the mission or do not want to take the mission, we will continue. To get the mission talk to Master Sevti on this same station. She may want you to meditate, but that is not part of your bonus mission.

branches.text: I need to acquire the mission before continuing.
I am not ready at all.

nodes.text: Very well then. Come back here when you are ready for your hull upgrade. You may travel often but I do not go anywhere.
Excellent. Head to the Paren Ship Yard with 10,000 credits and the engineer will upgrade your ship and advance your rank.
Return when you are ready. Do not hurry, you have all the time you need.

stages.description: Head to the Paren Ship Yard in Kailaasa, Capella System with 10,000 credits. If you want to take the bonus mission, talk to Master Sevti in Joves Fury and acquire the mission before completing this step. Note that Sha'ha'dem Pilgrimage is not the bonus mission.

nodes.text:
Hello @class!
I am the engineer at Paren Ship Yard and am here to upgrade your ship. Do you have the credits required?

Cool. We're upgrading your ship now. It will be done in just a second. Your new ship will have a stronger hull, more weapon or device slots and with the upgrade your rank will also go up to rank 2 for your class. Your ship will also look a bit more sleek, though some upgrades are more noticable than others. Enjoy!
Well come back when you have enough credits.

missions.name: Jenquai Rank 2 Promotion Bonus Part 2
missions.summary: Find the Fourth Inspiration.

nodes.text: Are you ready to begin part 2 of the rank 2 hull upgrade bonus mission, @name? We must make the Jenquai proud.
/agree Good, now head to Zweihander Planet and find the third fragment of the Fourth Inspiration.
I knew you weren't actually going to help me. You really are a Progen spy! I never should have trusted you. /rude Now get out of here!

stages.description: Search Zweihander for the third fragment.

nodes.text: *Bzzt* Hello traveler. I am cleaning bot, SAM. Please help. I am stranded underwater. My engines broke so I can not move.

branches.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.text: Find me spare parts. I fix myself and be able to move. If you do I give you shiney object I found other day. Please.

stages.description: Find Spare Parts for SAM.

nodes.text: Thank you. I will repair myself.

branches.text: Are you sure you don't need any more help?

nodes.text: Yes. I am fine. Here is what I found.

stages.description: Head back to Dahin Planet with the third fragment.
ATTENTION: Receive the incoming transmission at the Dahin Satellite by the gate to Kailaasa in Dahin Sector.

nodes.text: /smash Give up foolish Jenquai!
/threaten I am the Cenovar Firedancer. The mightiest of warriors. I have incredible power over you, so listen up. I have the last fragment of the Fourth Inspiration.

/no No. Everything you've done to assemble the Fourth Inspiration has been futile. One of our strongest warriors has the fragment and I am certain you cannot defeat him. Hahaha! Go ahead and try, I want to see you get destroyed! Us Cenovar are the most powerful and dedicated warriors in the galaxy. Face your doom, young Jenquai!

stages.description: Talk to Loremaster Daiki-ya about the Cenovar encounter.

nodes.text: You've found the third fragment. Good job.

branches.text: Daiki-ya, I know where the fourth fragment is.

nodes.text: /shrug What? Not even I know where it is.

branches.text: A Cenovar told me I have to kill a powerful warrior of theirs.

nodes.text: A Cenovar? Interesting. There are not many of them still around. They are an ancient group of people who had knowledge beyond the rest of us Jenquai. However they are also outcasts with radical beliefs. Why they are here I am uncertain. Regardless, you must defeat the Cenovar warrior so we can assemble the Fourth Inspiration. Do whatever you can to defeat it, and good luck, you will need it.

stages.description: Defeat the Cenovar Gladiator at the Fallen Moon Fragment.
Return to Loremaster Daiki-ya with the fragments.

nodes.text: You return with the fragment and a small reward. /clap Outstanding, young Jenquai! You have gone beyond all of my expectations to find the Inspirations and fragments.
But you are not done yet. You must assemble the Fourth Inspiration. Gather the fragments and manufacture it. You will need build devices level 1. Quickly now.

stages.description: Manufacture the Fourth Inspiration and return to Daiki-ya.

nodes.text: /clap You have retrieved all of Elias Ben Joseph's Inspirations. Your work has been invaluable to all Jenquai. I thank you personally and acknowledge you are no spy, no progen, in fact you are one of the most valiant Jenquai.

You have completed your mission. I know it was long and arduous, but I thank you from the depths of my heart. Every Jenquai can now learn from the long lost Inspirations and I expect many more great things will happen in the future.



As your reward, I will grant you my appreciation and the level four reactor Source of Inspiration. I hope it will inspire you to always strive to be better. The Jenquai will need you again and I know you will be there for us. I look forward to seeing your name in the news reports. Good luck @name.

You certainly do look like one... I can see why any system would certainly cast you away from it.

missions.name: Panang's Seminar
missions.summary: In exchange for listening to her talk about money, Yun Panang will teach you build devices.

nodes.text: Hey. I've been waiting for you. Before we start our training for build devices I suggest you learn build engines and components first. Through that training you will know how to utilize build devices, because my session will not cover how to use the skill.

branches.text: I understand how to build things.

nodes.text: Let me know when you are ready to start training.
Thank you. Good luck in your learning!

stages.description: Listen to Yun Panang's advice.

nodes.text: As a Seeker, one of your main focuses is to make money. So I wanted to give you some tips about making money. There are a few ways to make money. Through trade routes, through other players, and through combat.

I'm not finished.. So let's talk about trade routes. I'm sure by now you know what trade routes are. They are one of the best ways to get trade experience especially at low levels. Similarly, they are one of the best ways for low level players to gain money, and the money they gain is always consistant. As your combat level raises however, trade route money will become chump change.

Making money from players is always a good source of money. As a builder, you will probably end up making money from players for your manufactured goods. As a builder, the money you will make depends on what you offer. Players will pay more for rare equipment and components than common ones so it would be wise to analyze rare items. If you find something desirable that few other builders have, you can make a fortune. If you build mediocre vendorbought material, few people will buy it and you will barely break even.

Also, mob drops. Mobs drop two basic types of items. Loot items and equipment. Most loot items  will stack, which allows them to be easier to accumulate. These loot items will usually offer better trade experience and credits. If you plan on going somewhere far away to hunt for a while, it's best to tractor the organic stacking material instead of the junk equipment to sell. If you tractor the equipment to sell it, your cargo will fill up fast.

Missions can also make you a decent amount of credits depending on the mission. Also remember, if you receive a mission to go from Station A to Station B, see if you can buy trade goods between the two stations for a bit of extra cash.


Thank you for listening and I hope you learned a lot. As money makes the world go round, pay me 10,000 credits to complete this mission and receive your build devices skill.

stages.description: Pay Yun Panang 10,000 credits to receive the Build Devices skill.

nodes.text: You have completed my training session and now know how to build devices.

missions.name: Obtain Skill: Build Devices
missions.summary: This mission will teach you the ancient skill of Building Devices. Visit Master Orosu at (Master Cha'Han's Dojo) on (Swooping Eagle) planet.

nodes.text: /bow Welcome young @profession, I see your skill has grown and you are ready to learn a new skill! This skill has been passed to from one Defender generation to another, it has aided us all to being sucessful in our travels. You must earn this skill first, are you ready?

branches.text: Yes I am, tell me what I need to do.
No I am not, I do need more time.

nodes.text: /clap Wonderful!  You are an eager @race indeed.  I need you too--... Wait a minute I do not have the data disc with the skill information stored on it.  It was left with my good friend Councillor Uje'da at Jove's Fury in Jupiter.  Can you go pick it up?

branches.text: Ugh...This had better be worth it.
I am not taking that hike!  Do I look like a Tradesman?

nodes.text: /clap That is very good indeed, I can see you are an honorable @profession!  You are well on your way to greatness!  Come back to me when you have the disc. Take this for your troubles.
/shocked How dare you talk to me with that tone!  You dishonor your race and yourself!  Get out of my sight!
/agree Aye, come back to me when you are ready.

stages.description: Go to Councillor Uje'da at (Jove's Fury) in (Jupiter) sector to retrieve the data disc.

nodes.text: /wave Hello @name, how can I help you?

branches.text: Master Orosu needs a data disc to teach me how to Build Devices.

nodes.text: /shocked What?  Oh that's right I do have his data disc right here, except I put it on a cube now to make things easier.   Holds more data, and faster access!  Sorry us @race's are an ancient race and new technology surprises us.

branches.text: I see... May I have that disc now?

nodes.text: Yes you can,  I do apologize for my bickering please tell Master Orosu I said hi!  Here is a little something for your troubles.

stages.description: Return to Master Orosu to give him the data cube.

nodes.text: Welcome back @name!  I thank you for taking the time to retrieve the item I asked of you,  it is wonderful to see you!  How was the trip?

That is wonderful indeed!  You have honored your race by retrieving this valuable information, I shall bestow it upon you now.  First though I would like you to take this Level 1 Device and analyze it and bring it back to me, once you have done that I shall give you a further reward.

stages.description: Analyze and obtain the blueprint for the Dolphin's Tail Master Orosu has given to you at the (Yasuragi) station on (Swooping Eagle) planet.  If you lose the item when trying to analyze it, you can buy another one from the vendors on the same station.
Now that you have the blueprint show it to Master Orosu back at (Master Cha'Han's Dojo) station on (Swooping Eagle) planet.

nodes.text: Ah, I see you have gotten the blueprint /bow Good Work!  You have done well!  I bow to your deeds and your commitment.  Of course those data cubes you gave me did not have the Build Devices skill you needed.  I had the ability to teach the skill to you this entire time.  You gave me a recipe to Red Dragon Soup. /smile

branches.text: Then why did you make me do that?

nodes.text: Sometimes @name, we have to do things we do not want to do.  Not every path is paved with cement.  Sometimes our path will be something we do not want to do, or something that is not normal or linear.
