Tucker's genemap got reloaded far too many times, and a bit of corruption happened.  It's why hes been 'retired' from active duty.  Try not to mock him, he don't like that!

branches.text: Ok, so why the Progen Small Arms?

stages.description:
Evacuate wounded from Botany Bay in the deep desert.
X: -19
Y: +40

nodes.text: Attention @profession, the Sand Storm is rising.  Our sensors are not working and our power plant is down.  Please land and wait for the wounded and our recent finds to be loaded to your vessel.

OK thank you for the Progen Small Arms, we really needed these.  You don't understand what is out there, no one does.

Prepare to receive wounded scientists in Emergency Pods and Scientific Research and Artifacts in Security Cargo.

branches.text: Ok, I have at least 20 empty cargo slots.

nodes.text:
Get back to Nostrand Vor, the Sand Storm is looking hellish out there, I hope the evacuation will be safe!

The evacuation is:

4 x Centuriata Legionaire Gene-Maps  
7 x Evacuation Pods containing wounded
9 x Secured Containers containg artifacts and equipment.

Are you good to go?

branches.text: No, I do not have the room.

nodes.text:
20 empty cargo slots were needed.

James tucker should have told you that.  You need to space some of your cargo if you want to continue.  Time is of the essence and we need to get going now!

branches.text: I can't do this, I must forfit.

nodes.text:
This makes me unhappy, @name.

I hope your 60,000 credits you just forfitted will pay for someone else to rescue us.
Oh, and Var in Arx Tiberious will want those gene maps.  Do not take them to the gene repositary, they are due for some special emergency processing.

stages.description: Return to Nostrand Vor City with the emergency evacuation.  Be careful now!

nodes.text:
Nostrand Vor City - Docking Bay
Careful, the landing is a little rough due to the bad weather.

stages.description: Oh no, the rough landing has damaged some of the cargo.  Go and tell Intuneric Vigoare now!

nodes.text:
@name !! 

You careless spacedog, what in Remus's name you you think you were doing?  Careful landing was needed, prescision.  What do you say for yourself?

branches.text: We had a rough landing and...

nodes.text:
You mean you don't know?

You broke 5 secured containers with those acrobatic stunts on docking.  Five!  Didn't you secure them?  What is the use of broken equipment?  Luckily the archaeological instruments were not damaged, unlike that artifact.

The scientists aren't that happy with you.  The things they are saying about you.  One of them only had a broken leg, and after that landing he's got multiple fractures all over his body.

I've had to take a premuim of the money you put up for assurances.  7% per damaged gear - your lucky I've only taken 21,000 credits.  Some of the scientists are after your blood!

Bad weather shoudn't stop a @profession from doing your task.

Bah.

Lets see if anything can be salvaged.

Archaeological Instruments.  A litte damaged, these'll need repairing though.  Go to James Tucker, he may be able to help.

Broken circuits and tactical display.  We'll have to replace these.  Why?  You may as well keep hold of them.  

Oh and look at this, a Broken Artifact.  It was a fine figurine of a snake rampant from the earth, now its been chopped off at the base.  This now is worthless, but Tucker may like it as a payment for repairing the Archaeological Instruments.

branches.text: I'll head to James Tucker right away, then I'm off this dump.

nodes.text:
Stop your whining and get out of my sight.  

Believe me, with the top brass's comments it'll be the best for you.  I'm doing you a favour here.  Best make yourself scarce if you know what I mean.

stages.description: Quickly go to James Tucker to repair the Archeological Instruments, you don't have time to tidy your cargo hold.

nodes.text: Stop yer blubberin' @name, wot der matter?

branches.text: I had a rough landing and damaged some goods

nodes.text:
Gah,
Dinna blame Intuneric, yer don' derstand? She bin coverin' fer yer.  Bosses watchin' 'er.  She 'ad to tear yer a new un yer see.  Dese egg 'eads canna look afta demslves n' I canna be asked t' side wid 'em.

branches.text: I'll stay out of harms way then.

nodes.text:
Lets see if yeh can get sommat out o' dis.

Pass o'er dat Artifact, n' i'll 'ave a butchers at it.

branches.text: Its all I got, i'm not sure if I want to let it go.

nodes.text:
@name,

See ya 'ere, t' glowing orb.  Dats gotta be betta dan a kick inna teeth.  Yer 'ave it n' I'll giz der Instruments back t' dem.  Dem egg 'eads neva know.

branches.text: That was in the base of the figurine?  Sure!

nodes.text: Yer moi wanna find someone t' look at der orb.  Giz t' time n' speak t' Intuneric later, she'll meh b' able to 'elp.  Oi meh forgot yer gotta tell Var 'bout t' gene-maps!  Giz 'im his boyz back.

branches.text: Yes, I will.  Ooo... it glows red.

nodes.text: See yer arond mate.
Well @name, yer dinna 'ave much choice, t's meh woi o' de hi ' woi.

stages.description: Giv dem genemaps t' Gratis Augustus Var n' Arx Tiberius, pronto mate.

nodes.text: Hello, @name, what can I do for you?

branches.text: Hail Var, I am returning your genemaps from Nostrand Vor.

nodes.text: Thank you for returning my elite shock troops, @name, for this I will give you a word of advice.  If you have aquired anything from the scientific expedition, @race, don't let Vinda have it.

branches.text: What are you going to do about security on Nostrand Vor Planet?

nodes.text: Recently, a Privateer had the audacity to show her a Yellow Sphere and a Blue Sphere!  After she removed the artifacts from him she reset his genemap to level 0.  Imagine having to do everything you ever did.. again.

branches.text: What are you going to do about security on Nostrand Vor Planet?

nodes.text: I may have to commit more troops to this expedition, the reports are sketchy but there seems to have been a massive drain of the expedition's shields and power before whatever it was that pulled the core of the facility one mile underground.  Imagine that,  one mile underground!

branches.text: Ouch!  Talk about a fox in the chicken coop.. what you going to do?
Vinda was in charge of that expedition, wasn't she?

nodes.text: Well, @name, we will not be using energy weapons - these failed.  Good old slug throwers using projectiles will be used.  I must congratulate James Tucker on his foresight there.

branches.text: I want to meet these brave Centuriata when they are reborn.

nodes.text:
I'd also watch out for the other races, expecially Terran, Jenquai and Red Dragons.  After Vinda confiscated those artifacts from the unfortunate 'newbie', there was heightened encrypted communication chatter between our adversaries and their unknown agents within our empire.

It just seems a great shame, the Privateer got wiped from a level 150 straight down to a level 0!  I'd hate to approach Vinda with any looted artifact!

branches.text: I don't believe you, there is some good in Vinda
It's a shame about the centuriata dead
Ok I'm going to stay well clear of Vinda.

nodes.text: Trust me you don't want to go to Vinda
Ok, your funeral.

stages.description: Do you really trust Vinda?

nodes.text: Well @name, I think I'll take that off you.

What this priceless red sphere of ancient origin?

This is Mine, I took off the planet Nostrand Vor.  And don't you forget this.  It is dangerous and I may be able to use this to my advantage.  They may even be able to be combined.

branches.text: I feel really stupid now.  What about my reward?

nodes.text:
Reward?

Your reward is serving me.  Now go.
And so my status grows.

missions.name: Hold the Twilight [version 0.0.J]
missions.summary: Three beautiful perfect glowing spheres, now what do we do with them?

nodes.text:
You know other players have also found blue orbs and red orbs?
Try and convince them to give you theirs so you get one of each colour!

[Mission incomplete]

missions.name: Hold The Twilight [Version 1.0.R]
missions.summary: Three beautiful perfect glowing spheres, now what do we do with them?

nodes.text: Look what has just crawled out of the mire.
Yes, you.  Another wretch in this station, slumly and stinking of alcohol.

Oh so you have a bit of spirit do you?  You think you are superior to the others?  What have you done to make a difference?  

You look nothing more than a low life pirate to me.  Lingering on.  A pox on the others, wasting our resources and frittering away our loot.

branches.text: I don't think you really know me.

nodes.text: Do you contribute to the Pirates?  Have you got something that I may be interested in...  Where are your spoils, the slaves, the credits, the gear that make our life better.....  I once ruled the universe, controlled over 80,000 minions and more than 1800 ships.
That's none of ye buisness!  Now why did you come and bother me?  Have you got something that I can use to regain what is rightfully mine?

branches.text: Well I looted these glowing spheres....

nodes.text:
Why didn't you say so before @name.... I'm always interested in @profession who can contribute to the cause.  Pass them over.

Interesting....

Where did you get them?

branches.text: One from archaeologists on Nostrand Vor and the others by subterfuge

nodes.text:
Nostrand Vor!

These are Vinda's artifacts aren't they?  I heard she was livid to hear that they were stolen....  @name, you have gone up in my opinion, annoying that gene-witch certainly has cheered me up.

branches.text: What do you think they are for?

nodes.text: Honestly... I don't know.  I'm busy trying to crack the protocol ids of these captured hardcoded ship IDs.  But if you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours.  Bring me more gear and I'll take a look at these baubles.

Each military ship has an ID hardcoded to the central core.  Some gates allow them through....  If we can crack these codes before they update them then our pirates can go unnoticed through the gates.  

You may have your use after all.  

[MISSION INCOMPLETE]

missions.name: Hold The Twilight [Version 2.0.T]
missions.summary: Three beautiful perfect glowing spheres, now what do we do with them?

nodes.text:
Mathematics is the pure language.  

Should this individual I perceive before me wish to converse with me, I suggest you solve my puzzels.  Time is money and my time will cost you money.  Prove to me you are more than just a thug and I may allocate you some of my time.

branches.text: I have no time for puzzels,

nodes.text: You have no concept of the absolute.  I have nothing more to say to you,

branches.text: Wait, I have something for you to look at,

nodes.text:
Go away.
I am not interested.

You show promise, a rare intelligent Progen.  Unique.  Next.
1 3 5 7  11

You show promise, a rare intelligent Progen.  Unique.  Next.
1 3 5 7  11

You show promise, a rare intelligent Progen.  Unique.  Next.
1 3 5 7  11
Very good.  Next.
Very good.  Next.
Very good.  Next.
Truely amazing and unheard of, a Progen with the understanding of binary and the prime numbers.  Well @name, I have allocated 5 minutes of my time for you.  What do you want?

branches.text: I'd like you to look at these glowing spheres.
My head hurts, I'd rather not do this mission.

nodes.text:
Interesting.

However, my time is precious so if I was to spend time on these objects you'd have to do something for me.  What are your thoughts on our glorious InfinitiCorp?

branches.text: I will assist you in defending InfinitiCorp.
I have no interest in InfinitiCorp.
It is my aim as a true Progen to eliminate InfinitiCorp.

nodes.text: Unfortunately I would love to converse with an intellectual such as yourself, but I need to go and tend to some mathematical problems.

Excellent.

I may just have something for you to do!  Please check your mission summary logs, I will send the instructions encrypted using an algorithym.  You will perform experiments and carry out tests for me in space while I study these spheres.

branches.text: Don't you need to have the spheres?

nodes.text:
No @name.

Keep them in your cargo hold and I can use remote monitoring in order to analyze them, they could be dangerous and I do not want to be caught having foreign technology at this station.

branches.text: You mean your using me as bait?

nodes.text: That's what Proken are known for,

stages.description: Doctor Sacha Ilriko wants you to do: [Mission incomplete - on hold]

missions.name: Retake the Night [Version 0.0.J]
missions.summary: Why did you do it?  Why do you always do it!  This Orange Orb is dangerous and you need to find a way of making it harmless.

missions.name: Retake The Night [Version 0.0.R]
missions.summary: Why did you do it?  Why do you always do it!  This Purple Orb is dangerous and you need to find a way of making it harmless.

missions.name: Retake The Night [Version 0.0.T]
missions.summary: Why did you do it?  Why do you always do it!  This Green Orb is dangerous and you need to find a way of making it harmless.

missions.name: Defend the Dawn [Version 0.0.-]
missions.summary: Nostrand Var, a desert world at the edge of the galaxy.  Harsh ionised sandstorms sweep the surface, obliterating all in their past.  A calling.  A longing.  Home.

missions.name: Hunting to Distinction
missions.summary: Assist Jar Vlodim with clearing Paramis space from all opposition

nodes.text: What is it that brings you to my feet?

branches.text: I have come to learn of who you are!
I am not at your feet!

nodes.text: You want to know who I am. I am Jar; I am currently leading the Talon to their new rising.

branches.text: The Talon will never rise again.

nodes.text: You do not know of the Talon? The Talon are the original Dragons. Betrayed by all that are Dragons now, or at lest claim to be Dragons.

branches.text: So you are where it all began? Is your following that of the true Black Beard?
The Red Dragons are the only true Dragons.

nodes.text: The Talon, follows the exact rules that were laid down to us by Black Beard. We take no mercy on the weak. We take what we want when we want it, and do it however we want.

branches.text: This sounds like something that fits me!

nodes.text: You think this is the lifestyle that you belong too? You look a little weak to be comparing yourself to the Talon! But, I give any new comer the chance to prove themselves!

branches.text: I cannot at this time prove myself.
I can be a true Talon, and I can prove myself over and over!

nodes.text: So be it then. To prove your worthiness, you must complete one task. There are many who call themselves Chavez in this area. Their known too as Pirates such as the Talons. We must make our stand, and prove that we are the ones.

branches.text: What would you like for me to do?

nodes.text: You must destroy them, and remove them from Paramis. This will allow for my forces of Talon to move into the area in full force to eliminate all other's that stand in our way.
You can find them to the East at the Secret Chavez Headquarters. Prove your worthiness to be called a Talon!
I suggest you leave here now, you have proven you don't belong!

stages.description: Destroy five 10th Circle Chavez Commanders
Return to Jar Vlodim

nodes.text: You have returned, have you fulfilled your calling to become a Talon?

branches.text: I have returned, they have been destroyed.
I could not bring myself to kill the Chavez.

nodes.text: You have done good, young Talon. We can now being to move our forces in, and begin our takeover.
You will never amount to what it takes to be a Talon!

missions.name: Chavez Insider
missions.summary: Clearing the area for the Chavez takeover. Pivitor Michael Trussel.

nodes.text: Welcome space traveler! You seem to be out of place here, so far away from any form of decent civilization.

branches.text: I'm here exploring the universe, and was surprised to find this place.
Your not decent either are you? I'm out!

nodes.text: Well, you should be surprised you have lived this long. This is one of the roughest places out there.

branches.text: I can handle this place easy!

nodes.text: Ahh, so the questions begin. I am Pivitor Michael Trussel, at your service. I'm here undercover for the Chavez Headquarters.

branches.text: I thought I smelled something funny.

nodes.text: You heard me right! We have been working to establish this area for quite some time. It has turned out to be more difficult than first thought.

branches.text: Why would you want to be here? There are much nicer places.
With your skills I can see why. I'm out of here!

nodes.text: Because this space has not been claimed by anyone. well other than the Pirates in the area. We can make this place ours, and use it to its benefits.

branches.text: Well, I'm here, anything I can do to help out?
You will never defeat the other Pirates. I'm out of here!

nodes.text: Well, I might be able to use you to help out a bit, and maybe afterwards I can give you some insight to where the Chavez Headquarters are, sound like a plan?

branches.text: No thank you, I'm not getting involved.

nodes.text: Ok, well first you need to prove your strength, stamina and cunningness. There is a machine in the sector, the pirates first created it to assemble drones for their practice. It has sense been abandoned, or so I think, but anyways. It is still popping out drones, lets see if you can dispose of a few of them.

branches.text: I can dispose of as many as you want.
I've tangled with them before. No thanks to doing it again.

nodes.text: That's the spirit, you will be an honorary Chavez in no time. Now, head out there, find the Controller and destroy 5 of them ugly drones. Then come back here, and I will figure out if we can use you for anything else.
Have it your way, you looked like one of those pirate types anyway.

stages.description: Destroy five Drones from the Controller.
Return to Pivitor Michael Trussel.

nodes.text: I see you have done well with the drones. And low and behold while you were gone the perfect opportunity for you came up.

branches.text: I think I've done enough already.

nodes.text: That's what I said, don't wear it out! Ok. So lets get down to the nitty gritty. It seems there are some Wandering Pirates out at some of the Nav's in the sector. Our guys our out there trying to excavate the area and are being attacked by them.  We need them stopped by any means.

branches.text: Ahh. more killing. I think I can handle that.
I think thats a bit much for me to be doing.

nodes.text: These pirates have proven to be pretty tough, so be careful. At last count there were 4 of them out there. Try to find something out about them, this way we can use it to rid the area of them if they come back.

branches.text: Tough or not, I'm not doing it.

nodes.text: Make sure you come back when you're done; I think this task will have a pretty reward attached to it if it's done cleanly.
Have it your way, you were so close to being in the door with the Chavez. So long, you wont have this chance again.

stages.description: Destroy four Wandering Pirates.
Return to Pivitor Michael Trussel.

nodes.text: You seem to amaze me every time you come back. and without even a scratch!

branches.text: Seems you gave those pirates too much credit.

nodes.text: And why would you say that?  They have wreaked havoc on us out there.

branches.text: They were a bit on the pansy side to me.
Because your too weak to take care of them yourself.

nodes.text: Wow. some times I have to wonder about you. one minute you sound so civilized then next. so much like a pirate. Well, as promised, I have been given permission to reward your work for us, and not to forget, if you feel like getting away you can visit the Chavez Headquarters over to the East of Paramis.
Seems to me that your not willing to help the Chavez cause. Come back when you can.

missions.name: Military Speed and Beyond
missions.summary: General Otto Hotenbaun-Bismark of a faction will help you with learning Afterburn for the Terran Scout.

nodes.text: Hello @name. You're just a cadet yet, but given time you'll find the need to know how to really burn those engines of yours.

branches.text: Burn them? Why would I want to burn them?

nodes.text: *takes on a slightly confused look* To go faster, of course! What'd you think I meant?

/rude Makes no mind anyway, I want you to visit India van Helkein-Naverre in Guiana Station to deliver this. If you perform well, I might consider teaching you some thrusting techniques that are incredibly advanced.

stages.description: Gen. Otto sent you to take this intel report to the Heiress van Helkein-Naverre. Deliver it with all due haste!

nodes.text: Hello @name, back here already huh? Get out there and get some exploration done. Hyperia must dominate InfinitiCorp in the markets. We're not going to do that without a new advantage over them.

branches.text: Gen. Hotenbaun-Bismarck sent me with this...

nodes.text: /happy1 Oh the general sent you, why didn't you say so?

Well, who's fault is that? Say something sooner and you might be able to avoid such unpleasantries. In any case, what do you have for me here? GETCo Security briefings huh? Let me upload them to my computer. I'll approve it and you can take it back to Otto for me.
No buts, the upload is done. Take this back, send my thanks to Otto, he's a good man. He's helped keep GetCo and Hyperia out of the hot water on more occasions than I can count.

stages.description: Return to Gen. Hotenbaun-Bismarck aboard Margesi station and deliver this security briefing back to him.

nodes.text: Hello again, @profession, who are you? Oh yes, the cadet I sent to take the Intel report to Ms. van Helkein-Naverre.
She sent it back!! What do you mean she sent it back?!

branches.text: Take a look, sir. *hand over report*

nodes.text: /take *glances darkly at the report for a moment, unlocks it, and blushes slightly*

Never you mind, cadet. Get out there and get your exploring done. You've dallied here quite long enough. As a reward, I'm uploading some changes to your ship's core CPU which will allow you to thrust your engines beyond their maximums.

missions.name: Nullifying the Environment
missions.summary: Frederick van Hoortendam aboard Adriel Mining Station is going to teach you how to get around environmental problems.. if you can cheer him up a little.

nodes.text: /sick Hi there, @race. I see you're here.. what could you possibly want? Is something else going to happen to me? This has been the worst day in the galaxy's history.
/not_sure Oh, it's hard to explain. I've just had a bad, bad day. Now, why are you here?

branches.text: I heard you can teach a trick or two, and I wanted to learn.

nodes.text: /panic Did you now? Well, I've kind of lost my confidence because of the way my day has been going. I doubt I could show you anything useful.

branches.text: Oh, buck up will you? This is pathetic.

nodes.text: /shock What? You try walkin' in my shoes. Maybe you'll understand after that. I doubt it though.

branches.text: I can take it on. Sheesh, you need to get over it.

nodes.text: Can ya now? I doubt that. Well in any case, go out to nav Proxima Approach 1 and destroy three Bot drifters. Then come back and we might talk.

stages.description: Frederick sent you out to destroy 3 Bot Drifters floating around Proxima Approach 1. Best to get goin', you won't be able to stand this guy's whining for too much longer.
Return to Frederick van Hoortendam aboard Adriel Mining Station to report the results.

nodes.text: /take Oh you're done, huh? Well that was nothin' the least of my worries. Now go out and get rid of some crazed miners. Though I'm gonna go ahead and warn you.. its dangerous.

/rude Well, you'll need to be able to protect yourself from the environment. So you'll need to learn to reconfigure the Sensor ring aboard your ship to project a powerful field of anti-energy. That is to say.. well..
I er.. /panic well you see, I'll need you to take care of a few claimjumpers to be found around the Gas Collection navs.

branches.text: So, you'll teach me how to do this?

nodes.text: Teach you? Oh heavens no, I doubt your fragile mind could handle something of this magnitude, but I will reprogram your ship CPU to allow you to engage a rudimentary form of this field to protect yourself.

stages.description: Head out to the Gas Collection Ring navs. They'll be closest to the star here. There are some crazed miners out there causing trouble. You must take care of them.
Return to Frederick to see if he has anything else that you need to do...

nodes.text: Hello again @name. You've brightened my day a bit. I don't have to do any other chores.. I mean you won't have to help me anymore. Thanks for the assistance! *starts crying uncontrollably*

branches.text: Why don't you get over it, already!

nodes.text: *sobbing quietly*
/crash Listen, I don't need you. Go away! This day can't get any worse.

missions.name: Manufacturing Sciences: Devices
missions.summary: Cassiopeia de Grey, wife of Loric, is going to teach you how to manufacture devices. If you can pay attention long enough.

nodes.text: /wave Oh, Hello there, @profession. I assume you're here to learn. Is that correct?

branches.text: Are you kidding me? Get outta here!

nodes.text: /clap That's for me to know, and you to learn. Obviously, now.. let's see, what can you do for me in payment?
/not_sure Okay, as you say then, do come back if you change your mind.
Credits? Oh how mundane. I was hoping you had more interest in science than that. Ah well, I s'pose that's the kind of thing to expect out of any @race @profession.

branches.text: Not I... you've got the wrong Terran.

nodes.text: Good, with that in mind. I need you to take this package to Frederick van Hoortendam aboard Adriel Mining Station.

stages.description: Ms. de Grey wanted you to take this package over to Frederick van Hoortendam aboard Adriel Mining Station (Adriel, Proxima Centauri)

nodes.text: /shrug Hello there, @profession. What do you need? I'll bet it's something terrible. It always is. *sob*

branches.text: No, no it's not bad.... I think.

nodes.text: You think?! *sobs uncontrollably*

branches.text: You know what? Just forget it. Ms. de Grey sent this to you.

nodes.text: /take Cassie? What've you sent me? /happy1

branches.text: It's a box. I don't know what's inside, just don't cry anymore.

nodes.text: *examines the contents of the box*
Aha, this brightens my day just a little. Thank you kindly.
/not_sure That's not really your business, but I s'pose it can't hurt too much. It's a rare spore. We studied some like these when we went to the Academy together.

stages.description: Return to Cassiopeia de Grey with the news.

nodes.text: Ah, hello again, @name. Good to see you're back. What did Freddie tell you?

branches.text: Waitaminute... that's both of you now with pet names for each other.. Is this something Loric knows about?

nodes.text: Er, no, and I'd prefer he didn't. Loric can be a little jealous and nothing's happening. Freddie's just a very good friend of mine from when we were younger.

branches.text: Ok then... you win this time. But if I find out something...

nodes.text: Well if that's the way you feel, I'm going to be needing you to do something else for me. Go out to Shipyard Beltway 6 here in Margesi and get rid of 4 Luminous Manes. They've causing us some shipping troubles and need to be out of the way.

stages.description: "Cassie" sent you out to kill four Luminous Manes that are to be found near nav Shipyard Beltway 6. Once you're done you should probably return.
Return to Cassiopeia de Grey aboard Margesi Station to report success.

nodes.text: You're back again, and successful in your task. Well, I guess I'll reward you. But you're going to keep your mouth shut, or I'll find ways to hurt you that you can't imagine.

Heh, you say that now. /crash but soon, you'll be thinking just that. Anyway, back to business, I need you to learn how to make a Chemical Inhibitor and provide one to me. With that in mind, I'll teach you how to build devices.

branches.text: That sounds good, what do I need to do?

nodes.text: Go get a Chemical Inhibitor from the bazaar, get it analyzed and build me one. Then bring it back.

stages.description: Analyze a Chemical Inhibitor. You should be able to buy samples here at Margesi.
Return to Cassiopeia de Grey aboard Margesi Station with a completed Chemical Inhibitor.

nodes.text: You've done it, you've learned all I can teach you for the moment. You might try me sometime later for something new.
Well, in any case. I'll reward you, this'll be useful for a task I need done.

missions.name: Manufacturing Sciences: Engines
missions.summary: Gwen Deraques aboard Margesi Station is teaching you about how to build Engines.

nodes.text: Hello there, @profession. What's your name?

branches.text: My name.. why do you want my name?

nodes.text: /rude Because, I like to know WHO I'm talking to, before I say too much.
/wave Well, hello @name. Nice to meet you. I'm Gwen Deracques. I'm going to teach you about Engines. But you've got to do a little something for me.

branches.text: What is it with everyone wanting things done?

nodes.text: I don't know, but I s'pose you could say favors make the galaxy go round.

branches.text: Fine, what do you want me to do?

nodes.text: Go out and destroy 5 Lambent Manes. You can find them between Shipyard Beltway 10 and 11 about halfway. They're harassing the area.

stages.description: Go out halfway between Shipyard 10 and Shipyard 11 to find and destroy 5 Lambent Manes.
Return to Gwen aboard Margesi Station.

nodes.text: /agree Well, you did what I needed, so now I'll teach you how to build Engines, but, I won't provide your parts, you'll have to buy those on your own.
/happy2 You need to get an engine, dismantle it piece by piece, and figure out how it works. Then you just put a new one together from base components. It's pretty easy, overall.
Oh relax. Just go get an engine and break it down. You can grab a Gliding Harrier from the bazaar and learn how to build it. Then make one for me.

branches.text: Why would I make one for you?

nodes.text: /rude Why else would I teach you?

stages.description: Analyze and build a Gliding Harrier engine.
Bring the Gliding Harrier you built back to Gwen for inspection.

nodes.text: /point Good job, yeah, you'll be a natural at this. However, that's all I've got to teach you for now. You might try another time to learn something else.

missions.name: Hardware Invasion
missions.summary: Gwen Deracques is going to teach you how to hack systems.

nodes.text: Hello there @name, I have something for you to test. If you're interested in it. The reward will be worthwhile.

branches.text: Oh? What do you want me to do?

nodes.text: /happy2 Well, I've invented a new Hacking Decryptor routine. I'll install it on your ship if you'll take it out and test it on a Belter. You can find some sufficient ones About two to three klicks west of Shipyard Beltway 1.
/rude Well, get goin' already!

stages.description: Gwen has sent you to test the new Hacking Decryptor routine she uploaded to your ship's computer.
Return to Gwen to report how the experimental Hacking Decryptor routine worked.

nodes.text: Welcome back, @name. How was the test?

branches.text: It worked! I can't believe it.

nodes.text: /disagree1 Doubt my abilities do you? Well, you shouldn't do that. It could come back to bite you later.

missions.name: Exploring: The Hardier, the better!
missions.summary: Claude van Gogh is going to teach you the fine art of patching your hull. It can be extremely useful.

nodes.text: Hi there, @profession. What's your name?
Well @name, I could use your help. You want to help?
/rude Well, since you have to ask, I want you to go visit India van Helkein-Naverre and tell her the following code words: "Pan-pan"

stages.description: Go see India van Helkein-Naverre and give her the code words given to you by Claude van Gogh.

nodes.text: Hello again @name. You're here again, shouldn't you be making advancements for Hyperia and GETCo.

branches.text: Claude van Gogh sent me, to give you some code words.

nodes.text: Eh? Well, what are they then? /happy3
Interesting, go to Administrator Luzzini here in the Lounge and tell him "Sitrep" for me.
Good.

stages.description: Go to Administrator Luzzini and provide the code words given by Ms. Helkein-Naverre.

nodes.text: Hello there @name, welcome back to Guiana. How can I help you today?

branches.text: India sent me to give you some code words?

nodes.text: She did, did she? What's she tellin' you to tell me?

branches.text: She told me to tell you "Sitrep". Does that make sense?

nodes.text: /agree Yes, yes. Of course it does. Go tell her "a-ok"

stages.description: Return to India van Helkein-Naverre with the new code words.

nodes.text: Hello again @name, what did Administrator Luzzini say?

branches.text: He told me to tell you "a-ok".

nodes.text: Did he? That's good. Return to Claude and tell him "The barn owl is flying."

stages.description: Return to Claude van Gogh and see if anything else needs to be done.

nodes.text: Welcome back, what do you have for me, @name?

branches.text: India told me to give you the phrase "The barn owl is flying."

nodes.text: Good, that's just what I wanted to hear. Thank you for your services. Anyway, I've installed some nanobots on your ship that you can activate to repair your hull as necessary. Thanks again.

missions.name: The Legend of the Phoenix
missions.summary: Cassiopeia de Grey is going to teach you how to bring another player's ship back online after incapacitation.

nodes.text: Hello again, @name. Have you ever heard the Legend of the Phoenix?

Well.. you see. The Phoenix is a bird that was once believed to rise from its own ashes, just prior to its death, it would build a nest, preferably in a fire or a very warm place. If you complete my task, I will tell you more.
/rude Sure you have. Well come back later, if you think you want to learn something useful.

stages.description: Casseopeia de Grey asked you to get her some Pet Food. The station's denizens need it for their pets. Pick up 10 units from Earth and bring them back.

nodes.text: Hello there @name, welcome back to Margesi. Oh, did you manage to find me the required Pet Food? I needed 10 units.
Oh thank you so much, so did you want to hear more about the Legend of the Phoenix?

branches.text: No thanks... it's a boring story.

nodes.text: Well, the phoenix was mentioned in many major religions, though there were some differences in each. This is important, usually the truth lies where all arguments intersect.

branches.text: So, why is the bird so important?

nodes.text: Well, fine then, come back if you change your mind. /rude
/happy1 Well, it seems to be reborn because of the way its lifecycle occurs. After death, it is reborn from the fiery ashes of its parent.

branches.text: That seems pretty cool, but what does this have to do with me?

nodes.text: /laugh1 Well, you see, rebirth can be important, but even more importantly it has things to teach you. For example, what do you do if one of your friends is incapacitated?

branches.text: Wait for them to receive a tow and return to our battlefield?

nodes.text: And THAT is where you fail to see my point, instead of just waiting, you can learn to resuscitate their ship's reactor so that they can come back online. If careful, you can use this to keep all of your friends in the fight.
Now that I've explained why this important, I need you to complete another task for me.

/rude Well @name, if you complete this successfully, we can talk about actually teaching you to do this for your friends. Besides, all I need you to do is go back to Earth and fetch me some Romance Novels. Margesi can get a little lonely. Loric isn't always here nor can I leave my duties to go visit regularly. Bring me 10 units of Romance Novels.

stages.description: Go fetch 10 units of Romance Novels from Earth Station and return to Margesi to give them to Casseopeia de Grey.

nodes.text: Oh hello again @name, welcome back once again to Margesi. Were you able to find me those Romance Novels?
/thumbs_up Thanks! You've made my day. So, now I will teach you how to make your friend's ships go again. You need to configure your reactor this way *shows you detailed schematics*

Once you've done this, you'll be able to target a friendly player or even self-target if you've got enough power in your reactor and jump start the power plant so they can recover. It's pretty simple. I've done the reconfiguration while you were staring dumbly at the diagram. All you need to do is activate it with a target.

branches.text: Sounds great, is there anything else I can do for you?

nodes.text: /give No, that's ok for now, come back and see me another time. I might have something for you.

missions.name: Navigation is Necessary
missions.summary: Raynard Duvet is going to teach you one of the most important things about exploration, expert navigation. You should pay attention to him.

nodes.text: Hello there, @profession. What is your name?

branches.text: Hi there Raynard, my name is @name.

nodes.text: Really? That's an.. interesting... name. Well, in any case, why might you be here?

branches.text: I received word that you might be able to teach me something useful.

nodes.text: /panic Did you now...? Well, I can think of a few things, but we hardly know each other. Why would I teach you anything?
/not_sure Don't you wish it was that easy? Well I'm afraid not. I'll need you to go out to Earth, pick up some Anti-Rads and bring them back to me. I'll need 10 units.

stages.description: Raynard Duvet told you to go get ten units of Anti-Rads from Earth Station and bring them back to him.

nodes.text: /wave Oh hi again, @name. I see you're back. Did you find the Anti-Rads that we needed?
Good, good. That's what I wanted to hear. Now, you've endeared yourself to me slightly, but what you've done so far is not enough to justify me teaching you the most important skill of any explorer.

branches.text: It's not? What do I need to do then?

nodes.text: I'm thinking I'll need you to head out and destroy some Bot Drifters, they should be around Proxima approach 1. You'll need at least 5 of them.

stages.description: Raynard sent you to destroy 5 Bot Drifters near nav Proxima Approach 1. Destroy them as soon as possible.
Return to Raynard Duvet, talk to him about that important skill he keeps hinting about.

nodes.text: Hello again, it seems you were successful. /thumbs_up I guess you're worthy of learning. I still am a bit unfavorable toward teaching you, but I have nothing else that needs doing for now. So welcome to the ranks of the Hyperian Explorers. Your navicomputer will be upgrade to allow you to gain extra speed and special warp capabilities for dealing with getting around the galaxy even faster than you usually would.
/rude Yes, yes, I know. That's why I was not really sure you deserved it, but you've proven yourself useful at least. Take this and go on. I might have some other work for you later.

missions.name: Cash for 'Roids
missions.summary: Raynard Duvet is going to teach you a vital Terran skill, Negotiation. Buy low and sell high, that's your most important goal!

nodes.text: /wave Oh hello again, @name. Welcome back. I want to teach you something else that you'll like to know. Unfortunately, I still don't have any work for you. So you'll have to learn this one by paying my fees.
Let's see, an introductory fee, reservation fee, materials fee, lab fee, and most importantly, an ignorance fee.

branches.text: An ignorance fee?! I'm not ignorant.

nodes.text: Oho, are you not? Then why are you here?
Then, ignorant you are. The fee stands.

branches.text: Well, I don't have a lot of money.

nodes.text: Heh, that's what every @race says. S'pose there might be something to ya after all. Frederick van Hoortendam owes me some money, why don't you go see him? He should be somewhere in this station.

stages.description: Negotiate the release of money owed to Raynard Duvet from Frederick van Hoortendam. This should be easy enough.

nodes.text: /panic Oh.. hi @name. What do you want?

branches.text: I'm just here to get money that you owe to Raynard.
Well, I need to talk to you about finances.

nodes.text: Oh no, no way. I don't owe him anything. I'm not paying!

branches.text: But you do though, he told me so.

nodes.text: /rude Raynard is a thief, he makes my life miserable. I'm not paying anything. So if that's what it's about, go away!
*sigh* My life is such a disaster, ever since I lost Cassie. I'm still not paying.

branches.text: You'll pay, or I'll have to do something about it.

nodes.text: Oho, that'lll do you no good. I mean honestly, what can you do to me that this universe hasn't already?
/panic Ok ok, fine. Here, take the credits. Just leave me be!

stages.description: Return the credits to Raynard Duvet.

nodes.text: Oh hi again @name. I see you successfully negotiated my credits from Fred, how'd you do that? He's impossible to get to pay on time.

branches.text: Hm, well, it's a bit of a trade secret.

nodes.text: *narrows his eyes at you* Really? I must know the answer if you want me to teach you.

branches.text: Well, once I got there. We entered into "Aggressive Negotiations"

nodes.text: /happy1 Aggressive Negotiations huh? Well, ok. I guess you've learned a little bit about how to negotiate. Now I need you to visit Gawain Modainas in our Bazaar, he also owes me money. If you can successfully get it outta him, we'll talk about you learning this skill.

stages.description: Go negotiate the release of credits from Gawain Modainas in the Bazaar.

nodes.text: Hello there @name, are you here to trade?

branches.text: No, I'm here to obtain money that you owe Raynard.

nodes.text: Oi! That guy again. I don't owe him anything, and I'm not paying.

branches.text: *narrow your eyes* Yes, you can, and you will.

nodes.text: I disagree, my friend. If you don't like it, well too bad for you.

branches.text: *pull out a hand blaster and stick it under his chin* Are you sure?

nodes.text: You make quite a tempting argument. Fine, fine, but never again, I swear it! Next time I'll be armed.
*narrows his eyes while transferring the credits to you* Now, it's complete. leave me be and don't let me ever see you working for that bum again.

stages.description: Return the credits to Raynard Duvet.

nodes.text: Welcome back, apprentice. It looks like you got my money from Gawain.

branches.text: I did, but it wasn't easy. He was very uncooperative.

nodes.text: Indeed, he usually is. Most people are. I like money though, so I have to get them to pay it one way or another. Besides, I have more for you...

branches.text: Oh no buddy, I'm done doing your dirty work. I want training!

nodes.text: /panic I uh.. well. It seems you know what I can teach you anyway, it's all just about negotiation!

branches.text: So you're telling me that you were going to teach me one of the most ingrained principles of Terran Society?

nodes.text: Yes.. quite so. Now that you've learned, off with you. I've got no more time.

branches.text: You're a real piece of work.

nodes.text: Heh, that's what they all say. *wink* Goodbye.

missions.name: Looking Ahead
missions.summary: Frederick van Hoortendam is going to teach you how to look ahead.

nodes.text: *sobbing uncontrollably* Oh hi @name. *sob* What do you need?

branches.text: I have it on a good authority that you can teach me how to better use my sensor ring.

nodes.text: *cry* Well, yes I could. But I'm in dire straights. /panic Whatever can I do?

I keep saving my money so I can move to Margesi, but that slag Raynard Duvet keeps taking my money, or sending others to do it for him. I'll never get off this tub unless I can get enough money to buy transport.
I know *begins to sob again*

branches.text: So... I say again, what's so important on Margesi?

nodes.text: *looks you straight in the eyes* True Love.

branches.text: Well sonny, True Love is the noblest cause in the world.

nodes.text: *brightens up* Can you help me? I would be forever indebted to you.

branches.text: Yes, I can take care of this in a heartbeat. But once I do, you'll teach me right?

nodes.text: If you can do that, I will do anything you want, so long as I can start saving for the move.

branches.text: You've got a deal then. I'll be back in a few minutes.

nodes.text: /happy2 Good luck!

stages.description: Go see (and threaten) Raynard Duvet into submission. Stop him from picking on poor Frederick van Hoortendam. This is for the noblest cause of all.

nodes.text: Oh, hello there. What do you want? As stationmaster, I have important things to be doin' you know.
Yes, important, and I don't have time for people like you.

branches.text: By important, you mean robbing innocent people of their money?

nodes.text: *narrows his eyes* I don't know what you mean?

branches.text: I have it on a good source that you've been alternatively visiting and sending "enforcers" for years.

nodes.text: And what if I have?

branches.text: Remember when you taught me to Negotiate?

nodes.text: Vaguely, but what of it?

branches.text: *stick the barrel of your sidearm under his chin* Well, its time to negotiate.

nodes.text: *narrows his eyes even further* And what are you terms?

branches.text: You leave everyone alone, or die now.

nodes.text: You realize I could have you clapped in irons for this.

branches.text: Not if I testify on your actions. You know they're against the Hyperian code.

nodes.text: Uh huh. I'm worried now. /rude Why don't you get out of my face? I've got to collect money to keep the station running. It's failing.

branches.text: Let's put it this way, Fred is now under my protection, if you bother him even once more. You're a dead man.

nodes.text: Fine, I will leave him be. Now get out of my face.

branches.text: *stop the recorder and play it back for him*

nodes.text: *eyes widen*

branches.text: I've got your testimonial here and your admissions, don't cross me or you'll end up in a bad place.

nodes.text: Fine, just go. I'll not bother him again.

stages.description: Return to Frederick and tell him the good news!

nodes.text: You did it? Really?! EXCELLENT!

branches.text: Yes, it's done. He'll never bother you again. If he does, let me know.

nodes.text: /wave Yes, as you wish. Now, what was it you wanted to know? Oh yes.. How to reconfigure the sensor ring so you could scan for greater distances. I've done that for you already. It's a simple algorithm change.

branches.text: Excellent, happy to hear it. Enjoy the true love, once you make it.

nodes.text: Thank you so much for your help, I am forever indebted to you! /thumbs_up

missions.name: Protecting your cargo
missions.summary: Mission to get the Psionic Shield Ability.

nodes.text: Hello there young @profession!  I am the overseer of this sector and control the cargo and shipments that come through, I also grant new skills to Jenquai Seekers.

branches.text: That's nice I don't have time for this.

nodes.text: Yes. I can grant you the ability of Psionic Shield.  This gives you a small amount of protection over your normal shields.   Jenquai's have learned this ancient skill long ago.  In case of pinch it gives you time to escape to protect that precious cargo of yours.

branches.text: That is wonderful, what must I do to earn such a skill?

nodes.text: Nothing really, you have earned it by advancing to the stage you are at now.  Let me give it to you and test it out.   I want you to go to Barn's Lookout nav and fight a Juuona Master. Even though we are mostly traders we need to be ready for combat at all times.

branches.text: Okay, I shall do just that.

nodes.text: Report back to me after you have tested it out, and I shall give you a substantial reward.  If you find the enemies too hard for you, take you time and complete the mission when you can, the ability is yours however.  May the way guide you @profession.
I see, you have a young tounge and young mind, come back to me when you want to learn.

stages.description: Head to Barn's Lookout
Use your shield ability to help you destroy a Juuona Master.

nodes.text: So did you kill the Muddled Belter Drudge and use your Psionic shield ability I have given you?

stages.description: Report back to Hou'jeu Byeon at the Sundari Weapons Factory nav.

nodes.text: So did you kill the Juuona Master and use your Psionic shield ability I have given you?

branches.text: Yes I did, it works nicely.

nodes.text: As it should, this ability will help you even further down the road when you are in tougher combat situations.  Use it well and it will protect you well.  I bid you adieu.  I hope every trade is profitable and every travel is short.  Please take some credits @profession, use them well.

missions.name: The Cake is not a Lie
missions.xml_name: The Cake is not a Lie
missions.summary: Speak to Emerald Lagasse CXIV who needs your help

nodes.text:
BAM, 
I need your help. I am missing all the ingredients in order to make the cake of the century. This cake was commissioned by the devs to to commemorate the date of September 22, 2004. As to remind that everyone when things are their darkest, a new sunrise is over the horizon.
The list of things I will need are not hard to get.
I need some milk from a cow. I hear there are some in Mars
I will also need eggs. I hear some birds in Mercury might have what I need.
No cake can be made without sugar. I hear that there are some white ball looking things that might have some. In ABG
Flour is a must. I hear you can get some off of fresh weeds that popped up around Earth.
Off you go then!
Thats a shame.

stages.description: Return to Emerald Lagasse CXIV (Net 7) with some Milk  (Mars), Eggs (Mercury), Sugar (Asteroid Belt Gamma) and Flour (Earth).

nodes.text: Thanks for the help, I will make you a perfect cake. And BAM!

missions.name: The Way of the Priest
missions.summary: Level 60 Mission for Jenquai Explorer

nodes.text: Hello humble @profession, I see you have gained much experience since your last travels.  You are becoming an experienced pilot as well as Explorer.  You are starting to learn our ways, and your Novice status is quickly diminishing, you are gaining in your ranks.  For that, I am proud to be your Councillor.

branches.text: Thank you, Ma'm.  That really means a lot to me.

nodes.text: Of course, all my trainess that come through this station hold a special place in my heart, and of course you are no exception.  I feel like I have grown with you, and for you.  However since you have gotten to this point I have something to test your skills as an explorer.

As an Explorer, prosecpecting and travel are the the most important things for us.  Combat comes last in line, I want to test your explorer skills and mine several things for me.  These are very important to our order, and will help you in the long run.  However this is not all I need you to do.

missions.name: Missile Weapon Techniques
missions.summary: Terran Enforcers need to visit First Sergeant Kagiso at Nav Luna Hub to learn about Missile Weapons.

nodes.text: *bzzt* Hello @name, I've been lookin' forward ta meetin ya'. *kzztssszzt* I've been hearin' your name just a bit, something about bein' reliable.

branches.text: Reliable? Someone's been lyin' to you.

nodes.text: *zzbzbzst* Reliable, eh? We'll we'll see soon enough, won't we? *bzzt* Why don't you go find yourself a Missile Launcher, and let's see if we can't teach you to use it? *kzzzz*

branches.text: That sounds good, what do I need?

nodes.text: *bzzzz* Well, that's just too bad, isn't it?
*bzzt* er.. well, go back to Luna station and see if you can find a Good ML Type X1
*kzz* Roger, see you shortly.

stages.description: First Sergeant Kagiso sent you to buy or build a Good ML Type X1, you might consider making sure you have a full set. You should probably get some ammunition for it too, there's sure to be some combat at hand.
Return to the First Sergant to let her inspect the missile launcher. Feeling nervous? Maybe you should try to learn it and build it. Or you can just provide this one, I doubt Kagiso will mind.

nodes.text: *kzz* Well, you follow directions at least. Good job on getting the right equipment for the job. Now, for the important part. I'll need you to go out around the Yeager Shipyards. They've got some Red Dragon drones that were being tested and were malfunctioning. You need to take care of 5 of them. *bzzz*

branches.text: Seems straightforward enough. I'll be back in a few.

nodes.text: Good, @name, see you then.

stages.description: Head out around the Yeager shipyards, and kill at least 5 of the Red Dragon drones that were in testing. They've malfunctioned and are harrassing shipyard business.
You've finished your task, head back to the first sergeant for more to do!

nodes.text: *kzz* Good job ensign, you might need some more ammo, I'm going to upload the schematic for building Rocket type X1 so you can keep that launcher you got firing for the good of EarthCorps.

branches.text: Ammo is always a useful addition.

nodes.text: *kzz* You have no idea how true that is. *zzt*

*skkst* Well, for now you need to go find yourself some more combat. I could suggest quite a few places, but you need to learn to observe the fields of battle for yourself, lest ye become an easy target. Out. *bzzztszts*

missions.name: Reconfiguration of Shields
missions.summary: Louden MacEwen is going to teach you something that will be useful in your career. You just have to get some things done for him...

nodes.text: Hallo thar, @name, I've got somethin' that may be o' use ter ya, later on. But I need some things done. First /point you need to go make me some credits...
Yes, what self-respecting Terran doesn't want credits? Credits make the universe go round.

branches.text: You're right of course, but why would I make you credits?

nodes.text: Because, you see, there's something more important in it for you, if you do.

branches.text: I'm not sure I believe you.

nodes.text: Yeah. Well, it be yer choice afterall, but wot I pla' ter teach yer, is some shield techniques that can make yer shield over-charge for a bit. Creatin' more max shield energy an' possibly some o'er benefi' fer yer ship.

branches.text: Impressive sales pitch. I'll give it a shot.

nodes.text: Bully, tha's wot I was hopin' fer
Your call. Come back later if you change your mind. /rude

stages.description: Louden wants you to make him 20,000 credits and bring it back to him.

nodes.text: Ah, you've got my credits. /take Thanks much. Now I need you to head out and get me an Orb Weaver ML-X4 from Earth Station. Bring it back to me when you're done.
No buts, get goin' @profession

stages.description: Now.. he wants some parts from Earth. Get him an "Orb Weaver" ML-X4. Then come back and visit. Maybe he'll deign you've made him enough credits to teach you.

nodes.text: An me Missile Launcher. Thanks. Yeh've done a good job. I've naught much else needs doin' for now. Now, yeh'll learn how to use Shield Charging, it increases shield capacity on yer ship an' provides some o'er nifty things.

missions.name: Trick or Treat [Halloween 2009]
missions.summary: Go "Trick or Treating" around the Galaxy.

nodes.text: I take it that you are here to celebrate halloween 2009?

Now that is the spirit. I the great Pumpkin shall give you this special "Trick or Treat" bag. Go forth and use this bag at Jove's Fury (Quj'da), Earth Station (Mackellan), and Arx Magister (Kerr) to "Trick or Treat."
Come back to me later if you change your mind.

stages.description: Visit Jove's Fury (Jupiter), Earth Station (Earth), and Arx Magister (Mars) for some "Trick or Treat" fun.
Visit Jove's Fury (Jupiter), Earth Station (Earth), and Arx Magister (Mars) for some "Trick or Treat" fun.
Visit Jove's Fury (Jupiter), Earth Station (Earth), and Arx Magister (Mars) for some "Trick or Treat" fun.
Return to the Great Pumpkin to recieve a "special" reward.

nodes.text: Did you recieve some good treats?
HA HA HA. Well it can not be all that. I have a "Special" surpirse for you.
This weapon I am giving you is specialy designed to shoot plasma coated Pumpkins at your enemies. Enjoy it as a treat for Halloween.
If you are interested, come back to me in five (5) minutes for a new mission. In the meantime, why don't you go take a break aboard Net-7.

missions.name: "Trick or Treak" with MacKellan [Halloween 2009]
missions.summary: "Trick or Treat" with MacKellan.

nodes.text: @name, cannat ye tell eim busy?

branches.text: Someone is not in the holiday spirit.

nodes.text: Fin'! Whaddya want?
If you wanna Treat, then yer gonna have ter pay me one thousand (1,000) credits.

branches.text: One thousand credits?!? Are you crazy?

nodes.text: Nothin' is free in this here Gal'xy, kid.
*Smile* Speak ter me again when yer hav' yer credits ready. I dun accep' check or money orders, jus straight credits.
Shoo. Shoo. Yer rainin' on me parade.

stages.description: Bring 1,000 credits to MacKellan.

nodes.text: I see yeh've broug' me payment.
Thankyer. Here be yer reward, a dab of Trade XP.
*smirk* Enjoy.

stages.description: Speak to MacKellan again, and voice your anger to her.

nodes.text: Canna yer see I'm busy?

branches.text: You Cheat! You lied to me.

nodes.text: No I didna. I told yer ya was goin' ter giv' yer a Trade XP. Thas is one (1) Trade XP point.
Oh, fine then! Here. Take this an leave me be.

missions.name: "Trick or Treat" with Kerr [Halloween 2009]
missions.summary: "Trick or Treat" with Kerr.

nodes.text: @name, What are you here for?
Ah, is Halloween already here? Well in the name of the Republic, I grant you a Treat!
Sure thing. Speak with me again in a minute. I need to find you a Treat!

stages.description: Speak with Kerr to see if your "Treat" is ready.

nodes.text: @name, are you ready to recieve your "Treat?"

missions.name: Pumpkin Pie, Anyone? [Halloween 2009]
missions.summary: Help the Great Pumpkin achieve his Halloween "Goal."

nodes.text: @name, since you have proven yourself as a fan of Halloween, I have a special assignment for you. I will not take "No" for an answer.

Your task is to "squash" four (4) Pumpkin Abomination. These Pumpkins refused to submit to my title as "Ruler" of this Galaxy! You can find them scattered accross the Galaxy. Remember that weapon I gave you?
You will find it entertaining, and useful for this task.

nodes.text: @name, I see you have returned. With your help, I am one step closer to my goal.

nodes.text: But of course.
A Special Device if you will complete my final task for you.

branches.text: Ok. When can I sign up for this mission?

nodes.text: Go relax onboard Net-7 for five (5) minutes, and then come back and speak with me.

missions.name: Destroy My Nemesis [Halloween 2009]
missions.summary: Proceed to Xipe Totec and Defeat my nemesis, Most Hallowed Gourd.

nodes.text:
@name, My final task for you this Halloween is to defeat my arch nemesis, Most Hallowed Gourd!

If you complete this mission, I will give you a "special" item to "launch" Pumpkins at your friends.

There can only be one "Ruler" of this Galaxy.  Most Hallowed Gourd is trying to "disrupt" my plans for Galactic Domanation!

He is currently in Xipe Totec, past the Intzalan Line, at Dragon's Watch Alpha. Go there and defeat him.

stages.description: Defeat the Most Hallowed Gourd at Dragon Watch Alpha, in Xipe Totec.
Return to The Great Pumpkin to boast about your victory.

nodes.text: Did you Smash the Most Hallowed Gourd?

As I stated before, I will give you the "Pumpkin Chunker." This Device is designed to fire a non-threatening pumpkin at a friendly player. So have fun with it, and stay out of trouble on this Halloween night.

-Happy Halloween 2009, from the EnB Development Team.

missions.name: Theodoric Cassel Station [Temporary]
missions.summary: Voice Conversation with Theodoric Cassel.

nodes.text: Hmm... Welcome to Tarsis. Don't tell anyone, but there are a lot of warriors here. Arx Tiberius is so inspiring. Isn't it? All these titles and uniforms. Decorum, yes. Thats the word. Thats what was lacking in Cygni, although we could have accomplished something there. If only we'd hung on! Oh what we lost, when we lost Cygni. My God, what a waste.
So are you here about the Sabine?

branches.text: Why would I be here about the Sabine?

nodes.text: Uninformed, eh? Well, it's possible you really don't know what it's all about. Some sort of childlike innocence, back in the nursery, about to switch on the magic lantern and hear the most wonderful fairy tale. It would have a certain charm if I didn't really need the proof, but I do! So I'll try this again.

Let me ask you something; and remember, ambition isn't always a sin. Loyalty is a virtue, that's true. But in ambition you can retain a certain size of spirit. You cannot be written out of society by an illegal treaty or by some untested ribonucleic meander. Do you see my meaning? Are you or are you not a Sabine supporter?
This difference.
Now get out of here while you still can.

stages.description: Speak with Theodoric Cassel, again.

nodes.text: Ah, had a chance to think things over?

branches.text: Have you been spreading lies about me?

nodes.text: Lies? I trashed your reputation with all the right people. I can fix it though.
That isn't quite what I mean.
Now I'm in a generous mood, and I'd like to forgive you your sins... but you'll have to prove yourself first.
I want you to see Laurel Provum on Endriago in Gallina, your to tell her you're looking for work... Got it?

branches.text: Are you sure this is on the up and up?

nodes.text: By the patience of the Ancient's, what do you want from me? A lot of ranting and recriminations, did I lose power over Cygni? Yes... did I show the pain... Never. I've kept my face in Gallina ever since that treaty, and I am magnificent at all times. I am more than magnificent. I am convincing, dispassionate, able and unbiased; every inch the Progen. I am this Galaxy's great actor, and now you have joined my little cast.
So go and do what I have told you to do. See Laurel Provum in Endriago and tell her you're looking for work. Now goodbye.

missions.name: Your Eyes Only
missions.summary: Get a hold of your very own Eyeball Popper!

nodes.text: What, not happy with what I already gave you? Want an Eyeball Popper too?
Fine, but you have to do something for me first.
I want you to get me five pieces of Crunchy Bits. I love Crunchy Bits.

branches.text: Okay, where can I find them?

nodes.text: How am I supposed to know? If I knew where they were, I wouldn't be asking you to get them for me. Now go!
And hurry back!
Then leave me alone. Oh, and if you already have five, go get at least one more. I want you to work for this!

stages.description: Go find five pieces of Crunchy Bits.
Talk to the Great Pumpkin (Saturn, Sol.)

nodes.text: Hello @name, got my candy?
Yes, here you go. Enjoy...

missions.name: Ammunition Resupply [Version 1.1.P]
missions.summary: Supply the Capital Contruction Ship around Arx Bursa with enough ammunition to withstand further Critter Swarm attacks.

nodes.text:
Hail @name.
That was a timely intervention of destroying those suicidal critters!  I was half wondering if I had to call in a favour to destroy them!

Ok, here's what we need:
5 Stacks of Rifle Ammunition (Plasma)
5 Stacks of Rifle Ammunition (Chemical)


Rifle ammuinition is the mainstay of the Progen Fleet.  More modern ammunition is out there, Mortars are in development and also the much sought after Archos.  However, once you reach the use of Rifles, you will be a serious contender out there.

branches.text: Can't you use Blowgun, Musket or Crossbow Ammunition?
I can't get you Rifle Ammunition.

nodes.text:
Level 2 ammunition doesn't fit my guns!

I know it is a bit much, you may have to return to me another time to get the required ammunition. I insist on the best, are you the one to supply it to me?

branches.text: I'm not advanced enough to do this.

nodes.text:
That's ok, your probably too unexperienced to deliver the goods.
Contact me again when you are ready to supply me with the ammunition!

That's the spirit.
I'll be waiting for the ammunition supply.  Who knows, if successful you may even get the contract to resupply the Fleet in 61 Cygni.

stages.description:
Obtain 5 stacks of Rifle Plasma Ammunition.  
[Doesn't Check for mor than 1 but you need the full amount to complete mission]
[Eventually this will be made by yourself only]

Obtain 5 stacks of Rifle Chemical Ammunition 
[Doesn't Check for mor than 1 but you need the full amount to complete mission]
[Eventually this will be made by yourself only]
Resupply the Capital Construction Ship around Arx Bursa with 5 stacks of Rifle Plasma Ammunition and 5 stacks of Rifle Chemical Ammunition.

nodes.text:
Well @name, that's what I like to see.
Rifle ammunition.

This will protect this station against the critter swarm.
Well done, @profession.

missions.name: Talk to Merjan Kathrada
missions.summary: Merjan Kathrada is the leader of the Sha'ha'dem Explorers. It would be wise to get to know her.

nodes.text: It's now time for you to meet your leader, the leader of all Sha'ha'dem, Merjan Kathrada. She comes off a bit strong, but she will be your new teacher. You can learn much from her.

branches.text: Ok, thank you for your teaching.
But I'm having tea with DeWinter this afternoon.. That won't do.
She doesn't deserve to be in my presense.

nodes.text: You are very welcome, @name. Proceed to Kailaasa, Capella and meet your new teacher.
Very well then. Finish your existing appointment and return to me. And tell her I said hello.

You disgrace me with your insults of our leader. Merjan is a great woman who has had a difficult life yet always seems to lead us to success. Treasure her knowledge, for she is one of our wisest and most experienced.

stages.description: Seek out the Sha'ha'dem leader, Merjan Kathrada at Paren Station in Kailaasa (Capella System).

nodes.text: Greetings Truth Seeker. I have expected you. Both Kalas Ben Joseph and Shin-Tzu Li look upon you favorably, which is a feat.
I am sure of it. Now you are here for many reasons. To learn about me, to learn about that strange object, and to serve the Sha'ha'dem.

I am Merjan Kathrada, leader, teacher and explorer of the Sha'ha'dem. I have led explorations into the most dangerous areas of uncharted space, and it is my goal to discover the secrets of the universe. There are many things we still do not know, and it is my goal to uncover as many of these secrets as I can.

It is nice to meet you, @name.

branches.text: So what should I do now?

nodes.text: So I heard you found what Shin-Tzu Li believes to be an ancient fragment. Ask him for that object back so you can bring it to Ayako Ravenlock, the Jenquai archaeologist who resides in this station. She is an expert with ancient technology who could hopefully unpuzzle this artifact.

branches.text: Ok. And you had a request?

nodes.text: It is up to you, Sha'ha'dem. If you would like to help the Jenquai, let me know. There would be a great deal in it for both of us.

missions.summary: Contact James Tucker in Nostrand Vor City about obtaining 15 units of Phosphates.  This mission is repeatable.

nodes.text:
Well 'ello yer young @proffession, wot canna I do fer yer t' day?

Der 10,000 credits woz to make sure yer don't run off, yer will get 'em back if yer do wot I say.  If not dem are fer me to use to pay others.

branches.text: I'm called @name and I understand you can get me some Phosphates

nodes.text:
Tzzzk, well @name, 

I'm 'oldin sum fer a gud friend, she's falln outta favour wid Vinda.  Trouble iz I don't know wen shes gonna turn up if yer gets my drift.  T' phosphates are gunna cost yer a bit of yer time.

branches.text: Thats ok, at least I don't have to wait for a Miner!

nodes.text:
Miners 're vital fer the economy, @name, my quarrel aint wid dem, but wiv Vinda on t' warpath over my friend, I canna take any chances at t' moment.

I need yer t' go to Friendship 7, collect six Exotic Dancers n' then wait fer my transmission t' tell yer where ey go.  Are yer interested in this mission?
That's the sipirit!

A pity, a real pity.
You've made yer own mind up n' I'll not be giving you a second chance.  Enjoy tryin' to find yer Phosphates on t' market channel.

branches.text: Wait, I've changed my mind, I will do your mission.
You can stuff yer mission, I'm not crossing Vinda!

nodes.text: Goodbye.
Well whattcha know,  @name.  'ere woz I thinking yer noggle woz wid der clouds.  Ok, get yer engines fired up and head off to Friendship 7!

stages.description: Obtain six Exotic Dancers from Friendship 7, and obtain further information from the seller there.

nodes.text:
You will take good care of the type III exotic dancers, won't you @name?
Don't worry, these have been vetted against any Terran Alliance influcences!

Yes,

It appears the Terran Alliance were using the earlier versions as means to assassinate Progen Combine troops to restrict supply to Moto in 61 Cygni.

James Tucker has specially ordered these Exotic Dancers, they have been modified.
Ask no questions.  One of his old comrades lost a mate in an earlier supply, and I believe this is revenge.

nodes.text:
Ha!
That'd worry 'em.  They'll be wantin' t' sweep the entire station fer security breaches.  Amazing whattya canna do wid harmless cargo!  Wastin' valuable time if yer know wotta I mean!

If you want more, contact Intuneric Vigoare but beware, Vinda's agents have just docked!

I feel this is going to be a long day!

Be careful with them.  No.  Don't have them in plain sight!

missions.summary:
You have been selected from many Sabine in order to train in the Call Forward Skill.
Warning:  The skill may not work!

nodes.text:
Attention:
You have been selected to take part in training to learn the unique skill 'Call Forward'.  Head over to Essence Research Laboratory on Arduinne Planet in order to start the mission.

branches.text: I cannot do it at this moment.

nodes.text: The scientist assigned to you is called Annia Severa.  She is expecting you now.

stages.description: Go and visit the Essence Research Laboratory (Arduinne Planet), in order to help us improve the Progen Gene.

nodes.text:
Well, if it isn't one of the brave progen genebank here to learn Call Forward!  
I'm a bit busy, quite a few @profession have been here.  Lets see.  I don't currently have any clean apparatus, but I can ask som Dog Soldiers to rummage around in our clinical waste to see if there is something suitable for you.
Well before we start remaping genenomes we nead a lab!!  Lets start by having you clean this Filthy Beaker the hounds have just found.  You will nead Chromium Ore and Sulphur to scour it clean.

My, you are a lippy one aren't you.
Goodbye.

stages.description: Clean the Filthy Beaker, using Sulphur and Chromium ore.
Return to Essence Research Laboratory (Arduinne Planet) with the Pristine Beaker.

nodes.text: Wow that's one clean beaker on to the next step

Next we will need a Radiated Petri Dish. so let get to it.. this should not be too to hard.  Take this dish to a terminal with the Sterilized Petri Dish and some Minosium.  This should provide you with what you need.

branches.text: I can't be asked to do this.

nodes.text: Off you go, hurry up before the beaker becomes dirty!
You are stating to get on my nerves.

stages.description: Prepare a Radiated Petri Dish.
Take the Radiated Petri Dish and show it to Annia Severa.

nodes.text: Ah thats the perfect glow needed to erradicate almost all known life.

There's one more thing needed to assist you in your project.  We need to create a nutrient broth.  Oh, all your equipment needs to be irradiated using Minosium, and this includes that pristine beaker.


Nutrient gel is created from Nitrogen and Grail Water.  
The best experiment to start on is to propagate vacuum stalks.  Come back to me when you have irradiated all your equipment, created the nutrient gel and produced a Vegetative Propagation Experiment.

branches.text: This is not for me, goodbye.

nodes.text: You are showing promise.
I think Ionnoa needs to look at your genemap before your next itteration.

stages.description: Create a Vegetative Propogation Experiment.
Show your Vegetative Propogation Experiment to Anna Severai

nodes.text:
Well @name.
That looks like a perfect Vegetative Propogation Experiment.  

Let's continue your training.

Next I want you to head over to  see an old collegue of mine called Caius Baro in the Valkyre Twins Sector.  You will be learning one of the core skills of a genetic scientist, how to create an enucleated egg that can take your chosen genetic experimental material.

stages.description: Visit Caius Baro in Valkyrie Twins to learn how to create a genetic receptical for your chosen genetic material.

nodes.text:
About time you got here, @name.
Accorfing to Annia you're quite the slacker.  I don't think she expects you to succeed.  


Anyway, let's get this done so you can rub your success in her face and I can get back to my work.  What exactly are you doing?

branches.text: I've created a Vegetation experiment and now want to learn more.

nodes.text:
Ah, you've come to the right person then!

I'll train you how to remove the nucelus from the cells of the receptical for your experiment.  We tend to use Ouraboros Worms eggs, you should require about 3 to make this work. 

By enucleating the cells, literally removing the nuclear material, we add the donor genetic material, which will then grow using the receptor enucleated cells.  What are you waiting for?  Bring me 3 Ouraboros Worm Eggs!
I'll be waiting.

stages.description: Obtain 3 Ouraboros Eggs and return to Caius Baro in the Valkyre Twins Sector.

nodes.text:
Right @name, now I want you to create a Storm Gull Cloning Kit, to show you understand the genetic engineering process.  You will need a Storm Gull Wing for the donor genetic material, and the following equipment:


First you need to irradiate this Steralised Reagent Bottle I am going to give to you.  Then you need to add the Gull Wing to some Dry Ice in the Irradiated Reagent Bottle to make the Storm Gull Specimin.  Finally, at a manufacturing terminal you need to build a Storm Gull Cloning Kit.

Did you understand what I said?

Take the Storm Gull Cloning Kit back to Annia Severa to demonstrate you know what to do.

branches.text: Sorry, can you recap what I have to do?

nodes.text: Off you go then.

stages.description: Show your Storm Gull Cloning Kit to Annia Severa on the Essence Research Laboratory (Arduinne Planet).

nodes.text:
Well @name, you have been busy.




Hmm..  This is quite a good effort.  I didn't think you had it in you.  I can now see that you are ready for the next stage.  Take these Mutated Biostructs to Drusus Bellator at the Mutation Viability Field Lab (Near Detention Centre Onorum in Asteroid Belt Gamma).
Just don't let those merius militia get their hands on them.

stages.description: Go to Drusus Bellator at the Mutation Viability Field Lab. (Near Detention Center Onorum, Asteroid Belt Gamma).

nodes.text:
Ok, @name, I want you to prove to me you can step up your research.
I will now instruct you in how to refine a Viable Mutation Strain A1

You will need to be able to obtain the following:
Refined Zoisium, Refined Minosium, Refined Bromide and Refined Potassium.
Juoona Brain and Scuttle Wing,

Can you obtain these?
Right, you will need to Irradiate a Steralized Graduated Cylander and a Steralized Test Tube.  You will need to refine Fluorine, Bromide and Potassium to make the Chem Stim.

branches.text: I have written this down so far.

nodes.text: Then simply refine the Juoona Brain, Scuttle Wing and Ziosium combined with the enzyme Chem Stim in the apparatus Radiated Test Tube and Radiated Graduated Cylinder.  This produces the Viable Mutation Strain 1A.

branches.text: Can you repeat what you said?

nodes.text: Return to me when you have obtained the Viable Mutation Strain A1

stages.description: Return the Viable Mutation strain 1A to Drusus Bellator.

nodes.text: Now thats what I call a viable strain, @name.

Now I want you to prove to Annia Severa that you can create an Interpolative Gene Remapping Apparatus.  I have uploaded the schematics into your build list.  If you give one to her she will award you the call forward skill.
Off you go, @profession.

stages.description: Take the Interpolative Gene Remapping Apparatus back to Annia Severa as proof of your skills in genetic research.

nodes.text: Well you have done well haven't you?

nodes.text:
Attention, @race.

Breaking News!  There is a WAR happening in 61 Cygni and both the Progen Combine and the Terran Alliance are seeking recruits.  As an impartial observer, Net 7 has been given some Draft Cards to give to prospective recruits.

branches.text: Quick, I don't need to know!

nodes.text:
Yes, @name.

The card I can give you will allow you to select one side to be on.  Remember, although you may speak to both sides, you may only select one.  From what I hear they have made this a 'local matter', with opposing factions.

The Terran Alliance and Progen Combine 

These are the two factions that directly oppose each other in this sector.  Any time you gain one you will loose double the other.  Make your choice wisely.

The representive for the Progen Combine can be found in the bar area of Arx Magister (Mars).  She has quite an impressive figure, but it seems no musical taste.  A problem when she is meant to sound the charge for battle!  Getting lots of recruits may mean she can return to the battlezone!

branches.text: Thats all I need to know!

nodes.text: The representive for the Terran Alliance can be found in the main lobby of Earth Station.  Javier Domingue wants to prove himself to the hierachy, and be a merchant force to be wary of.  Recruiting you means he will be able to climb the ranks.

branches.text: Thats all I need to know!

nodes.text: There is no Jenquai representive as they are not directly battling here, but this doesn't matter as some Progen have chosen the Terran Alliance side and some Terrans have chosen the Progen Combine side.

branches.text: That's all I need to know.

nodes.text: Speak to Esther McCabe in the main trade hall when you are ready to accept your use once only Draft Card ID.

branches.text: Ok, I am ready to be a raw recruit.
Can you repeat what is happening here?
I refuse to join this pointless war, may they both boil in the vacuum of space.

nodes.text: See you soon, @name.
Neither race has their time for you.  This mission has been removed from your log!

Are you sure?

If you select this option then you will NEVER be able to do missions in the warzone.  This is your final warning.

branches.text: I made a mistake, I will get the draft ID card.
I will not complain about missing this zone.

stages.description: Esther McCabe (Net7 Saturn) has a Draft Card ID! for you to present to either Signifier Tubicines on Arx Magister (Mars) or Javier Domingue on Earth Station (Earth).

nodes.text: Here is the Draft Card ID.
