missions.name: Cornering the Market
missions.summary: Ferry a shipment of gases to the refinery, and take the refined product back for export.

nodes.text: Tradesman, we need you for courier duty. High pay, high risk.

branches.text: I'd rather retire with all my body parts intact, sorry.

nodes.text: Alright, it's a straightforward courier mission. We'll be loading some unrefined gases from the planetary clouds onto your ship. You are to proceed to Spectre Processing Station, in low orbit around Chandilar Planet. Deliver the gases, wait for them to refine it all, then take the products back to me for export shipping.

The station is in the middle of a gravitic anomaly, imperative for efficient refining operations. Warp travel is difficult or impossible within 20K of that station, and we've had reports of piracy within the anomaly itself. I'd suggest bringing an escort along or travelling in numbers. You'll be paid appropriately upon completion of duties, but you'll also take on full liability for lost cargo.

branches.text: Alright, but I expect to be paid in full.

nodes.text: You will be.
Suit yourself. Come back if you reconsider.

stages.description: Take the unrefined gases to Spectre Refinery for processing.

nodes.text: Approaching ship, please state identity and purpose of visit.

branches.text: InfinitiCorp Tradesman, I have gases that need to be refined.

nodes.text: Okay, we'll transport them now. Please wait.
Processing.
Okay, here you go.

stages.description: Return safely to Dispatcher Sonus with the refined product.

nodes.text: The refined gases, good. Here's the agreed upon payment. Come back if you want more work.
Good, good.

missions.name: Economic Superiority
missions.summary: Transport unrefined gases to Spectre Refinery, wait for the refining process to complete, and take the results back to Zook Station for later shipping.

nodes.text: We have courier duties to fill. There's danger involved, you in?

branches.text: I'd rather not have to get called forward, if you know what I mean.

nodes.text: We'll be loading some unrefined gases into your cargo bay. Go to the Spectre Processing Station and deliver them for refining. Once the refining process is complete, return here with the cargo. Be careful, you need to pass through a gravity well and we've gotten confirmed reports of piracy there. You will be paid on route completion.
Make sure to get Centuriata escort if you don't think you can handle trouble yourself.
Pfft. Return to me when you grow a spine.

Processing.
Okay, here you go.

stages.description: Return safely to Varo with the refined product.

nodes.text: Good work. Here's your pay. return to me if you want to do another run.

nodes.text: Oh, hello. Are you free for courier duty? It might be dangerous.

branches.text: I don't feel I'm ready for such a mission yet.

nodes.text: We need some unrefined gases brought to the Spectre refinery. You'll have to travel through the gravitic anomaly, and there's pirates patrolling in there. Once you reach the refinery, have them process your cargo and return the finished product to me here.

branches.text: I'll see what I can do.

nodes.text: Have the Shinwa assign you escort if you're worried.
When you are, return here. Safe journey.

stages.description: Return safely to Kiana with the refined product.

nodes.text: I'm glad to see you made it back safely. Here's your reward for nice work done. do return to me for more courier work if you ever want it.
Great.

missions.name: Gatekeeper Memnon Station Loop
missions.summary: Voice conversation with Gatekeeper Memnon.

nodes.text: Welcome to Praetorium, at this time all Warriors are asked to be confident of their training.

branches.text: Why should the Warriors be confident in their training?

nodes.text: We must prepare for the inevitable.

Perhaps, but even on Praetorium we can't drown out the homeworlds. Every day of the week there are word-beams, letters. People want Kahn to apologise, or they demand to know what he expects to achieve by this lifestyle, small minded people who attack his views and ways of thinking.

The galaxy will soon reach the end of politics, I can't say i'm sorry. I don't think many people are dissapointed, thanks to politics we have borders and laws.... but we also have fantasies and illusions. If we had settled Cygni the right way, Kahn would never have been exiled. And we would never have the situation we have now, but we'll see soon enough.

branches.text: Khan deserves exile, or so my superiors have claimed.

nodes.text: Interesting.

branches.text: You do not believe our superiors?

nodes.text: They are not madmen, yet they call for wars extinction. And even doubt the validity of hand to hand combat, can you imagine in this day and age. But that's a debate that must keep.

branches.text: So... Can you give me a mission to do?

nodes.text: See your class leader for a mission, I don't give missions here.

nodes.text: Hey stranger, we don't get many ships here or we didn't used anyway.

missions.name: Reactor Optimization for the Seeker [OFF]
missions.summary: Learn Reactor Optimization.

nodes.text: Are you interested in learning how to Optimizae your Reactor output?
Speak with me again.  I need to call for your ship to recieve this "upgrade."
Suit yourself.

stages.description: Talk to Omaka again.

nodes.text: I am ready to equip your ship with this skill.
Take care young one.

missions.name: Some Funeral
missions.summary: Omaka needs you to scan the wreckages of his deceased students for information. A good opportunity to test your reactor optimization skill in the perils of space.

nodes.text:
So you have learned how to fight, barely, but if you chose the path of the Sharim to fight, you may want to reconsider. 

Seekers lack the discipline and firepower of the Shinwa Defenders, but they have advantages to make up for that fact. I'm sure somebody on the station has already preached to you about the Seeker's money making prowess, but they probably didn't tell you all the uses of having a Seeker in one's group.

branches.text: Oh? Well I guess shield recharge helps.
I think I'll stick to fighting alone.

nodes.text: It does. As you will see, shield recharge can be vital in groups.
Suit yourself... But that's a foolish mistake.

Don't you DARE tell me to get on with it! The fact that I'm teaching you at all should mean you bowing at my feet.

Now then, another helpful aspect of the Seeker is the ability to optimize your own reactor and the reactors of others. Through optimization you can increase reactor capacity and recharge rate. Unfortunately all reactors are set to reset themselves after a certain amount of time to prevent any long term damaging effects, so the effect is temporary.

Optimization is extremely useful for surviving situations where your reactor is draining too fast to meet demands. As you will soon find out.

Yes that's right. I need you to do another task for me. For some reason a few of my younger students decided to travel to the Kor Kor Asteroid Belt, a small yet dangerous field inhabited by aggressive Manes. Since you have been one of my more promising students I ask that you travel to the site of their hulks and scan them to see if there are any items of value that would be worth sending in a recovery patrol for.
I'll provide you the ability to optimize your reactor, and hopefully it will keep you from joining my earlier students..
Some cowards never learn...

stages.description: Head to Kor Kor Asteroid Belt and scan the Wreckage of Nan'Jeu Gopal. If you encounter Manes, use shield recharge and reactor optimization to keep yourself alive.
Scan the Wreckage of Nan'Jeu Ranjit and prepare to warp back to the Azmundi Maru.
Return to Azmundi Maru and talk to Omaka Kasinagi.

nodes.text: Now let's see what they had on them...

branches.text: This whole situation seems pretty crude.

nodes.text: Listen, I don't want to risk the lives of anyone if I don't have to. Except maybe your life, but that was for the sake of training.

branches.text: You're the most caring guy I know.

nodes.text: Sarcasm is a cowards weapon. But I am done with you for now. Achieve level 10 and talk to Kayen Silva to learn your last portion of training, cloaking. I would thank you for your efforts, but I am the teacher and think it would be more fitting if you were to thank me.
I hope that the next time I teach you, you will do better...
/smash Such impudence I did not even expect from the likes of you. Now GO!

Goto Path of Fire 7 and find Aragoth Probe 1

missions.name: A Present for You All
missions.summary: Ho Ho Ho. Merry X-mas! Help Old Nick gather 5 presents from his elves and he might give you a present in return.

nodes.text: Ho Ho Ho! @name would you like a present?

branches.text: Of course I would like a present!
I do not take presents from strange men.

nodes.text: I need your help picking up 5 presents from several elves in various stations.

branches.text: At second thought, this is probably going to be a wild goose chase.

nodes.text: The first elf will be at Net-7. After getting the present, you will be told where the second elf is. Listen carefully and hurry, @name! I have an agenda to keep and this task must be completed to help bring presents to all the little nice girls and boys throughout the universe.
Then you will get nothing this year. Enjoy your time on the naughty list!

stages.description: Get the first present from Askasleikir.

nodes.text: Hello @name what can I do for you?

branches.text: I was sent here to get a present for Old Nick.

nodes.text: Errmm let me check... Oh wait...  Yes I got it! Here is the present.

branches.text: Thank you. Do you know where to get the second present?

nodes.text: Yes, it should be in Orsini Mining Platform, talk to my friend Bjugnakraekir.
No problem, but hurry up. Old Nick has an agenda he has to keep!
Then leave me alone, I am busy.

stages.description: Get the second present from Bjugnakraekir

nodes.text: Ho Ho Ho! @name, I been hearing you're here for the present to pick up for Old Nick.
Here you go, one present for Nick. Thanks for your help!

branches.text: Thank you. Do you know where I have to go to next?

nodes.text: Yes @name, you have to go to Fenris Prime Observatory. There you will find Faldafeykir who should have the next present for you.

stages.description: Talk to Faldafeykir to receive the third present.

nodes.text: Welcome @name. How can I help you?

branches.text: I am here to pick up a present for Old Nick.

nodes.text: Hmmm I have not had word that someone was going to be here to pick up a present for him. Are you sure you're in the right place?
Hold on... Let me contact him.
Well seems I did not get the message, but you're right. Old Nick has sent you so here is the present.

branches.text: Thank you, and might I ask you a question?

nodes.text: Sure @name. What is it you want to know?

branches.text: Where can I pick up the next present?

nodes.text: You can pick it up from Earth station from Gattathefur.
Now off you go!

stages.description: Talk to Gattathefur to get the fourth present.

nodes.text: Hi there @name. How are you?

branches.text: I am fine, thank you. How about yourself?

nodes.text: I am fine too, thank you for asking. What can I do for you?

branches.text: I am here to pick up a present for Old Nick.

nodes.text: Ah yes, I was waiting for you. Here you go. Good luck!
The final present can be received from Giljagaur at ECS Dauntless.

stages.description: Get the final present from Giljagaur then return to Old Nick in Saturn.

nodes.text: Hiya @name.
You are here for a reason?

branches.text: Yes. I am here to get the final present for Old Nick.

nodes.text: Ah yes, the final present... here you go. Now return to Old Nick in Saturn! Better hurry and catch him before he takes off!

stages.description: Give Old Nick the five presents you gathered and receive your reward.

nodes.text: Ho Ho Ho @name. You got all my presents?

branches.text: Yes Old Nick. I got them, all five.

nodes.text: Wonderful, any problems on the way?

branches.text: Not really, but an elf did not receive your message that I was coming.

nodes.text: Yes I heard, he contacted me... wonder why he did not get the message.
Thank you @name. Here is something for your troubles, Ho Ho Ho! Merry Christmas!

missions.name: Radiation Testing
missions.summary: Sai'li Raushna is concerned with the radiation levels in Xipe Totec. Help her test the radiation as you wander to the other side of the Intzalan Line.

nodes.text: Hello. I'm sure you have heard of the perils of this sector by now. The main problem I believe is the oni, which I have studied greatly. If you would like to know more about them we can discuss them later. Unfortunately the oni also bring many problems with them. You may not have discovered yet, but on the other side of that giant energy net is a dangerous field of radiation.

branches.text: I'm definitely not going over there.

nodes.text: Well most ships are usually able to manage the shallow depths of the outer edge. If you're looking to explore, the only thing that would be affected is your shields. Though if you're really unlucky, you might run into equipment failure and hull deterioration. Hopefully this will not be the case.

As I mentioned before I am interested in tracking the progress of the oni. Since they are too dangerous to study we have to use other methods of tracking them. The safest method is to study the radiation at certain depths of the area, a study in which I am looking for volunteers.
Did I say it was safe? I said radiation gathering was the safest method of study. That doesn't mean you won't come across hardship, such as engine failure in the middle of field of manes.

Excellent! Finally, a taker. For some reason, nobody really wants to travel to the other side of the Intzalan Line. Proceed to test the radiation at Dragon's Watch Alpha. I want to see if the radiation has progressed or not. And please don't die...
Fine, sheesh.. Though please come back, I'll probably still be looking for a volunteer.
Yes, I thought adventurers were supposed to be, well, adventurous.
Well that's a positive spirit, but I'm afraid you won't fit in around here. The good spirited ones are the dead ones. But I suppose you can prove me wrong. Would you like to volunteer?
Well when you're not busy, I'm always looking for volunteers, that is, until one actually signs up. I mean... you're missing out on a golden opportunity.

stages.description: Find Dragon's Watch Alpha in Xipe Totec, Sirius System.
You have collected a radiation sample. Return it to Sai'li Raushna in Prasad Station.

nodes.text: You... return!
My face is simply radiated over this sample. Ahaha, you've done well.

branches.text: It wasn't as dangerous as you made it sound.

nodes.text: Very well, so you got lucky, but your luck will eventually run out. Heed this warning. As indicated by the radiation, the great oni's power is increasing. Stay away from the depths of the radiation field and you will escape this sector with your hide.
I'm sorry, but if it makes you feel any better, the radiation has increased over the course of the past two years. The great oni's power is growing.

branches.text: How is that supposed to make me feel better?

nodes.text: It makes my life more interesting, and I'm sure there will be more opportunities to volunteer in the future. Thanks for your help and enjoy your reward.

missions.name: The Rescue
missions.summary: A Shinwa has requested emergency assistance after wandering past the Intalzan Line. Find and rescue the ship.

nodes.text: Just in time! @name, I urgently require you as a volunteer.

A Shinwa wandered out beyond the Intzalan Line and has since sent out an S.O.S. I don't know what has happened to him or why he has wandered out there, but I do know that he needs rescue. Please hurry.
/point The Shinwa are in need and you must help. When you are called, do not avoid it!

stages.description: S.O.S. was submitted from Dragon's Watch Alpha.
Target was heading for Dragon's Watch Beta.
New S.O.S. received. Coordinates: -8.60, 19.05, 0.
Return to Sai'li Raushna on Prasad Station.

nodes.text: @name, why did you not bring back the missing Shinwa? Were you unable to find him?

The oni take yet another life. For years I found the oni fascinating creatures, but since you volunteered last, they have only grown in power. The Shinwa pilot had been patrolling the Intalzan line and was most likely lured into madness by the great oni, a terrible and painful fate I am sure it was.

I really don't know @name, but I have remorsefully put you in a terrible situation. I didn't tell you when I signed you up, but the Shinwa you were sent to rescue was the nephew of our great leader, Du'Shao Silva. I'm sure Silva will be crippled by the news as he had a close relationship with his nephew. Since you were the one who witnessed his demise, please relay what happened to Silva. It may be difficult for him to hear, but it is necessary.

stages.description: Tell Du'Shao Silva of his nephew's plight. Silva resides at Yasuragi on Planet Swooping Eagle.

nodes.text: Welcome. I am Silva and this is Yasuragi. What are you here for? You look to me nervous.

branches.text: I bring bad news. Your nephew has fallen.

nodes.text: /no My nephew? I had hoped this day would never come. I always knew Xipe Totec was a dangerous place for any Shinwa, but we must do our duty. He was leading by example. Even I looked up to him in courage. Tell me, what led him to his end?
What outrage is this? For what reason did you silence my nephew?

branches.text: He was driven mad by the oni. I was only defending myself.

nodes.text:
...Unforgiving is fate at times. To fall to one's friends is not the warrior's way, but I understand my nephew had little choice.

...I will be grateful for you for your services one day, but not today. It is a somber day for me.

stages.description: Return to Sai'li Raushna.

nodes.text: Thank you for volunteering for this.. difficult job.

branches.text: When duty calls, it calls all Jenquai.

nodes.text:
Thank you for answering the call and I hope I can call upon you in the future yet again.

I reward you for your efforts, but do not forget about this place. To preserve our place in this sector, our bastion against the oni must not fall.

missions.name: How Repulsive!! [Version 1.0.S]
missions.summary: After completing Prospect II, speak to Fet Rastain to learn another skill.

nodes.text: I tell you @name, that was some mighty looking fine copper you supplied me.

branches.text: Great, is there anything I can do for you?

nodes.text:
Actually, @profession, there's something I can do for you!

We've developed a skill called Repulsor Field that is very useful to Sentinels, once activated on yourself or others, the Repulsor Field can divert incoming fire back to enemies.

Do you want to learn it?

The thing is, your ship is not correctly designed to handle the Repulsor Field's effects.  We need you to go and mine some Magnetite Ore so we can modify your ship to handle the energies.



As we speak, the Shipyard in Primus is backdated with many vessels being 'modified'.

Return to me with an amount of magnetite you have prospected to match your hull strength.  Don't you know it?  Next time you are in space, hover your mouse over the red bar.  That is your hull.  If its not 13 then someone has made a mistake...


.. or something has started to eat you!

Don't forget, @race.
13 units of magnetite ore that you have prospected.

stages.description: Prospect enough magnetite ore to cover your hull.
Return to [Fet Rastian] to allow the magnetite cover to be applied to your hull.

nodes.text:
Quick, bring the magnetite ore here!

Let me see it.

RECLAIMER!!!
Come here.

Where is he?  Ah there you are.
Take this ore and use your plasma forge apply it to the hull coating.
It shoudn't be that long, but we need the covering to initialise in battle before it can be used.  You don't want a leaky hull do you!

branches.text: Not without means of patching the hull, I don't!

nodes.text:
Go to Debris Area Beta and engage in combat with a [Swarming Mane CL1].  This should fix your hull up nicely as your shield attempts to counter the mane's attacks.  



I'll then send you the code to unlock the Repulsor Field skill.  While you are there you may as well apply it to yourself and slay another [Swarming Mane CL1].  Hopefully you will notice some difference.

Return to me when you are done.

branches.text: Kill then apply skill then kill and return.  OK.

nodes.text: Happy hunting!

stages.description: Go and kill a Swarming Mane in Debris Area Beta [CL 1]
After putting points into Repulsor Field and activating it on yourself, see the difference by killing another Swarming Mane [CL 1]
Return to Fet Rastian.

nodes.text: Well, @name how was that!

I know.
And at higher skill levels you can apply it to others.  Don't worry about having to supply more magnetite ore, we've developed a Progen Hull Alloy which contains the magnetite and will be used in all future hull upgrades.

What are you waiting for?
Go and find something to do or someone who wants you to do something!

nodes.text: Hello @name.

branches.text: Can you teach me fold space?

nodes.text: Fold space is a skill designed to teleport yourself, friends, and enemies. By teleporting you gain a tactical advantage over enemies.
You now know fold space. Use it well.

missions.name: Where is my Reactor Skill?
missions.summary: A temporary mission till the other one is fixed.

nodes.text: Hey there partner.  Could I ask ye a big favor?
Well this fancy smancy lady-gal with blonde hair left me some work orders to fix this here terminal up, real good if you know what I mean.

branches.text: This is not another boring "please get me blah" now is it?

nodes.text: No sir'e do.  See, I need to special order tool from Infinit-tity Corp.  But being a blue collered worker these days, it is hard to make enough credits to afford the tools I need.  This tool costs Thirty-Five Thousand credits.  Out of my price range, if you get what i mean.

branches.text: If I help you, what is in it for me?

nodes.text: Well, see that Blonde Lady-gal left this here book on the counter of the bar.  I'll give it to you as payment.  *shows a textbook titled "How to Build Reactors, for Dummies"*

branches.text: Forget it, I am not interested.
Sure thing pops.  Be back in a jippy.

nodes.text: Well then, see you around the station.
When you bring me those credits, I'll gladly hand this book over to you.  Of course, the longer you delay, the longer this job is going to take me.

stages.description: Bring 35,000 credits back to the Getco Mechanic.

nodes.text: Thank yer for the credits.  This should let me buy the parts I need to fix her up real good. *wink*
